description.zh: 大小写变形叠加双写。判据：绕过大小写敏感剥离。
description.en: Case variance on top of double writing. Success: survives case-sensitive stripping.

description.zh: 带版本号后缀双写。判据：剥离后仍解析为 php。
description.en: Version-suffixed duplication. Success: still parsed as PHP after stripping.

description.zh: 提交含敏感片段的文件名，观察服务端字符串替换清洗的行为细节。命中判据：确认存在单次替换式清洗逻辑，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit names with sensitive fragments to observe replace-based sanitizing. Success: a single-pass replace is confirmed.

description.zh: 以 ttxtxt 类双重写入变体上传，让清洗后重新拼出受保护扩展名。命中判据：落盘文件扩展复原成功。
description.en: Upload ttxtxt-style double-written names so sanitizing reassembles the extension. Success: the stored name recovers it.

attackChain.payload:
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt"
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.tTxTxt"
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.txttxtt"
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.aasasa"
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.jjsjs"
filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.txttxttxt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 --head "http://127.0.0.1:8080/uploads/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

description.zh: 回读原文件名确认最终存储形态与扩展名归属。命中判据：存储名中包含目标脚本扩展且可被访问，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Read back under the original name to confirm the stored form. Success: the name carries the target extension.

title.zh: 触发脚本解析建立控制

description.zh: 访问落盘文件触发服务器脚本解析执行，建立命令控制通道。命中判据：返回代码执行的输出结果，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Request the stored file to trigger script parsing. Success: execution output is returned.

overview.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名针对过滤器通过重复字符串替换删除扩展片段的场景：单次清洗后受保护后缀会重新拼合。验证 ttxtxt、tTxTxt 等变体在清洗与落盘两个阶段的差异。
overview.en: Upload double-write extensions target filters that delete extension fragments via repeated string replacement, letting protected suffixes reassemble after a single cleaning pass. It contrasts the cleaning and storage phases across ttxtxt, tTxTxt, and related variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器以单次字符串替换删除黑名单扩展片段，重复构造的文件名在单次清洗后重新拼出受保护后缀；只有当重组后的扩展名越过处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a filter deleting extension fragments through repeated string replacement, reassembling the protected suffix after a single cleaning pass; risk holds only when the reassembled extension crosses a handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块以 PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt、tTxTxt、txttxtt、aasasa 等双重写入变体逐条上传，每条上传后按原文件名 HEAD 回读；命中判据为清洗后的存储名重新拼出受保护扩展名（如 .txt 或 .php），记录清洗输入、清洗输出与落盘名三者对照作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the double-write variants PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt, tTxTxt, txttxtt, and aasasa one by one, HEAD-reading back under the original filename after each; a hit is the cleaned storage name reassembling the protected extension (e.g., .txt or .php)—record the cleaning input, cleaned output, and stored name as three-way contrast evidence.

mitigation.zh: 停止使用字符串替换清洗，改为对最终规范化名称执行允许列表校验并生成服务端对象名；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部双重写入变体，确认存储名不再拼出受保护后缀且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Stop string-replacement cleaning; validate the final normalized name against an allowlist and generate server-side object names; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 double-write variants and confirm stored names no longer reassemble protected suffixes while normal uploads work.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异

description.zh: 下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the download parameter is interpreted inconsistently across URL decoding, separator folding, and root confinement. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

title.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异验证块 1
title.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential Validation Block 1

execution.command:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/download?file="
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}....//outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%2e%2e/outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%252e%252e%252foutside%252fPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}..%5coutside%5cPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../documents/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

description.zh: 对 download 参数依次施加 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠七种变体，验证一次解码、二次解码与分隔符折叠的不一致。
description.en: Applies seven variants (../, ....//, single- and double-encoded, backslash) to the download parameter, exposing inconsistencies between single decoding, double decoding, and separator folding.

title.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异验证块 2
title.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential Validation Block 2

description.zh: 以纯查询串形式重放双重编码与反斜杠变体，对照 curl 场景验证不同入口的解码顺序差异。
description.en: Replays double-encoded and backslash variants as raw query strings, contrasting with the curl cases to show decoding-order differences across entry points.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 双重解码后还原 ../。判据：返回 passwd 内容。
description.en: Double decoding restores ../. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: 过滤剥离一次 ../ 后仍余遍历。判据：读出目标文件。
description.en: Stripping one pass still leaves traversal. Success: file read.

description.zh: 代理剥离分号段后端仍遍历。判据：200 且含 root 行。
description.en: Proxy strips ;params, backend traverses. Success: 200 with root line.

description.zh: 编码反斜杠绕过仅匹配 / 的规则。判据：内容返回。
description.en: Encoded backslashes dodge slash-only rules. Success: content returned.

title.zh: 定位下载参数与正常文件

description.zh: 请求正常文件下载记录响应形态与参数名，摸清入口行为与限制。命中判据：正常文件可以稳定重复下载，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Download a normal file to capture response shape and parameter names. Success: normal downloads work reliably.

description.zh: 对下载参数施加 ../、....//、单双编码与反斜杠五类遍历变体，观察解码差异。命中判据：某变体返回根外文件内容。
description.en: Apply ../, ....//, single/double encodings and backslash variants. Success: one variant returns outside files.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/download?file="
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}....//outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%2e%2e/outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%252e%252e%252foutside%252fPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}..%5coutside%5cPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../documents/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

description.zh: 以纯查询串形式投递编码变体，测试不同入口对解码顺序的处理差异。命中判据：发现可利用的解码不一致点，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Re-submit encoded variants as raw query strings to compare decoding order. Success: an exploitable mismatch appears.

description.zh: 用命中的变体构造路径，读取服务器配置、凭据与源码文件并外带。命中判据：敏感内容成功返回响应，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Use the winning variant to pull configs, credentials and sources. Success: sensitive content returns.

overview.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异针对下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间不一致的场景。验证 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠五类遍历变体加两个对照路径的解码与最终路径差异，以 marker 回读为准。
overview.en: The file-download path normalization differential targets download parameters inconsistent across URL decoding, separator folding, and root constraints. It contrasts decoding and final-path behavior across seven variants—../, ....//, double encoding, and backslashes—judged by marker read-back.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致；只有当差异使最终路径越过预期目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is download parameters inconsistent across URL decoding, separator folding, and root constraints; risk holds only when the difference pushes the final path past an expected directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 download 参数依次施加 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠五类遍历变体并记录每次响应；命中判据为某一变体返回根目录外 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt 的内容。再用第 2 步以纯查询串形式重放双重编码与反斜杠变体，对照 curl 场景验证不同入口的解码顺序差异；两条路径的命中都应记录最终解析路径作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, apply the seven variants—../, ....//, single and double encoding, backslashes—to the download parameter and record each response; a hit is any variant returning the out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt content. Then replay the double-encoding and backslash variants as pure query strings per step 2, contrasting decoding-order differences between entry points; record the final resolved path for every hit as evidence.

mitigation.zh: 使用服务端对象标识，统一解码和规范化，并在打开文件前强制执行根目录与 scheme 允许列表。修复后同时重放第 1、2 步异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法下载保持可用。
mitigation.en: Use server-side object identifiers, unify decoding and normalization, and enforce root-directory and scheme allowlists before opening files. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 anomalous samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate downloads keep working.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 上传文件名解析差异

description.zh: 入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界的解释不同。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Filename Parser Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: ingress, storage, and static serving layers interpret multiple extensions and filename boundaries differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

title.zh: 上传文件名解析差异验证块 1
title.en: Upload Filename Parser Differential Validation Block 1

description.zh: 这些请求变体复用受控上传夹具中的 BASE 与 MARKER 变量。命中判据：不同 filename 变体产生不同的存储名与判定结果。
description.en: These request variants reuse BASE and MARKER from the controlled upload fixture. Success check: different filename variants produce different stored names and verdicts.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: filename* 优先于 filename 造成解析差异。判据：落盘为 shell.php。
description.en: filename* wins over filename in some parsers. Success: saved as shell.php.

wafBypass.command:
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.jpg"
Content-Disposition: form-data; filename="b.php"

description.zh: 两个 Content-Disposition 各取所需。判据：以 php 落盘。
description.en: Two headers parsed differently. Success: stored as PHP.

description.zh: 重复 filename 参数取值差异。判据：php 后缀生效。
description.en: Repeated parameter picks differ. Success: .php suffix wins.

description.zh: 无引号形态绕过带引号匹配。判据：上传成功。
description.en: Unquoted form. Success: upload accepted.

description.zh: 以不同的 filename 变体多次上传同一文件内容并回读。命中判据：变体之间产生了不同的存储文件名。
description.en: Upload the same body under different filename variants. Success: variants yield different stored names.

title.zh: 比对存储名找解析差异
title.en: Diff stored names for parser gaps

description.zh: 比对各层对文件名的解释结果，定位口径不一致的组件位置。命中判据：找到可以被利用的分歧层，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Compare how each layer interprets the names to find disagreeing components. Success: a divergent layer is found.

title.zh: 借差异落盘可执行文件
title.en: Land an executable via the gap

description.zh: 利用解释分歧让脚本扩展只被其中一层看到，绕过检查。命中判据：脚本文件成功存储且可访问，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Use the divergence so only one layer sees the script extension. Success: the script file is stored.

overview.zh: 上传文件名解析差异针对入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界解释不同的场景：同一文件名在不同层产生不同结论。验证多个 filename 变体的存储名与判定结果对照。
overview.en: The upload filename-parser differential targets entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently—the same name yields different conclusions per layer. It contrasts stored names and verdicts across filename variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界的解释不同；只有当差异使最终文件跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently; risk holds only when the difference pushes the final file past a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步复用受控夹具中的 BASE 与 MARKER 变量，以 txt.jpg、jpg.txt、txt.bin 三种文件名变体逐一上传同一内容；命中判据为不同 filename 变体产生不同的存储名与判定结果，说明至少两层对边界解释不一致。每条上传后 HEAD 回读记录存储名、Content-Type 与处理器路由，形成解析差异矩阵。
exploitation.en: Reusing the fixture's BASE and MARKER variables as in step 1, upload the same content under txt.jpg, double-extension, case, and semicolon filename variants; a hit is different filename variants producing different stored names and verdicts, showing at least two layers disagree on the boundary. After each upload, HEAD-read back and record stored name, Content-Type, and handler routing to form a parsing-difference matrix.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，让入口与存储消费同一规范化结果；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，确认存储名与判定一致且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and have entry and storage consume the same normalized result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm stored names and verdicts agree while normal uploads work.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: XSLT document() 文件读取边界

description.zh: 使用完整的五行 XSLT 1.0 样式表，验证服务端转换器是否允许 document() 解析外部文件资源。
description.en: Preserves the complete five-line XSLT 1.0 stylesheet to test whether a server-side transformer permits document() to resolve an external file resource.

prerequisites.zh: 用户可控完整样式表进入已识别的 XSLT 处理器，处理器版本、base URI、document() 和 URIResolver 策略已冻结。
prerequisites.en: A user-controlled complete stylesheet reaches an identified XSLT processor, with processor version, base URI, document(), and URIResolver policy frozen.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 在运行前改为只含随机 XML marker 的沙箱文件，转换进程无其他宿主文件和网络权限。
prerequisites.en: Before execution, replace /etc/passwd with a sandbox XML marker containing only a random value and give the transformer no other host-file or network permission.

description.zh: 按来源保留完整结构；实际测试只把 document() 参数改为沙箱 marker.xml，不访问系统文件。
description.en: The complete source structure is preserved; during testing change only the document() argument to sandbox marker.xml and do not access a system file.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须同时有目标转换进程读取合法 marker.xml 和随机值进入输出。`select`、namespace URL、文件路径文本、解析成功或错误信息都是结构/诊断信号，不证明越界读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires both the target transformer reading valid marker.xml and its random value entering output. The select attribute, namespace URL, file-path text, parse success, or errors are structural or diagnostic signals and do not prove a boundary-crossing read.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用有效的小型 marker.xml，禁止系统文件、网络 URL、递归文档或大体积资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only a small valid marker.xml and prohibit system files, network URLs, recursive documents, or large resources.

opsecTips.zh: 一次性转换进程使用短超时和只读目录，完成后删除样式表、源 XML、marker、输出与 resolver 日志令牌。
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable transform process with a short timeout and read-only directory, then delete stylesheet, source XML, marker, output, and resolver-log tokens.

description.zh: 绝对路径读取绕过相对限制。判据：返回 passwd。
description.en: Absolute path read. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: file URI 跨平台读取。判据：返回 win.ini。
description.en: file URI cross-platform read. Success: win.ini returned.

description.zh: 以外部实体替代 document()。判据：实体内容回显。
description.en: External entity instead of document(). Success: entity content echoed.

description.zh: 记录实现、版本、base URI、安全开关和常量转换基线。
description.en: Record implementation, version, base URI, security switches, and constant-transform baseline.

description.zh: 只替换 document() 参数，在隔离转换任务中运行一次。
description.en: Replace only the document() argument and run once in an isolated transform job.

description.zh: 匹配 resolver、文件读取、任务 token 和转换结果中的随机值。
description.en: Match resolver, file read, job token, and random value in transform output.

title.zh: 拒绝外部 URI 并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通固定 XSLT 输出不变，marker 在打开前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation fixed ordinary XSLT output is unchanged and the marker is rejected before open.

overview.zh: XSLT document() 文件读取边界针对服务端转换器允许 document() 解析外部文件资源的场景：转换输出可能包含渲染主机文件。验证以完整 XSLT 1.0 样式表加载 marker.xml，确认 URI resolver 的访问范围。
overview.en: The XSLT document() file-read boundary targets server-side transformers allowing document() to resolve external file resources, where transform output may include renderer-host files. It loads marker.xml with a complete XSLT 1.0 stylesheet to confirm the URI resolver's access scope.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用执行不可信样式表且允许文件 URI 或相对路径越出资源根，转换输出可能包含渲染主机文件；路径出现在错误、函数被识别或 URI 打开失败均不等于内容读取。
vulnerability.en: If the application executes untrusted stylesheets and permits file URIs or relative paths beyond the resource root, transform output may include renderer-host files; paths appearing in errors, the function being recognized, or failed URI opens do not equal content reads.

exploitation.zh: 保留第 1 步的完整五行 XSLT 样式表结构，把 document() 参数改为沙箱内的 marker.xml 后提交到目标转换入口；命中判据为转换输出包含 marker.xml 的内容，证明处理器允许 document() 解析外部文件。记录转换器类型、base URI 与 resolver 行为；确认读取能力后按同一语法评估是否可越出资源根，切勿直接读取系统文件。
exploitation.en: Keep the complete five-line XSLT stylesheet structure from step 1, change the document() argument to an in-sandbox marker.xml, and submit to the target transform entry; a hit is transform output containing marker.xml content, proving the processor lets document() resolve external files. Record transformer type, base URI, and resolver behavior; once read capability is confirmed, evaluate escaping the resource root with the same syntax—never read system files directly.

mitigation.zh: 只允许签名或版本控制的固定样式表，启用安全处理并用拒绝外部 URI 的 resolver；转换进程使用最小只读资源根、无网络和低权限身份。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认 document() 外部引用被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Allow only signed or version-controlled fixed stylesheets, enable secure processing, and use a resolver that rejects external URIs; run transforms with a minimal read-only resource root, no network, and low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm external document() references are rejected while normal transforms work.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Puppeteer 本地 File URI 读取边界

description.zh: 以同步与异步 XMLHttpRequest 两类 file URI 载荷验证无头 Chromium 的页面来源与启动策略是否允许读取渲染主机文件；fetch 对 file: scheme 恒失败，仅可作阴性对照。
description.en: Verify whether headless Chromium page origin and launch policy allow reading host files via fetch and synchronous XMLHttpRequest file URIs.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 路径在执行前替换为渲染沙箱内只含随机标记的临时文件
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced before execution with a temporary marker-only file inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: Chromium 使用临时 Profile 和最小文件权限，文件审计可区分 URI 解析、打开与内容读取
prerequisites.en: Chromium uses a temporary profile and minimal file permissions, with file audit distinguishing URI parsing, open, and content read.

title.zh: File Fetch 与 XHR 变体

description.zh: 实际验证仅指向临时 marker 文件；保留原命令用于追溯，不读取系统账户文件。
description.en: During validation point only to the temporary marker file; the original command remains for provenance and the system account file is not read.

analysis.zh: 浏览器文件读取审计和返回通道中的同一标记共同构成阳性。file URI 出现在 DOM、控制台错误或请求对象中只证明输入被解析，不能证明宿主文件泄露。
analysis.en: Browser file-read audit plus the same marker in the return channel constitutes a positive. A file URI in the DOM, console error, or request object proves parsing only, not host-file disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 绝不指向系统文件、密钥或宿主挂载，只使用自动销毁的单行 marker 文件
opsecTips.en: Never target system files, keys, or host mounts; use only an automatically destroyed one-line marker file.

opsecTips.zh: 测试进程无管理员权限、无网络并设置文件读取配额，首次成功读取后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Run without administrator rights or networking, enforce a file-read quota, and stop after the first successful read.

description.zh: 查询串干扰 file:// 匹配。判据：标题显示 passwd 内容。
description.en: Query string alters the signature. Success: title shows passwd.

description.zh: 显式 localhost 等价读取。判据：内容回显。
description.en: Explicit localhost form. Success: content echoed.

description.zh: XHR 路径绕过 fetch 特征。判据：标题含内容。
description.en: XHR path avoids fetch signatures. Success: title contains content.

description.zh: 在临时挂载写入一次性随机值并开启浏览器进程文件审计。
description.en: Write a one-time random value in a temporary mount and enable file auditing for the browser process.

title.en: Rewrite the path and test the APIs

description.zh: 逐一运行同步与异步 XHR 变体，对每次渲染使用新 Profile。
description.en: Run fetch and XHR one at a time using a fresh profile for every render.

description.zh: 关联文件打开、读取字节和 title 标记，排除仅路径解析。
description.en: Correlate file open, bytes read, and title marker and exclude path parsing alone.

description.zh: 修复后确认 marker 在打开前被拒绝且普通内联页面仍可渲染。
description.en: After remediation confirm marker access is rejected before open while ordinary inline pages still render.

overview.zh: 验证同步与异步 XHR 两类 file URI 变体（fetch 对 file: scheme 恒失败，仅作对照），测试仅指向 marker 文件。
overview.en: The Puppeteer local file-URI read boundary targets whether headless Chromium rendering pages can read host files, depending on page origin, launch policy, and sandbox permissions. It validates fetch and synchronous-XHR file-URI variants, testing only against marker files.

vulnerability.zh: 若攻击者控制渲染页面脚本且浏览器可读取宿主文件，内容可能进入 title 或其他返回通道；错误中出现路径、请求被创建或文件存在性信号均不等于读取内容。
vulnerability.en: If an attacker controls rendered page scripts and the browser can read host files, content may leak into title or other return channels; paths appearing in errors, requests being created, or file-existence signals do not equal content reads.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留两条原始行作追溯，实际执行时把 URI 改为临时 marker.txt：先用同步 XMLHttpRequest 读取并把结果写入 document.title，再用异步 XHR（onload 回调）重复同一读取；命中判据为 title 或回传通道出现 marker 内容，证明 file URI 可被页面脚本读取。分别记录浏览器启动参数、页面来源与读取结果；读取失败要区分策略拦截与文件不存在。
exploitation.en: Keep the two original lines from step 1 for traceability but point the URI at a temp marker.txt when executing: first read via fetch and write the result into document.title, then repeat the same read with synchronous XMLHttpRequest; a hit is marker content in title or the return channel, proving page scripts can read file URIs. Record launch flags, page origin, and read results separately; distinguish policy blocks from missing files on failure.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问启动选项，把渲染器放入只含工作目录的只读沙箱，并在输入规范化后拒绝 file scheme；避免把任意页面输出直接返回。修复后重放第 1 步变体，确认 file URI 读取被拒绝且正常渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Disable local-file-access launch options, place the renderer in a read-only sandbox containing only the working directory, and reject the file scheme after input normalization; never return arbitrary page output directly. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm file-URI reads are rejected while normal rendering works.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 File 图片资源

description.zh: 验证静态 img 的 file URI 能否被 wkhtmltopdf 直接加载（无需脚本执行）。
description.en: Verify whether wkhtmltopdf directly loads file URIs from static img tags without script execution.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 替换为渲染沙箱内带可见随机标记的最小图片
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced with a minimal image carrying a visible random marker inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结本地文件访问开关和 base URL，文件审计覆盖 wkhtmltopdf 进程
prerequisites.en: Local-file access settings and base URL are frozen and file audit covers the wkhtmltopdf process.

description.zh: 实际渲染只指向临时 marker.png；原路径仅用于来源追踪，不读取系统文件。
description.en: During rendering point only to temporary marker.png; the original path is retained for provenance and no system file is read.

analysis.zh: 文件 read 和 PDF 中随机图像标记的组合证明静态本地资源可达。若只出现 URI、权限错误或破图占位，则没有文件内容泄露证据。
analysis.en: The combination of a file read and the random image marker in the PDF proves static local-resource reach. A URI, permission error, or broken-image placeholder alone is not evidence of file-content disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 只挂载 marker 图片目录，禁止系统路径、符号链接和宿主卷进入渲染容器
opsecTips.en: Mount only the marker-image directory and prohibit system paths, symlinks, and host volumes in the render container.

opsecTips.zh: 限制图片尺寸、解码内存和文件数，验证后删除图片、PDF 与工作目录
opsecTips.en: Limit image dimensions, decode memory, and file count, then delete the image, PDF, and working directory after validation.

description.zh: link 标签读取本地文件。判据：PDF 报错或内容包含文件。
description.en: link tag fetch. Success: error or content in PDF.

description.zh: CSS 背景触发读取。判据：资源加载日志。
description.en: CSS background fetch. Success: fetch logged.

description.zh: embed 标签引用。判据：渲染异常暴露内容。
description.en: embed tag reference. Success: render error leaks content.

description.zh: 寻找把用户内容渲染成PDF的功能，提交含标记的HTML确认输出包含标记，即锁定注入HTML的入口。
description.en: Find a feature rendering user content to PDF; a marker in HTML surviving into the output locks the injection entry.

title.en: Inject a file-scheme image to read files

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在 HTML 中放 img 标签指向沙箱 marker.png，生成的 PDF 出现该图片内容即确认本地读取；读取文本类文件需改用 iframe、link 样式表等变体，img 方式的命中判据只对图片成立。
description.en: Embed an img pointing at file:///etc/passwd per the execution payload; contents in the PDF text layer confirm local read.

description.zh: 把资源地址换成内网 URL 与云元数据地址，改用 iframe、link 等可承载文本响应的标签触发渲染（img 无法显示非图片响应），PDF 出现内网响应内容或稳定的渲染差异即完成内网探测推进。
description.en: Swap the resource for internal URLs and metadata endpoints, rendering as in step 2; internal content in the PDF advances inward.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 File 图片资源针对静态 img 的 file URI 能否由渲染器打开沙箱内本地图片的场景：无需 JavaScript 即可触发本地资源加载。验证 img 引用 marker.png 的渲染行为，与脚本化 iframe 分离。
overview.en: The wkhtmltopdf static file image resource targets whether static img file URIs open local images in the rendering sandbox: local resource loading triggers without JavaScript. It validates rendering of an img referencing marker.png, kept separate from the scripted iframe.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可指向渲染主机文件，格式可解析的内容可能进入 PDF；路径接受、open 尝试或破图图标不证明文件内容已经读出。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can point at renderer-host files, parseable content may enter the PDF; accepted paths, open attempts, or broken-image icons do not prove file content was read.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留原行作来源追踪，实际渲染只指向临时 marker.png 并提交到 HTML 转 PDF 入口；命中判据为 PDF 中出现 marker 图片内容，证明静态 img 的 file URI 触发了本地资源加载。记录 wkhtmltopdf 版本、本地访问开关与渲染身份权限；与脚本化 iframe 结果分开归档，静态资源不需要脚本执行前提，命中即可单独成立。
exploitation.en: Keep the step-1 original for source tracing, but render only against a temp marker.png and submit to the HTML-to-PDF entry; a hit is marker image content in the PDF, proving the static img file URI triggered local resource loading. Record the wkhtmltopdf version, local-access switch, and renderer-identity permissions; archive separately from the scripted iframe—static resources need no script-execution precondition, so a hit stands alone.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问或只允许规范化资源根；渲染容器仅挂载批准资产，并拒绝输入中的 file scheme 和路径逃逸。修复后重放第 1 步静态 img，确认 file URI 被拒绝且正常图片渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Disable local file access or allow only a normalized resource root; mount only approved assets in the rendering container and reject file schemes and path escapes in input. After the fix, replay the step-1 static img and confirm file URIs are rejected while normal image rendering works.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 路径遍历过滤与规范化差异
name.en: Path Traversal Filter and Normalization Differentials

description.zh: 使用点号变体与产品特定下载路由样例，验证边界过滤与后端文件路径规范化是否一致。
description.en: Uses dot variants, double encoding, and product-specific download routes to verify consistent path normalization between edge filters and backend file handlers.

prerequisites.zh: 目标路由接受文件名、模板名或资源路径
prerequisites.en: The target route accepts a filename, template name, or resource path.

prerequisites.zh: 测试环境提供位于允许目录外的无敏感标记文件
prerequisites.en: The test environment provides a nonsensitive marker file outside the allowed directory.

description.zh: 逐条按目标技术栈选择使用，并把敏感文件替换为隔离环境中的标记；产品特定 URL 不应无差别发送到其他框架。
description.en: Select samples according to the target stack and replace sensitive files with an isolated marker; do not spray product-specific URLs at unrelated frameworks.

analysis.zh: 每行必须结合对应产品与实际文件 API 解释。最强证据是规范化后的真实文件路径和标记读取，单纯 WAF 放行或响应长度变化不构成文件读取。
analysis.en: Interpret each line in the context of its product and file API. Canonical path and marker-file access are strong evidence; WAF acceptance or response-length change alone is not a file read.

opsecTips.zh: 先替换所有系统文件路径为测试标记，避免在验证过程中读取真实配置或账户数据。
opsecTips.en: Replace every system-file target with a test marker before validation to avoid reading real configuration or account data.

opsecTips.zh: 仅对已识别组件使用对应 URL，降低无关日志噪声与潜在服务压力。
opsecTips.en: Use product-specific URLs only against identified components to reduce irrelevant logs and service load.

title.zh: 边界与后端规范化复测

description.zh: 保留原集合中的重复测试集，用于修复后对 WAF 规范化与后端根目录校验分别做回归。
description.en: Preserves the duplicate original test set for separate post-fix regression of WAF normalization and backend root enforcement.

description.zh: 根据路由、版本和正常请求确认实际文件 API，避免向无关技术栈发送产品特定路径。
description.en: Use routes, versions, and normal requests to identify the actual file API and avoid sending product-specific paths to unrelated stacks.

title.zh: 提交匹配的规范化样例

description.zh: 把文件目标替换为隔离标记后逐条请求，记录原始值、边界解码值和后端规范路径。
description.en: Replace file targets with an isolated marker, request each sample, and record raw, edge-decoded, and backend-canonical paths.

description.zh: 通过标记内容或文件访问遥测证明最终打开路径越过允许根目录，并排除自定义 404。
description.en: Use marker content or file-access telemetry to prove the opened path escapes the allowed root and exclude custom 404 responses.

description.zh: 完成根目录校验与组件升级后重放合法文件和全部匹配样例，确认只有允许对象可访问。
description.en: After root enforcement and component updates, replay valid files and all matching samples to confirm only allowed objects remain accessible.

overview.zh: 路径遍历过滤与规范化差异针对边界过滤与后端文件路径规范化不一致的场景：产品特定下载路由各自存在解码差异。验证点号变体、双重编码与产品路由样例在边界与后端两层的结论。
overview.en: Path traversal filter and normalization differentials target boundary filtering disagreeing with backend file-path normalization: product-specific download routes each carry decoding gaps. It contrasts boundary versus backend conclusions across dot variants, double encoding, and product route samples.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是对原始字符串做黑名单过滤，却在后端进行额外 URL 解码、点段折叠、别名解析或平台路径转换；产品插件若把查询参数直接拼入文件 API，重复编码或非标准点号会在后续阶段恢复父目录跳转。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is blacklist filtering on raw strings while backends perform extra URL decoding, dot-segment folding, alias resolution, or platform path conversion; when product plugins splice query parameters into file APIs, repeated encodings or non-standard dots restore parent-directory jumps in later stages.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步按目标技术栈逐条选择样例使用（/tmui/... 的 F5 路由、.asp 的 IIS 变体、ithemes-sync-request 的 WordPress 参数等），并把敏感文件替换为隔离标记；命中判据为某一变体在边界放行且后端返回标记内容。产品特定 URL 不应无差别发送到其他框架；逐条记录边界解码值与后端最终路径的两层对照。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, select samples matching the target stack (the F5 /tmui/... route, the .asp IIS variant, the ithemes-sync-request WordPress parameter, etc.), replacing sensitive files with isolated markers; a hit is a variant passing the boundary while the backend returns marker content. Never send product-specific URLs indiscriminately to other frameworks; record the two-layer contrast of boundary-decoded values versus final backend paths per sample.

mitigation.zh: 把用户标识映射到服务端对象 ID，不接受任意路径；必须处理路径时，完成全部解码后解析规范绝对路径并验证其位于固定根目录，拒绝符号链接越界；同时升级存在已知问题的产品组件，WAF 规则仅作补充。修复后重放第 1 步全部样例。
mitigation.en: Map user identifiers to server-side object IDs and never accept arbitrary paths; when paths must be handled, resolve canonical absolute paths after completing all decoding, verify they sit in a fixed root, and forbid symlink escape; upgrade product components with known issues while treating WAF rules as supplemental. After the fix, replay all step-1 samples.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化差异

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：从大小写混淆、双写与注释混淆，到空字节截断与标签属性变形，再到事件处理器变体，并附 Data URI 与 SVG 动画绕过，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。
description.en: Covers filter normalization-differential bypasses for XSS: from case obfuscation, doubling, and comment confusion through null-byte truncation and tag-attribute mutations to event-handler variants, with Data URI and SVG animation bypasses, locating filter-rule gaps item by item.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 过滤与规范化差异 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Filtering and Canonicalization Differences are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 大小写混淆提交；仍执行即确认过滤对大小写不敏感。
description.en: Submit mixed-case payloads; execution confirms the filter is case-insensitive.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "ScRiPt" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 大小写混合的事件处理器
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "OnErRoR" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 双写提交；删除后拼回有效标签执行即确认关键字删除过滤可绕过。
description.en: Submit double-written payloads; reassembly after deletion into a working tag confirms keyword-deletion filtering is bypassable.

explanation.zh: 中间的script被删除后形成完整标签
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "scr<script>ipt" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 注释插入提交；仍执行即确认注释混淆可绕过检测。
description.en: Submit comment-obfuscated payloads; execution confirms comment obfuscation evades detection.

description.zh: 空字节截断提交；截断后标签重组执行即确认空字节处理差异可利用。
description.en: Submit null-byte truncation payloads; tag reassembly and execution after truncation confirms exploitable null-byte handling.

explanation.zh: 空字节，某些过滤器会在此截断
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "\\x00" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 以制表符/换行/空格变形事件属性提交；仍执行即确认空白字符处理差异可利用。
description.en: Submit event attributes deformed with tabs, newlines, and spaces; execution confirms exploitable whitespace handling.

execution.command:
<body onpageshow=alert(1)>
<input onfocus=alert(1) autofocus>
<marquee onstart=alert(1)>
<video><source onerror=alert(1)>
<details open ontoggle=alert(1)>

title.zh: 大小写混淆绕过黑名单

description.en: Mix case across tags and attributes; case-sensitive blacklists miss them while the case-insensitive HTML parser still executes.

description.zh: 过滤器只删除一遍关键字时提交双写形态载荷，删除内层后剩余字符恰好拼回完整标签名，载荷恢复执行能力继续利用。
description.en: Submit scrscriptipt-style double writes; after one deletion pass the leftovers reassemble the original tag name.

description.zh: 在脚本体与事件属性值内的 JS 代码中插入注释（如 alert/**/(1)）打断连续特征串，浏览器执行时忽略注释内容，语句恢复完整语义执行；标签属性之间插注释在现代浏览器不生效，不要作为主向量。
description.en: Interleave /**/ or fake comments between tokens; long signatures shatter while the parser ignores comments and restores semantics.

title.en: Cut matching short with null bytes

description.zh: 在关键字内部插入空字节，按字节串匹配的过滤器失效，解析器遇空字节截断，前缀恰好还原出可执行标签继续运行。
description.en: Insert null bytes inside keywords; byte-oriented matchers fail while parsers truncate at the null and still honor the tag.

title.zh: Data URI 变体加载执行

description.zh: 链接与 iframe 的 src 用 data URI 承载整页脚本，绕开对外部域名的限制，用户点击或页面内嵌时即加载执行代码。
description.en: Carry scripts in data:text/html URIs on a or iframe src, dodging external-domain restrictions and executing on click or embed.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：大小写混淆、关键字双写、注释混淆、空字节截断、标签属性空白变形与冷门事件处理器六类变体，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。适用于目标存在关键字黑名单或简单过滤器的场景。
overview.en: Covers normalization-differential bypasses of XSS filters across six variant families: case mixing, keyword double-writes, comment obfuscation, null-byte truncation, tag/attribute whitespace mutations, and uncommon event handlers, used to locate filter gaps item by item. Suitable when the target runs keyword blacklists or simple filters.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器按字面形态匹配关键字，未考虑大小写折叠、一次删除、注释分词、空字节与空白规范化等解析差异；黑名单漏掉的冷门事件处理器也保持可执行，规则缺口即注入通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is filters matching keywords by literal shape, ignoring parsing differentials such as case folding, single-pass deletion, comment tokenization, null bytes, and whitespace normalization; uncommon event handlers missing from the blacklist stay executable, and rule gaps become injection channels.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步大小写混淆提交，仍执行即确认过滤按大小写敏感的字面匹配（未做大小写折叠）；第 2 步双写关键字，删除后拼回有效标签执行即确认单次删除可绕过；第 3 步注释插入、第 4 步空字节截断、第 5 步制表/换行变形属性逐一验证；第 6 步用 onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle 等冷门事件确认黑名单覆盖不全。仍被拦截时改用 Data URI 或 SVG 动画绕过。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits case-mixed payloads — execution proves the filter is case-insensitive; step 2 double-writes keywords — execution after deletion reassembles a valid tag, proving single-pass deletion bypass; steps 3-5 verify comment insertion, null-byte truncation, and tab/newline attribute mutations one by one; step 6 uses uncommon handlers like onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle to prove incomplete blacklist coverage. If still blocked, switch to Data URI or SVG-animation bypasses.

mitigation.zh: 放弃关键字黑名单，改按输出上下文编码并用维护中的 sanitizer 白名单化，统一解码后再做检测；修复后重放全部六类变体应无可执行差异，并对新增事件属性保持白名单更新。
mitigation.en: Drop keyword blacklists in favor of context-appropriate output encoding and a maintained sanitizer allowlist, decoding uniformly before inspection; after the fix, replaying all six variant families must show no executable differentials, with allowlists kept current for new event attributes.

overview.zh: 覆盖跨上下文通用的 Polyglot XSS 载荷：经典全上下文、短格式、属性注入与 URL 参数形态四类，用于在未知输出上下文中一次投递、多点命中注入面。适用于快速确认输入位可达的解析上下文范围。
overview.en: Covers cross-context Polyglot XSS payloads in four forms: classic full-context, short format, attribute injection, and URL-parameter shape, delivering once to hit multiple injection surfaces in unknown output contexts. Suitable for quickly mapping which parsing contexts an input position can reach.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是同一输入位可能同时进入 HTML、属性、脚本与 URL 多种解析上下文，而过滤器只按单一上下文假设处理；Polyglot 载荷借助各上下文共享的语法形态在多处同时形成可执行结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a single input position potentially entering HTML, attribute, script, and URL parsing contexts simultaneously while filters assume a single context; Polyglot payloads leverage syntax shapes shared across contexts to form executable structures in several places at once.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交经典全上下文 Polyglot，任一上下文（HTML/属性/脚本/URL）触发执行即确认该输入位多上下文可达；第 2 步短版本验证闭合既有标签后的执行；第 3 步属性注入形态以悬停/聚焦/点击触发；第 4 步 URL 参数形态以导航或脚本执行确认。命中后按命中的具体上下文转到对应专项条目细化。WAF 变体区提供高级 Polyglot 形态。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits the classic full-context Polyglot; execution in any context (HTML/attribute/script/URL) confirms the input position reaches multiple contexts. Step 2 verifies the short form executing after closing the existing tag; step 3 triggers the attribute-injection form via hover/focus/click; step 4 confirms the URL-parameter form via navigation or script execution. After a hit, move to the dedicated entry for the specific context hit. The WAF section provides advanced Polyglot forms.

mitigation.en: Set HttpOnly on all session cookies together with Secure and SameSite, and fix XSS injection points in parallel (context encoding plus CSP); after the fix, replaying each channel script must produce no collector requests, and document.cookie must not contain session credentials.

name.zh: JavaScript 标识符混淆变体

description.zh: 使用 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接和 Function 构造等方式重建调用，验证只识别危险关键字的过滤策略是否可绕过。
description.en: Reconstructs calls through String.fromCharCode, concatenation, and Function construction to test filters that recognize only dangerous keywords.

prerequisites.zh: 目标防护主要依赖危险标识符黑名单，可控表达式在过滤后仍进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文或动态求值 sink。

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接或 Function 构造前后的源码值，marker 仅修改隔离页面中的固定布尔标志。
prerequisites.en: Source values before and after String.fromCharCode, string concatenation, or Function construction are recorded, and the marker only changes a fixed Boolean in the isolated page.

title.en: Validation step 1 for JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants

description.zh: 逐行以 fromCharCode、字符串拼接、括号索引、逗号求值、atob 等混淆构造执行；执行即确认词法混淆可绕过标识符检测，SVG 行外发 cookie 到 {ATTACKER_HOST} 作为外带验证。

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是混淆表达式通过目标过滤，运行时重建危险调用并执行 marker，且反混淆值、执行 sink 与来源能连续关联。 假阳性边界：过滤器未告警、字符串成功拼接、反混淆工具得到 alert 文本、CSP 阻断或表达式只作为数据显示均不是执行证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the obfuscated expression to pass the target filter, reconstruct the dangerous call at runtime, and execute the marker, continuously correlating deobfuscated value, execution sink, and source. False-positive boundary: No filter alert, successful string concatenation, an alert string produced by a deobfuscator, CSP blocking, or display as data is not execution evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 标识符混淆验证不得重建 cookie、storage、网络或系统 API；发现动态导入、外连、全局原型修改或循环执行时停止。
opsecTips.en: Identifier-obfuscation validation must not reconstruct cookie, storage, network, or system APIs; stop on dynamic imports, egress, global prototype changes, or execution loops.

opsecTips.zh: 删除混淆脚本和 marker 变量，恢复全局对象/原型，清理脚本缓存并重载页面后用普通 JavaScript 业务路径回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete obfuscated scripts and marker variables, restore global objects and prototypes, clear script caches, reload, and regress normal JavaScript business paths.

description.zh: 绕过字母级规则：base64 还原。判据：弹窗。

description.zh: 绕过 alert 整词匹配：拼接属性访问。判据：弹窗。

description.zh: 绕过引号形态检测：字符码构造方法名。判据：执行成功。

description.zh: 绕过字母级规则：字符码逐个构造。判据：执行成功。

description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the attacker already controls a JavaScript execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal tokens such as alert or eval instead of removing the code-injection sink, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“JavaScript 词法混淆”多层基线

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“JavaScript 标识符混淆变体”
title.en: Run a single-variable JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants check

description.zh: 在确认可执行的 sink 中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换字符编码、属性拼接和 Function 构造，定位是哪一种词法规则产生差异；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: in a confirmed executable sink, test a direct call first and then substitute character encoding, property concatenation, and Function construction one at a time to locate the differing rule; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.en: Retest the JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants remediation boundary

description.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。

overview.zh: 覆盖 JavaScript 词法混淆变体的验证：String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接、括号索引、逗号求值、atob 与 Function 构造在运行时重建调用。用于确认只识别危险关键字的过滤策略是否可绕过。
overview.en: Covers JavaScript lexical-obfuscation variants: String.fromCharCode, string concatenation, bracket indexing, comma evaluation, atob, and Function construction rebuilding calls at runtime. Used to test whether filters recognizing only dangerous keywords can be bypassed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入汇；运行时重建的函数名与参数绕过静态字符串规则。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the attacker already controlling a JavaScript execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal keywords like alert and eval without eliminating code-injection sinks; runtime-rebuilt function names and arguments bypass static string rules.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行以 fromCharCode、字符串拼接、括号索引、逗号求值、atob 等混淆构造执行；执行即确认词法混淆可绕过标识符检测，SVG 行向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 发送带唯一标记的带外请求作为验证。在确认可执行的汇中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换编码形态，定位产生差异的词法规则。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to execute via fromCharCode, string concatenation, bracket indexing, comma evaluation, atob, and similar obfuscation line by line; execution confirms lexical obfuscation bypasses identifier detection, with the SVG line exfiltrating cookies to {ATTACKER_HOST} as out-of-band proof. Inside a confirmed-executable sink, test direct calls first, then swap encodings one by one to locate which lexical rule makes the difference.

mitigation.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单。修复后混淆表达式的运行时值与调用目标应无法还原为有效执行。
mitigation.en: Remove user-controllable code contexts at the root, adopting fixed call maps and data serialization; neither server nor frontend should rely on dangerous-function-name blacklists. After the fix, obfuscated expressions must be unable to resolve into valid execution at runtime.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 polyglot 记录和 DOM fixture，清理模板/页面缓存，恢复原包裹结构并用合法 title/style/textarea 内容回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete polyglot records and DOM fixtures, clear template and page caches, restore original wrappers, and regress with valid title, style, and textarea content.

description.zh: 绕过多上下文结构过滤：注释闭合全部开放标签后触发。判据：至少一处上下文执行。
description.en: Closes all open tags via comment trick then fires. Success: executes in at least one context.

description.zh: 保留混淆核心的紧凑形态，绕过长度限制。判据：点击执行。
description.en: Compact form keeping the obfuscation core. Success: fires on click.

description.zh: 关键字符编码绕过明文规则。判据：解码后执行。
description.en: Key characters encoded. Success: executes after decoding.

description.zh: 混合引号括号尖括号扰乱解析器状态机。判据：异常上下文仍执行。
description.en: Mixes delimiters to confuse parser state machines. Success: executes in odd contexts.

title.zh: 定位“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码和拼接”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that untrusted data lands in an opaque nested template where only ordinary HTML-text encoding is applied or an intermediate component decodes and concatenates the value again, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“HTML Tokenizer 状态突破”解析基线
title.en: Establish the HTML Tokenizer State Breakout baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“解析器状态对应的最小闭合前缀、生成节点和执行事件均可从最终 DOM 解释，避免保留无法说明原因的超长字符串”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set check

description.zh: 先确认当前元素和属性状态，再提交原 Polyglot；对命中项逐段删除前缀和后缀，直到得到能解释 tokenizer 转换的最小样例；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: identify the current element and attribute state before submitting the original polyglot, then delete prefixes and suffixes from a hit until the tokenizer transition has a minimal explainable sample; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 修复并回归“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”
title.en: Retest the Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set remediation boundary

description.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string no longer appears.

overview.zh: 覆盖结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 的 tokenizer 状态突破验证：title、style、textarea、script、属性与 MathML/SVG 嵌套结构的闭合序列。用于确认复杂输出位置中 tokenizer 能否切换到可创建事件节点的状态。
overview.en: Covers tokenizer state-breakout verification with structurally closed XSS Polyglots: closure sequences across title, style, textarea, script, attributes, and MathML/SVG nesting. Used to confirm whether the tokenizer can switch to states that create event nodes in complex output positions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码拼接；组合闭合序列把 tokenizer 从 RCDATA、RAWTEXT、属性值或外来内容状态切出。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted values landing inside opaque nested templates with only plain HTML text encoded, or intermediate components re-decoding and re-concatenating encoded results; combined closure sequences switch the tokenizer out of RCDATA, RAWTEXT, attribute-value, or foreign-content states.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交结构闭合型 Polyglot（含 MathML/mglyph 分支）；任一上下文突破执行即确认对应 Tokenizer 状态可达。先确认当前元素和属性状态再提交；对命中项逐段删除前缀和后缀，直到得到能解释状态转换的最小样例。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit structurally closed Polyglots line by line (including MathML/mglyph branches and module-script forms); breakout execution in any context confirms the corresponding tokenizer state is reachable. Confirm the current element and attribute state before submitting; on hits, strip prefixes and suffixes segment by segment until a minimal sample explaining the state transition remains.

mitigation.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types；修复后各闭合序列应停留在原解析状态，无事件节点生成。
mitigation.en: Let the template engine auto-escape in the final context, forbid component re-decoding, and apply namespace-aware sanitizers with Trusted Types for rich HTML; after the fix, closure sequences must remain in their original parse states with no event nodes created.

name.zh: CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式
name.en: CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes

description.zh: 聚焦同源或可信 CDN JSONP、可控脚本资源与泄露 nonce，验证 CSP 设计缺陷，而非把示例域名当作可直接利用地址。
description.en: Focuses on same-origin or trusted-CDN JSONP, controllable script resources, and leaked nonces to test CSP design failures without treating example domains as live exploit targets.

subCategory.zh: 信任脚本源与回调滥用

prerequisites.zh: 页面已存在 script 元素注入能力，实际 CSP header 已捕获，并能证明同源/可信 CDN 端点可控或 nonce 在当前文档中真实泄露/复用。
prerequisites.en: The page already permits script-element injection, the actual CSP header is captured, and control of a same-origin or trusted-CDN endpoint or real nonce disclosure or reuse in the current document is proven.

prerequisites.zh: 可信端点使用自有 mock，nonce 使用专用一次性测试值，记录 policy 解析、script 请求、响应体、nonce 匹配和 marker 调用栈。
prerequisites.en: Trusted endpoints use owned mocks, nonces use dedicated one-time test values, and policy parsing, script requests, response bodies, nonce matches, and marker call stacks are recorded.

description.zh: 以 JSONP 回调、可信 CDN 脚本与泄漏 nonce 构造 4 类 CSP 失效样例；对应脚本执行即确认该信任模型缺陷可利用。
description.en: Build four CSP failure samples from JSONP callbacks, trusted-CDN scripts, and a leaked nonce; the corresponding script executing confirms the trust-model flaw is exploitable.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 CSP 因可控可信脚本端点或可复用 nonce 允许攻击者脚本，并在目标来源执行 marker；单纯列入 allowlist 不足。 假阳性边界：可信 CDN 不可写、JSONP callback 被限制、nonce 猜测/过期、策略仅 report-only、script 请求被 MIME 阻止或示例域名不存在都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires CSP to allow attacker-controlled script through a controllable trusted endpoint or reusable nonce and execute the marker under the target origin; allowlist membership alone is insufficient. False-positive boundary: A nonwritable trusted CDN, restricted JSONP callback, guessed or stale nonce, report-only policy, MIME-blocked script, or nonexistent example domain is not a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: CSP 信任模型测试不得使用生产 nonce、真实 CDN 写权限或第三方端点；发现真实凭据/nonce、公共请求或持久脚本时停止。
opsecTips.en: CSP trust-model testing must not use production nonces, real CDN write access, or third-party endpoints; stop on real credentials or nonces, public requests, or persistent scripts.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换并删除测试 nonce，移除 mock 端点和注入 script，清理 CDN/script 缓存及 CSP 报告，并恢复生产策略副本。
opsecTips.en: Rotate and delete test nonces, remove mock endpoints and injected scripts, clear CDN and script caches plus CSP reports, and restore the production-policy copy.

title.zh: 基线对照：CSP 绕过模式样例
title.en: Baseline control: CSP bypass pattern samples

description.zh: 与 execution[0] 逐字节相同，作为无 WAF 场景的对照组：先确认 4 条样例直连时的行为与判定依据，再叠加 WAF 复测对比拦截与放行差异；本条不提供额外绕过变体。
description.en: Byte-identical to execution[0]; serves as the no-WAF control group: confirm how the 4 samples behave when directly connected, then retest behind the WAF to compare blocking differences. This entry adds no extra bypass variant.

description.zh: 绕过单端点封禁：换用同为可信域的 revoke 端点。判据：回调执行弹窗。
description.en: Switches to another trusted-domain JSONP endpoint. Success: callback executes.

description.zh: 绕过参数值校验：回调后接 // 注释掉尾部语法噪声。判据：执行成功。
description.en: Appends // to comment out trailing syntax noise. Success: executes.

description.zh: 绕过回调参数中 alert 明文：编码传递。判据：解码执行。
description.en: Encodes the callback name. Success: executes after decoding.

description.zh: 绕过外域脚本检测：优先探测同域端点。判据：同域回调执行。
description.en: Probes same-origin endpoints to dodge external-script rules. Success: same-origin callback runs.

title.en: Validation step 1 for CSP Trusted-Origin JSONP Callback Abuse

description.zh: 以真实公共端点（Google 搜索/revokes、翻译、YouTube）的 JSONP 回调携带 alert 提交；CSP 放行且回调执行即确认可信源 JSONP 回调滥用成立。
description.en: Submit JSONP callbacks carrying alerts on real public endpoints (Google search/revokes, Translate, YouTube); CSP allowing the request with the callback executing confirms trusted-origin JSONP abuse.

title.zh: 解析“CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式”的生效策略
title.en: Scope the CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes data flow

description.zh: 抓取最终响应头并展开指令回退，确认前提“页面已存在脚本元素注入，可信源提供可控 JavaScript 响应，或者 nonce 没有为每个响应随机生成并受到模板隔离”真实存在，而不是配置文档中的预期。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the page already permits script-element injection, a trusted origin serves controllable JavaScript, or the nonce is not freshly randomized per response and isolated from untrusted templates, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“CSP 脚本信任模型”策略基线
title.en: Establish the CSP Script Trust Model baseline

description.zh: 用合法同源资源记录允许行为，再结合 CSP 违规事件、网络请求和证据标准“生效响应头、脚本请求来源、nonce 生成与复用证据以及唯一执行标记共同证明策略失效”区分结果。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐能力验证“CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式”
title.en: Run a single-variable CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes check

description.zh: 从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，并比较两次响应 nonce；仅用自有无害端点替换示例 URL 复核，每次只测试一种元素、指令或 URL 方案。
description.en: extract the effective policy from the real page, determine whether trusted-origin response content is controllable, compare nonces across two responses, and verify only with a harmless owned endpoint substituted for examples; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 收紧 CSP 并执行回归
title.en: Retest the CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes remediation boundary

description.zh: 采用 strict-dynamic 配合每响应随机 nonce 或稳定脚本 hash，移除通配主机和不必要 JSONP，并确保 nonce 不进入用户可控模板或缓存；随后重放业务资源与异常输入，确认指令边界清晰且合法内容仍可加载。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure no longer appears.

overview.zh: 覆盖 CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式验证：同源或可信 CDN 的 JSONP、可控脚本资源与泄露 nonce 四类失效样例。用于确认 CSP 脚本信任模型的设计缺陷而非示例域名的可达性。
overview.en: Covers CSP allowlist and nonce failure-mode verification: four failure samples of same-origin or trusted-CDN JSONP, controllable script resources, and leaked nonces. Used to confirm design flaws in the CSP script trust model rather than reachability of the sample domains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 script-src 依赖可被借用的主机允许列表，或 nonce 可预测、复用、泄露并应用到注入脚本；页面已有脚本元素注入且可信源提供可控 JS 响应时策略即失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is script-src relying on borrowable host allowlists, or nonces being predictable, reused, leaked, and applied to injected scripts; the policy fails once script-element injection exists and trusted origins serve controllable JS responses.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 JSONP 回调、可信 CDN 脚本与泄漏 nonce 构造 4 类 CSP 失效样例；对应脚本执行即确认该信任模型缺陷可利用。从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，比较两次响应 nonce，示例 URL 以自有无害端点替换复核。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build four CSP failure samples from JSONP callbacks, trusted-CDN scripts, and leaked nonces; the corresponding script executing confirms the trust-model flaw is exploitable. Extract the effective policy from the real page, confirm whether trusted-origin responses are controllable, compare nonces across two responses, and re-verify with sample URLs replaced by your own harmless endpoints.

mitigation.zh: 采用 strict-dynamic 配合每响应随机 nonce 或稳定脚本 hash，移除通配主机与不必要 JSONP，确保 nonce 不进入用户可控模板或缓存；修复后相关指令应稳定阻断越界脚本执行。
mitigation.en: Adopt strict-dynamic with per-response random nonces or stable script hashes, remove wildcard hosts and unnecessary JSONP, and keep nonces out of user-controllable templates and caches; after the fix, the directives must consistently block out-of-bounds script execution.

name.zh: 存储型 XSS 管理视图触发
name.en: Stored XSS Triggered in an Administrative View

description.zh: 验证评论、资料或工单内容是否被持久化，并在管理员或其他高权限用户查看时未经上下文编码与消毒进入可执行浏览器位置。
description.en: Validate whether comments, profiles, or ticket content is persisted and later reaches an executable browser context without context-aware encoding and sanitization when viewed by an administrator or another privileged user.

prerequisites.zh: 评论、资料或工单输入被持久化，并在明确的管理员/高权限视图中进入可执行 HTML、属性或脚本上下文。
prerequisites.en: Comment, profile, or ticket input is persisted and later enters an executable HTML, attribute, or script context in a known administrator or privileged view.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离测试管理员和唯一存储 token，原始 cookie 外传/beacon 行替换为只设置固定 marker 的本地事件，并保存存储与渲染记录。
prerequisites.en: An isolated test administrator and unique stored token are used, replacing source cookie-exfiltration and beacon lines with a local event that only sets a fixed marker, while storage and render records are preserved.

title.zh: 存储的XSS (评论 -> 管理员查看)

description.zh: 把外发与事件载荷注入评论等存储点，等待管理员查看触发；管理员会话执行后 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收到数据或弹出标记即确认高权限查看页存储型 XSS 成立。将 evil.com 语义由 {ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集域，载荷仅携带测试数据。
description.en: Inject exfil and event payloads into stored points such as comments and wait for an administrator view; execution in the admin session with data or markers arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms stored XSS on the privileged view. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection domain and payloads carry only test data.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一存储 token 在高权限视图被浏览器解析为活动节点并执行 marker，数据库记录、渲染路由、DOM 节点、调用栈和测试会话相互对应。 假阳性边界：字符串被存储、script src 被链接预览/扫描器请求、管理员页面安全编码、CSP 阻止、低权限自查看执行或未关联网络回调均不是高权限存储型 XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same stored token to be parsed as an active node and execute the marker in the privileged view, correlating database record, render route, DOM node, call stack, and test session. False-positive boundary: Stored text, script-source requests from previews or scanners, safe encoding in the admin view, CSP blocking, execution only in the submitter's own low-privilege view, or an uncorrelated callback does not prove privileged stored XSS.

opsecTips.zh: 存储型 XSS 测试禁止读取 cookie、storage、DOM 数据或发送 beacon；发现非测试管理员、真实会话、外连、持久 worker/service worker 或跨页面传播时停止。
opsecTips.en: Stored XSS testing never reads cookies, storage, or DOM data or sends beacons; stop on a non-test administrator, real session, egress, persistent workers or service workers, or cross-page propagation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除存储记录及搜索索引/队列副本，清理模板/CDN/浏览器缓存，移除 marker 与 service worker，吊销测试会话并复查后台。
opsecTips.en: Delete stored records plus search-index and queue copies, clear template, CDN, and browser caches, remove markers and service workers, revoke test sessions, and recheck the admin view.

description.zh: 绕过 cookie 明文检测：编码后外带。判据：服务端 base64 还原出 cookie。
description.en: Encodes the cookie before egress. Success: server decodes the cookie.

description.zh: 绕过 URL 长度与明文：Blob body 发送。判据：POST body 含 cookie。
description.en: Sends the cookie as a Blob body. Success: cookie in POST body.

description.zh: 绕过一次性触发清理：localStorage 防重载持续控制。判据：管理员多次访问均回连。
description.en: localStorage flag keeps control across views. Success: repeated callbacks from admin sessions.

description.zh: 脚本被过滤时退化为 CSS 侧信道。判据：CSS 请求命中字符。
description.en: Falls back to CSS side channel when script is filtered. Success: CSS requests arrive.

title.zh: 追踪持久化值到管理 DOM
title.en: Trace the stored value to the administrative DOM

description.zh: 用纯文本标记定位数据库字段、序列化响应和最终高权限渲染上下文。
description.en: Use a plain-text marker to locate the database field, serialized response, and final privileged rendering context.

title.zh: 在隔离浏览器验证执行
title.en: Validate execution in an isolated browser

description.zh: 提交原始语料并仅使用测试管理员打开页面，以 DOM、CSP 和自有端点请求证明浏览器执行。
description.en: Submit the original corpus and open the page only as a test administrator, using DOM, CSP, and owned-endpoint requests to prove browser execution.

title.zh: 修复所有高权限输出 Sink

description.zh: 应用上下文编码和消毒后重放内容，确认后台、导出和通知均显示安全文本且业务格式保持。
description.en: After context-aware encoding and sanitization, replay content and confirm administrative views, exports, and notifications render safe text while preserving business formatting.

overview.zh: 覆盖存储型 XSS 在高权限查看页的触发验证：评论、资料或工单内容持久化后，在管理员等高权限用户查看时未经编码进入可执行位置。写入者、持久化层与查看者三主体是验证关键。
overview.en: Covers stored XSS triggering in high-privilege views: comments, profiles, or tickets persisted, then entering executable positions unencoded when administrators or other privileged users view them. The writer-persistence-viewer triad is the verification key.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用写入时保留 HTML 或事件属性，高权限页面按 innerHTML、模板非转义输出或危险 URL 上下文渲染；输入跨存储边界后被误认为可信，入口过滤不能替代输出上下文编码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications preserving HTML or event attributes at write time while high-privilege pages render via innerHTML, unescaped template output, or hazardous URL contexts; input crossing the storage boundary is mistakenly trusted, and entry filtering cannot replace output-context encoding.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把外发与事件载荷注入评论等存储点，等待管理员查看触发；管理员会话执行 marker（弹出标记或自有端点收到不含敏感数据的标记请求）即确认高权限查看页存储型 XSS 成立。先用随机纯文本标记确认数据库值与管理页 DOM，再在隔离管理员浏览器观察执行与 CSP 报告，避免使用真实会话。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject exfiltration and event payloads into storage points like comments, then wait for an administrator view to trigger; data reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} or a popup flag under the admin session confirms stored XSS in the high-privilege view. Confirm the database value and admin-page DOM with a random plain-text marker first, then observe execution and CSP reports in an isolated admin browser without touching real sessions.

mitigation.zh: 按 HTML 文本、属性、URL 与 JS 上下文分别编码输出，富文本走维护中消毒器与最小允许列表，部署 nonce/hash CSP 并给会话 Cookie 设置 HttpOnly/SameSite；回归覆盖所有后台、导出与通知 Sink。
mitigation.en: Encode output per HTML text, attribute, URL, and JS contexts, run rich text through maintained sanitizers with minimal allowlists, deploy nonce/hash CSP with HttpOnly/SameSite session cookies; regression must cover every admin, export, and notification sink.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Unicode 与控制字符 XSS 规范化

description.zh: 使用制表符、换行等控制字符的 HTML 实体与百分号编码形态混入脚本协议，检查各层规范化后浏览器是否恢复可执行语义。
description.en: Mixes tabs, newlines, and Unicode characters into script schemes to test whether browser normalization restores executable semantics.

prerequisites.zh: 固定输入编码、代理解码、HTML 属性上下文和浏览器版本，逐层记录 Unicode code point 与最终 DOM 属性。
prerequisites.en: Pin input encoding, proxy decoding, HTML attribute context, and browser version, recording Unicode code points and final DOM attributes at every layer.

prerequisites.zh: 以无副作用 DOM canary 替代 alert，对控制字符、百分号编码、全宽字符及规范 ASCII 版本做配对。
prerequisites.en: Replace alert with a side-effect-free DOM canary and pair control characters, percent encoding, full-width characters, and canonical ASCII forms.

description.zh: 以控制字符与编码变形拆分 javascript: scheme 提交；规范化后仍执行即确认字符混淆差异可绕过，作为 WAF 复测对照基线。
description.en: Split the javascript: scheme with control characters and encoded variants; execution after normalization confirms exploitable character-confusion differences, serving as the WAF retest baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求过滤器看到的变体经后续规范化恢复为浏览器可执行 scheme/事件，并实际触发 canary，负责转换的层可定位。浏览器能显示 Unicode、属性字符串变化、URL 解码发生、script scheme 被阻止、解析失败或只在日志中看似 javascript 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a filter-visible variant to normalize later into a browser-executable scheme or event and actually trigger the canary, with the responsible layer identified. Browser Unicode display, changed attribute strings, URL decoding, blocked script schemes, parse failure, or javascript appearance only in logs is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 定位一个规范化差异并触发 canary 后停止，不叠加实体、双编码或外部资源加载。
opsecTips.en: Stop after locating one normalization differential and triggering the canary; do not stack entities, double encoding, or external resource loads.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 Unicode fixture 与浏览器数据，清理各层原始捕获/缓存，并恢复统一字符集和规范化后校验。
opsecTips.en: Delete Unicode fixtures and browser data, clear raw captures and caches at every tier, and restore one character set and post-normalization validation.

title.zh: 基线对照：Unicode/UTF-8 混淆样例

description.zh: 与 execution[0] 逐字节相同，作为无 WAF 场景的对照组：先确认 12 条样例直连时的行为与判定依据，再叠加 WAF 复测对比拦截与放行差异；本条不提供额外绕过变体。
description.en: Byte-identical to execution[0]; serves as the no-WAF control group: confirm how the 12 samples behave when directly connected, then retest behind the WAF to compare blocking differences. This entry adds no extra bypass variant.

title.zh: 建立脚本协议字符混淆基线
title.en: Establish the Script-Scheme Character Obfuscation baseline

description.zh: 在目标浏览器记录安全 URL、含控制字符的普通文本和净化后 DOM 属性，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record a safe URL, ordinary text containing controls, and sanitized DOM attributes in the target browser, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行脚本协议字符混淆变体
title.en: Execute the Script-Scheme Character Obfuscation variants

description.zh: 逐项提交原始 Unicode/UTF-8 变体，并把脚本动作替换为无害页面标记，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Submit original Unicode and UTF-8 variants one at a time and replace script actions with harmless page markers, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验Unicode 与控制字符 XSS 规范化证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Unicode and Control-Character XSS Normalization

description.zh: 通过 DOM 属性、事件触发和调用栈确认规范化后确实形成脚本执行；同时排除字符被保留为文本、URL 解析失败、浏览器拒绝协议或仅 WAF 日志命中。
description.en: Use DOM attributes, event triggering, and stack traces to confirm that normalization produces script execution; also exclude Characters preserved as text, URL parse failure, browser scheme rejection, or WAF-log matches only.

overview.zh: 覆盖脚本协议字符混淆的规范化验证：以制表符、换行与 Unicode 字符混入 javascript: scheme，检查各层规范化后浏览器是否恢复可执行语义。
overview.en: Covers normalization verification for script-scheme character obfuscation: mixing tabs, newlines, and Unicode characters into javascript: schemes, checking whether browsers restore executable semantics after per-layer normalization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WAF 与净化器未按浏览器规则统一规范化，危险协议在过滤阶段不可见而在 DOM 中重新组合；判定标准是规范化后确实形成脚本执行并触发标记。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WAFs and sanitizers not normalizing uniformly per browser rules, leaving the dangerous scheme invisible at filtering yet reassembled in the DOM; the decision standard is script execution actually forming after normalization with markers firing.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以控制字符与编码变形拆分 javascript: scheme 提交；规范化后仍执行即确认字符混淆差异可绕过，作为 WAF 复测对照基线。先记录安全 URL、含控制字符的普通文本与净化后 DOM 属性，再逐项提交变体并把脚本动作替换为无害页面标记。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit javascript: schemes split by control characters and encoding mutations; post-normalization execution confirms the character-obfuscation differential bypass, serving as the WAF retest baseline. Record safe URLs, control-character plain text, and sanitized DOM attributes first, then submit variants replacing script actions with harmless page markers.

mitigation.zh: 统一到明确 Unicode 规范形态后再校验；使用上下文编码与协议允许列表而非黑名单；在支持浏览器中测试控制字符、全角字符与多重解码。
mitigation.en: Normalize to a defined Unicode canonical form before validating; use context encoding and protocol allowlists rather than blacklists; test control characters, fullwidth characters, and multi-decoding in supported browsers.

name.zh: WebSocket 富文本 XSS 上下文探针

description.zh: 覆盖 chat/send/message/data 四类消息信封（消息外层 JSON 结构）、交互事件、SVG/data URL 与高风险外传样例，验证 WebSocket 富文本内容在不同 DOM 上下文是否缺少编码。
description.en: Covers chat, send, message, and data envelopes plus interactive events, SVG, data URLs, and high-risk exfiltration samples to test context-specific encoding of WebSocket rich text.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别实际支持的消息 schema 与最终 HTML、属性、URL 或 SVG sink，其他信封仅作为负对照。
prerequisites.en: Identify the supported message schema and final HTML, attribute, URL, or SVG sink; treat unsupported envelopes as negative controls.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离账号，浏览器禁止访问外部网络；所有 alert/fetch/sendBeacon 原始动作用本地无害执行标记替代。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated account and networkless browser and replace source alert, fetch, and sendBeacon actions with a harmless local execution marker.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 注入富文本上下文与外发载荷；格式化渲染后执行或 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 cookie 即确认富文本上下文 XSS 成立。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为隔离收集器。
description.en: Inject rich-text context and exfil payloads over WebSocket; execution after formatted rendering or cookies arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms the rich-text XSS context. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to the isolated collector.

analysis.zh: 该集合含明显高风险 Cookie 外传与 data/SVG 变体，验证不需要实际外传。消息被广播或存储只是到达条件；必须在特定接收端 sink 中执行无害标记。被 CSP 阻止、DOMPurify 删除、客户端显示转义文本或只有发送者自我执行均是假阳性/影响边界。
analysis.en: The set contains high-risk cookie-exfiltration and data or SVG variants, but validation never requires exfiltration. Broadcast or storage is only reachability; a harmless marker must execute in the specific receiving sink. CSP blocking, sanitizer removal, escaped rendering, or sender-only self-execution defines false-positive or impact boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 一个接收端上下文执行本地标记后停止，不使用原始 Cookie 外传、sendBeacon、data URL 或跨用户批量消息。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one receiver context executes the local marker; do not use source cookie exfiltration, sendBeacon, data URLs, or cross-user bulk messages.

opsecTips.zh: 删除所有测试消息和附件，清理接收端浏览器存储/service worker，关闭连接并检查持久队列不再广播。
opsecTips.en: Delete all test messages and attachments, clear receiver storage and service workers, close connections, and verify persistent queues no longer broadcast them.

description.zh: 媒体子元素错误事件。判据：加载失败弹窗。
description.en: Media child error event. Success: alert on failure.

description.zh: 冷门事件绕过黑名单。判据：渲染触发。
description.en: Rare event bypass. Success: fires on render.

description.zh: 导航式执行需一次点击。判据：点击弹窗。
description.en: Navigation-style payload. Success: alert on click.

description.zh: object 的 data 属性执行。判据：渲染执行。
description.en: object data attribute execution. Success: fires on render.

description.zh: 绕过 script 消息过滤：图片事件执行。判据：消息渲染即弹窗。
description.en: img event payload in the WS message. Success: prompt on render.

description.zh: svg 事件在富文本容器执行。判据：触发弹窗。
description.en: svg event in the rich-text container. Success: alert.

description.zh: 服务端解码一次客户端再解码导致执行。判据：二次渲染后执行。
description.en: Decoded twice across server and client. Success: executes on second render.

description.zh: 需要用户交互，绕过自动执行检测。判据：悬停弹窗。
description.en: Needs interaction to fire. Success: alert on hover.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message DOM-XSS Probes

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 两种消息格式注入事件载荷标签；前端把消息写入 DOM 后执行即确认 WS 消息到 DOM Sink 可达。
description.en: Inject event-payload tags over WebSocket in both message formats; execution after the client writes messages into the DOM confirms the WS-message-to-DOM-sink path.

title.zh: 富文本上下文提交协议载荷
title.en: Submit scheme payloads into rich-text contexts

description.zh: 向富文本消息提交以 javascript: 伪协议作为 iframe 源的载荷，观察内容区是否按 HTML 渲染执行；命中即确认消息通道侧存在脚本注入。
description.en: Post iframe javascript: sources into rich-text messages; HTML-style rendering in the feed indicates WS-side XSS.

title.zh: 事件属性变体扩大命中

description.zh: 补充链接跳转与悬停等交互事件属性载荷，受害者交互时触发弹窗，确认多种标签上下文均可注入并执行攻击代码，攻击面随之扩大。
description.en: Add a-href and div onmouseover variants; hover-triggered alerts prove multiple tag contexts execute injected markup.

description.zh: 以可执行上下文为基础注入外带脚本或伪装输入框，窃取 Cookie 与输入内容，把消息通道变成攻击跳板。
description.en: With execution established, plant beacons or fake inputs to steal cookies and keystrokes, turning the feed into the attack pivot.

overview.zh: 面向 WebSocket 富文本上下文的 XSS 验证：覆盖 chat/send/message/data 消息信封、交互事件、SVG/data URL 与 Cookie 外传形态，检验富文本内容在不同 DOM 上下文是否缺少编码。
overview.en: Covers XSS verification in WebSocket rich-text contexts: spanning chat/send/message/data envelopes, interaction events, SVG/data URLs, and cookie-exfiltration forms, testing missing encoding of rich text across DOM contexts.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是消息在存储、广播或客户端重放时进入与其编码不匹配的富文本 sink，允许事件属性、危险 URL 或 SVG 脚本执行；需按最终输出上下文选择样例而非批量投递。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is messages entering rich-text sinks mismatched with their encoding during storage, broadcast, or client replay, permitting event attributes, hazardous URLs, or SVG script execution; samples must be chosen per final output context rather than sprayed.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令经 WebSocket 注入富文本载荷与外发样例；消息被渲染为 HTML 后载荷执行，或 {ATTACKER_HOST}（指向本地隔离收集器）收到 cookie，即确认富文本上下文 XSS 成立。先用纯文本定位上下文，只选择一个无网络标记变体并与消毒/编码对照，分别观察发送端与接收端。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject rich-text contexts and exfiltration payloads via WebSocket; execution after formatted rendering or {ATTACKER_HOST} receiving cookies confirms rich-text context XSS, with {ATTACKER_HOST} rendered as an isolated collector. Locate the context with plain text first, choose a single network-free marker variant contrasted against sanitization/encoding, and observe sender and receiver sides separately.

mitigation.zh: 对每个字段执行 context-aware 编码，富文本采用严格允许列表消毒，拒绝 javascript/data 协议并部署无 unsafe-inline 的 CSP；修复后重放对照应保留合法功能且执行消失。
mitigation.en: Apply context-aware encoding per field, sanitize rich text with strict allowlists, reject javascript/data schemes, and deploy CSP without unsafe-inline; after the fix, replaying controls must preserve legitimate functionality with execution gone.
