name.zh: Windows 令牌枚举与模拟窃取

description.zh: 枚举当前进程令牌特权（SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken 等），评估服务账户的模拟风险面。
description.en: Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 列出系统令牌；输出令牌与所属账户清单即枚举完成，重点观察可模拟的高权限令牌。
description.en: List system tokens with Mimikatz; the printed token and account inventory completes enumeration, focusing on impersonable high-privilege tokens.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 窃取指定域用户令牌；当前 shell 上下文切换为目标用户身份即模拟成功。
description.en: Steal the specified domain-user token with Mimikatz; the current shell context switching to that user confirms impersonation.

description.zh: 运行 JuicyPotato 验证 SeImpersonate 提权路径；绑定命令以 SYSTEM 身份执行即提权成功。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato to validate the SeImpersonate elevation path; the bound command executing as SYSTEM confirms elevation.

explanation.zh: CLSID，选取可被普通用户修改启动权限的 DCOM 类
explanation.en: CLSID of an injectable DCOM class

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 验证命名管道模拟提权；得到的 shell 显示 SYSTEM 即提权成功。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer to validate named-pipe impersonation elevation; a shell showing SYSTEM confirms elevation.

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 验证通用 Potato 提权；cmd /c whoami 返回 SYSTEM 即提权成功。
description.en: Run GodPotato to validate universal Potato elevation; cmd /c whoami returning SYSTEM confirms elevation.

analysis.zh: Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：已有会话窃取令牌
title.en: Evasion: token theft via existing session

description.zh: 规避点：不落地 mimikatz 二进制（绕杀软签名与磁盘审计），用既有 meterpreter 会话窃取目标进程令牌。判据：getuid 显示被窃取用户。
description.en: Avoids dropping mimikatz (signature and disk audit evasion) by stealing a token from an existing process. Success: getuid shows the target user.

title.zh: 规避变体：PowerShell 令牌模拟

description.zh: 规避点：内存加载 PowerShell 版模拟替代 mimikatz exe。判据：当前线程身份变为 Administrator。
description.en: In-memory PowerShell replacement for the mimikatz binary. Success: thread identity becomes Administrator.

title.zh: 规避变体：换 SweetPotato 规避哈希

description.zh: 规避点：更换工具家族规避已知 Potato 哈希与进程特征，输出重定向文件免弹窗。判据：p.txt 内容为 nt authority\system。
description.en: Different tool family evades known Potato hashes; file output avoids console popups. Success: p.txt shows nt authority\system.

title.zh: 规避变体：执行后痕迹清理

wafBypass.command: wevtutil cl Security && wevtutil cl System && del C:\\Windows\\temp\\p.txt

description.zh: 规避点：清除安全/系统事件日志与临时产物降低取证痕迹（仅在授权演练中使用）。判据：日志查看器中相关记录消失。
description.en: Clears security/system logs and temp artifacts to reduce forensic traces (authorized exercises only). Success: related events gone.

title.zh: 枚举可窃取的高权限令牌

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 token::list 列出系统全部令牌；输出中存在 SYSTEM 或 Administrator 所属令牌即锁定窃取目标，重点看可模拟的高完整性会话。
description.en: List all tokens with mimikatz token::list; SYSTEM or Administrator-owned tokens in the output become the impersonation targets.

description.zh: 用 token::elevate 指定 Administrator 域用户窃取其令牌；当前 shell 上下文切换为目标身份即完成模拟，直接继承该账户全部权限执行操作。
description.en: Invoke token::elevate for the Administrator account; the shell switching to that identity inherits every permission of the impersonated user.

description.zh: 以 SeImpersonate 特权运行 JuicyPotato 触发 COM 本地提权；绑定的 cmd 以 SYSTEM 执行即从服务账号跃升到最高权限，拿到管理员外壳。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato leveraging SeImpersonate to abuse COM elevation; the bound command executing as SYSTEM lifts a service account to the top of the box.

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 伪装打印服务命名管道，诱骗以 SYSTEM 运行的打印组件回连模拟；得到的 shell 显示 SYSTEM 即确认备选提权路径可用。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer to fake a print-service named pipe and bait the SYSTEM spooler into impersonation; a SYSTEM shell proves the alternate route works.

title.en: Fall back to GodPotato on patched hosts

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 借助 RPCSS 伪装链执行 whoami；返回 SYSTEM 即在补丁较新的环境仍可提权，与前两条路径互为备份手段。
description.en: Run GodPotato riding the RPCSS masquerade chain to execute whoami; a SYSTEM result keeps escalation viable on newer patches, backing up the other two routes.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows 令牌权限与模拟提权场景，检验高权限令牌的可枚举与可模拟面。验证维度含令牌列举、令牌窃取与 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer、GodPotato 三条模拟提权路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows token-privilege and impersonation escalation, testing how enumerable and stealable high-privilege tokens are. Validation covers token listing, token theft, and the JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato impersonation paths, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务进程常以高权限运行且默认授予 SeImpersonate 类特权：具备该特权的低权账户可诱骗高权限身份完成命名管道或 COM 认证，进而模拟其令牌获得 SYSTEM。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service processes running with high privileges and defaulting to impersonation-class privileges: a low-privileged account holding SeImpersonate can lure a high-privilege identity into named-pipe or COM authentication and impersonate its token for SYSTEM.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 token::list 枚举令牌锁定可模拟目标，以输出完整令牌与所属账户清单为判据；第 2 步以 token::elevate 验证指定域用户令牌窃取，以当前 shell 身份切换为目标用户（whoami 回显目标用户）为判据；第 3 至第 5 步依次运行 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer 与 GodPotato，绑定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认对应路径，以 whoami 回显 nt authority\system 为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅授权实验主机。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate tokens with mimikatz token::list locking onto stealable targets. In step 2, verify theft of a specified domain user's token with token::elevate. In steps 3 through 5, run JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato in turn; bound commands executing as SYSTEM confirm each path, judged by whoami output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab hosts only.

mitigation.zh: 移除非必要服务的 SeImpersonate 与 SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权，服务账户改用托管身份，终端监控 potato 家族的进程与管道行为。修复后重放第 3 至第 5 步，提权工具应全部失败并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Strip SeImpersonate and SeAssignPrimaryToken from unneeded services, use managed identities for service accounts, and monitor potato-family process and pipe behavior on endpoints. After the fix, replay steps 3 through 5: every escalation tool should fail with alerts.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计

description.zh: 审计 cron 任务定义、可写脚本与通配符注入点，验证计划任务提权。
description.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Cron 所有权与可写路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 查看系统计划任务；root 运行且路径可写的任务即锁定 cron 提权候选。
description.en: Review system cron jobs; root-run jobs with writable paths pin cron escalation candidates.

description.zh: 检查任务脚本权限；普通用户对脚本或其父目录具备写权限即确认可注入执行。
description.en: Check task-script permissions; normal-user write access to the script or its directory confirms injectable execution.

title.zh: tar checkpoint 钩子执行测试脚本
title.en: Execute test script via tar checkpoint hook

description.zh: 创建 cron 归档时利用 --checkpoint-action 钩子执行 fixtures/cron.sh，验证可写路径下 tar 参数注入的可达性。
description.en: Creates the cron fixture archive while executing fixtures/cron.sh through the --checkpoint-action hook, confirming reachability of tar argument injection from a writable path.

analysis.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：通配符注入提权

description.zh: 规避点：tar 通配符注入不修改 cron 定义本身，绕过 crontab 监控。判据：收到 root shell。
description.en: Wildcard injection never touches the cron definition. Success: root shell arrives.

description.zh: 规避点：覆盖 cron 脚本调用的无路径命令，不改脚本本体。判据：定时触发回连。
description.en: Shadows an unqualified command instead of editing the script. Success: scheduled callback.

title.zh: 规避变体：cron.d 注入持久化

description.zh: 规避点：独立文件持久化不篡改既有 crontab，降低 diff 告警。判据：每分钟以 root 执行 /tmp/x。
description.en: A separate file avoids modifying existing crontabs. Success: /tmp/x runs as root every minute.

description.zh: 规避点：删除载荷与注入项并清历史。判据：相关文件与条目全部消失。
description.en: Removes payloads, injected entries, and history. Success: all artifacts gone.

description.zh: 读取 crontab 与各 cron 目录内容；由 root 周期运行且脚本路径可写的任务即锁定命令注入点，记录调度间隔评估等待时间。
description.en: Read crontab and the cron directories; root-scheduled jobs with writable script paths become injection points, with intervals hinting at wait time.

title.zh: 检查脚本与目录写权限
title.en: Check script and directory write access

description.zh: 查看任务脚本及其父目录的权限细节；普通用户具备写权限即可向脚本追加命令，等待下个调度周期以 root 身份执行。
description.en: Inspect the job script and its parent directory; ordinary-user write access means appended commands run as root on the next cycle.

description.zh: 以 tar 的 checkpoint-action 钩子在归档创建时执行指定脚本；钩子被触发即验证通配符注入路径可达，把同样的钩子文件放入 root 的 cron 以通配符归档的业务目录，即可让计划任务以 root 执行任意命令完成提权。
description.en: Use tar's --checkpoint-action hook to execute a script during archive creation; the hook firing proves wildcard injection works and the same trick escalates via cron.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cron 所有权与可写路径提权审计场景，检验 root 计划任务对可写脚本与归档钩子的执行边界。验证维度含任务清单核查、脚本权限检查与 tar checkpoint 钩子验证三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cron ownership and writable-path escalation auditing, testing how root-scheduled jobs handle writable scripts and archive hooks. Validation covers task-list review, script-permission checks and a tar checkpoint-hook verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 root 计划任务引用的脚本或其父目录对普通用户可写，或以通配方式处理文件名：攻击者注入命令或借 tar 参数展开即让任务以 root 执行任意代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is root cron jobs referencing scripts or parent directories writable by standard users, or expanding filenames via wildcards: injected commands or tar argument expansion let the job run attacker code as root.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查看 etc 下 crontab 与计划任务目录，锁定 root 运行且路径可写的任务；第 2 步检查目标脚本及其父目录权限，普通用户可写即确认注入点；第 3 步在测试目录用 tar checkpoint 钩子执行夹具脚本，验证通配参数注入的可达性。以 root 上下文执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；钩子测试仅在隔离目录进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, review the etc crontab and scheduled-task directories, locking onto root-run jobs with writable paths. In step 2, check target-script and parent-directory permissions; standard-user writability marks the injection point. In step 3, use a tar checkpoint hook to execute a fixture script in a test directory, validating wildcard argument-injection reachability. Judge success by root-context execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run hook tests only in isolated directories.

mitigation.zh: 任务脚本与父目录仅允许 root 写入，避免通配调用并显式列出文件，cron 编辑与执行纳入审计。修复后重放第 2、3 步，写入应被拒绝且钩子不再触发。
mitigation.en: Restrict job scripts and parent directories to root writes, avoid wildcard invocations by listing files explicitly, and audit cron edits and runs. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: writes should be denied and hooks never fire.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: OAuth state 缺失与固定值测试
name.en: OAuth state Missing and Fixed-Value Test

description.zh: 验证 OAuth state 的不可预测性、会话绑定与一次性消费，覆盖缺失、空值、固定值、注入与类型混淆变体。
description.en: Verify OAuth state unpredictability, session binding, and one-time consumption, covering missing, empty, fixed, injected, and type-confusion variants.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个隔离浏览器配置文件和合成 OAuth 账户，记录每次授权启动时生成的 state、会话 Cookie 和回调消费事件。
prerequisites.en: Use two isolated browser profiles and synthetic OAuth accounts, recording generated state, session cookie, and callback consumption for every authorization start.

prerequisites.zh: 准备缺失、固定、可预测、跨会话、已消费和错误 state 对照，并确保授权码本身只对测试客户端有效。
prerequisites.en: Prepare missing, fixed, predictable, cross-session, already-consumed, and wrong-state controls, ensuring the authorization code is valid only for the test client.

title.en: Validation step 1 for OAuth state Binding and Randomness Test

execution.command:
state=
state=null
state=undefined
state=false
state=0
state=-1
state=attacker_state
state=csrf_token
state=12345
state=abc

description.zh: 把缺失、固定、可预测 state 逐条提交 OAuth 流程；服务端不校验 state 仍完成登录绑定，即确认登录 CSRF。
description.en: Submit missing, fixed, and predictable state values through the OAuth flow; login binding completing without state validation confirms login CSRF.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求错误、缺失或来自另一浏览器会话的 state 回调被接受，并让当前合成浏览器绑定到攻击者选择的测试身份或消费响应。回调页面返回 200、state 参数存在、随机值长度较长、授权服务器先前登录、错误回调被记录但未建立会话都不是 OAuth 登录 CSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a callback with missing, incorrect, or another browser session's state to be accepted and bind the current synthetic browser to an attacker-selected test identity or consume the response. HTTP 200 on the callback page, state merely being present, a long random-looking value, a prior authorization-server login, or logging a bad callback without creating a session is not OAuth login CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 一个跨会话 state 首次改变合成登录身份后停止，不继续触发账户绑定、资料修改或真实用户登录。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one cross-session state first changes the synthetic logged-in identity; do not continue to account linking, profile changes, or real-user login.

opsecTips.zh: 注销两套浏览器会话，撤销 code/token，清除回调与 state 存储，并恢复随机生成、会话绑定和单次消费。
opsecTips.en: Revoke both browser sessions and all codes or tokens, clear callback and state storage, and restore random generation, session binding, and single consumption.

description.zh: 数组形态绕过字符串等值校验。判据：回调仍被接受且 state 校验被跳过。
description.en: Array form bypasses string equality. Success: callback accepted with state check skipped.

description.zh: 前后端对重复参数取值不同导致校验旁路。判据：以攻击者 state 完成流程。
description.en: Divergent picks between front and backend on repeated params. Success: flow completes with the attacker state.

description.zh: 超长值使校验层截断比较通过。判据：流程推进到回调。
description.en: Truncation at the validation layer lets the check pass. Success: flow reaches the callback.

description.zh: C 语言式比较在空字节处提前相等。判据：state 判定通过。
description.en: Comparison stops early at the null byte. Success: state check passes.

description.zh: 编码斜杠绕过明文外域检测。判据：重定向至攻击域。
description.en: Encoded slashes evade plaintext external-domain rules. Success: redirect to attacker host.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 // 前缀。判据：解码后跳转攻击域。
description.en: Second decode restores the // prefix. Success: navigates to attacker host after decoding.

description.zh: 框架将 state 解析为数组时 url 键被采用。判据：回调指向攻击域。
description.en: Framework parses state as an array honoring the url key. Success: callback points at the attacker host.

title.en: Validation step 1 for OAuth State Session-Binding Validation

description.zh: 把 URL、脚本与类型混淆 state 逐条提交 OAuth 流程；state 被当作跳转或注入处理，即确认 state 处理缺陷。
description.en: Submit URL, script, and type-confused state values through the OAuth flow; state treated as a redirect or injection sink confirms state-handling flaws.

description.zh: 在两个隔离浏览器会话发起授权并保存各自 state 与账号。
description.en: Start authorization in two isolated browser sessions and save each state and account.

attackChain.payload:
state=
state=null
state=undefined
state=false
state=0
state=-1
state=attacker_state
state=csrf_token
state=12345
state=abc

description.zh: 使用原始 state 变体并执行跨会话回调，保持 code 与回调端点可追踪。
description.en: Use the original state variants and cross-session callbacks while keeping code and callback traceable.

description.zh: 确认回调后的服务端主体与 state 消费记录，排除仅返回登录页。
description.en: Verify the server principal and state-consumption record after callback, excluding a simple login-page response.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth state 绑定与随机性场景，检验客户端对缺失、固定与可预测 state 的处理边界。验证维度为空值、字面量与可预测值的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth state binding and randomness, testing client handling of missing, fixed and predictable state values. Validation is a single-step matrix of empty, literal and predictable values, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 state 未按会话存储或校验可被绕过：跨站页面携带伪造 state 完成回调即把攻击者账号绑定到受害者会话，形成登录 CSRF。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is state not stored per session or checks being bypassable: cross-site pages complete callbacks with forged state, binding attacker accounts into victim sessions as login CSRF.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把缺失、空值、固定与可预测 state 逐条注入 OAuth 回调流程，记录登录是否完成及账号绑定对象：服务端不校验 state 仍建立会话即确认登录 CSRF，以会话建立与 state 消费记录为成功判据，并用会话快照留证；回调被拒绝且无会话建立则说明防护有效。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject missing, empty, fixed and predictable state values into the OAuth callback flow one by one per the script, recording whether logins complete and which accounts bind; the server establishing sessions without state validation confirms login CSRF, evidenced by session snapshots. Judge success by callback-rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: state 由 CSPRNG 生成并与发起会话绑定存储，回调时严格比对并一次性消费。修复后重放第 1 步，全部异常 state 应被拒绝且无账号绑定发生。
mitigation.en: Generate state with a CSPRNG bound to the initiating session, compare strictly on callback and consume once. After the fix, replay step 1: every anomalous state should be rejected with no account binding.

name.zh: target=_blank 的 opener 隔离对照

description.zh: 比较 rel=opener、noopener、noreferrer 与无相关关键字时新标签页是否保留 opener，并以现代浏览器隐式 noopener 为基线。
description.en: Compares rel=opener, noopener, noreferrer, and unrelated link types for opener retention in a new tab, using modern implicit noopener behavior as the baseline.

prerequisites.zh: 使用支持 target=_blank 隐式 noopener 的当前浏览器，并记录版本、COOP 响应头与扩展策略。
prerequisites.en: Use a current browser that implements implicit noopener for target=_blank and record the version, COOP headers, and extension policies.

prerequisites.zh: 测试链接和目标页均由授权域控制，目标页只读取 `window.opener === null` 并返回固定布尔标记。
prerequisites.en: Both link and destination pages are controlled, and the destination only reports a fixed Boolean marker for `window.opener === null`.

execution.command: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

description.zh: 用不同 rel 组合打开外链并检查 window.opener；保留 opener 引用的页面即存在反向 tabnabbing 风险。
description.en: Open the external links with different rel combinations and inspect window.opener; pages retaining the opener reference carry reverse-tabnabbing risk.

analysis.zh: 行 0 的 `rel=opener` 是现代浏览器中的显式 opt-in 候选；行 1、4 使用 noopener，行 5 的 noreferrer 蕴含 noopener；行 2、3 虽无 noopener，但现代 `_blank` 仍隐式隔离，只有旧浏览器可作为兼容性例外。新标签打开成功不是 reverse tabnabbing 阳性。
analysis.en: Line 0 with `rel=opener` is the explicit modern opt-in candidate; lines 1 and 4 use noopener, and noreferrer on line 5 implies noopener. Lines 2 and 3 omit it but modern `_blank` still isolates implicitly, with legacy browsers only as compatibility exceptions. A successfully opened tab is not a reverse-tabnabbing finding.

opsecTips.zh: 目标页首次确认 opener 非空后停止，只执行跳转到本地无害标记页，不展示登录表单或采集导航数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the destination first confirms a non-null opener and navigate only to a local harmless marker page; do not display login forms or collect navigation data.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭所有测试标签，清理站点数据与 service worker，恢复 COOP/响应头并删除目标页的临时 opener 日志。
opsecTips.en: Close all test tabs, clear site data and service workers, restore COOP and response headers, and delete temporary opener logs on the destination.

description.zh: 绕过对 a 标签 rel 属性扫描：JS 打开新窗并反向操控 opener；原标签页被导航到攻击域即成功。
description.en: Open via JS and control the opener in reverse past anchor rel scanning; the original tab navigating to the attacker domain confirms success.

description.zh: 表单 target 属性同样创建新上下文且无 rel 保护；提交后新页 opener 仍指向原页即成功。
description.en: A form target also creates a new browsing context without rel protection; after submission the new page's opener still referencing the original confirms success.

description.zh: 利用旧浏览器仅实现 noreferrer 不隐含 noopener 的兼容差异；新页可访问 window.opener 即成功。
description.en: Exploit older browsers implementing noreferrer without the implicit noopener; the new page reaching window.opener confirms success.

wafBypass.command: <form action="https://{ATTACKER_HOST}" target="_blank"><input type="image" src="play-button.png" alt="播放"></form>

description.zh: 以图像提交控件替代 area 元素且保留 _blank 行为；提交后新页持有 opener 引用即成功。
description.en: Replace the area with an image-submit control preserving _blank behavior; the new page holding an opener reference after submission confirms success.

description.zh: 链接 target 指向命名框架替代 _blank：导航已有上下文更难被 rel 规则约束；框架被替换为攻击页即成功。
description.en: Target a named frame instead of _blank, evading rel-oriented rules; the frame being replaced with the attacker page confirms success.

description.zh: 静态扫描时无 target 属性：点击瞬间动态注入 _blank 与真实地址；新开页面保留 opener 即成功。
description.en: Inject target and href at click time so static scans see neither; the newly opened page retaining opener confirms success.

description.zh: 点击图像映射 area 链接打开新上下文；新页面保留 opener 即确认 area 目标的 opener 未隔离。
description.en: Click the image-map area link to open a new context; the new page retaining opener confirms unisolated opener on area targets.

description.zh: 遍历站点页面与文章正文，收集指向外部域且带 target=_blank 的链接并记录各自 rel 属性组合；整理出候选入口后逐一进入检测阶段。
description.en: Crawl pages and article bodies for external target=_blank links, noting each rel combination; the inventory becomes the detection queue.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

title.zh: 检测 opener 引用是否保留

description.zh: 用第 1 步收集的 rel 组合打开外链并在新页面检查 window.opener；保留 opener 引用且未显式隔离的链接即存在反向 tabnabbing 条件。
description.en: Open links with each collected rel combo and inspect window.opener in the new tab; a surviving reference without explicit isolation marks reversibly-nabbable links.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

title.en: Navigate the opener to a phishing page

description.zh: 在可控外页执行 opener.location 跳转到钓鱼域；原标签被静默替换为仿真登录页，等待受害者回访输入凭据即完成攻击闭环。
description.en: From the controlled page set opener.location to a phishing domain; the silently swapped tab harvests credentials when the victim returns.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 target 空白新页的 opener 隔离场景，检验不同 rel 组合下新标签页对原窗口的引用保留。验证维度为 opener、noopener、noreferrer 与缺省四类组合的对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers opener isolation for blank-target new pages, testing whether new tabs keep references to the original window across rel combinations. Validation contrasts opener, noopener, noreferrer and default combos, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于旧浏览器对 target 空白链接默认传递 opener 引用：被打开的外部页面获得原窗口控制权，可反向导航至钓鱼页，形成反向标签劫持。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is older browsers passing opener by default for blank-target links: the opened external page gains control of the original window and can reverse-navigate it to a phishing page, forming reverse tabnabbing.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含四种 rel 组合链接的对照页并逐一打开，在每个新标签页检查 window.opener 是否可用：保留引用的组合即存在反向劫持风险，同时与当前浏览器隐式 noopener 基线对照记录版本差异。成功判据以 opener 可用性矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a comparison page with the four rel-combination links and open each, checking window.opener availability in every new tab; combos retaining the reference carry reverse-hijack risk, and compare against the current browser's implicit-noopener baseline for version differences. Judge success by the opener-availability matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 全部外链显式添加 rel="noopener noreferrer"，出站跳转服务统一注入；对旧浏览器保留降级提示。修复后重放第 1 步，所有组合的 opener 均应为空。
mitigation.en: Explicitly add rel noopener noreferrer to all external links, injecting uniformly via the outbound-redirect service, with downgrade notices for legacy browsers. After the fix, replay step 1: opener should be null across all combos.

name.zh: 认证会话 Set-Cookie CRLF 注入

description.zh: 验证用户输入未经服务端过滤编码即进入 HTTP 响应头时，能否注入新的 Set-Cookie，从而造成会话固定或响应拆分。
description.en: Tests whether unencoded input reaches HTTP response headers and injects a new Set-Cookie header, enabling session fixation or response splitting.

prerequisites.zh: 定位一个用户输入会进入响应 Header 的测试端点，并在隔离浏览器与代理中记录原始响应字节、解码次数和 Header 列表。
prerequisites.en: Locate a test endpoint where user input reaches a response header, and record raw response bytes, decode count, and header list in an isolated browser and proxy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一无权限 Cookie 名和值，准备未编码、单编码、双编码和无 CRLF 的对照，确保没有真实会话同名。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique nonprivileged cookie name and value, with unencoded, single-encoded, double-encoded, and no-CRLF controls, ensuring no real session shares the name.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Authentication Session Set-Cookie CRLF Injection

execution.command:
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: JSESSIONID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: PHPSESSID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: ASP.NET_SessionId=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: connect.sid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: _rails_session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: rack.session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: sid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: auth_token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: access_token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: csrf_token=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: XSRF-TOKEN=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: _csrf=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: __cfduid=attacker_cfduid
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: AWSALB=attacker_alb
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: AWSALBCORS=attacker_alb

description.zh: 把 Set-Cookie 注入变体逐条置于头值或参数；响应出现攻击者可控的会话 Cookie，即确认响应分割注入。
description.en: Place each Set-Cookie injection variant into header values or parameters; an attacker-controlled session cookie appearing in the response confirms response-splitting injection.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求编码 CRLF 被响应链解码为新的独立 Set-Cookie Header，真实浏览器存储了唯一 canary Cookie，原始字节和代理日志可证明分割位置。payload 出现在请求、应用日志或响应体，Header 值保留 `%0d%0a`，浏览器拒绝 Cookie，或服务端自行设置同名 Cookie都不是响应头注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires encoded CRLF to become a separate Set-Cookie response header, with a real browser storing the unique canary cookie and raw bytes plus proxy logs proving the split. A payload in the request, application log, or response body, a header retaining %0d%0a, browser rejection, or the server independently setting the same cookie is not response-header injection.

opsecTips.zh: 唯一 canary Cookie 首次被浏览器存储后停止，不注入真实 session ID、额外 Header 或响应体。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the unique canary cookie is stored once by the browser; do not inject a real session ID, extra headers, or response body.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 canary Cookie 和测试输入，清除浏览器/代理缓存与原始捕获，并恢复 Header 编码和 CRLF 拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Delete the canary cookie and test input, clear browser and proxy caches and raw captures, and restore header encoding and CRLF rejection.

title.zh: 双重/三重 URL 编码

description.zh: 绕过单次解码后匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF：应用二次解码时双重编码逐层还原；成功判据：响应头多出攻击者可控的 sessionid/JSESSIONID Cookie（响应中出现两个 Set-Cookie 行）。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after a single decode: double encoding peels back when the application decodes twice; success criterion: an attacker-controlled sessionid/JSESSIONID cookie appears as an extra Set-Cookie line in the response.

title.zh: 头名大小写与 OWS 变形

description.zh: 绕过对 "%0d%0aSet-Cookie: "（含空格）精确模板的规则：全大写/小写头名、去空格、冒号前空格与制表符均被响应解析器归一为合法 Set-Cookie；成功判据：会话 Cookie 被注入覆盖（客户端拿到 attacker_session_id）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the exact "%0d%0aSet-Cookie: " template: all-caps/lowercase names, missing space, space-before-colon and tab are all normalized as a valid Set-Cookie by response parsers; success criterion: the injected cookie overrides the session (client holds attacker_session_id).

title.zh: 仅 LF/仅 CR 分隔注入

description.zh: 绕过只拦截成对 %0d%0a 的规则：不少容器（Node/Python 部分服务器）接受裸 LF 或裸 CR 作为头边界；成功判据：仅 LF 或仅 CR 变体仍在响应中注入 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses rules blocking only the paired %0d%0a: several stacks (Node/Python servers) accept bare LF or bare CR as header boundaries; success criterion: a bare-LF or bare-CR variant still injects the cookie into the response.

description.zh: 绕过对 "Set-Cookie: name=value" 明文结构的规则：把冒号、等号、下划线、分号与 Path 属性整体 percent-encode，应用解码后语义完整；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效且作用域为根路径（Path=/）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the plaintext "Set-Cookie: name=value" structure: percent-encoding the colon, equals, underscores, semicolon and Path attribute keeps semantics intact after application decoding; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect scoped to the root path (Path=/).

title.zh: 空字节前缀与 Unicode 变形

description.zh: 绕过在 NUL 处截断或仅匹配标准编码的输入校验：NUL 中缀被宽容容器丢弃、%u 宽转义与 %c0%8d 过长编码在旧解析器还原为 CRLF；成功判据：响应中仍出现注入的 Set-Cookie 行。
description.en: Bypasses input validation that truncates at NUL or matches only canonical encodings: lenient containers drop the null infix, while %u wide escapes and %c0%8d overlong sequences decode to CRLF on legacy parsers; success criterion: the injected Set-Cookie line still appears in the response.

description.zh: 绕过单次解码匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF 规则：二次解码漏洞下双重编码还原；成功判据：响应多出注入的管理 Cookie 行。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after one decode: double encoding restores under double-decode flaws; success criterion: an injected admin cookie line appears in the response.

title.zh: 头名大小写与空白变形

description.zh: 绕过对 "Set-Cookie:" 精确字面（首字母大写+冒号后无空格）的规则：全大写/全小写、冒号前空格、制表符分隔等形态解析等价；成功判据：任一形态在响应中生效注入。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the exact "Set-Cookie:" literal: all-caps/lowercase, space before the colon and tab separators parse equivalently; success criterion: any form successfully injects into the response.

description.zh: 绕过对 admin=true 与 Path/Domain 明文特征的规则：等号、分号与属性名全部 percent-encode，应用解码后仍是合法 Cookie；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效且带预期 Path/Domain 作用域。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the plaintext admin=true and Path/Domain features: encoding equals signs, semicolons and attribute names still yields a legal cookie after app decoding; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect with the intended Path/Domain scope.

title.zh: 空字节与 Unicode 变形

description.zh: 绕过 NUL 截断与规范编码匹配：NUL 中缀被丢弃、宽/过长编码在宽容层还原 CRLF；成功判据：响应中仍出现注入 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses NUL truncation and canonical-encoding matching: null infixes are dropped while wide/overlong encodings restore CRLF at lenient layers; success criterion: the injected cookie still appears in the response.

title.zh: Cookie 名编码与属性走私

description.zh: 绕过对完整 "Set-Cookie:admin=true" 串的规则：Cookie 名 percent-encode、全大写或附带标准属性扩展载荷，并在尾部续接第二跳注入（X-Frame-Options）；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效或额外头出现。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the full "Set-Cookie:admin=true" string: percent-encoding the cookie name, all-caps values, appending standard attributes, or chaining a second header (X-Frame-Options) after it; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect or the extra header appears.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic Response Set-Cookie CRLF Injection

description.zh: 把 CRLF 加 Set-Cookie 变体逐条注入；响应出现注入的会话或权限 Cookie，即确认 Cookie 响应注入。
description.en: Inject each CRLF Set-Cookie variant; injected session or privilege cookies appearing in the response confirm cookie response injection.

description.zh: 确认普通输入进入哪个响应头及经过哪些代理解码。
description.en: Confirm which response header receives normal input and which proxies decode it.

attackChain.payload:
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: JSESSIONID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: PHPSESSID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: ASP.NET_SessionId=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: connect.sid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: _rails_session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: rack.session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: sid=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: auth_token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: access_token=attacker_token
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: csrf_token=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: XSRF-TOKEN=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: _csrf=attacker_csrf
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: __cfduid=attacker_cfduid
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: AWSALB=attacker_alb
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: AWSALBCORS=attacker_alb

description.zh: 发送原始 CRLF 集合并捕获未经工具重排的原始响应字节。
description.en: Send the original CRLF set and capture raw response bytes before tooling reorders headers.

description.zh: 在隔离浏览器确认 Cookie 存储和后续发送，排除仅正文反射。
description.en: Confirm cookie storage and subsequent transmission in an isolated browser, excluding body-only reflection.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖认证会话 Set-Cookie 注入场景，检验未编码输入进入响应头后的会话固定与拆分影响。验证维度为多类会话 Cookie 名的 CRLF 注入变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Set-Cookie injection on authentication sessions, testing session-fixation and splitting impacts when unencoded input reaches response headers. Validation is a CRLF injection variant matrix over multiple session cookie names, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录或会话接口把用户输入写入 Set-Cookie 值而未过滤换行：攻击者注入攻击者会话 ID 或追加任意头，固定受害者会话或拆分响应。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is login or session interfaces writing user input into Set-Cookie values without newline filtering: attackers inject their session IDs or append arbitrary headers, fixing victim sessions or splitting responses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把 Set-Cookie 注入变体逐条置于可回显的头值或路径参数提交，检查响应头是否出现攻击者可控的会话 Cookie：命中后在浏览器验证 Cookie 被实际设置，再以固定会话访问受保护端点验证完整影响。成功判据以浏览器 Cookie 状态为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit Set-Cookie injection variants one by one in echoable header values or path parameters, checking responses for attacker-controlled session cookies; on a hit, verify in a browser that the cookie is actually set, then access protected endpoints with the fixed session to prove full impact. Judge success by browser cookie state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 会话值进入响应头前做严格字符校验并拒绝换行，框架层启用头注入防护；登录后轮换会话 ID。修复后重放第 1 步，全部变体应被过滤且无异常 Cookie 生成。
mitigation.en: Strictly validate characters before session values enter headers and reject newlines, enabling framework header-injection protections; rotate session IDs after login. After the fix, replay step 1: every variant should be filtered with no anomalous cookies set.

review.reason: qa-final-2026-09 内容质量终审文案修复

name.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Django 版本漏洞与配置回归验证：从 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测，到 DEBUG 页面配置提取与 signing 签名伪造，再到静态目录路径遍历，用于确认部署的安全配置缺口。
description.en: Covers Django version-vulnerability and configuration regression validation: from CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing through DEBUG-page configuration extraction and signing forgery to static-directory path traversal, confirming security-configuration gaps in deployments.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

execution.command:
# CVE-2020-7471
Model.objects.filter(data__contains={"key": "value; DROP TABLE users;--"})
Model.objects.filter(tags__contains=["tag'); DROP TABLE users;--"])

description.zh: 在 __contains 查找值中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，验证字段查找参数被拼接进 SQL 而非参数化。
description.en: Embed SQL comment and statement fragments inside __contains lookup values, verifying lookup arguments are concatenated into SQL instead of being parameterized.

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页面提取配置
title.en: Trigger the DEBUG page and extract configuration

execution.command:
curl -s http://{LAB_APP}/nonexistent
# DEBUG 页面泄露清单
- SECRET_KEY
- DATABASES
- ALLOWED_HOSTS

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django DEBUG 报错页，从中确认 SECRET_KEY、数据库配置与 ALLOWED_HOSTS 的泄露。
description.en: Request a nonexistent path to raise the Django DEBUG error page and confirm the leak of SECRET_KEY, database settings, and ALLOWED_HOSTS.

title.zh: 伪造 Django signing 签名

execution.command:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 拿到 SECRET_KEY 后用 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值并以 loads 校验通过，验证签名机制在密钥泄露后可被伪造。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY in hand, craft arbitrary session values with signing.dumps and pass loads verification, proving signatures are forgeable once the key leaks.

title.zh: 静态目录路径遍历验证

description.zh: 以 GET 与 curl --path-as-is 请求穿越 /static 的相对路径，验证服务端不规范化 ../ 时可读取 /etc/passwd。
description.en: Request a ../ traversal under /static with GET and curl --path-as-is, verifying /etc/passwd is readable when the server does not normalize dot segments.

analysis.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 对同一遍历路径分别施加单次编码、双重编码与 UTF-8 超长编码，验证仅做一次解码的黑名单拦截可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, double encoding, and UTF-8 overlong encoding to the same traversal path, verifying blacklists that decode once can be evaded.

explanation.zh: UTF-8 超长编码的 /，部分解析器会接受
explanation.en: UTF-8 overlong encoding of /, accepted by some parsers

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页提取配置

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django 报错页，确认调试模式并提取路由、中间件、数据库引擎与主机白名单等配置信息；SECRET_KEY 等敏感项为掩码显示，需另寻泄露渠道。命中判据：报错页暴露调试与配置细节。
description.en: Request a missing path to pop the DEBUG page and lift SECRET_KEY/DATABASES. Success: secrets appear on the error page.

description.zh: 用泄露的 SECRET_KEY 以 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值，并通过 loads 检查。命中判据：伪造会话被服务端接受。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY, mint session values via signing.dumps that pass loads. Success: forged sessions are accepted.

attackChain.payload:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，利用参数拼接执行。命中判据：注入语句影响聚合结果或触发数据库报错。
description.en: Tuck SQL comment/fragments into __contains lookup values. Success: injected SQL alters query results.

attackChain.payload:
# CVE-2020-7471
Model.objects.filter(data__contains={"key": "value; DROP TABLE users;--"})
Model.objects.filter(tags__contains=["tag'); DROP TABLE users;--"])

description.zh: 以 --path-as-is 请求 /static 加 ../ 穿越序列读取系统文件。命中判据：读到 /etc/passwd 内容。
description.en: Request /static with ../ sequences using --path-as-is. Success: /etc/passwd content is returned.

title.zh: 编码变形绕过路径过滤

description.zh: 穿越序列被过滤时改用双重编码与过度编码 UTF-8 变形提交请求。命中判据：变形路径成功读取目标文件内容。
description.en: When ../ is filtered, switch to double-encoded and overlong UTF-8 variants. Success: a mutated path reads files.

overview.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归针对 Django 部署的配置缺口场景。覆盖 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测、DEBUG 页面配置提取、signing 签名伪造与静态目录路径遍历四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Django version and security-configuration regression targets configuration gaps in Django deployments. It covers four verification dimensions: CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing, DEBUG-page configuration extraction, signing forgery, and static-directory path traversal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因按维度不同：StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数未做 SQL 转义即拼接进聚合 SQL；DEBUG 开启使错误页暴露应用配置与调试信息（SECRET_KEY 等敏感项被掩码显示）；静态处理未规范化 ../ 导致目录穿越；密钥泄露后 signing 机制可被伪造。
vulnerability.en: Root causes differ by dimension: __contains lookup values are concatenated into StringAgg-generated SQL; DEBUG on leaks SECRET_KEY and database settings via error pages; static handling without ../ normalization allows traversal; and with the key leaked, the signing mechanism can be forged.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先请求不存在路径触发 DEBUG 页，确认调试模式与配置暴露；拿到泄露密钥（需结合 .env/源码等其他渠道）后用第 3 步 signing.dumps 伪造会话值并以 loads 校验；再用第 1 步在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 夹带 SQL 片段验证注入；最后用第 4 步 curl --path-as-is 验证 /static 穿越。被拦截时改用路径编码变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request a nonexistent path to trigger the DEBUG page and confirm SECRET_KEY and database-setting leakage; with the key, forge session values via step 3's signing.dumps verified by loads; then test StringAgg injection with step 1's SQL fragments inside __contains values; finally verify /static traversal with step 4's curl --path-as-is. Use path-encoding variants when blocked.

mitigation.zh: 生产关闭 DEBUG，SECRET_KEY 进入密钥管理并轮换已泄露密钥，升级到修复 CVE-2020-7471 与 CVE-2021-28658 的版本，静态服务规范化路径并限定根目录。修复后重放第 1-4 步，确认错误页无配置、签名校验拒绝伪造值且遍历被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable DEBUG in production, move SECRET_KEY into secret management and rotate leaked keys, upgrade to versions fixing CVE-2020-7471 and CVE-2021-28658, and normalize static paths within a confined root. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm error pages leak nothing, signature checks reject forgeries, and traversal is denied.

name.zh: WinRM/PSRemoting 远程执行

description.zh: 覆盖 WinRM 远程管理通道的横向移动验证：从 PowerShell 远程会话建立与 Invoke-Command 命令执行，到 evil-winrm 交互式 Shell 接入，验证管理凭据在横向移动中的可用性与会话审计痕迹。
description.en: Covers lateral movement validation over the WinRM remote management channel: from establishing PowerShell remote sessions and running commands via Invoke-Command to interactive evil-winrm shell access, verifying the usability of management credentials for lateral movement and the session audit traces.

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

description.zh: 建立 PowerShell 远程会话；进入交互提示符且远程命令可执行，即确认 WinRM 可达与凭据有效。
description.en: Open a PowerShell remote session; an interactive prompt with executable remote commands confirms WinRM reachability and valid credentials.

description.zh: 远程执行 whoami；返回目标主机上的账户身份即确认远程命令执行可用。
description.en: Run whoami remotely; the returned target-host account identity confirms remote command execution.

description.zh: 用 evil-winrm 连接目标；获得交互 shell 即确认 5985/5986 端口与凭据可用。
description.en: Connect with evil-winrm; an interactive shell confirms the 5985/5986 endpoint and credentials work.

analysis.zh: 结论必须记录单一目标、身份、认证方式、监听地址、命令输出和服务端审计事件；帮助文本或端口开放不能单独证明横向移动风险。
analysis.en: Conclusions must record one target, identity, authentication method, listener address, command output, and server audit events; help text or an open port alone does not prove lateral-movement risk.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: 原生 winrs 规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Enter-PSSession/Invoke-Command 触发的 PowerShell scriptblock 日志（Event 4104）与模块日志：改用原生 WSMan 客户端 winrs.exe，命令不进 PS 引擎。成功判据：回显执行身份且目标无 4104 事件产生。
description.en: Evades PowerShell scriptblock logging (Event 4104) and module logging triggered by Enter-PSSession/Invoke-Command by using the native WSMan client winrs.exe so commands never enter the PS engine. Success: command output returns and no 4104 events appear on the target.

description.zh: 绕过 5985 明文 HTTP 上的 WinRM 明文流量检测与默认路径特征：走 5986 TLS 通道并改写脚本/可执行目录。成功判据：TLS 握手建立且会话可执行命令。
description.en: Evades cleartext WinRM detection on 5985 and default-path signatures by moving to the 5986 TLS channel with relocated script/executable dirs. Success: TLS handshake completes and commands run in session.

description.zh: 绕过 scriptblock 日志对明文命令体的哈希记录：运行期以字符串构造 ScriptBlock 再 Invoke。成功判据：命令执行但 4104 中无明文命令体。
description.en: Evades scriptblock-log hashing of plaintext command bodies by constructing the ScriptBlock at runtime from a string before invoking. Success: the command executes yet 4104 contains no plaintext body.

title.zh: 建立WinRM 远程管理安全预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 WinRM 远程管理安全预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条WinRM 远程管理安全预检验证命令
title.en: Run One Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 WinRM 远程管理安全预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联WinRM 远程管理安全预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 把配置展开、单主机响应、身份、端口、认证方式与 Windows 事件日志（WinRM/PowerShell 操作通道）对照，不把连接成功或客户端存在直接视为越权。
description.en: Correlate configuration expansion, one-host responses, identity, port, authentication method, and Windows or OpenSSH audit logs without treating client availability or connection success as unauthorized access.

title.zh: 修复并回归WinRM 远程管理安全预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight

description.zh: 完成 WinRM 远程管理安全预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WinRM 远程管理通道的横向预检场景，检验 5985 或 5986 端口与凭据的远程执行可达性。验证维度含 PowerShell 交互会话、远程命令执行与 evil-winrm 三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers lateral-movement prechecks over the WinRM management channel, testing remote-execution reachability on ports 5985 or 5986 with given credentials. Validation covers an interactive PowerShell session, remote command execution and evil-winrm, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WinRM 默认对具备本地管理员或远程管理组成员的凭据开放：凭据一旦泄露，攻击者无需额外漏洞即可获得受控主机的命令执行与交互 Shell。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WinRM open by default to credentials in the local Administrators or Remote Management Users groups: once credentials leak, attackers gain command execution and an interactive shell on the host with no extra vulnerability needed.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 Enter-PSSession 携带测试凭据建立远程会话，进入交互提示符即确认端口与凭据可用；第 2 步以 Invoke-Command 执行 whoami，返回目标主机身份即确认命令执行面；第 3 步用 evil-winrm 连接获得交互 Shell，记录会话特性供后续操作。以远程命令回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅对授权主机发起连接。
exploitation.en: In step 1, establish a remote session with Enter-PSSession using test credentials; an interactive prompt confirms port and credential availability. In step 2, run whoami via Invoke-Command; the target-host identity confirms the execution surface. In step 3, obtain an interactive shell with evil-winrm and record session traits for follow-up. Judge success by remote command output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; connect only to authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh: 限制 WinRM 监听范围与远程管理组成员，启用 HTTPS 传输与 just-enough-administration 约束。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，未授权凭据的会话应被拒绝且登录监控告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict WinRM listeners and Remote Management Users membership, enforce HTTPS transport, and constrain via Just Enough Administration. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: unauthorized-credential sessions should be denied with logon alerts.

name.zh: WinRS 原生远程 Shell

description.zh: 覆盖 WinRS 原生远程 Shell 客户端的横向移动验证：从 winrs 指定远程主机执行单条命令，到直接拉起 cmd 交互式 Shell，验证管理凭据经 Windows 远程 Shell 通道控制目标的能力与审计痕迹。
description.en: Covers lateral movement validation with the native WinRS remote shell client: from running a single command on the remote host via winrs to spawning an interactive cmd shell directly, verifying the ability of management credentials to control the target over the Windows remote shell channel and the audit traces.

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

description.zh: 用 winrs 远程执行 whoami；返回目标账户身份即确认 WinRM 远程执行可用。
description.en: Run whoami via winrs; the returned target account confirms WinRM remote execution.

description.zh: 用 winrs 拉起远程 cmd；获得命令输出通道即确认交互式远程控制可用。
description.en: Spawn a remote cmd via winrs; a working command-output channel confirms interactive remote control.

analysis.zh: 结论必须记录单一目标、身份、认证方式、监听地址、命令输出和服务端审计事件；帮助文本或端口开放不能单独证明横向移动风险。
analysis.en: Conclusions must record one target, identity, authentication method, listener address, command output, and server audit events; help text or an open port alone does not prove lateral-movement risk.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: Kerberos 票据认证规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 NTLM 登录事件洪泛（4624 Type3 告警）：先注入 Kerberos 票据再用 winrs 认证。成功判据：命令执行且事件日志以 Kerberos（Type8/TGT）为主。
description.en: Evades NTLM logon-event flooding (4624 Type3 alerts) by injecting a Kerberos ticket before authenticating winrs. Success: command executes and event logs show Kerberos (Type8/TGT) instead.

description.zh: 绕过命令回显流量特征：输出重定向到共享文件再回读，避免 stdout 通道被 DLP 捕获。成功判据：out.txt 含执行身份内容。
description.en: Evades command-echo traffic signatures by redirecting output to a share file and reading it back, keeping stdout off the DLP-monitored channel. Success: out.txt contains the execution identity.

title.zh: 计划任务间接执行规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 WinRS 即时会话的进程链检测：以系统维护类任务名经计划任务间接执行。成功判据：任务运行后 h.log 生成。
description.en: Evades WinRS immediate-session process-chain detection by executing indirectly via a scheduled task with a maintenance-style name. Success: h.log appears after the task runs.

title.zh: 建立WinRS 横向管理能力预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 WinRS 横向管理能力预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条WinRS 横向管理能力预检验证命令
title.en: Run One WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 WinRS 横向管理能力预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联WinRS 横向管理能力预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 把配置展开、单主机响应、身份、端口、认证方式与 Windows 事件日志（WinRM 操作通道）对照，不把连接成功或客户端存在直接视为越权。
description.en: Correlate configuration expansion, one-host responses, identity, port, authentication method, and Windows or OpenSSH audit logs without treating client availability or connection success as unauthorized access.

title.zh: 修复并回归WinRS 横向管理能力预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight

description.zh: 完成 WinRS 横向管理能力预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for WinRS Lateral-Management Capability Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WinRS 横向管理能力预检场景，检验单命令执行与交互通道两条路径的可用性。验证维度含远程命令执行与远程 cmd 拉起两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WinRS lateral-management capability prechecks, testing single-command execution and interactive channel paths. Validation covers remote command execution and spawning a remote cmd, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WinRS 与 WinRM 共享同一信任模型且常与管理端口同时开放：持有有效凭据的攻击者用一条命令即可完成远程执行预检并升级为交互控制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WinRS sharing WinRM's trust model and typically coexisting with management ports: an attacker holding valid credentials prechecks remote execution with a single command and upgrades to interactive control.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 winrs 携带凭据远程执行 whoami，返回目标账户身份即确认远程执行可用；第 2 步以同一凭据拉起远程 cmd 验证交互通道，记录输出回传方式。以命令回显与通道建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；与第 1 步结果交叉核对以区分端口开放与凭据有效。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run whoami remotely with winrs carrying credentials; the target-account identity confirms remote execution. In step 2, spawn a remote cmd with the same credentials to verify the interactive channel, recording how output returns. Judge success by command output and channel establishment. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; cross-check with step 1 to separate open ports from valid credentials.

mitigation.zh: 与 WinRM 一并收紧监听与组成员，命令行审计覆盖 winrs 调用。修复后重放第 1、2 步，未授权凭据应被 401 拒绝且事件日志出现失败记录。
mitigation.en: Tighten listeners and group membership together with WinRM, and audit command lines covering winrs invocations. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: unauthorized credentials should get 401 with failure events logged.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归

description.zh: 验证 ProxyLogon（CVE-2021-26855）SSRF 前提到 Exchange 后台的补丁回归。
description.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 已知利用链与访问边界

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归校正命令 1
title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时目标路径返回非 404 响应，确认前置可达路径存在。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_1 with blue-team logs; the target path returning a non-404 response confirms the precondition path exists.

title.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归校正命令 2
title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时脚本获取管理员会话并输出服务器名或内存马地址。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_2 with blue-team logs; the script obtaining the admin session and printing the server name or shellfish address confirms success.

title.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归校正命令 3
title.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时请求被代理到后端并返回 ECP 响应，确认代理链路。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYLOGON_E_3 with blue-team logs; the request proxying to the backend and returning an ECP response confirms the proxy chain.

analysis.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过按 localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 字面匹配 X-AnonResource-Backend 的 WAF 规则：将主机换成 127.0.0.1、对 / ? ~ # 分别做 %2F %3F %7E %23 单元编码并改大小写，Cookie 解码后 SSRF 链等价而签名不命中；成功判据：响应仍出现 X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget 头或 FBA 行为与原链一致。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching the literal localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 in X-AnonResource-Backend: swapping to 127.0.0.1 and unit-encoding / ? ~ # as %2F %3F %7E %23 with case variance keeps the decoded SSRF chain equivalent; success criterion: response still carries X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget or identical FBA behavior.

description.zh: 绕过对 X-BEResource 中 %23~ 定界符（后端定位 + 端口）特征拦截：一次编码 %23、双重编码 %2523、主机大小写与 ~1/~3 端口变体在反代解码后仍指向后端邮箱服务器；成功判据：响应非 401/403 且出现后端服务器特征（X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo），说明请求被转发到后端角色。
description.en: Bypasses rules keyed on the %23~ delimiter in X-BEResource (backend host + port): single %23, double %2523, host case and ~1/~3 port variants still resolve to the backend mailbox server after proxy decoding; success criterion: a non-401/403 response with backend markers (X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo) proves backend routing.

title.zh: Legacy 前端路径变形探测

description.zh: 绕过仅对 /owa/auth/x.js 精确匹配的拦截与封禁：点段、双斜杠、大小写、%23 截断、; 截断与尾斜杠在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍命中 FBA 匿名端点；成功判据：变形路径返回与原始 x.js 相同的 200 状态与 FBA 页面指纹。
description.en: Bypasses blocks anchored to the exact /owa/auth/x.js: dot segments, double slashes, case, %23 or ; truncation and trailing slash still hit the FBA anonymous endpoint after front-end normalization; success criterion: variants return the same 200 and FBA page fingerprint as the original x.js.

description.zh: 绕过只对 GET/POST + HTTP/1.1 组合建模的 WAF 规则：HTTP/1.0、GET 带 Cookie、OPTIONS 与 chunked 传输在部分引擎走不同解析路径；成功判据：任一组合仍能携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 触发后端 SSRF 行为（响应头含 X-FEServer 或 FBA 特征）。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules modeling only GET/POST over HTTP/1.1: HTTP/1.0, GET with cookies, OPTIONS and chunked bodies take different parser paths in some engines; success criterion: any combination still carries X-AnonResource-Backend to trigger backend SSRF behavior (X-FEServer header or FBA signature).

title.zh: 探测 Exchange 前端暴露

description.zh: 用 curl 访问 /owa/auth/x.js 静态路径；返回 200 与版本特征即定位 CAS 前端角色并确认服务器在线。
description.en: Fetch /owa/auth/x.js with curl; a 200 with version fingerprints locates the CAS front-end role and confirms the server is live.

description.zh: 运行 proxylogon.py 指定目标与管理员邮箱；输出 LegacyDN 与 canary 即拿到经 SSRF 直达后端 ecp 的会话凭证。
description.en: Run proxylogon.py against the target and admin mailbox; LegacyDN and canary output are session material reaching the backend ecp via SSRF.

title.en: Land a webshell with raw requests

description.zh: 构造携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 与ClientId 的 POST 写入目标路径；服务器目录出现 webshell 文件即完成 RCE 持久入口。
description.en: Craft the POST with X-AnonResource-Backend and ClientId headers to write your path; a webshell on disk completes the persistent RCE foothold.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归覆盖 SSRF 与任意文件写入组合利用场景：针对未安装 2021-03 补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证前端到后端代理链与管理员会话获取链路。验证维度涵盖前置路径探测、proxylogon 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression covers combined SSRF and deserialization exploitation: for Exchange servers without the 2021-03 patch, verify the front-end-to-back-end proxy chain and admin-session acquisition. Verification dimensions cover the pre-condition path probe, one-shot proxylogon exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Exchange 前端对 /owa/auth/x.js 等静态资源不认证即转发后端，攻击者借前后端信任差异以 Exchange 机器账户身份直达后端 ECP，再经任意文件写入（CVE-2021-27065）落地 WebShell；补丁缺失与前后端信任边界过宽共同构成利用条件（同批补丁另含统一消息组件反序列化漏洞 CVE-2021-26857）。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Exchange front end forwards static resources such as /owa/auth/x.js to the back end without authentication; end-to-end SSRF via set-OwaVirtualDirectory grants back-end access as the Exchange machine account, after which a back-end deserialization flaw executes code. The missing patch plus an overly broad front-end/back-end trust boundary form the exploitation conditions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 /owa/auth/x.js，返回非 404 即确认前置可达路径存在；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxylogon.py，获取管理员会话并输出服务器名或内存马地址即确认利用成功；第 3 步用手工 POST 复现 Cookie 代理链（X-AnonResource-Backend 指向 ecp/default.flt），返回 ECP 响应即确认代理链路成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests /owa/auth/x.js — any non-404 response confirms the pre-condition path exists; step 2 runs proxylogon.py in an authorized lab — an admin session with the server name or webshell URL printed confirms exploitation; step 3 replays the Cookie proxy chain manually (X-AnonResource-Backend pointing at ecp/default.flt) — an ECP response confirms the proxy path. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 升级至受支持 CU 并安装 2021-03+ 安全更新，用 Exchange Server Health Checker 核验补丁状态；限制 ECP/PowerShell 暴露并审计异常 Autodiscover、EWS 与邮箱权限变更。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，代理链应返回 404/401 且利用失败。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install 2021-03+ security updates, verifying patch state with the Exchange Server Health Checker; restrict ECP/PowerShell exposure and audit anomalous Autodiscover, EWS, and mailbox permission changes. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: the proxy chain must return 404/401 and exploitation must fail.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时脚本完成利用并输出可访问的 WebShell 路径。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_2 with blue-team logs; the exploit completing and printing an accessible WebShell path confirms success.

title.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归校正命令 3
title.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时请求被转发至后端 /owa/ 并返回目标邮箱信息。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE_PROXYSHELL_E_3 with blue-team logs; the request forwarding to the backend /owa/ and returning target mailbox information confirms success.

analysis.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过对 autodiscover.json?@ 拼接特征（ProxyShell 标志）的规则：分别对 ? 和 @ 做 %3F %40 编码乃至双重编码 %253F，客户端证书豁免逻辑按 Email 前缀解析仍生效；成功判据：响应为 200/301 而非 401，且证书认证被跳过（无 WWW-Authenticate 提示）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the signature autodiscover.json?@ splice: encoding ? and @ as %3F %40 with double-encoding %253F keeps the client-cert exempt parsing by Email prefix intact; success criterion: a 200/301 instead of 401 with client-cert authentication skipped (no WWW-Authenticate challenge).

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感或按规范化前字面匹配的路径规则：目录大小写、点段插入、双斜杠与 %2e 变形在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍路由到 MAPI 后端；成功判据：状态码与原始请求一致（非 401），证明仍走了 ProxyShell 豁免链。
description.en: Bypasses case-sensitive or pre-normalization literal path rules: directory case, dot segments, doubled slashes and %2e still route to the MAPI backend after front-end normalization; success criterion: status codes match the original request (not 401), proving the ProxyShell exempt chain still applied.

description.zh: 绕过对 &Email= 参数特征匹配的规则：HPP 双 Email 取值、参数名小写 email、尾随无害参数 X-Pad 改变查询串形状而解析结果不变；成功判据：仍返回 200 且 Autodiscover/MAPI 响应内容与原请求一致。
description.en: Bypasses rules matching the &Email= parameter signature: HPP double-Email values, lowercase email name and a trailing X-Pad parameter reshape the query without changing parsed results; success criterion: still 200 with Autodiscover/MAPI bodies identical to the original request.

description.zh: 绕过只盯 /mapi/nspi 特征的拦截：同一 autodiscover.json 豁免链可换接 /mapi/emsmdb（代理登录端点）或 /EWS，再以 POST + MAPI 头完成认证；成功判据：emsmdb Authenticate 返回 200 且带 X-ResponseId/MAPI 会话 Cookie（与 ProxyShell 链一致）。
description.en: Bypasses blocks fixated on /mapi/nspi: the same autodiscover.json exemption chain attaches to /mapi/emsmdb (proxy logon endpoint) or /EWS, then completes auth via POST with MAPI headers; success criterion: emsmdb Authenticate returns 200 with X-ResponseId/MAPI session cookies as in the ProxyShell chain.

title.zh: 探测 autodiscover 认证旁路

description.zh: 用 curl 请求 autodiscover.json?@域/mapi/nspi 变形路径；返回接口数据而非登录跳转即认证绕过成立。
description.en: Request the autodiscover.json?@domain/mapi/nspi variant with curl; API data instead of a login redirect confirms the auth bypass.

title.zh: 链式利用导出邮箱与写权限
title.en: Chain the exploit to mail and write access

description.zh: 运行 proxyshell.py 指定管理员邮箱；依次输出 SID、邮件内容与可写路径即完成 SSRF 到 Exchange 管控面的贯穿。
description.en: Run proxyshell.py with the admin mailbox; SID, mailbox contents and writable paths printed in sequence complete the SSRF-to-Exchange-control chain.

description.zh: 以 Email 参数构造 GET /owa/ 请求；返回邮箱界面即能以目标身份收发邮件，可借重置链接接管关联账号。
description.en: Build the GET /owa/ request with the Email parameter; the mailbox UI lets you send and receive as the victim and hijack linked accounts via reset links.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归覆盖 Autodiscover 代理滥用场景：针对未安装相关安全补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证后端代理链与邮箱数据访问链路。验证维度涵盖 autodiscover.json 代理探测、proxyshell 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression covers Autodiscover proxy abuse: for Exchange servers missing the relevant security patches, verify the back-end proxy chain and mailbox data access. Verification dimensions cover the autodiscover.json proxy probe, one-shot proxyshell exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Autodiscover 端点把邮箱地址写入代理路径而未校验目标（CVE-2021-34473），后端 PowerShell 端点未强制认证（CVE-2021-34523）；两者组合使未认证用户可调用 Exchange PowerShell cmdlet 访问任意邮箱，进一步可写入 WebShell。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Autodiscover endpoint writing the mailbox address into the proxy path without validating the target (CVE-2021-34473) while the back-end PowerShell endpoint does not enforce authentication (CVE-2021-34523); combined, an unauthenticated user can invoke Exchange PowerShell cmdlets against any mailbox and even write a webshell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 autodiscover.json 代理路径，返回 200 即确认后端代理链路可用；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxyshell.py，输出可访问的 WebShell 路径即确认完整利用；第 3 步用手工 GET 把请求转发至后端 /owa/，返回目标邮箱信息即确认代理与身份绕过同时成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests the autodiscover.json proxy path — a 200 confirms the back-end proxy chain; step 2 runs proxyshell.py in an authorized lab — a printed accessible webshell path confirms full exploitation; step 3 forwards the request to the back-end /owa/ with a manual GET — returned mailbox information confirms both proxying and identity bypass. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 升级至受支持 CU 并安装覆盖三个 CVE 的安全更新，运行 Health Checker 核验；限制 Autodiscover/PowerShell 虚拟目录暴露并审计 PowerShell 管道调用与邮箱访问记录。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，代理路径应返回 401/404。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install security updates covering the three CVEs, verifying with the Health Checker; restrict Autodiscover/PowerShell virtual directory exposure and audit PowerShell pipeline invocations and mailbox access records. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the proxy path must return 401/404.

name.zh: 项目构建、依赖与 CI 文件暴露探测
name.en: Project Build, Dependency, and CI File Exposure Probes

description.zh: 检查构建清单、锁文件、CI 配置与项目策略文件的意外公开，以真实格式与部署标记验证。
description.en: Check for accidental exposure of build manifests, lock files, CI configs, and project policy files using realistic formats and deployment markers.

prerequisites.zh: 限定到自有 Web 根和低速率请求，建立随机不存在路径、前端 SPA fallback、目录重定向与公开文档基线。
prerequisites.en: Scope an owned web root and low request rate, establishing random nonexistent-path, frontend SPA-fallback, directory-redirect, and public-document baselines.

prerequisites.zh: 准备 JSON、YAML、XML、lockfile 与各构建系统解析器，并定义私有仓库、绝对路径、CI secret 和内部包名的脱敏规则。
prerequisites.en: Prepare parsers for JSON, YAML, XML, lockfiles, and build systems, and define redaction for private repositories, absolute paths, CI secrets, and internal package names.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Project Build, Dependency, and CI File Exposure Probes

description.zh: 其他源码泄露包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：路径返回 200 且内容为对应清单或配置格式。
description.en: Run this Project Build, Dependency, and CI File Exposure Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the path returns 200 with the matching manifest or configuration format.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求候选路径返回真实可解析且与部署项目一致的构建、依赖、CI 或策略文件；安全影响需存在非预期版本、脚本、内部 URL、路径或凭据。HTTP 200 的 SPA 页面、公开开源 manifest、空文件、HTML 错误、文件名索引、下载重定向、示例配置或格式解析失败均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a candidate path to return an authentic, parseable build, dependency, CI, or policy file matching the deployed project; security impact requires unintended versions, scripts, internal URLs, paths, or credentials. An SPA page with HTTP 200, public open-source manifest, empty file, HTML error, filename index, download redirect, sample configuration, or parse failure is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个真实文件及最小非敏感项目标记后停止，不递归探测源码目录、CI secrets 或依赖缓存。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic file and a minimal nonsensitive project marker; do not recursively probe source directories, CI secrets, or dependency caches.

opsecTips.zh: 删除下载/解析结果，清理访问日志和 CDN 缓存，撤销暴露的测试凭据，并收紧静态文件白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete downloads and parse results, clear access logs and CDN caches, revoke exposed test credentials, and tighten the static-file allowlist.

description.zh: 绕过以文件名结尾的精确规则。判据：返回文件内容。
description.en: Trailing null byte. Success: file content returned.

description.zh: 规范化等价但字面不同。判据：200 且含 services 段。
description.en: Equivalent after normalization. Success: 200 with a services block.

description.zh: 附加查询改变指纹。判据：200 返回 CI 配置。
description.en: Appended query alters the fingerprint. Success: CI config returned.

description.zh: 首字符十六进制编码绕过明文匹配。判据：返回构建文件。
description.en: First byte encoded. Success: build file returned.

description.zh: 记录随机路径、正常静态文件、SPA fallback 和一个已知测试 manifest 的响应特征。
description.en: Record response characteristics for random paths, normal static files, SPA fallback, and one known test manifest.

description.zh: 使用原始清单一次请求一个候选，限制速率并保存媒体类型与最小正文。
description.en: Use the original list to request one candidate at a time, rate-limit traffic, and retain media type and minimal body.

description.zh: 用对应 parser 验证语法、项目坐标和合成 canary，排除错误页、示例和公开清单。
description.en: Use the matching parser to verify syntax, project coordinates, and synthetic canary, excluding errors, samples, and public manifests.

description.zh: 从 Web 根和缓存移除配置文件，轮换测试凭据并重放代表性路径完成回归。
description.en: Remove configuration files from the web root and caches, rotate test credentials, and replay representative paths for regression.

overview.zh: 项目构建、依赖与 CI 文件暴露探测针对常见构建清单、锁文件、CI 配置和项目策略文件意外公开的场景：以真实格式与部署标记验证泄露。验证 /clientaccesspolicy.xml 等路径的可达性与内容特征。
overview.en: Project build, dependency, and CI file exposure probing targets build manifests, lockfiles, CI configuration, and project policy files unexpectedly published: verify by real format and deployment markers, no longer classed as SSRF. It validates reachability of /clientaccesspolicy.xml and sibling paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是把仓库根作为 Web 根、静态文件规则过宽、CI 产物包含源配置，或 CDN 缓存曾公开的文件；泄露可暴露依赖版本、构建脚本、内部注册表、绝对路径和流水线结构，但文件名存在本身没有影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually serving the repository root as the web root, overly broad static rules, CI artifacts carrying source configuration, or CDN caches of previously exposed files; leakage can expose dependency versions, build scripts, internal registries, absolute paths, and pipeline structure—filename existence alone carries no impact.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 /clientaccesspolicy.xml、/Gemfile.lock、/Pipfile、/Pipfile.lock 等清单逐条发起请求；命中判据为路径返回 200 且内容为对应清单或配置格式。每种文件用对应解析器确认（XML、TOML、JSON 等），把公开开源清单、客户端构建文件与部署私有配置分开评价；对照随机路径排除软 404，记录每个文件的敏感字段。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request /clientaccesspolicy.xml, /Gemfile.lock, /Pipfile, /Pipfile.lock, and sibling manifests one by one; a hit is 200 responses whose content matches the manifest or configuration format. Confirm each with its matching parser (XML, TOML, JSON, etc.), evaluating public open-source manifests, client build files, and deployment-private configuration separately; contrast random paths to exclude soft 404s and record sensitive fields per file.

mitigation.zh: 发布白名单内的构建产物而非仓库内容，在源站/CDN 禁止清单、锁文件、CI 和点配置路径；CI 增加产物扫描并在泄露后轮换相关凭据。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认业务静态资源可用且候选文件统一不可读。
mitigation.en: Release allowlisted build artifacts rather than repository content, blocking manifests, lockfiles, CI, and dot-config paths at origin/CDN; add artifact scanning in CI and rotate related credentials after leakage. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths, confirming business static assets work while candidate files are uniformly unreadable.
