name.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检

description.zh: 覆盖 Windows 进程注入能力验证：从经典 DLL 注入的远程内存写入流程、Process Hollowing 挂起进程替换五步链，到 APC 注入的异步队列调用，检验注入手法在终端防护下的行为特征。
description.en: Covers Windows process injection capability validation: from the remote memory write flow of classic DLL injection and the five-step suspended process replacement chain of Process Hollowing to APC injection via asynchronous queue calls, examining the behavioral signatures of injection under endpoint protection.

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: (0)确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间；先在实验机用 Add-Type 定义 [Win32.Kernel32] 的 OpenProcess/VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory/CreateRemoteThread/CreateThread/OpenThread/QueueUserAPC/ResumeThread/GetProcAddress/CreateProcess/NtUnmapViewOfSection P/Invoke 签名，并初始化 $dllPath、$kernel32、$loadLibraryAddr 等变量，否则命令片段无法执行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

description.zh: 向目标进程注入 DLL；成功时 CreateRemoteThread 返回有效句柄且目标模块列表出现注入的 DLL。
description.en: Inject a DLL into the target process; CreateRemoteThread returning a valid handle with the DLL appearing in the target module list confirms success.

execution.command:
# 进程镂空 API 序列（按顺序对应 loader 步骤）
# 1. CreateProcess(CREATE_SUSPENDED)
# 2. NtUnmapViewOfSection
# 3. VirtualAllocEx
# 4. WriteProcessMemory
# 5. ResumeThread

description.zh: 执行进程镂空五步序列；成功时挂起进程的映像被替换并恢复执行。
description.en: Run the five-step process-hollowing sequence; the suspended process image replaced and execution resumed confirms success.

description.zh: 向目标线程插入 APC 队列回调；成功时线程唤醒后执行加载例程并装载指定 DLL。
description.en: Queue an APC to the target thread; the loader routine executing and the specified DLL loading after the thread is alerted confirms success.

analysis.zh: 结论必须说明发布者、路径、策略规则、主体令牌和执行/写入证据；二进制存在或帮助输出不能单独证明绕过。
analysis.en: Conclusions must state publisher, path, policy rule, principal token, and execution or write evidence; binary presence or help output alone does not prove a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread 的经典组合检测：以共享内存映射写入，无 WPM 调用。成功判据：载荷在目标进程执行且无 WPM 事件。
description.en: Evades the classic WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread detection pair by writing via shared-section mapping with no WPM calls. Success: payload executes in the target with no WPM events.

title.zh: APC 回调变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过直接线程创建告警：挂起态线程配 APC 排队触发执行，无 CreateRemoteThread 特征。成功判据：APC 触发执行成功。
description.en: Evades direct thread-creation alerts by queueing an APC onto a suspended thread, avoiding CreateRemoteThread signatures. Success: the APC fires and executes.

description.zh: 绕过镜像落盘扫描：挂起合法进程后卸载原镜像再注入新节。成功判据：合法进程名下执行注入载荷。
description.en: Evades on-disk image scanning by suspending a legit process, unmapping its image, and injecting a fresh section. Success: the injected payload runs under a legitimate process name.

title.zh: 建立进程注入能力安全预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 进程注入能力安全预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条进程注入能力安全预检验证命令
title.en: Run One Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 进程注入能力安全预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

attackChain.payload:
# 进程镂空 API 序列（按顺序对应 loader 步骤）
# 1. CreateProcess(CREATE_SUSPENDED)
# 2. NtUnmapViewOfSection
# 3. VirtualAllocEx
# 4. WriteProcessMemory
# 5. ResumeThread

title.zh: 关联进程注入能力安全预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 保存签名状态、策略命中、进程路径、父子关系、令牌和审计事件，区分合法系统组件调用与未授权代码执行。
description.en: Preserve signature status, policy decisions, process paths, parent-child relationships, tokens, and audit events to distinguish legitimate system-component use from unauthorized code execution.

title.zh: 修复并回归进程注入能力安全预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight

description.zh: 完成 进程注入能力安全预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检覆盖跨进程代码执行场景：针对已获得终端执行上下文的测试主体，验证经典 DLL 注入、进程镂空与 APC 注入三条链路的可行性与遥测可见性。验证维度涵盖跨进程写入链、挂起进程映像替换与异步过程调用劫持。
overview.en: Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight covers cross-process code execution: for a test principal holding an execution context on the endpoint, verify the feasibility and telemetry visibility of classic DLL injection, process hollowing, and APC injection. Verification dimensions span the cross-process write chain, suspended-process image replacement, and asynchronous procedure call hijacking.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许持有足够句柄权限的进程对其他进程执行 VirtualAllocEx+WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread；镂空与 APC 变体进一步让恶意代码借用合法进程映像运行，检测必须依赖跨进程访问与映像一致性告警。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process with sufficient handle rights run VirtualAllocEx+WriteProcessMemory+CreateRemoteThread against other processes; hollowing and APC variants further let malicious code run under a legitimate process image, so detection must rely on cross-process access and image-consistency alerts.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步对 notepad 执行经典 DLL 注入链（OpenProcess→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→CreateRemoteThread），目标模块列表出现注入 DLL 即确认成功；第 2 步按 CREATE_SUSPENDED→NtUnmapViewOfSection→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→ResumeThread 顺序完成镂空，挂起进程映像被替换并恢复执行即确认；第 3 步用 QueueUserAPC 把 LoadLibraryA 挂入目标线程，线程唤醒后加载 DLL 即确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs the classic DLL injection chain against notepad (OpenProcess→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→CreateRemoteThread) — the injected DLL appearing in the target's module list confirms success; step 2 completes hollowing in the CREATE_SUSPENDED→NtUnmapViewOfSection→VirtualAllocEx→WriteProcessMemory→ResumeThread order — the suspended process image replaced and resumed confirms; step 3 queues LoadLibraryA into the target thread with QueueUserAPC — DLL load on wake confirms. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用进程访问审计与 EDR 跨进程注入检测，按路径和发布者收紧 AppLocker/WDAC 规则并限制 SeDebugPrivilege 分配；对跨进程写内存与远程线程创建实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，注入应被阻断或产生高置信告警。
mitigation.en: Enable process-access auditing and EDR cross-process injection detections, tighten AppLocker/WDAC rules by path and publisher, and restrict SeDebugPrivilege assignments; alert in real time on cross-process memory writes and remote thread creation. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: injection must be blocked or raise a high-confidence alert.

description.zh: 绕过对 /owa 精确路径的 WAF 拦截与 vhost 限制：大小写、点段、登录子路径与 url 参数回跳在 Exchange 规范化后命中同一 OWA 前端；成功判据：任一变形返回 200/302 登录页（而非 403/WAF 拦截页），即可继续邮箱访问链。
description.en: Bypasses WAF blocks and vhost limits on the exact /owa path: case, dot segments, the logon subpath and url-parameter bounce normalize to the same OWA front end; success criterion: any variant returns the 200/302 logon page (not a 403/WAF block), keeping the mailbox access chain viable.

description.zh: 绕过对 /ews/Exchange.asmx 认证端点做字面监控的防护：NTLM 直连换大小写、尾斜杠、点段与 %3F 截断仍到达同一 EWS 终结点完成协商；成功判据：变形路径返回 200（WSDL/服务响应）且 NTLM 三次握手完成。
description.en: Bypasses literal-path monitoring of the /ews/Exchange.asmx auth endpoint: NTLM direct access with case change, trailing slash, dot segments and %3F truncation reaches the same endpoint and completes negotiation; success criterion: variants return 200 (WSDL/service response) after the NTLM handshake.

description.zh: 绕过只对 /owa 与 /ews 两个入口布防的访问控制：同一凭据改走 MAPI/HTTP、ActiveSync 与 Autodiscover.xml 三个备用协议端点验证邮箱可达性；成功判据：任一端点用 {LAB_USER} 凭据返回 200/207，证明邮箱边界在备用端点未收敛。
description.en: Bypasses access controls deployed only on the /owa and /ews entries: the same credentials probe the MAPI/HTTP, ActiveSync and Autodiscover.xml alternate protocol endpoints for mailbox reachability; success criterion: any endpoint returning 200/207 with {LAB_USER} credentials proves the mailbox boundary is not enforced on alternates.

overview.zh: Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检覆盖邮箱数据访问场景：针对持有实验账号凭据的测试主体，验证账号可触达的邮箱范围与导出能力。验证维度涵盖 OWA 端点探测、exchanger 登录列目录、执行链路标记与 PST 导出四类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight covers mailbox data access: for a test principal holding lab account credentials, verify the reachable mailbox scope and export capability. Verification dimensions cover OWA endpoint probing, exchanger login with folder listing, execution-chain marking, and PST export.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是邮箱角色与委派授权配置过宽或遗留认证未禁用时，单个实验账号即可读取超出其业务边界的邮箱数据；New-MailboxExportRequest 还允许把整个邮箱导出为 PST 落到任意 UNC 路径，形成批量数据外带通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad mailbox roles and delegation grants, or legacy authentication left enabled, letting a single lab account read mailboxes beyond its business boundary; New-MailboxExportRequest additionally exports entire mailboxes to arbitrary UNC paths as PST, creating a bulk exfiltration channel.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步访问 /owa 确认端点可用（返回登录页）；第 2 步用 exchanger.py 以实验账号登录并列出邮箱文件夹，确认可读范围；第 3 步用带尾斜杠的 /owa/ 路径复测并读取控制台输出的状态码（200/302 即链路贯通）；第 4 步用 New-MailboxExportRequest 把实验邮箱导出为 PST 到操作主机共享，导出完成且 PST 落盘即确认数据外带能力。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 accesses /owa to confirm the endpoint (a login page returns); step 2 logs in with exchanger.py as the lab account and lists mailbox folders to confirm the readable scope; step 3 emits a marker string to verify the execution chain; step 4 exports the lab mailbox with New-MailboxExportRequest to the operator share — completed export with PST on disk confirms exfiltration capability. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按最小权限收紧邮箱与角色委派授权，禁用遗留认证，限制 New-MailboxExportRequest 等管理 cmdlet 的使用主体并保留审计；对跨邮箱读取与导出请求告警。修复后用第 2、4 步样例回归，越界读取与导出应被拒绝并留审计。
mitigation.en: Tighten mailbox and role delegation grants per least privilege, disable legacy authentication, restrict principals for cmdlets such as New-MailboxExportRequest with auditing retained, and alert on cross-mailbox reads and exports. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 4 samples: out-of-bound reads and exports must be denied with audit records.

analysis.zh: 阳性：仅凭序列规律即可预测出的未公开码被未授权账户成功兑换；绑定用户的码可跨用户转移核销；已用码可重复核销；并发请求在优惠账本中产生多于一条入账记录。假阳性：码格式看似连续但实际随机不可预测；错误信息仅泄露码存在性但无法兑换；购物车显示折扣但结算时按原价重算；重复请求看似成功但账本仅落一条记录（重复请求全部失败则直接判阴性）。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an unpublished code independently predicted from the sequence and redeemed by an unauthorized account, a bound code transferred across users, a used code replayed, or concurrent requests producing more than one ledger benefit. Sequential appearance, existence-leaking errors, a cart-only discount corrected at checkout, all duplicate requests failing, or a single final ledger entry is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次产生一笔未授权或重复的无价值优惠账本记录后停止，不批量猜码或创建真实订单。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first unauthorized or duplicate valueless benefit ledger entry; do not guess codes in bulk or create real orders.

opsecTips.zh: 冲正测试优惠，删除订单、账户和全部合成码，清除幂等缓存并恢复原子单次兑换约束。
opsecTips.en: Reverse test benefits, delete orders, accounts, and all synthetic codes, clear idempotency caches, and restore atomic single-redemption constraints.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于优惠码按可预测规律生成而核销缺少用户绑定与频率控制：批量提交规律候选即可命中有效码，权益被无成本套取且事后难以追责。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is codes generated on predictable patterns with redemption lacking user binding and rate controls: batch-submitting patterned candidates hits valid codes, extracting entitlements cost-free with little traceability.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把规律命名的码本候选逐条提交核销端点，记录接受结果与响应差异：任一候选被成功核销即确认可枚举，统计命中率并核对权益入账以评估影响。成功判据以核销成功记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅对测试账号核销并事后回滚。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit patterned codebook candidates to the redemption endpoint one by one per the script, recording acceptances and response differences; any candidate redeeming confirms enumerability, with hit rates tallied and entitlement postings checked for impact. Judge success by successful-redemption records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; redeem only on test accounts and roll back afterwards.

mitigation.zh: 优惠码改用 CSPRNG 生成并与用户或订单绑定，核销接口限频且失败计数锁定，权益发放走异步对账。修复后重放第 1 步，候选命中应为零且批量请求被限流。
mitigation.en: Generate codes with a CSPRNG bound to users or orders, rate-limit redemption with lockouts on failures, and post entitlements through asynchronous reconciliation. After the fix, replay step 1: candidate hits should be zero with batches throttled.
